chapters.title: Chapter 3801: Boldness
paragraphs: However, who knew where Tang Yan was? He couldn’t just abandon him and go back by himself, right?
Yes, that was why he had to find Tang Yan first.

With the existence of the Galaxy Network, the news that they had yet to achieve victory and suffered a head-on attack had already spread back to the Imperial Capital. Under such circumstances, if they were still commanded to continue charging towards Golden Wealth Planet, Meng Yonghua would really be an idiot.
Now, he would be a hero if he could return alive.
A second thought flashed through Ling Han’s head. Now, everyone was thinking of fleeing back to the Moonlight Planet. Then, could he do the opposite and go to Golden Wealth Planet?
That was a resource planet. Usually, it would be heavily guarded by the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, but now... he might be able to make a small fortune.
All of a sudden, Ling Han was filled with anticipation.
En, en, en. He had best find Tang Yan first.
“Contact Tang Yan and ask him where he is,” Ling Han said to the large black dog.
“F*cking gay,” the large black dog said in disdain. At the same time, he connected to Galaxy Network and contacted Tang Yan.
“What, that guy is on Golden Wealth Planet?” After Ling Han heard the large black dog’s retelling, he couldn’t help but feel surprised.

As it turned out, this guy was on the only warship that had reached Golden Wealth Planet, but very unfortunately, the moment they landed, they were attacked by the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire. Fortunately, they had three Spirit Transformation True Lords on board, who just barely blocked the attack, gaining time for Tang Yan and the others to retreat.
However, everyone was separated now, scattered and hiding in the tall mountains and dense forests, waiting for rescue.

Tang Yan even specially instructed Ling Han to stay where he was. Practically all the troops of the expedition army this time round had been wiped out, and the news had already been reported. Not only was Meng Yonghua furious, even that old Venerate Tier was furious. It was said that he might personally charge over.
If the Venerate Tier at the fourth pinnacle level charged over, all the elites of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire that were present would be a piece of cake.

Because the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire didn’t have a Venerate Tier elite on standby, and the reason they dared to launch an invasion was because the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire’s old Venerate Tier was severely wounded, and thought that his battle prowess had already fallen from the Venerate Tier.

That’s right. This old Venerate Tier elite was indeed severely injured, and indeed did not want to make a move, but the Shadow Moon Empire Majestic Empire had gone too far this time. Not only had they occupied Golden Wealth Planet, they had also practically wiped out the entire expeditionary army. If the old Venerate Tier elite still did not make a resolute move to redeem the situation, then the empire of the Meng Clan would really be done for.

-There were too few elites at the level of Sect Master in the Meng Clan. There was only Meng Yonghua. Once the old Venerate Tier elite was gone, the Meng Clan would be worth nothing. Thus, the Venerate Tier elite from the Meng Clan definitely had to act this time. He had to let everyone know that he still existed in the Meng Clan, and that no one would be able to bully them!
Ling Han decided to go to Golden Wealth Planet. If he went to fish in troubled waters now, he should be able to gain a lot.
The problem was, how were they supposed to get there?

If they flew on a Tool, with so many people from the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire here, the moment they left, they would expose themselves. In this boundless galaxy, how could a Cauldron Forging Tier possibly outrun a warship?
He had it.
Ling Han looked at the warship at the foot of the mountain. Once he boarded it, wouldn’t he be able to hitchhike?
He grabbed the large black dog and the perverted pig. Under the cover of the Void Beast hide, he approached the warship.
When he arrived at the warship, he leaped onto the ship.

Xiu, a figure suddenly leaped out of the ship’s hold, and stood on the deck, a puzzled expression on his face, because he sensed that someone had leaped onto the deck, and the main troops had already been sent out. Those that could board at this time... must be people from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire.
However, there was actually no one on the deck, which naturally made him feel that it was strange.
Could it be that it was a misconception?

Ling Han gritted his teeth internally. This person was very strong, and he couldn’t see through the depths of his cultivation level at all. He reckoned that he was a True Self Tier elite, because if it was any higher, a Spirit Transformation True Lord would be able to see through the disguise of the Void Beast hide with a single glance.
The True Self Tier elite was truly powerful. With a single leap, he had actually alerted the other man.
“Lord Sun, what have you discovered?” Another thirteen elites walked out. This time, Ling Han could see clearly. They were all in the cultivation level of the Core Formation Tier.
The True Self Tier elite pondered for a moment before waving his hand and saying, “It’s fine.”
After saying this, he turned around and entered the ship’s hold. The 13 Core Formation Tier cultivators hurriedly followed him in.
Ling Han waited patiently, and only when a team returned did he follow behind these people and sneak into the ship’s hold.
With so many people, even the True Self Tier elite wouldn’t be able to sense anything strange.

About a day passed, and all the teams that had been sent out had returned. In the meantime, those Core Formation Tier cultivators had also left one after another. The search team should have encountered troublesome enemies, and needed these Core Formation Tier cultivators to
move out.

Because the moon was only so big, and most importantly, there was no place to hide. In just a day, the search team had completed their mission. The warship slowly set sail, flying towards Golden Wealth Planet.
Very soon, the warship landed, and everyone disembarked, one after another.
Ling Han waited for a very long time before moving. He was very careful. Who knew if there were elites standing guard outside? He didn’t even dare to release his divine sense.
Of course, if he really encountered a powerful enemy, worse come to worst, he could just summon the Heavenly Dao Flames. This was something that could burn even Venerate Tier
elites to death.
However, as the saying goes, the enemy of an enemy is a friend. Unless absolutely necessary, he did not want to make a move on the people of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire.
He disembarked from the warship, and observed carefully. He saw that this was a very large base, with tents erected everywhere.

If Ling Han were a loyal subject of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, he would definitely try to find the main tent and find an opportunity to investigate the military intelligence. Unfortunately, he wasn’t. Moreover, even if he ran over, what if he encountered a Spirit Transformation True Lord, or even a great Sect Master elite?
The hide of the Void Beast wasn’t safe at all.
Thus, Ling Han’s only thought was to run away and roam around the mines to earn some extra money. There were some precious metals that the Meng Clan couldn’t possibly sell, and they
couldn’t be bought even with money.
Yi?
After walking for a while, he discovered that there was a large expanse of empty land on his left side, and there were tents all around him.
Was this a training ground?
Ling Han grumbled internally, but immediately discovered that something was off, because
he discovered that the heaven and earth of this place had actually changed. Furthermore, it
was not just by a little bit, but was astonishingly huge.
This was a formation?
Ling Han activated his eye technique, and when he looked over again, he discovered even
more things.
Underneath this empty land, there were multiple black iron stakes buried, and in the centre,
there was a spear.
“Ah!” Ling Han humphed lightly, tears of blood already streaming from his eyes.

“Little Han!” The large black dog was shocked. They were clearly still wrapped in the Void Beast hide, and there was no sign that they had been exposed. Why had Ling Han’s eyes suddenly bled? Which supreme elite had made this move? But when a supreme elite made a move, would Ling Han only shed tears of blood?
“It’s fine.” Ling Han shook his head, but his heart throbbed greatly. That was because that spear was too terrifying. Merely a single look was enough to make his eyes bleed.
What level of precious tool was this?
More importantly, it was still inside the formation... was the formation used to suppress its
viciousness, or was it strengthening it?
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head, and he suddenly recalled the old Venerate Tier elite
from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire.
Hiss!

chapters.title: Chapter 3802: Killing Trap?
paragraphs: The Shadow Moon Majestic Empire dared to launch a large-scale invasion, so they definitely wouldn’t have failed to realize that the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire still had an old
Venerate Tier elite. Thus, could this spear be used to target that old Venerate Tier?
Ling Han thought about the whole matter, and suddenly had a feeling that this was a trap set up against the old Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan.

Under normal circumstances, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire wouldn’t be able to provoke the Venerate Tier elite into action, and if they directly charged toward the Moonlight Planet, that was the Meng Clan’s home ground.
But now, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire could easily set up arrangements on Golden Wealth Planet. On the other hand, the old Venerate from the Meng Clan had become an away
team.
Ling Han didn’t know what level of weapon that spear was. He only guessed that it might be able to kill Venerate Tier elites.

And there was also this formation. Though it had not been completely set up, from the distortion of the great power of heaven and earth, this was definitely no ordinary formation. Whether it was or not, only one point was needed to prove it.
Ling Han circled the surroundings for a short while, and soon found the Transfer Formation.
As expected.

He nodded internally. If that old Venerate Tier elite from the Meng Clan had charged over, he would definitely have come directly from the Transference Portal. With his strength, he was naturally unafraid of being ganged up on by Sect Master great elites, but if he had just appeared, and the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire activated the great formation and delivered a fatal blow with their supreme Spirit Tool?
The elite of an era could possibly be annihilated just like that.
However, what did this have to do with him?

Ling Han had absolutely no intention of sending the news back. The old Venerate Tier elite of the Meng Clan should be the one who had seized the throne of the Jin Clan, and had even suppressed Brother Monkey for more than two thousand years, and Ling Han was supposed to save this old b@stard?
What a joke.

If he died, he deserved it. He was considered lucky not to have died, but when Brother Monkey advanced into Venerate Tier and returned, the old b@stard would still be unable to flee death. Ling Han quietly left the camp. This was the main camp of the invasion of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire. There were too many elites gathered here, so it was too dangerous for him to stay here.

He had already made contact with Tang Yan, and knew where he was hiding. He travelled cautiously and slowly all the way, and only after he had left that base far behind did Ling Han fly on his Tool, and set out at full speed.
Xiu!
After flying for ten minutes, a cold light suddenly shot over from the ground, slashing towards Ling Han.
Ling Han turned around, dodging this cold light. However, xiu, xiu, xiu! Another cold light slashed out, intertwining to form a net.
Ling Han activated the Starlight Screen and blocked all of the attacks.
Immediately afterward, seven cultivators flew over from the ground on their Spirit Tools, each wielding a weapon.
“Surviving dregs, surrender yourself!” one of them shouted.

These were the soldiers of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire, but they were definitely not ordinary-level soldiers. Instead, they were elites of the Foundation Building Tier and the Cauldron Forging Tier – if any force could mobilize an army that was completely made up of Foundation Building Tiers, that would really be inconceivably powerful.
Even though there were billions of Foundation Building Tiers in the entire universe, on average, tens of thousands of Foundation Building Tiers was already a very large number for every planet.
Ling Han swept an eye over them, and said, “Move aside. I don’t want to kill anyone.”
“Hahahaha!” The seven people on the other side all laughed loudly.
Was this not hilarious? A mere fish that had slipped through the net actually dared to speak such conceited nonsense. He was really unbelievably stupid.
“He must be the young master of some so-called noble clan.”
“Kill him, kill him, I hate this kind of second-generation young master the most.”

Someone was the first to charge out. With a sweep of the sword, shua, Sword Qi was several kilometers long, entwined with high-level azure energy, covered densely with seals, as if even a high mountain could be sliced open with a single strike.
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. He didn’t want to wound anyone, yet this attack was a deadly one. This made him extremely displeased.
“Humph!” He shot out a punch, very simple and down-to-earth.

However, the great dao was extremely simple. This punch shattered the Sword Qi, and the remaining power did not diminish. It was still rolling towards that person. Peng, the punch landed, and that person fell down from the skies.
“What!”
The remaining six people were all greatly shocked. How could this “second-generation young master” be so powerful? The might of a single punch had reached this level?
“This brat is powerful.”
“Don’t underestimate him in any way.”
“Die!”
A good few of them were exuding light from their bodies. That was because they were wearing armour. Once they were activated, multiple veined patterns lit up, looking very
majestic.
Obviously, there was also a very large gap between the wealth of these six people. Two of them did not have any armor, and seemed a little shabby.
After activating their armor, they naturally became even more courageous. They started to attack Ling Han again.
The six of them joined forces, and they were all at the Cauldron Forging Tier. Their might was extremely terrifying.
With a thought from Ling Han, a barrage of murderous aura immediately shot over, causing the six people to stagnate, and they all fell from the skies.

Five people directly fell onto the ground, and only one person’s divine sense was tenacious. After descending two thirds of the distance, he recovered, and once again flew on his Tool, saving him from the danger of a fall.

So what if they were Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators? Those six people had all broken bones from the fall, and this was still thanks to the fact that they were Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators. Otherwise, it was possible that they would have been directly smashed into mush. The remaining person was so scared that he flew to an extremely far place, his face still filled
with fear.
This was too terrifying. How could there be such a terrifying guy?
Ling Han didn’t give chase. Instead, he turned around and flew on his divine tool. Xiu! He
quickly disappeared into the horizon.
On the way, he had been sniped several times, but the strongest was only Cauldron Forging
Tier. This naturally could not possibly stop him.
Half a day later, Ling Han finally arrived at a dense forest.
This was the Giant Deer Forest, and Tang Yan was hiding inside.
The large black dog handed over Tang Yan’s latest coordinates, and Ling Han headed in that
direction.
After walking for another half an hour, he arrived at a small valley. The valley was very hidden, and was blocked by rocks. If he didn’t search carefully, it would really be difficult to
discover it.
With Tang Yan’s reminder, Ling Han naturally found the entrance very quickly, and strode in.
Shua!
He had just entered into the valley, when he saw a cold light slash over. It was incredibly fast, and extremely sharp.
“Stop!” someone shouted. However, it was already too late.
Ling Han raised his fist and shot out a punch. Ding, this ray of light immediately crumbled.
He was merely a Foundation Building cultivator, and he could easily suppress him with a casual raise of his hand.
“Haha, it’s actually you!” Amidst long laughter, a young man in embroidered robes walked over. It was as if he was surrounded by stars, and there were five people following behind him.
He was filled with arrogance.
Yi, Meng Yangcheng.
Ling Han was astonished. This world was far too small! He had actually come across Meng
Yangcheng here!
“Yi, Your Imperial Highness recognizes Ling Han?” Tang Yan also walked out. Previously, it was he who had shouted “stop” loudly.
“Of course.” Meng Yangcheng stared at Ling Han with a piercing killing intent in his eyes.

Previously, he had already found the ruins of the Buddhist Race’s inheritance. In the end, he had actually been forced to flee in panic by Ling Han. Not only had he failed to obtain the inheritance of the Buddhist Race, he had even lost a considerable number of his subordinates. “Old Cai, apprehend him!” he turned around and said to a subordinate behind him.
“Yes, Your Imperial Highness.” A middle-aged man immediately stepped out.
At first, he had curbed his aura, and was as careful as a servant, but now that his aura had
spread out, he instantly exuded an astonishing pressure.
This was a Cauldron Forging Tier elite.
-In Meng Yangcheng’s eyes, Ling Han was naturally only a Foundation Building Tier. Then,
even if you are the strongest Foundation Building Tier, how could you possibly match a Cauldron Forging Tier?

Those six people had all broken bones from the fall, and this was still thanks to the fact that they were Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators.
Otherwise, it was possible that they would have been directly smashed into mush.
The remaining person was so scared that he flew to an extremely far place, his face still filled
with fear.
This was too terrifying.
How could there be such a terrifying guy?
Ling Han didn’t give chase.
Instead, he turned around and flew on his divine tool.
Xiu!
He
quickly disappeared into the horizon.
On the way, he had been sniped several times, but the strongest was only Cauldron Forging
Tier.
This naturally could not possibly stop him.
Half a day later, Ling Han finally arrived at a dense forest.
This was the Giant Deer Forest, and Tang Yan was hiding inside.
The large black dog handed over Tang Yan’s latest coordinates, and Ling Han headed in that
direction.
After walking for another half an hour, he arrived at a small valley.
The valley was very hidden, and was blocked by rocks.
If he didn’t search carefully, it would really be difficult to
discover it.
With Tang Yan’s reminder, Ling Han naturally found the entrance very quickly, and strode in.
Shua!
He had just entered into the valley, when he saw a cold light slash over.
It was incredibly fast, and extremely sharp.
“Stop!” someone shouted.
However, it was already too late.
Ling Han raised his fist and shot out a punch.
Ding, this ray of light immediately crumbled.
He was merely a Foundation Building cultivator, and he could easily suppress him with a casual raise of his hand.
“Haha, it’s actually you!” Amidst long laughter, a young man in embroidered robes walked over.
It was as if he was surrounded by stars, and there were five people following behind him.
He was filled with arrogance.
Yi, Meng Yangcheng.
Ling Han was astonished.
This world was far too small!
He had actually come across Meng
Yangcheng here!
“Yi, Your Imperial Highness recognizes Ling Han?” Tang Yan also walked out.
Previously, it was he who had shouted “stop” loudly.
“Of course.” Meng Yangcheng stared at Ling Han with a piercing killing intent in his eyes.
Previously, he had already found the ruins of the Buddhist Race’s inheritance.
In the end, he had actually been forced to flee in panic by Ling Han.
Not only had he failed to obtain the inheritance of the Buddhist Race, he had even lost a considerable number of his subordinates.
“Old Cai, apprehend him!” he turned around and said to a subordinate behind him.
“Yes, Your Imperial Highness.” A middle-aged man immediately stepped out.
At first, he had curbed his aura, and was as careful as a servant, but now that his aura had
spread out, he instantly exuded an astonishing pressure.
This was a Cauldron Forging Tier elite.
-In Meng Yangcheng’s eyes, Ling Han was naturally only a Foundation Building Tier.
Then,
even if you are the strongest Foundation Building Tier, how could you possibly match a Cauldron Forging Tier?

chapters.title: Chapter 3803: You are the slave, and I am the master
paragraphs: “Your Imperial Highness!” Tang Yan hurriedly stepped out to block him, spreading out his arms, “Ling Han is my friend. Is there some kind of misunderstanding between the two of you?”
“Your friend?” Meng Yangcheng’s eyes sharpened, and he couldn’t help but feel suspicious.
Previously, when Ling Han had snatched his fated opportunity, could it be that it had been commanded by Tang Yan?

Otherwise, how could a minor character that he had never heard of dare to oppose him? Furthermore, aside from a clan with a powerful background like the Tang Clan, how could they possibly find the historical site of the Buddhist Race?
“Tang Yan, how dare you make an enemy of the Imperial Family!” he said balefully.
Tang Yan was at a loss, “Your Imperial Highness, what is the meaning of this?”
“What is the meaning of this?” Meng Yangcheng sneered and waved his hand. “Take them all down!”
So what if he was a junior marquis? As long as he dared to oppose the Meng Clan, all of them would only be cannon fodder.
Ling Han shook his head with a smile, saying, “Tang Yan, this has nothing to do with you. Let me deal with it.”

Tang Yan really didn’t want to give up. It wasn’t that he didn’t believe in Ling Han’s strength, but it was precisely because he knew how strong Ling Han was that he wanted to stop him. Otherwise, once they got into a fight, Ling Han would definitely get into trouble. When the old Venerate Tier arrived, Meng Yangcheng would make a complaint, and what would happen then?
However, Ling Han gave him a light shove, so Tang Yan could only step aside.

That “Old Cai” took another step forwards, and as he walked, he released his own powerful aura. It was obvious that he wanted to use his Cauldron Forging Tier cultivation level to forcefully suppress Ling Han.
There were nine levels in Celestial Path, and there was a massive gap between each minor level of Celestial Path, what more when it was a major tier of Celestial Path.
I am superior to you in terms of level of being, crushing you. Who cares if you submit or not? Your only option would be to kneel.
Of course, he had miscalculated. To say nothing of suppressing Ling Han, as long as Ling Han summoned the Celestial Cauldron, he would only be trembling on his knees.
“Meng Yangcheng, are you seeking death?” Ling Han asked calmly.
Meng Yangcheng sneered, “Ignorance! Old Cai, what are you standing around for?”
Old Cai was slightly surprised. He had clearly released the unique aura of the Cauldron Forging Tier to suppress Ling Han, so why was Ling Han completely unresponsive?
However, with Meng Yangcheng’s urging, he didn’t have the time to investigate further. He immediately leaped forward and grabbed at Ling Han.
Peng!

He had just leaped over, when he saw Ling Han shoot out a kick. Old Cai was sent flying backwards at an even faster speed, and crashed heavily into the mountain rock. Ka, ka, ka! With him as the centre, the mountain wall was covered densely with fine cracks, and then shattered with a bang. His whole person had sunk in, about two feet deep.
Then, he leaned forward and fell to the ground, leaving behind a huge spherical groove behind him. There was a pool of blood in the center.
Upon seeing this, Meng Yangcheng and the others all wore expressions of disbelief.
This was actually a Foundation Building cultivator?
Absolutely impossible!
Meng Yangcheng stared at Ling Han for a while before saying with a sneer, “So you’ve advanced to the Cauldron Forging Tier!”
This explained Ling Han’s strength, but it was still shocking, because only a few months had passed, and Ling Han had already completed a leap of a major tier. This was inconceivable.
Ling Han remained silent and simply crooked a finger at Meng Yangcheng. This time, he wouldn’t give him another chance to escape.
“Old Chen, Old Yun, you guys attack together!” Meng Yangcheng said calmly.

So what if he defeated Old Cai? That was only the weakest Cauldron Forging Tier by his side, but Old Chen and Old Yun were both Earth Cauldrons. With the two of them working together, and added with the advantage of a minor cultivation level, how could it be that they would not be able to take down a Human Cauldron?
“Yes, Your Imperial Highness!”

Another two middle-aged men walked out. They were Meng Yangcheng’s true “wealth”. After all, Meng Yangcheng himself was only a Cauldron Forging Tier. His cultivation level wasn’t high enough, and the resources in his hands weren’t enough either. It was impossible for a Core Formation Tier elite to join him.
The two of them flanked Ling Han, one on the left and one on the right.
“Die!” The two of them attacked at the same time. One brandished a flaming saber, while the other wielded a lightning sword. High-level energy surged, and the surrounding mountain rocks crumbled.
Ling Han’s figure flashed. Xiu, he was as fast as lightning. He first kicked Old Chen away, then raised his foot and kicked Old Yun away as well.
Peng! Peng!
The two of them crashed into the groove that Old Cai had created previously, one after another, enlarging this groove quite a few times, and also a few feet deeper.
They collapsed onto Old Cai, one after another. The three men were stacked on top of one another, and no matter how one looked at it, it looked a little vulgar.
However, no one paid attention to Old Cai and the others. They were all looking at Ling Han in
shock.
“How is this possible!” Meng Yangcheng gritted his teeth. Why was there such a powerful Human Cauldron?
Could it be that Ling Han was invincible in Foundation Building Tier, and could also be like this in Cauldron Forging Tier?

Meng Yangcheng was filled with regret. If he had known that Ling Han was so powerful, he wouldn’t have sent Old Cai and the others up one by one. Instead, he would have them form a formation and funnel all the power into him. However, now that the three of them had lost consciousness, there were only two left. What was the point of forming a formation?
“Alright, you win!” He chose to temporarily bow his head. As long as his ancestor charged over, he would immediately make a complaint.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. “Meng Yangcheng, are you a three-year- old child? How can you be so childish? Do you think that I’ll let you go with just a single
word?”

“No matter what, we have to a$$-r@pe him!” the large black dog, the entity, interjected from the sidelines. He had not spoken for so long, and it was almost suffocating him to death. Ling Han was instantly rendered speechless. He turned around and said to the large black dog, “My aura was so strong just then, and now that you’re saying this, you’ve directly dragged me down to the same level as you. How am I supposed to continue?”
“Woof! Stop pretending, brat! Be careful of being struck by lightning!” The large black dog wore an expression that said, ‘I’ve already seen through you’.
Ling Han turned around and said to Meng Yangcheng, “Sorry, sorry. Where were we just
now?”
“Speaking of a$$-r@pe,” the large black dog continued to interrupt.
“Ling Han, have you had enough!” Meng Yangcheng roared. “You’re a subject, I’m a monarch,
you’re a slave, and I’m the master. If you dare to touch me, that would be treason!”
When these words fell, Tang Yan’s expression changed drastically.
In the eyes of the members of the Meng Clan, were subjects like them slaves?
Meng Yangcheng decided to take a gamble, and said to his two remaining subordinates,
“Attack with me!”
The two of them naturally could only walk the path of darkness with Meng Yangcheng. They
both nodded.
The three of them charged over together. With Meng Yangcheng taking the lead, their might
was considerably shocking.
Meng Yangcheng still had some confidence, because this was different from the battle that
had taken place in the ruins of the Buddhist Race. He had a great many powerful treasures that
he could use, and this was the true power of an imperial heir.
“Go!” he shouted loudly. His forehead split open, and a silver sword flew out, shooting
rapidly towards Ling Han.
Spiritual Power Spirit Tool!
In just an instant, it had accelerated to more than 20 times the speed of sound. There was no sound at all, because its speed had far surpassed the speed of sound.
Ling Han also had his own Spiritual Power Spirit Tool, so he naturally wouldn’t be careless.
He unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and streaks of Primal Chaos Qi descended, forming thousands of Dao Manifestations.
Peng, the silver sword hit, and blasted into the Primal Chaos Qi. Not only did it not manage to penetrate through, it was instead forcibly crushed onto the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 3804: So be it if I kill him
paragraphs: Meng Yangcheng couldn’t imagine this. They were both precious tools, but why was the gap between them so wide?
It should be known that he was controlling a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool!

In a situation when their levels were equal, it was definitely the Spiritual Power Spirit Tool that was stronger. Otherwise, the ingredients for Spiritual Power materials wouldn’t be so expensive, and there would be no lack of buyers.
He had to be seeing things.
Yet Ling Han was slightly disappointed. This was too weak, wasn’t it? It couldn’t even block a flash of Primal Chaos Qi?

If he had known that this would be the extent of its might, he would have directly used his fists to attack. In fact, the Sword of Metal that he had nurtured in his abdomen was not inferior to this either.
“Sigh, I have really overestimated you!” He shook his head.
Peng, peng, peng! The attacks of Meng Yangcheng and the others arrived, yet not one of them managed to penetrate the Primal Chaos Qi.

Ling Han put away the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and said calmly, “Meng Yangcheng, if you want to deal with me, you can do it openly. I would have respected you, but you’re using underhanded methods. Hehe, I look down on you!”

“You found out?” Meng Yangcheng was surprised. He had done this very covertly, and with Ling Han’s identity and status, it should have been impossible for him to discover the tricks he was playing behind the scenes.
-Tang Yan!
He couldn’t help but think that if Tang Yan interfered, he should be able to find out about his existence.
Damn it, he was really too detestable.
Just wait. Once he saw his ancestor, he would definitely kill Ling Han, and Tang Yan, or even the Tang Clan, would not be able to stay out of this either.

“What one does, the heavens will see.” Ling Han shook his head, “You are truly hopeless. Even now, you are still thinking about how to snitch on me. Hehe, I can’t be bothered to waste my breath on you. You had best be on your way.”
His killing intent was on full display.
Meng Yangcheng was astonished, and he shouted, “You dare?!”
Tang Yan was also shocked. Ling Han wanted to kill Meng Yangcheng?
Hiss, this was really outrageously bold.
Once the news leaked out, it would only lead to death. In fact, it could even lead to the execution of his entire clan.
“Ling Han, don’t be rash!” Tang Yan hurriedly said. Regardless of any misunderstandings or enmity between the two of them, he, as a member of the Tang Clan, should still be able to resolve them.
However, once Meng Yangcheng was killed by Ling Han, Ling Han would become the mortal enemy of the Meng Clan.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “The members of the Meng Clan aren’t all that impressive. So be it if I kill them. What’s there to be afraid of?”
“That’s right, a$$-r@pe!” the large black dog shouted from the sidelines.
“Ling Han!” Tang Yan still wanted to persuade him further. This was really an inconceivable matter.
However, Ling Han didn’t give him another chance. With a punch, Meng Yangcheng was killed.
This time, he had no chance to escape.
Tang Yan hesitated slightly, then suddenly moved.
Of course, it was not targeting Ling Han, but rather killing all five of Meng Yang Cheng’s subordinates.
“What happened today never happened,” he said solemnly.
“Resolute!” The large black dog gestured with his paw.
Ling Han also nodded internally. He smiled, and asked, “You won’t blame me for dragging you down with me, right?”
Tang Yan shrugged, “Then what can be done?”
Ling Han patted his shoulder and said, “What would you think if I told you that it’s extremely likely that the Venerate Tier elite from the Meng Clan would be killed?”

“What?!” Tang Yan was astonished. That was a Venerate Tier elite! Just how powerful was he? It had already been close to ten million years since an Ancestral King had appeared in the universe. It could be claimed that Saints were the most powerful beings in battle prowess, but throughout the universe, how many Saints were there?
Thus, the value of Venerate Tier elites was naturally high, especially in this galaxy. They were definitely invincible.

If it weren’t for the fact that they were wary of the Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan, would the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s offensive be so “gentle”? Moreover, if it weren’t for the fact that the Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan was severely wounded, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire wouldn’t dare to mobilize troops at all, all right?
Now, Ling Han said that the Venerate of the Meng Clan could possibly be killed. How could he believe this?

“Just wait and see. I think the reason why the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire suddenly conquered Golden Wealth Planet was to lure the Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan to appear, and then kill him,” Ling Han continued, but didn’t say what he saw.
Tang looked at him solemnly, “Are you sure about that?”
“90%.” Ling Han nodded, but still left a sliver of leeway.

Tang Yan had no choice but to seriously consider this possibility. With the present age gap of the Meng Clan, once the old Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan died, there would be no need for the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire to launch an invasion at all, and the whole Empire would immediately collapse.
This was because the Meng Clan only had a single Sect Master elite. Meanwhile, other Sect Master-level forces had two or even three of such elites.
If that really happened, the Meng Clan would be finished, and such a “small matter” like Ling
Han
killing Meng Yangcheng would naturally not be pursued.
“I have to immediately inform the clan to prepare for any changes,” Tang Yan said seriously.

Ling Han nodded. The Tang Clan was the favorite subject of the Majestic Empire of the Meng Clan, but it was also because of this that once the Meng Clan collapsed, the Tang Clan would also bear the brunt of it, and suffer a huge blow.
Tang Yan sent a message to the clan through the Galaxy Network. As for what preparations the
clan would make, it was out of his reach.
“What do we do now?” he asked Ling Han.

Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, “Let’s change locations and hide for a while. The battle just then might attract pursuers. In the future, we’ll have to see if that Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan can survive this tribulation.”

“I still don’t believe it. The Shadow Moon Majestic Empire actually has the guts to snipe a Venerate Tier elite!” Tang Yan was still a little dazed. “That is a Venerate Tier; just how powerful an existence is that? With a single palm strike, even Sect Master great elites would
die by the dozens.”
Ling Han smiled faintly and did not speak.

“Even if the Old Emperor is heavily injured, and his battle prowess has greatly decreased, a starving camel is still bigger than a horse. Even if he is not as powerful as he was all those years ago, it is definitely not difficult for him to break out of a Sect Master-level siege.” Tang Yan was still analyzing from the sidelines, and the more he thought about it, the more he felt that it was impossible.
“Let’s go. We’ll find out after waiting patiently for a few days.” Ling Han pulled Tang Yan along with him as he ran.
The two of them continued to hide in a different location to avoid their pursuers. However, after half a day, they were just resting with their eyes closed, when they suddenly felt the
world shake.
What was going on?

They came out from their hiding place, and saw light flickering in the distant skies. There was a figure that was indomitable, indescribably tall. His whole body was exuding golden light, like he was an Immortal, but blood was gushing out of his chest. Clearly, he had been severely
injured.

This person was really big, and probably not much smaller than Golden Wealth Planet. Around him, there were a great many smaller people that were ganging up on him. Spirit Tools of all shapes and sizes showed their might, and every one of them seemed capable of destroying the heavens and earth.
Ling Han and Tang Yan were both smart people, and immediately guessed that the incredibly tall figure was the old Venerate of the Meng Clan, Ling Han. He was presently being ganged up
on by the people of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire.
“The situation is far from good!” Tang Yan said with a frown. From his standpoint, he
naturally didn’t want the Meng Clan to fall.
But looking at how the old Venerate from the Meng Clan looked, he was obviously heavily injured again, and was in an extremely dangerous situation.
Meanwhile, Ling Han knew that the moment the old Venerate Tier elite from the Meng Clan
left the Transfer Formation, he must have suffered a head-on blow from that vicious spear. He must have also been hit, and that was why he was bleeding endlessly.
The problem now was, would this Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan be able to carve a path of blood out of this trap?

Even now, you are still thinking about how to snitch on me.
Hehe, I can’t be bothered to waste my breath on you.
You had best be on your way.”
His killing intent was on full display.
Meng Yangcheng was astonished, and he shouted, “You dare?!”
Tang Yan was also shocked.
Ling Han wanted to kill Meng Yangcheng?
Hiss, this was really outrageously bold.
Once the news leaked out, it would only lead to death.
In fact, it could even lead to the execution of his entire clan.
“Ling Han, don’t be rash!” Tang Yan hurriedly said.
Regardless of any misunderstandings or enmity between the two of them, he, as a member of the Tang Clan, should still be able to resolve them.
However, once Meng Yangcheng was killed by Ling Han, Ling Han would become the mortal enemy of the Meng Clan.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “The members of the Meng Clan aren’t all that impressive.
So be it if I kill them.
What’s there to be afraid of?”
“That’s right, a$$-r@pe!” the large black dog shouted from the sidelines.
“Ling Han!” Tang Yan still wanted to persuade him further.
This was really an inconceivable matter.
However, Ling Han didn’t give him another chance.
With a punch, Meng Yangcheng was killed.
This time, he had no chance to escape.
Tang Yan hesitated slightly, then suddenly moved.
Of course, it was not targeting Ling Han, but rather killing all five of Meng Yang Cheng’s subordinates.
“What happened today never happened,” he said solemnly.
“Resolute!” The large black dog gestured with his paw.
Ling Han also nodded internally.
He smiled, and asked, “You won’t blame me for dragging you down with me, right?”
Tang Yan shrugged, “Then what can be done?”
Ling Han patted his shoulder and said, “What would you think if I told you that it’s extremely likely that the Venerate Tier elite from the Meng Clan would be killed?”
“What?!” Tang Yan was astonished.
That was a Venerate Tier elite!
Just how powerful was he?
It had already been close to ten million years since an Ancestral King had appeared in the universe.
It could be claimed that Saints were the most powerful beings in battle prowess, but throughout the universe, how many Saints were there?
Thus, the value of Venerate Tier elites was naturally high, especially in this galaxy.
They were definitely invincible.
If it weren’t for the fact that they were wary of the Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan, would the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire’s offensive be so “gentle”?
Moreover, if it weren’t for the fact that the Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan was severely wounded, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire wouldn’t dare to mobilize troops at all, all right?
Now, Ling Han said that the Venerate of the Meng Clan could possibly be killed.
How could he believe this?
“Just wait and see.

I think the reason why the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire suddenly conquered Golden Wealth Planet was to lure the Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan to appear, and then kill him,” Ling Han continued, but didn’t say what he saw.
Tang looked at him solemnly, “Are you sure about that?”
“90%.” Ling Han nodded, but still left a sliver of leeway.
Tang Yan had no choice but to seriously consider this possibility.

With the present age gap of the Meng Clan, once the old Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan died, there would be no need for the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire to launch an invasion at all, and the whole Empire would immediately collapse.
This was because the Meng Clan only had a single Sect Master elite.
Meanwhile, other Sect Master-level forces had two or even three of such elites.
If that really happened, the Meng Clan would be finished, and such a “small matter” like Ling
Han
killing Meng Yangcheng would naturally not be pursued.
“I have to immediately inform the clan to prepare for any changes,” Tang Yan said seriously.
Ling Han nodded.

The Tang Clan was the favorite subject of the Majestic Empire of the Meng Clan, but it was also because of this that once the Meng Clan collapsed, the Tang Clan would also bear the brunt of it, and suffer a huge blow.
Tang Yan sent a message to the clan through the Galaxy Network.
As for what preparations the
clan would make, it was out of his reach.
“What do we do now?” he asked Ling Han.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, “Let’s change locations and hide for a while.
The battle just then might attract pursuers.
In the future, we’ll have to see if that Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan can survive this tribulation.”
“I still don’t believe it.
The Shadow Moon Majestic Empire actually has the guts to snipe a Venerate Tier elite!” Tang Yan was still a little dazed.
“That is a Venerate Tier; just how powerful an existence is that?
With a single palm strike, even Sect Master great elites would
die by the dozens.”
Ling Han smiled faintly and did not speak.
“Even if the Old Emperor is heavily injured, and his battle prowess has greatly decreased, a starving camel is still bigger than a horse.

Even if he is not as powerful as he was all those years ago, it is definitely not difficult for him to break out of a Sect Master-level siege.” Tang Yan was still analyzing from the sidelines, and the more he thought about it, the more he felt that it was impossible.
“Let’s go.
We’ll find out after waiting patiently for a few days.” Ling Han pulled Tang Yan along with him as he ran.
The two of them continued to hide in a different location to avoid their pursuers.
However, after half a day, they were just resting with their eyes closed, when they suddenly felt the
world shake.
What was going on?
They came out from their hiding place, and saw light flickering in the distant skies.
There was a figure that was indomitable, indescribably tall.
His whole body was exuding golden light, like he was an Immortal, but blood was gushing out of his chest.
Clearly, he had been severely
injured.
This person was really big, and probably not much smaller than Golden Wealth Planet.
Around him, there were a great many smaller people that were ganging up on him.
Spirit Tools of all shapes and sizes showed their might, and every one of them seemed capable of destroying the heavens and earth.
Ling Han and Tang Yan were both smart people, and immediately guessed that the incredibly tall figure was the old Venerate of the Meng Clan, Ling Han.
He was presently being ganged up
on by the people of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire.
“The situation is far from good!” Tang Yan said with a frown.
From his standpoint, he
naturally didn’t want the Meng Clan to fall.
But looking at how the old Venerate from the Meng Clan looked, he was obviously heavily injured again, and was in an extremely dangerous situation.
Meanwhile, Ling Han knew that the moment the old Venerate Tier elite from the Meng Clan
left the Transfer Formation, he must have suffered a head-on blow from that vicious spear.
He must have also been hit, and that was why he was bleeding endlessly.
The problem now was, would this Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan be able to carve a path of blood out of this trap?

chapters.title: Chapter 3805: Slaying a Venerate
paragraphs: In the galaxy, bloody battles raged.

Even if a Venerate Tier elite had been severely wounded in the first place, and had been targeted by a sneak attack, and then severely wounded, his abilities were still frighteningly strong. He was like a dying lion, and was still not someone that could be bullied by a few wolves or dogs.
Boom, every punch and palm strike possessed the might to destroy the heavens and earth.

Right now, the Venerate Tier elite of the Meng Clan was as large as a planet. Thus, his power was naturally terrifyingly large. If it weren’t for the fact that he had been blocked by those Sect Master elites, perhaps this planet would have been obliterated in just a few exchanges. It was also because of this that this Venerate was able to struggle on at death’s door.

This was quite ironic. Golden Wealth Planet clearly belonged to the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, but the old Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan actually threatened to destroy this planet, and those elites from the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire were continuously trying to save it, greatly reducing the pressure on him.

Both Ling Han and Tang Yan’s expressions were ugly, because if Golden Wealth Planet was really blown up, putting aside the question of whether they would be able to survive the force of the planet’s explosion, even if they could, they would be floating in the boundless universe, and it was very likely that they would die before they could even reach the next living planet.
From this aspect alone, they also hoped that the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire would win.
“This old b@stard is really willing to do anything just to save his own life!” Tang Yan couldn’t help but curse.

Previously, Meng Yangcheng had called him a servant, and now, seeing the old Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan completely disregarding the subjects of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire that were still on Golden Wealth Planet, he was finally extremely disappointed. -Didn’t they come here to work for the Meng Clan? But how did the Meng Clan treat them? This was bitterly disappointing. This was far too disappointing.

The bloody battle was still ongoing. Though the old Venerate Tier elite from the Meng Clan had temporarily relieved the pressure on him, his injuries were too heavy, after all. The longer the battle dragged on, the worse his situation would be.
He began to retreat.
How could the great elites of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire let him have his way?

Wasn’t the reason why they had gone to so much effort to lay out such a trap just to get rid of this person? Once the old Venerate of the Meng Clan died, the invasion of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire would no longer be obstructed.
These great elites all set off in pursuit, each using their own movement techniques. Their speed was astonishingly fast.
The old Venerate from the Meng Clan tore a rip into space. He wanted to create a wormhole and directly leap through it.

“Meng Jiuyao, your time is over!” a great elite shouted. A golden pestle appeared in his hand, exuding a majestic light that measured millions and millions of meters, which smashed towards the old Venerate from the Meng Clan.
These majestic lights condensed, and actually took the form of a Buddha. One hand was holding a flower, while the other formed a palm, which pressed down on the old Venerate Tier from the Meng Clan.

“The Buddhist Race?” the old Venerate Tier elite from the Meng Clan exclaimed in shock. “No wonder the puny Shadow Moon Majestic Empire dared to violate the law. As it turned out, there’s actually a shadow of the Buddhist Race behind this! Damn it, I couldn’t kill you all in the past, and actually made a comeback!”
“Amitabha Buddha!” the great elite chanted. “The inheritance of Dharma Buddha is in the hearts of the people, not in form. You’re at too much of a disadvantage!”
Boom!

The Buddha’s image shot out by this golden pestle had boundless might, blasting the old Venerate of the Meng Clan into a retreat of tens of thousands of kilometers. The action of tearing open space naturally stopped.
Those great elites charged over once more, and it was as if they were a pack of wolves swallowing a tiger.

The old Venerate from the Meng Clan was fighting with his life on the line. He didn’t want to die here. Boom! A purple aura rose from his body, and he could be seen clearly even from such a far distance.
“Old Geezer Meng is putting his life on the line.”
“Humph, even the great dao Purple Qi is burning. Old geezer Meng has completely given up the idea of becoming a Saint.”
“Continue to exert pressure. As long as we exhaust him of Purple Qi, he will be a dead crab.”
In the eyes of those great elites that were ganging up on him, the old Venerate from the Meng Clan was already at the end of his line.

However, the old Venerate from the Meng Clan was extremely resolute. The reason why he had expended the great dao Purple Qi wasn’t for the sake of putting his life on the line. Instead, he had formed a shield around himself, protecting him so that he could easily tear open a wormhole and take advantage of the opening to crawl in.
“Chase!”

How could those great elites bear to give up? After much difficulty, they had finally forced the old Venerate from the Meng Clan to the point of exhaustion. Hurriedly, they worked together to open that wormhole, and continued their pursuit.

Boom! The devastating shockwaves of energy continued to sweep over the surface of the Golden Wealth Planet. Large amounts of trees were shattered into dust, and some mountains were even flattened. The sea evaporated, transforming into a barren land.

This was truly astounding. Those elites were clearly battling outside the planet, yet just the shockwaves alone possessed such terrifying might. If they were targeted directly at Golden Wealth Planet, even if it was just a single shockwave, would Golden Wealth Planet immediately crumble?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel like he was extremely insignificant, as well as a strong sense of danger.
Without reaching the level of Sect Master, he would only be an ant, after all.
He had to increase his cultivation level as soon as possible. Otherwise, if he came across a conflict between two great elites, he could possibly become cannon fodder.
Half a day later, peace returned to the world.
Ling Han and Tang Yan hurriedly connected to the Galaxy Network and contacted their
families respectively.
Previously, they had not done so, because the energy of heaven and earth was chaotic, and the Galaxy Network couldn’t be connected at all.
Ling Han communicated with the empress and the others. Unexpectedly, they already knew about the Venerable Tier elite from the Meng Clan.

As it turned out, the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire had actually broadcasted this grand event of killing “Venerate Tier” live. On the Galaxy Network, who knew how many people had simultaneously witnessed this scene. Furthermore, the empress and the others knew even
more than Ling Han.

Because after the old Venerate from the Meng Clan tore open the wormhole and left, Ling Han and Tang Yan didn’t see what happened after that. However, the empress and the others could still see clearly through the live broadcast of the Galaxy Network.

...The great elites of the Shadow Moon Empire caught up to the old Venerate from the Meng Clan again, and a fierce battle ensued. The old Venerate from the Meng Clan had no choice but to unleash a forbidden technique, self-destructing his arms and one leg. Only then did he finally break out of the siege and escape with his life.

However, after this battle, the old Venerate Tier elite from the Meng Clan could be considered to have withdrawn from the ranks of elites. Even if he could still recover from his injuries, without two arms and one leg, how much of his battle prowess could he still retain? Moreover, he had been recuperating all this while, and it had already been tens of thousands of years, yet he still hadn’t recovered fully, what more now?
After this, this Venerate Tier elite would probably only be able to wait for death in some
corner of the universe.
“Don’t stay in the city any longer. Leave immediately and find a secluded place to stay. I will return as soon as possible,” Ling Han said.

It could be imagined that though the old Venerate Tier elite from the Meng Clan hadn’t died, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire would definitely launch a full-scale invasion and completely overthrow the Meng Clan’s rule.
Under such a massive change, the slightest carelessness would turn everyone into cannon
fodder.
Ling Han very much wanted to immediately return to Moonlight Planet, but unfortunately, he didn’t have a shuttle, nor could he use the Transference Portal, so he could only wait here.

Fortunately, the empress and the others weren’t weak either. Moreover, they still had the protection of seven children. Tang Yun’er even had a shuttle, and added together, it should be enough for them to protect themselves.
Ling Han suppressed his worries and forced himself to focus on other matters.
This was a resource planet. There was a large amount of precious metals, as well as a small
amount of Celestial medicine.
“Come, let’s go and plunder.” He called out to Tang Yan.
Tang Yan was slightly dazed. Such a powerful Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was actually
about to collapse, and the Tang Clan, which had flourished for a while, was also about to fall.
This was something he could not accept.
“You can create another golden age for the Tang Clan,” Ling Han encouraged him.

chapters.title: Chapter 3806: Azure Dragon Majestic Empire Destroyed
paragraphs: With Ling Han’s encouragement, Tang Yan also pulled himself together.
The strength of a clan should not be based on their dependence on another force, but rather derived from their own strength.
The Tang Clan also had a Spirit Transformation True Lord. No matter where in the galaxy, this kind of strength was enough.
“In the future, I too want to become a Venerate Tier elite, and rule over a region,” Tang Yan said, clenching his fists.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. Why was this guy’s ambition so small?

But upon further thought, Ancestral Kings would only appear once every ten million years, so this was ruled out first. Furthermore, Saints were also as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns. In a galaxy, it would be quite impressive if there was even one in a million years.
Thus, it was more practical to become a Venerate Tier.
“All right. You will become a Venerate Tier elite, and I will become an Ancestral King Tier elite,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Tang Yan rolled his eyes, “Why is it that when you become an Ancestral King, I can only become a Venerate Tier?”
“Wasn’t that what you said?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
The two of them took the initiative to move, beginning to search for valuable things.
When they arrived near the Transfer Formation, the two of them saw teams of troops passing through the Transfer Formation.
“They should have gone to the Moonlight Planet.” Tang Yan’s expression was livid.
Ling Han nodded, similarly very solemn.
If a war broke out, the ones who would suffer the most would definitely be the lower ranks. To them, no matter which side won, it would be a calamity.
“Let’s go.” Ling Han withdrew his emotions. At present, there was nothing he could do, and the only thing he could work hard on was to make himself stronger.

They walked through one mine after another, and also went to the more dangerous primitive forests. They were hunted by powerful Demonic Beasts, and there were also patrolling Shadow Moon Majestic Empire troops that discovered them, and battles broke out.
Half a month later, they all received the news.
The Azure Dragon Majestic Empire had been defeated and gone.

Following the large-scale invasion of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire, the forces that originally belonged to the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire all switched sides. These were all Sect Master-level forces. Even the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire didn’t want to force them too far, so they naturally recruited them one by one.
Now that these elites had defected, what was left of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire?

Meng Yonghua abandoned his position and left. The clansmen of the Meng Clan shut down the formation that guarded the Imperial Capital, allowing the troops of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire to enter. They officially announced their surrender. From now onwards, Moonlight Planet was a subordinate planet of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire.
At the same time, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire also announced that the national religion was Buddhism, and the Majestic Empire would abide by the Buddhist Race’s teachings.

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel emotional. 30,000 years ago, the Buddhist Race hadn’t been able to pass on their religion in the Azure Dragon Empire, but 30,000 years later, it was still the Buddhist Race that won.
The Buddhist Race did not have any specific bloodline. It was not a certain surname that had been passed down from generation to generation, but rather a kind of belief.
As long as one had the faith of Buddha, they would be a member of the Buddhist Race.

This was truly terrifying. At first glance, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire was the Majestic Empire of the Li Clan, but in truth? They all believed in Buddhism, and the Buddhist Race was the real leader.
-In fact, even the members of the Li Clan had to act according to the teachings of the Buddhist Race.

This kind of invasion was practically smooth and silent, yet pervasive at the same time. Even if the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire was finished in the future, whichever clan ascended the throne would still be under the control of the Buddhist Race.

It had to be admitted that the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire sniping the spread of the Buddhist Race was very prescient. Otherwise, after so many years, the entire Azure Dragon Empire, whether in terms of material or mentality, it would completely be adherent to the Buddhist Race.
From this, it could be seen just how terrifying the Ancestral King was.

The Four Directions Great Emperor of the Chang Clan founded the Galaxy Network, and to this day, it was also the one that had the most widespread influence. Furthermore, the teachings of the Buddhist Race had spread far and wide, and who knew how many people in the galaxy believed in Buddhism. The size of their force was unimaginable.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before coming to his senses.
There was no point thinking about these things. The most important thing was strength.

In these few days, he had just cultivated the first Celestial Cauldron into a three-legged Celestial Cauldron. His improvement could be considered quite astonishing. This was because The and Tang Yuan had found a few Celestial medicines.

He had alchemical poison in his body, so it was not appropriate for him to take any more alchemical pills. However, there was no problem with Celestial medicines. This was a gift from the heavens, and did not have the slightest side effect. Of course, if he directly ingested the Celestial medicine, he would not be able to fully activate the medicinal effects, and that would be a great waste.
However, there was nothing that could be done. Who asked Ling Han to not be able to take alchemical pills now?
So be it. Time was what was most valuable.

Following the destruction of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, Golden Wealth Planet’s level of alert also dropped. Everyone was the citizens of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire, so they naturally didn’t need to face their own citizens with weapons.
The Transfer Formation was once again open to the public, and could be used as long as one
paid.

Ling Han and Tang Yan were both eager to return. After putting on a disguise, they went to the Transfer Formation and paid the Transfer Formation fee. Xiu, amidst the surge of white light, they soon returned to the Moonlight Planet and arrived at the Imperial City.
The two of them split up first, both wanting to find their own family.
Ling Han exited the city, crossing many mountains and rivers, and arrived in a forest. After walking for more than 50km, he was greeted by a lake.
“Ling Han!” The empress, Hu Niu, and the others all came out to receive him.
Ling Han also ran over quickly, his left arm around the empress, his right arm around Hu Niu,
and planted a passionate kiss on their mouths.
“Yi, kissing would get you pregnant!” The seven babies all covered their eyes.
Tang Yun’er licked her candies, and muttered in displeasure, “Damn Handsome Brother
steals away Beautiful Sister!”
What made Ling Han feel gratified was the fact that the empress and Hu Niu’s improvement was very obvious. They were only a sliver away from forming Ultimate Dao Foundation.
They settled down in peace, far from the seat of power.

From the Azure Dragon Empire to the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire, this was a massive change for those in power. Many people went from high and mighty to ordinary overnight, but for normal people, there was not the slightest change.
He would continue to live as he had always lived.
Ling Han could still purchase ingredients and sell alchemical pills through Galaxy Network. The Chang Clan had a transcendent status, so they were completely unaffected.
To Ling Han’s surprise, someone actually made a comeback.

-Those people from the Political Hostage Manor had all ran out now, and those like Liu Xunyu, Zhao Xiao and the others all had Spirit Transformation True Lord-level, or even Sect Master-level forces behind them. Now that the Meng Clan had fallen, they naturally became arrogant, and began to look for Ling Han everywhere, wanting to kill him to avenge grudges.

Ling Han naturally didn’t care about such minor characters. However, since these clowns dared to be so arrogant, Ling Han planned to kill them if he had the chance to, lest they continue to blabber nonsense.

dissipate.
Afterwards, he would be able to take alchemical pills to cultivate, so that the improvement of his cultivation level could soar.

Three months had passed, and he had finally cultivated to the level of Heaven Cauldron. The two Celestial Cauldrons had already formed a complete three legs, and the third Celestial Cauldron had also grown a leg.
Right at this moment, a huge piece of news suddenly spread out on the Galaxy Network.
After cultivating in seclusion for 20,000 years, the Nine Suns Holy Land was planning to open
their doors to recruit disciples.
All of a sudden, the entire galaxy was shaken.
The Nine Suns Holy Land had naturally produced a Saint before. Otherwise, how could it be
called the Nine Suns Holy Land?

And that Nine Suns Saint was an incredibly fierce man. When he was young, he could almost be considered invincible among his peers, and had once had the possibility of becoming an Ancestral King, but in the end, all his efforts had come to nothing, and he had lost to the Ancestral King Lingtian.

The strength of a clan should not be based on their dependence on another force, but rather derived from their own strength.
The Tang Clan also had a Spirit Transformation True Lord.
No matter where in the galaxy, this kind of strength was enough.
“In the future, I too want to become a Venerate Tier elite, and rule over a region,” Tang Yan said, clenching his fists.
Ling Han was rendered speechless.
Why was this guy’s ambition so small?
But upon further thought, Ancestral Kings would only appear once every ten million years, so this was ruled out first.
Furthermore, Saints were also as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns.
In a galaxy, it would be quite impressive if there was even one in a million years.
Thus, it was more practical to become a Venerate Tier.
“All right.
You will become a Venerate Tier elite, and I will become an Ancestral King Tier elite,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Tang Yan rolled his eyes, “Why is it that when you become an Ancestral King, I can only become a Venerate Tier?”
“Wasn’t that what you said?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
The two of them took the initiative to move, beginning to search for valuable things.
When they arrived near the Transfer Formation, the two of them saw teams of troops passing through the Transfer Formation.
“They should have gone to the Moonlight Planet.” Tang Yan’s expression was livid.
Ling Han nodded, similarly very solemn.
If a war broke out, the ones who would suffer the most would definitely be the lower ranks.
To them, no matter which side won, it would be a calamity.
“Let’s go.” Ling Han withdrew his emotions.
At present, there was nothing he could do, and the only thing he could work hard on was to make himself stronger.
They walked through one mine after another, and also went to the more dangerous primitive forests.
They were hunted by powerful Demonic Beasts, and there were also patrolling Shadow Moon Majestic Empire troops that discovered them, and battles broke out.
Half a month later, they all received the news.
The Azure Dragon Majestic Empire had been defeated and gone.
Following the large-scale invasion of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire, the forces that originally belonged to the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire all switched sides.
These were all Sect Master-level forces.
Even the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire didn’t want to force them too far, so they naturally recruited them one by one.
Now that these elites had defected, what was left of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire?
Meng Yonghua abandoned his position and left.
The clansmen of the Meng Clan shut down the formation that guarded the Imperial Capital, allowing the troops of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire to enter.
They officially announced their surrender.
From now onwards, Moonlight Planet was a subordinate planet of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire.
At the same time, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire also announced that the national religion was Buddhism, and the Majestic Empire would abide by the Buddhist Race’s teachings.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel emotional.
30,000 years ago, the Buddhist Race hadn’t been able to pass on their religion in the Azure Dragon Empire, but 30,000 years later, it was still the Buddhist Race that won.
The Buddhist Race did not have any specific bloodline.
It was not a certain surname that had been passed down from generation to generation, but rather a kind of belief.
As long as one had the faith of Buddha, they would be a member of the Buddhist Race.
This was truly terrifying.
At first glance, the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire was the Majestic Empire of the Li Clan, but in truth?
They all believed in Buddhism, and the Buddhist Race was the real leader.
-In fact, even the members of the Li Clan had to act according to the teachings of the Buddhist Race.
This kind of invasion was practically smooth and silent, yet pervasive at the same time.
Even if the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire was finished in the future, whichever clan ascended the throne would still be under the control of the Buddhist Race.
It had to be admitted that the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire sniping the spread of the Buddhist Race was very prescient.
Otherwise, after so many years, the entire Azure Dragon Empire, whether in terms of material or mentality, it would completely be adherent to the Buddhist Race.
From this, it could be seen just how terrifying the Ancestral King was.
The Four Directions Great Emperor of the Chang Clan founded the Galaxy Network, and to this day, it was also the one that had the most widespread influence.
Furthermore, the teachings of the Buddhist Race had spread far and wide, and who knew how many people in the galaxy believed in Buddhism.
The size of their force was unimaginable.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before coming to his senses.
There was no point thinking about these things.
The most important thing was strength.
In these few days, he had just cultivated the first Celestial Cauldron into a three-legged Celestial Cauldron.
His improvement could be considered quite astonishing.
This was because The and Tang Yuan had found a few Celestial medicines.
He had alchemical poison in his body, so it was not appropriate for him to take any more alchemical pills.
However, there was no problem with Celestial medicines.
This was a gift from the heavens, and did not have the slightest side effect.
Of course, if he directly ingested the Celestial medicine, he would not be able to fully activate the medicinal effects, and that would be a great waste.
However, there was nothing that could be done.
Who asked Ling Han to not be able to take alchemical pills now?
So be it.
Time was what was most valuable.
Following the destruction of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, Golden Wealth Planet’s level of alert also dropped.
Everyone was the citizens of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire, so they naturally didn’t need to face their own citizens with weapons.
The Transfer Formation was once again open to the public, and could be used as long as one
paid.
Ling Han and Tang Yan were both eager to return.
After putting on a disguise, they went to the Transfer Formation and paid the Transfer Formation fee.
Xiu, amidst the surge of white light, they soon returned to the Moonlight Planet and arrived at the Imperial City.
The two of them split up first, both wanting to find their own family.

chapters.title: Chapter 3807: Nine Suns Saint
paragraphs: It was said that the Nine Suns Saint and the young Ancestral King Lingtian had battled countless times, and were old enemies, old rivals, and both had won and lost before.
From this, it was clear just how powerful the Nine Suns Saint had been in the past. Even a future Ancestral King had been unable to suppress him.

However, the Nine Suns Saint’s cultivation technique was far too powerful, and this left him with far too many wounds when he was young. It was because of this that he had lost to Ancestral King Lingtian on his path to becoming an Ancestral King. As such, he could only become a Saint.
In his later years, Nine Suns Saint kept an extremely low profile, but it was said that he was creating an extremely powerful technique. In fact, he had even simulated an Imperial Technique.
Now, the Nine Suns Holy Land had reopened their doors to recruit disciples. To say nothing of ordinary people, even the heirs of Imperial Clans were itching to give it a try.
Of course, it was definitely not just any random person that could enter into the Nine Suns Holy Land.
Firstly, it was the qualifications for registration. One only had to satisfy any one of the following three conditions.
Firstly, ranked in the top 10,000 on the Galaxy Network.
Secondly, Innate Divine Physique.

Thirdly, the Celestial Foundation, or Celestial Cauldron’s quality had reached Gold Grade. That’s right. There was also an implicit requirement for this registration, and that was only targeting those in the Foundation Building Tier and the Cauldron Forging Tier.
Ling Han wasn’t born with a Divine Physique, but he satisfied the first and third conditions.

But the problem was, he did not want to expose the secret that he was “Number One in the Galaxy”. Furthermore, his Celestial Cauldron was clearly of a higher grade than Gold grade, but in the eyes of outsiders, it seemed to be forged from stone.
How was he supposed to deal with this?
Ling Han took a look. The Nine Suns Holy Land’s gates would open for ten years, and a selection would be conducted every year. Ten years later, the gates would close again.
Thankfully, there was still a lot of time.

Ling Han planned to return to the Celestial Sea Planet. This was because he had already advanced to the Cauldron Forging Tier, and he didn’t have the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire to restrict his freedom. Thus, it was time for him to search for the second test that the Ancient Sun Saint had laid out.
Though the Turbid Heaven Scroll was not weak, it was still inferior to a Saint’s technique, after all.
Of course, if it was possible, Ling Han still wanted to cultivate the technique of a Great Emperor.
Regarding Ling Han’s decision, the empress and Hu Niu were naturally in full support. Thus, they boarded the shuttle and headed towards Celestial Sea Planet.
Ling Han contacted Lin Luo and the others. They naturally saw the notice from the Nine Suns Holy Land, and decided to set out in a few days.
Ling Han naturally believed in the strength and talent of Lin Luo and the others. Thus, after he dealt with the Ancient Sun Saint’s second trial ground, he would meet up with Lin Luo and the others.

Tang Yun’er finally advanced into the Foundation Building Tier, greatly improving her control over the shuttle. Thus, in just a month’s time, they returned to Celestial Sea Planet. Originally, the Celestial Sea Planet was subordinate to the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. Now that the Meng Clan had fallen, it was naturally subordinate to the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire.
Ling Han and his group had just entered into a city, when they saw tall structures rising from the ground, erected in the centre of the city. They had not been completely built yet.
This was a Buddhist temple, and it was said that there would be Buddhist Race monk settling here in the future, spreading the teachings of the Buddhist Race.
The invasion of the Buddhist Race had begun. This was not conquering a person physically, but rather from the spiritual level. Undoubtedly, this was even more terrifying.
Ling Han ignored this. They found an inn and settled down temporarily.
He wanted to analyze where the second test was.
On the Celestial Sea Planet, one couldn’t buy a completely corresponding map, because the Celestial Sea Planet had long since been destroyed.
Ling Han could only search for clues, and then make a comparison.
Hopefully, the entrance to the second testing ground was still on the Celestial Sea Planet. If it was a piece of the planet that had flown to some corner of the galaxy, that would be terrible.
Fortunately, this entrance was really on the Celestial Sea Planet.
After Ling Han compared the ancient map for a whole three days, he finally found the place.
“Let’s go.”
He brought the women, as well as the large black dog and the pervert pig, and set out towards their destination.

In just half a day’s time, they arrived at their destination. However, the world had changed, and after so many years, the entrance to the land of inheritance had long since been hidden underground. A town had been built here, and the location of the entrance that Ling Han was looking for was beneath the wealthiest family in the town.
If he wanted to enter into the land of inheritance, he would first have to destroy their family home.

If Ling Han were a tyrant, he would have directly demolished the building. However, firstly, he wasn’t that kind of person, and secondly, he didn’t want to cause too much commotion. Thus, he decided to buy this manor that occupied a large area.
He paid a visit, and slightly revealed the aura of an elite, and was immediately welcomed in.

“Dare I ask your name, Young Hero?” The head of this clan was a middle-aged man in his forties. His surname was Liu, and his name was Liu Gaoxi. Behind him was a yellow-robed young man. He was actually in the Foundation Building Tier.
It should be known that Celestial Sea Planet’s cultivation could be said to have started from scratch. Now, he actually saw a Foundation Building Tier cultivator in a small town. This was
naturally unusual.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before saying, “My name is Han Lin.”
“So it’s Young Hero Han. Please, please, please.” Liu Gaoxi was very cordial. After inviting
Ling Han into the living room, he introduced the yellow-robed young man beside him, “This is my son, Liu Menglin. He is cultivating under the banner of the Primordial Sect.”
Primordial Sect?
Ling Han looked at the yellow-robed young man and nodded.

However, Liu Menglin was incredibly proud. In his eyes, he was the heir of one of the five great forces of Spiritual Transformation Tier on the Celestial Sea Planet, so he was naturally high and noble, having an incredibly strong feeling of superiority.
He ignored Ling Han, and sat down on his own.

Liu Gaoxi was slightly embarrassed. However, his son was far too powerful, so there was nothing he could do about this. Thus, he could only turn to Ling Han and say, “Young Hero Han, may I know why you’ve come today?”
Ling Han smiled, “I would like to ask Clan leader Liu to do me a favor, and sell this manor to
me.”
“Haha!” Liu Gaoxi had not even spoken, when Liu Menglin smirked coldly. He looked disdainfully at Ling Han, “This is the ancestral grounds of our Liu Clan. It is not for sale!”
Liu Gaoxi naturally didn’t want to sell either. However, he definitely wouldn’t offend others
like Liu Menglin had. Cold sweat formed on his forehead.
If Ling Han were to flip out, would his son be able to stop him?
Ling Han was naturally a little displeased as well. ‘I’m discussing nicely with you. Even if you
don’t agree, there’s no need for you to speak so harshly, right?’
This young man was clearly used to smooth sailing, so he was condescending, and spoke
without thinking.
Ling Han couldn’t be bothered to argue with this kind of person, and said, “I’ll offer 200 Dao
Stonesa|”
“Really!” Liu Menglin stood up before Ling Han could finish his words, his eyes shining.
Two hundred Dao Stones, this was an astonishing amount of wealth.
His natural talent was very high, and in the Primordial Sect, he could be considered a True
Disciple. However, he could only obtain two Dao Stones every month. With such a comparison, it was clear how valuable 200 Dao Stones were.
“We will sell!” Liu Menglin seemed to be afraid that Ling Han would regret it, and
immediately decided.
Liu Gaoxi: “ax|”
Just now, who had been so disdainful, and said that the ancestral grounds were not for sale,
but what was the result?
However, all the hopes of the Liu Clan rested on Liu Menglin. Thus, Liu Gaoxi would not undermine him either. He nodded slowly.
“Give us three days to move,” Liu Menglin said. However, he was sneering in his mind.
