chapters.title: Chapter 3808: Greedy Villain
paragraphs: There was a saying: don’t reveal your wealth.
Ling Han had revealed 200 Dao Stones at once. What did this signify?
He was rich, and extremely, extremely rich at that.
Who would not want to kill such a fat sheep when they saw it?
Liu Menglin did not want to sell his ancestral grounds. He only wanted to detain Ling Han, so that he could invite elites from the sect to suppress Ling Han.

He very much wanted to take it all for himself, but he could vaguely sense how strong Ling Han was, so he did not dare make a move rashly. Thus, just to be safe, he had best invite a few more Senior Brothers from his sect.
They couldn’t be too strong, or it was possible that they would turn on him.

En, he would just ask Senior Brother Yang, Senior Brother Zhang, Senior Brother Li, and Senior Sister Tian. Usually, the five of them had a good relationship, and had also explored ancient sites together, nurturing a certain level of tacit understanding.
He immediately sent out a message through the Galaxy Network, telling these four people to rush over at the first instant.
Ling Han returned to the inn, and the empress asked, “How was it?”

“It’s generally going quite smoothly. There might be some twists and turns,” Ling Han said with a smile. He didn’t know what Liu Menglin was planning, but the latter had changed his mind too quickly, making him feel that things weren’t as simple as he thought.
The empress only gave an ‘en’, and did not take it to heart at all.
That was the kind of prideful person she was,
Ling Han couldn’t help but be moved. He grabbed the empress and strode towards the bedroom.
“Niu wants to play too!” When Hu Niu saw this, she hurriedly sprinted in as well.
How could she miss out on something as fun as having children?
Time passed very quickly. Three days later, Ling Han went to receive the house. He brought the empress, Hu Niu and the other main troops.
“Please! Please!” The guard appeared cordial and polite, and invited Ling Han and his group into the living room. They saw that Liu Gaoxi and Liu Menglin were already waiting for them.
Ling Han waved a hand at the table, and a pile of Dao Stones appeared. He said calmly, “200 Dao Stones are here.”
Liu Menglin shook his head, “I’m really sorry. Someone has offered a higher price, so I won’t be selling this house.”
Hehe, was there really such a coincidence? Within three days, someone had taken a fancy to this place again?
Ling Han naturally didn’t believe him. He smiled slightly, and said, “Oh, are there other buyers?”

Thus, how could she miss out on such a fun opportunity?

Pa! A claw slammed down, and Liu Menglin fell to the ground.
The large black dog stepped on Liu Menglin’s head, and said with an indifferent expression,
“How lonely is it to be invincible!”
How pretentious.
However, Li Yuansi and the others were all solemn.

The information wasn’t right. Wasn’t it said that there was only one Foundation Building cultivator? Why was there a freakish dog demon now? This was the cultivation level of Heavenly Dao Foundation, and it had knocked Liu Menglin down with a single strike. Its
battle prowess was too fierce.
“Who else is there?” The large black dog stood on his hind legs like a human, his two front paws crossed behind his back, his iron underwear flashing.
“Perverted demonic dog, don’t be too smug!” Zhang Yiyuan walked out. He was also
Heavenly Dao Foundation, and thought that he wouldn’t lose to the large black dog.
“Come!” The large black dog hooked his paw at him.
Zhang Yiyuan charged over, and shot out a punch.
The fist had just shot out, when he roared furiously, and forcibly withdrew it.
“Despicable!” he spat through gritted teeth. This was because the large black dog had
actually lifted Li Menglin up and used him as a shield.
“What? You’re saying Grandpa Dog is despicable?” The large black dog looked astonished.
“Can’t I scold you?” Zhang Yiyuan said angrily.
The large black dog suddenly laughed loudly, “Grandpa Dog is despicable, shameless, and vulgar. What can you do about it?” He turned around, and waved his behind at Zhang Yiyuan,
looking very vulgar.
F***, how could there be such a shameless Demonic Beast?
To say nothing of Zhang Yiyuan, even Yang Yuansi and the others had turned livid with anger.
“Do you think that I can’t do anything to you like this?” Zhang Yiyuan continued to attack. He was extremely furious. He was determined to capture the large black dog.
The large black dog was still the same. Using Liu Menglin as a shield, he forced Zhang Yiyuan
to cancel his own attack, while he continued to wave his paw.

had been raised as defence, but he had absolutely no intention of stopping, and continued his
attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 3809: Azure Cloud Mystery Realm
paragraphs: Zhang Yiyuan knew very well that if he was tied up, he would never be able to defeat the large black dog.
Thus, he decided to cut his losses, and no longer held back.
On the other hand, Liu Menglin was only his Junior Brother. He wasn’t his father, nor was he his son.
Yang Yuansi, Li Zhengping, and the others actually didn’t open their mouths to stop him either. In their eyes, this was the best solution.
Only Liu Gaoxi was extremely nervous. The one being used as a shield was his son, so nothing could happen to him.

The large black dog shook his head, and said, “How vicious!” However, he didn’t hold back at all, using Liu Menglin as a shield. Peng, peng, peng! After a dozen or so exchanges, Liu Menglin was severely wounded.

“Don’t hit me anymore! Don’t hit me anymore! I don’t want this manor anymore. As long as you let my son go, we’ll leave immediately.” Tears streamed down Liu Gaoxi’s face. He was not that greedy. He only wanted his son to be fine.
“All right, I’ll return him to you!” The large black dog waved a paw, and tossed Liu Menglin out. In any case, he had already damaged this “shield”.
“Humph, die!” Zhang Yiyuan’s offensive instantly intensified.

Even if he did not fear hurting the hostage and attacked fully, he still didn’t dare to kill Liu Menglin. After all, they were Sect Brothers. If he killed Liu Menglin, he wouldn’t be able to escape responsibility either.
Thus, he had truly gone all out now.
He stimulated high-level energy, and there was a dark green light wrapped around his fist, causing the might of the fist technique to increase to another level.
“Do you think Grandpa Dog is afraid of you?” the large black dog roared. He also lashed out with his paw, clashing with Zhang Yiyuan.
Boom!
Fists and claws clashed, and Zhang Yi Yuan’s expression immediately changed drastically. His whole person was sent flying, blood spurting from his mouth.
What, even Zhang Yiyuan was no match for this freakish demonic dog?
Yang Yuansi and the others all felt their scalps go numb. Oh no, they had been screwed over by Liu Menglin. How was this group of people fat sheep? They were clearly ferocious tigers.
“Hehe, it’s a misunderstanding, it’s all a misunderstanding!” Yang Yuansi hurriedly played mediator.
“Do you want to fight with Niu? Come on then!” Hu Niu immediately leaped out and launched an attack at Yang Yuansi.
‘F*ck you!’

Yang Yuansi was extremely depressed. He was asking for peace, okay? Little girl, don’t you have ears? He glanced at Hu Niu. Though her face was covered by a thin veil, and her true appearance could not be seen clearly, he could vaguely see her excited expression.
F***, this was a battle-thirsty character.
He was helpless against Hu Niu, and could only passively accept the challenge. However, he had only parried one move, when he paled in shock, because Hu Niu was too strong.
This was probably Ultimate Dao Foundation, right? Otherwise, how could she be so powerful? In just a few moves, he was also beaten to the ground.
When Li Zhengping and Tian Lijing saw this, they no longer had any fighting spirit. Hurriedly, they turned around and fled.
Since they had already made their move, how could he allow them to flee?
Ling Han nodded at the seven babies. After getting his permission, the seven babies all rushed out excitedly.
They hadn’t advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier yet, but they were all born with a Divine Physique, so just how terrifying were their abilities?
Li Zhengping and Tian Lijiing were both beaten into pig heads.
“Little Han, kill them to keep the secret,” the large black dog said viciously, scaring Zhang Yiyuan and the others so much that they trembled.
“I’ll keep them alive for now. They might be useful.” Ling Han thought for a moment, and decided not to kill them for the moment.
He began to search for the entrance to the Mystery Realm, and naturally needed to dismantle the manor of the Liu Clan. After digging three feet into the ground, he found a stone pillar.
This was the one.

According to the information he had obtained in the Moon Occult Mystery Realm, he soon found the method to open it. He used his Spiritual Power to form a special seal and placed it on the stone pillar.
Ka, ka, ka! The stone pillar twisted, and then a platform rose up from the ground. Complex formation patterns were drawn on it.
“Let’s go.”

Ling Han beckoned the empress, the large black dog, and the others over. Even Liu Menglin, Zhang Yiyuan and the others were brought along. He activated the formation again. Weng! A brilliant light surged over, and everyone instantly disappeared from their original positions. Light flashed madly in front of their eyes, but very soon, it stopped, and they saw that they had appeared on a plain, and there was azure multicoloured light at the horizon.
This was the Azure Cloud Mystery Realm, the second trial grounds set up by the Ancient Sun Saint.

Liu Menglin and Yang Yuansi naturally understood why Ling Han wanted to buy the ancestral grounds of the Liu Clan. As it turned out, this was actually the entrance to a Mystery Realm. They were all anxious. Now that they knew such a big secret, would they still be able to leave alive?
“The multicolored light here is very nutritious,” Ling Han said. This was also the information he had obtained.
Why had he come here as soon as he had the chance after advancing into Cauldron Forging Tier? Aside from the inheritance of the Saint, this multi-colored light was also one of his
targets.
The large black dog immediately broke into a run and ran towards the horizon, “Little Han, Grandpa Dog will take my leave first.”
This damn dog!
Ling Han chuckled. This multi-colored light was not that easy to obtain, either.
“Come, let’s go to the Earth Mystery Palace first.”

The Earth Mystery Palace was the land of inheritance for the Saint, and it was also the keystone that controlled this Mystery Realm. If one wanted to obtain the multi-colored light, they would have to first obtain the Earth Mystery Palace.
“Hey, where are you guys going?” The large black dog ran for half a day, yet did not see Ling

Han and the others catch up to him. He then scrambled back, but when he saw that they were not heading towards the multicolored light at all, he couldn’t help but feel anxious. He hurriedly called out as he gave chase.
This Mystery Realm was much smaller than the Moon Occult Mystery Realm.

In truth, the Moon Occult Mystery Realm was used by the Ancient Sun Saint to select his heirs. Those who stood out were the candidates, and the remaining three Mystery Realms were used to examine whether they were worthy of being his heirs. After all, there were some people who were stunning for a while, but would soon disappear among the masses. Thus, the Ancient Sun Saint would rather have his Dao lost than to pass it on to a mediocre person, and bring dishonor to his name.
After walking for about 10 minutes, they arrived at the Earth Mystery Palace.
This place was very small. Rather than calling it a palace, it would be better to call it a larger
house.

Ling Han pushed open the doors and entered. He saw that there was a very wide aisle ahead of him. It was about three hundred meters in length, and there was a sword at the end. “That sword is the hub that controls this place,” Ling Han said. “In the past, the Ancient Sun Saint used the Spirit Tool when he was in Cauldron Forging Tier. After he became a Saint, he refined it again, and among Two Star Spirit Tools, it can be considered peak grade.” “Grandpa Dog just happens to be missing a Spirit Tool. This sword belongs to Grandpa Dog now,” the large black dog immediately said.
When these words fell into the ears of Liu Menglin and the others, their eyes lit up.
Control hub.
If they obtained this sword, then wouldn’t they be able to control this Mystery Realm? To say nothing of escaping, they could even turn the tables and become the Master instead.
Haha, these people were really arrogant. They actually didn’t restrict their cultivation level,
which really gave them great convenience.
The five of them looked at each other, and suddenly exploded in unison, charging towards the
end of the passage.
However, they had just taken a step, when they both stumbled, and almost tripped.
In this passageway, the gravity field was extraordinarily strong.
Not only that, but multiple figures also surfaced from the ground, instantly covering the entire passageway.
Shua! The person at the forefront immediately launched an attack at Liu Menglin and the
others.

chapters.title: Chapter 3810: Yin souls
paragraphs: These figures were not solid, but rather semi-transparent, as if they were formed from light and shadow. The moment they appeared, they exuded a powerful chilling aura.
Liu Menglin and the others were instantly embroiled in a tough battle. They didn’t dare to retreat. If they fell into Ling Han’s hands again, would they still have a chance of survival?

Thus, they could only charge forward and obtain that treasured sword. They would then be able to control the entire Mystery Realm. Not only would they be able to turn the situation around, but they would even be able to obtain a great opportunity.
However, the battle prowess of those figures was really too strong, instantly blasting them to the point that they were groaning in pain.
“Little Han, is this the reason why you brought them in?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Am I that two-faced?”
“Yes!” The large black dog nodded with certainty, and the perverted pig beside him nodded even faster. It was all this b@stard’s fault for causing him to wander around everywhere, b@stard.

Ling Han was rendered speechless. He hadn’t planned to screw Liu Menglin and the others over, but for the sake of secrecy, he had brought the five of them with him. He hadn’t thought that they would insist on seeking death.
Of course, without sealing off their cultivation levels, Ling Han was actually indulging them, intentionally or otherwise.

“What the hell are these figures?” The large black dog naturally didn’t mind whether Ling Han was two-faced or not. In fact, it even expressed its delight at this. In a world where the strong ruled, what was the use of having nothing but righteousness? He couldn’t even protect himself, and still wanted to protect others?
Ling Han activated his ocular technique and looked closely, saying, “It should be a vengeful ghost.”
“Yin soul!” Second Baby continued.

“That’s right. The Celestial Sea Planet is the exit to a netherworld. At that time, they even caused the Ancient Sun Saint to die. Thus, it is very normal for the Ancient Sun Saint to capture some Yin souls here,” Eldest Eldest Baby also said.
Ling Han nodded. These were indeed not human figures that had evolved from formations. That eerie feeling was completely incompatible with normal living beings.
“When people die, will they really become Yin souls?” He suddenly became curious.
If that was really the case, then wouldn’t the people he had killed all be thinking about him in the Netherworld?

“The great elites of ancient times have studied it. It is said that after a living being dies, the yin soul would enter into the netherworld. This is a completely different place from our world. Theoretically, there should be absolutely no possibility of communication between the two worlds. Only in the instant of death, would the yin soul be able to penetrate the barrier between the two realms. But perhaps, the two worlds have existed for too long, causing some places to begin merging,” Second Baby said seriously.

Hearing a child say such words in such a serious manner, he felt an inexplicable urge to laugh. Ling Han tried his best to control himself. He looked at Liu Menglin and the others who were engaged in a tough battle, “Celestial Sea Planet are the point where the two Realms merge. At that time, the underworld opened up, and countless Yin souls surged in, causing a great calamity.”
“That’s right.” The seven babies nodded in unison.

As they conversed, Liu Menglin and the others could no longer hold on. They all wanted to charge back, but there was a terrifying gravity field on this path, which made it difficult for them to advance. More importantly, they had been determined to charge to the other side at that time. Furthermore, they had really charged out a distance, and now they actually wanted to charge back?
It would be difficult.
Ling Han and the others had no intention of helping. This was what the five of them had asked for.
It wasn’t long before the five of them were killed.
A strange scene appeared. With the deaths of these five people, those Yin souls actually began to kill each other, fighting extremely intensely.
However, in the end, five of the strongest Yin souls won and surged into the corpses of Liu Menglin and the others respectively. Then... they actually stood up shakily.
F***, they had come back to life!
“Liu Menglin” and the others soon set their eyes on Ling Han and the others. Their movements were no longer stiff. Xiu, xiu, xiu, they all pounced over, launching attacks at Ling Han and the others.
In this process, the Yin souls in the passageway did not make a move on them, as if they agreed that they were on the same side.

“This Yin soul can actually come back to life through a corpse?” Ling Han was shocked. No wonder when the doors to the netherworld opened, it would cause a great calamity. They were replacing a living person.
He charged out at the first instant, and shot out a punch. The Heavenly Dao Flames was burning fiercely, and the power of flames should be an extremely good weapon against Yin
souls.
Peng, peng, peng! After only five punches, Liu Menglin and the others were sent flying. Their bodies cracked, but they actually didn’t explode.

Ling Han was surprised. Though he had only done it casually, with his Cauldron Forging Tier- level power, even if it was just a sliver, it was enough to kill a Foundation Building cultivator. After being possessed by the Yin soul, these corpses actually underwent such a massive change.

“Hehehe,” Liu Menglin and the others all released strange sounds. The aura exuding from their bodies actually increased greatly, and all of a sudden, they had rushed up to the level of Cauldron Forging Tier, Human Cauldron, Earth Cauldron, Heaven Cauldron... they were still increasing, and had not advanced into the level of Core Formation Tier, but Ling Han was sure that it had reached four cauldrons, or even five cauldrons in fact.

Pa, pa, pa! More and more cracks appeared on the bodies of Liu Menglin and the others, and they became deeper and deeper. For example, one of Tian Lijing’s arms had even fallen off. The increase in aura of the five of them stopped at the same time. It was not that they could no longer be stronger, but rather their bodies could not bear it.

Hiss, the strength of those five Yin souls when they were alive must have far surpassed the Cauldron Forging Tier. Otherwise, it was impossible that a mere Yin soul would be able to increase the physical strength of the host so much.
Ling Han’s expression was solemn. This Yin soul was really terrifying. No wonder it had caused such a calamity in the past.
Moreover, even the Heavenly Dao Flames did not have much of a restraining effect on Yin souls. It was as if their bodies had become wet and tightly woven wood, and were extremely
hard to burn.
Then he’ll switch tactics.
Ling Han’s hands shook, and Destructive Energy wrapped around his fists at the same time.

In the past, he hadn’t been able to do so. This was because there were far too few Destructive Energy Particles. They could only wrap around one fist. Now, however, they could only wrap around two fists.
When Destructive Energy appeared, Liu Menglin and the others actually took a step back at the same time. There was obvious wariness on the zombies’ faces, as well as a strong sense of
disgust.

It was not just them. The Yin souls in the passage also seemed to have been angered, and became incredibly restless. If it was not for some kind of power restraining them, they would probably either charge towards Ling Han, or flee completely.
Yi, Destructive Energy was capable of restraining Yin souls?
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind, yet his figure charged out without hesitation.
He threw a punch, and Liu Menglin and the others didn’t dare to face it head-on. They
hurriedly retreated.
Ling Han used the Imminent Skyline Technique, and had already caught up to Zhang Yiyuan.
He threw a punch.
Zhang Yiyuan had no choice but to parry, and also threw a punch back at Ling Han.
Peng!

The two fists crashed into each other, and both of them trembled. In terms of power, they were actually evenly matched, but the Destructive Energy spread out through Zhang Yiyuan’s fist, instantly burning all over his body. Its speed was so fast that it was as if his body was
covered with wax.

In just an instant, Zhang Yiyuan was burnt to ashes, and the Yin soul that had entered his body also ran out in extreme terror. However, it was useless. It had already been ignited, and was continuously releasing divine sense-level howls, appearing to be in extreme pain.
In a short while, it too had been burnt into ashes.

chapters.title: Chapter 3811: Multicolored light nourishes the body
paragraphs: As expected, Destructive Energy was extremely effective against Yin souls.
Although the bodies of Liu Menglin and the others had been borrowed by the Yin souls, and all of them had zombie faces which were extremely numb, they were all wearing expressions of fear now.
In terms of power, they were not inferior to Ling Han. However, Ling Han’s black energy was too terrifying, and had an astonishing restraining effect on them.
They couldn’t fight.
The four of them leaped up at the same time, choosing to flee.

How could Ling Han possibly let them leave? Using the Imminent Skyline, he quickly caught up to one of them and threw a punch. Then, without even looking, he chased after the second person. He did the same thing. After four punches, he stopped, and saw that Liu Menglin and the others had all burnt to nothing, and so had the four yin souls.
The large black dog stuck out his tongue. Thankfully, he did not run out greedily. Otherwise, he would have probably become a Yin soul dog by now.
Ling Han strode into the passageway. With a shua, those Yin souls all retreated, squeezing together, showing a strong fear.
It wasn’t that they were afraid of him, but rather Destructive Energy.
Ling Han continued to advance, and these Yin souls continued to retreat, squeezing even harder.
When Ling Han was about to reach the end of the passageway, those Yin souls could no longer retreat, and were completely squeezed together.
They continuously released sharp whistles via divine sense, as if warning Ling Han not to come any closer. Otherwise, they would not hesitate to fight to the death.
How could Ling Han possibly give them any regard? He continued to advance.
A shocking scene appeared. These Yin souls actually began to kill each other again. Yi, had they been scared silly?

A few Yin souls were soon killed, and it could be clearly seen that the light particles that formed their bodies were shattered, absorbed by the other Yin souls, and these Yin souls immediately became larger.

Ling Han was surprised. Though this was killing each other, it was also a means to save themselves. They would devour their companions to strengthen themselves, and ultimately reach a level that could match Ling Han.
Die.
Ling Han wasn’t in the mood to see how strong they would become in the end. He charged out, swinging his fists repeatedly, and nothing could not be destroyed by Destructive Energy.
The Yin souls instantly withered away at a visible rate. In less than a minute, all the Yin souls were destroyed.
Ling Han strode out of the passageway, his hand gripping the hilt of his sword.
Instantly, a thought was sent over.

There was a considerable amount of information. There was the Cauldron Forging Tier chapter of the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, the coordinates of the next test site and the method to open it, as well as some knowledge that the Ancient Sun Saint had about yin souls.
Ling Han’s eyeballs trembled rapidly. He was presently receiving information, and digesting
it.
After a few minutes, he released his grip.
“Come over here. There’s no more danger,” Ling Han said.
The large black dog rushed out with a woof, snatching the opportunity to pull out the sword, “This is Grandpa Dog’s!”
“All right, all right, all right. Here,” Ling Han said with a smile.
He had the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, so any Spirit Tool was nothing but dirt in his eyes.
“I’m about to begin receiving the rays of light. I’m ready,” Ling Han said. He then turned to the large black dog and said, “Bring me the sword first. I need to use it to control this Mystery Realm.”
The large black dog’s expression was filled with suspicion, “It can’t be that you want to embezzle Grandpa Dog’s treasure, right?”
“Get lost!”

Everyone sat down in a cross-legged position. Ling Han inserted the treasured sword again, and his intent instantly spread throughout the entire Mystery Realm through the treasured sword, as if he was an omnipotent god.
Azure light, come!
Xiu, xiu, xiu! On the horizon, multiple streaks of azure light shot over, circling around the empress, Hu Niu and the others.

The empress and the others channelled the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Multiple streaks of light were absorbed by them, turning into the most fundamental force, increasing their cultivation level and strengthening their Celestial Foundation.
“Grandpa Dog is about to break through!”
Not long after, the large black dog called out. At this moment, his aura was extremely strong and unstable.
The empress and Hu Niu had also reached the peak stage of Heavenly Dao Foundation, and were beginning to break through to the Ultimate Dao Foundation.
Ling Han dispersed the multi-colored light first. At present, the empress and the others’ cultivation levels differed considerably. He had to increase their cultivation levels first.

To the empress and the large black dog, breaking through to Ultimate Dao Foundation was naturally nothing too difficult. In less than half a day, they broke through one after another. Ling Han summoned the multi-colored light again, allowing them to continue cultivating. If they could charge up to the Cauldron Forging Tier in one go, that would be great. However, though this multi-colored light was very nutritious, there was also a level of saturation that one could reach, just like alchemical pills. Another half a day later, the empress and the others were no longer able to boost the advancement of their cultivation level by absorbing the multi-colored light.

Only then did Ling Han sit down in a cross-legged position. With the Cauldron Forging Tier chapter of the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, he was recultivating the mystical power. Multiple rays of light were absorbed by him, helping his mystical power become purer. Otherwise, his cultivation level would definitely decline slightly.
When all the multicolored light disappeared, Ling Han’s cultivation level was also close to the peak stage of Heaven Cauldron Tier. The third leg of the cauldron was just a sliver away from
completion.
Ling Han was very pleased. Though his cultivation level hadn’t improved much, his mystical power had been purified considerably, so his battle prowess had naturally improved
considerably.
“Let’s go, it’s time to leave.”
The large black dog was slightly dissatisfied, and he said, “Are the benefits of a Mystery
Realm so measly?”

“Heh, this is only a stopover. If I truly want to reap great rewards, I’ll have to wait until the last Mystery Realm,” Ling Han said. It was still the examination stage for the Ancient Sun Saint, so being able to obtain nourishing multicolored light in addition to the cultivation technique, as well as a treasured sword, was already quite impressive.
“Sigh, what a miserly Saint,” the large black dog mocked.
“That’s right, too stingy.” Hu Niu also joined in agreement.
“Let’s go.”
They exited the Mystery Realm, and Ling Han had already erased all the relevant memories of the members of the Liu Clan. He headed directly to the Imperial City.

Ling Han first went to visit Xuanyuan Dingguo. Xuanyuan Dingguo had finally advanced into the Foundation Building Tier, but because of his natural talent, it was possible that he wouldn’t be able to break through to the Cauldron Forging Tier in the next one to two hundred years. Ling Han left a great many Foundation Dissolution Pills for Xuanyuan Dingguo, hoping to lend him a helping hand so he would have a chance to advance into the
Cauldron Forging Tier in the future.
Then, he went to see the princess of the Demon Race.
Princess Bixiao still stayed in the Imperial City. When she saw Ling Han, she immediately asked expectantly, “You are going to the Nine Suns Holy Land, right?”
“That’s right, what about it?” Ling Han countered.
“I was just worrying about not being able to go over. You came at the right time.”
True, with the help of Brother Monkey, Princess Bixiao awakened the power of her bloodline. By now, she could also be considered a Natural Divine Physique. This was in line with the
recruitment criteria of the Nine Suns Holy Land.
“Alright, then let’s go together.”

There wasn’t much to delay on the Celestial Sea Planet, and Ling Han didn’t visit Chen Fengyan either. After all, he was a Spiritual Transformation True Lord, so he was afraid that Chen Fengyan would be embarrassed if he saw him. Thus, it was best not to meet him.
Ling Han had Tang Yun’er take out the shuttle. They returned to the Moonlight Planet. There was a Transfer Formation there, which was much faster than the shuttle.

A month later, they arrived at the Moonlight Planet. Lin Luo and the others had long since set out. Ling Han did not stay idle either, and began his journey with the empress and the others. After taking seven consecutive Transfer Formations, they had no choice but to stop and find a place to stay.

If I truly want to reap great rewards, I’ll have to wait until the last Mystery Realm,” Ling Han said.

It was still the examination stage for the Ancient Sun Saint, so being able to obtain nourishing multicolored light in addition to the cultivation technique, as well as a treasured sword, was already quite impressive.
“Sigh, what a miserly Saint,” the large black dog mocked.
“That’s right, too stingy.” Hu Niu also joined in agreement.
“Let’s go.”
They exited the Mystery Realm, and Ling Han had already erased all the relevant memories of the members of the Liu Clan.
He headed directly to the Imperial City.
Ling Han first went to visit Xuanyuan Dingguo.

Xuanyuan Dingguo had finally advanced into the Foundation Building Tier, but because of his natural talent, it was possible that he wouldn’t be able to break through to the Cauldron Forging Tier in the next one to two hundred years.
Ling Han left a great many Foundation Dissolution Pills for Xuanyuan Dingguo, hoping to lend him a helping hand so he would have a chance to advance into the
Cauldron Forging Tier in the future.
Then, he went to see the princess of the Demon Race.
Princess Bixiao still stayed in the Imperial City.
When she saw Ling Han, she immediately asked expectantly, “You are going to the Nine Suns Holy Land, right?”
“That’s right, what about it?” Ling Han countered.
“I was just worrying about not being able to go over.
You came at the right time.”
True, with the help of Brother Monkey, Princess Bixiao awakened the power of her bloodline.
By now, she could also be considered a Natural Divine Physique.
This was in line with the
recruitment criteria of the Nine Suns Holy Land.
“Alright, then let’s go together.”
There wasn’t much to delay on the Celestial Sea Planet, and Ling Han didn’t visit Chen Fengyan either.
After all, he was a Spiritual Transformation True Lord, so he was afraid that Chen Fengyan would be embarrassed if he saw him.
Thus, it was best not to meet him.
Ling Han had Tang Yun’er take out the shuttle.
They returned to the Moonlight Planet.
There was a Transfer Formation there, which was much faster than the shuttle.
A month later, they arrived at the Moonlight Planet.
Lin Luo and the others had long since set out.
Ling Han did not stay idle either, and began his journey with the empress and the others.
After taking seven consecutive Transfer Formations, they had no choice but to stop and find a place to stay.

chapters.title: Chapter 3812: Setting up a Tournament Stage
paragraphs: Every time one used the Transfer Formation, it would cause a certain burden on his body. The farther the distance was, the greater this burden would be. As time accumulated, it would
cause extremely great damage.
Someone used Transfer Formation 17 times in a row, and when they came out for the last time, their whole person was torn to shreds by the power of Space.
Thus, after using Transfer Formation a few times, Ling Han decided to rest. They would set out again after they had completely recovered.
After staying here for a few days, they set out again.
And just like that, they stopped here and there. A month later, they finally arrived at the Nine Suns Planet.

The Nine Suns Planet was the planet where Nine Suns Holy Land was located. It didn’t have this name before, but the Nine Suns Saint was too famous. At the time, he was known as the number one elite in the universe, and it was only when the Ancestral King Lingtian became an Emperor that he was ranked second.
Calculating the time, this was something that had happened almost 100 million years ago.

There were no immortal beings in this world, and even those as powerful as Ancestral Kings could only live for tens of millions of years. Saints only had a lifespan of a million years, and this was under the condition that they lived for the fullest extent of their lifespan. In truth, there was practically no one that could live that long, unless they had obtained a Saintly medicine that could extend their lifespan.
Ling Han was very rueful. Even the strongest Ancestral King would have his lifespan end, and his lifetime of invincibility would ultimately come to an end.
From this aspect, wouldn’t it be better to live in the Genesis World?

He laughed in spite of himself. Unless the Divine Stone was indestructible, so the Genesis World would be able to exist eternally, but once it was destroyed, all the living beings inside would only die.
In this way, even if he could live for a few more epochs, so what? His life and death would still have to depend on the will of heaven.
His fate had to be grasped in his own hands.
Ling Han’s willpower became firm again, and he no longer worried about personal gains and losses.

The empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog and the others had already ranked in the top 10,000 on the Galaxy Network. Princess Bixiao had an Innate Divine Physique, so it was equivalent to her directly obtaining the qualifications to register. They only had to confirm it through the Galaxy Network when the time came.
Ling Han couldn’t do the same. He had to think of some other way to obtain the qualification to register.
The simplest method was to fight, and make a name for himself. Then, the Nine Suns Holy Land would naturally personally send him the qualifications to register.
He would do as he said.
Ling Han arrogantly set up a martial arts ring and raised a banner with the words “Cauldron Forging Tier’s number one elite” on it, beginning a round of mockery.

Some people were disdainful, and thought that Ling Han was merely grandstanding, deliberately attracting attention. However, some people were displeased, and issued a challenge to him. Naturally, they suffered a terrible defeat.
In these few days, Ling Han did not suffer a single defeat. Naturally, his reputation spread widely, which also attracted some truly powerful people.
However, it was useless no matter who challenged him. Ling Han easily won, displaying his invincibility.

This reputation naturally spread wider and wider, and also caused heated discussions on the Galaxy Network. Some people even called for elites ranked in the top ten thousand to suppress Ling Han. How could they allow a little-known brat to be so arrogant?
It wasn’t long before someone replied, wanting to meet Ling Han.
This person’s name was Lu Jianyun, and he was ranked in the 9000s on Galaxy Network. He was extremely impressive, and on a planet, he would definitely be one of the top elites. He was a true prodigy.
“With Brother Lu stepping out, haha, that guy’s good days would come to an end.”
“Ling Han, where did he pop out from?”
“It seems to be the Moonlight Planet.”
“What? A planet that hasn’t even produced a Saint before?”
“That’s right. He’s a country bumpkin from this kind of small place. He thinks that he’s
invincible in the world just because he defeated a few nobodies.”
“Hehe, those who are truly capable are all on the Galaxy Network.”
“When and where are they going to fight? I want to join in on the excitement.”
“Let’s go together.”

A great many people expressed their desire to go and watch the battle, and Lu Jianyun was also very generous, saying that he would give everyone time. He would only go and issue a challenge three days later, so that everyone would have enough time to rush over.
Of course, this was only for those who had already arrived at the Nine Suns Planet. It could not
be done for those who were still in some corner of the galaxy.
But it was all right. There would definitely be people who would broadcast it live through Galaxy Network.
Ling Han naturally heard about it as well, and couldn’t help but smile, not taking it to heart at
all.
Three days’ time passed very quickly. After Ling Han had finished cultivating, he went outside to set up a martial arts ring.
When it was almost noon, a great many streaks of light appeared in the horizon. Upon a closer look, this was a great many people flying on their respective Tools.

Xiu, xiu, xiu! Multiple figures descended, and surrounded by people, a young man strode out. He was tall and slender, and his hair was black and thick. He had a kind of divine light of Dao, and would make anyone who saw him feel a pleasing feeling.
Lu Jianyun had come?
Ling Han only glanced at him for a moment before withdrawing his gaze. Who cared who he was? Even if Origin or Myriad Dao came, he wouldn’t be afraid of a battle.
That’s right, had those three fierce people come yet?
“So you are Ling Han?” The young man in the lead had already leaped onto the tournament stage, casting a disdainful sideways glance at Ling Han.
Ling Han scoffed, “If you weren’t an idiot, you wouldn’t have asked such a low-level
question.”
The young man’s expression changed drastically. However, before he could even open his mouth to speak, a wave of curses swept through the crowd.
“How arrogant! Who does he think he is? He actually dares to speak to Brother Lu like this!”
“Brother Lu is ranked 9632nd in the Cauldron Forging Tier of the Galaxy Network.”
“You’re wrong. That was yesterday’s ranking. Today, he’s already ranked 9629th.”
“Yi, he has improved again? Brother Lu really has boundless future prospects. He has advanced into the top 10,000, and can still maintain a steady rise in his ranking.”
“As expected of a super genius.”
“After entering Nine Suns Holy Land, Brother Lu’s ranking will definitely increase greatly.”

Lu Jianyun’s anger turned into pride. Did you hear that? Just what kind of existence was he? “What are you standing around for? Aren’t you going to make a move?” Ling Han shook his head, “What is it? Have you come to be a mascot?”
Lu Jianyun instantly exploded in fury. With a furious roar, he charged towards Ling Han.
He couldn’t hold himself back any longer. Who cared if he was gentlemanly or not, or if he was showing off? Right now, he only wanted to give Ling Han a good beating.

Being able to rank in the top 10,000 of the Galaxy Network, Lu Jianyun’s strength was indeed extraordinary. He used a celestial technique, and the image of a great mountain appeared above his head. As he charged out, the mountains also fell one after another towards Ling Han. They were incredibly real, as if they wanted to smash him to pieces. Without using the Spirit Tool, it was completely a display of one’s own strength.
Ling Han remained seated and unmoving. When the other’s attack arrived, he finally threw a
punch at Lu Jianyun.
This punch... how could it be described?
In Lu Jianyun’s eyes, this was like a planet had crashed down on him. In front of this kind of punch, he was as insignificant as an ant, feeling extremely helpless.
Boom, the punch landed, and Lu Jianyun was instantly sent flying, directly falling off the
tournament stage.
The cheers and shouts from below came to an abrupt stop. All of them were numb with shock.
It was only a single punch, and Lu Jianyun had already been defeated. Just how wide was the
gap in strength between them?
“Hiss, no matter what, this person has to be one of the top 9000 in Galaxy Network.” “That’s right. The gap between top 10,000 and top 9,000 is like the gap between heaven and
earth.”
“Since this Ling Han is so strong, why is he still fighting on the tournament stage? He can
directly obtain the qualification to register.” “Er, perhaps he is deliberately showing off.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3813: Gathering of prodigies and beauties
paragraphs: No matter how pretentious Ling Han was, it was a fact that he had defeated Lu Jianyun.
Thus, when Ling Han put away the tournament stage and was about to return, a great many people immediately gathered around him, wanting to befriend him.
Ling Han didn’t deliberately offend anyone. He said some pleasantries, but didn’t say anything substantial.
Just as Ling Han was about to return, he was stopped by an elder.
“This old man is from the Nine Suns Holy Land. Does young friend have time?” the old man asked.
Hadn’t Ling Han set up this martial arts ring to attract people from the Nine Suns Holy Land? He smiled, “Yes.”
“Hehe, then let’s chat as we walk,” the old man said with a smile.
The two of them walked forwards, but though the old man said that he wanted to chat, he did not speak the whole time.
Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry either. He simply acted as if the person beside him didn’t exist.
After a long while, the old man finally spoke, and asked, “Young friend, why have you set up such a tournament stage?”

Ling Han told the truth, “I have not fulfilled the registration conditions of the Holy Land, so I can only come up with this last resort. I hope that the Holy Land can open a back door and allow me to register.”

“Yi?” This answer was something that the old man had not expected. He looked at Ling Han, his expression filled with surprise. ‘You are already capable of sending Lu Jianyun flying with a single punch, and your Galaxy Network’s ranking is at least in the top 9000, and you still have not met the conditions?’
Ling Han smiled and said, “Because of some personal reasons, I didn’t participate in the ranking battles.”
So that was how i was.

The old man believed him, because there were indeed some great clans that did not allow their descendants to participate in the ranking battles. Some did so because they wanted to keep a low profile, while some wanted to amaze the world with a single feat. Though there were not many, there were indeed such cases.

“So that’s how it is.” The old man also smiled, “All right, this old man understands. In view of your situation, the Holy Land will indeed have special circumstances to deal with you. Where do you live? In a few days, this old man will apply for a permit to enter, and I will deliver it to you.”
“Then thank you very much.”
The old man left, and Ling Han returned to the inn. He had already achieved his goal, so there was naturally no need for him to set up another tournament stage.
However, when he stopped setting up the martial arts ring, it caused a heated discussion on the Galaxy Network.

Most people thought that Ling Han had cowered. Now that Lu Jianyun had lost, there would definitely be even stronger prodigies ranked in the top 9000 and top 8000 that would appear to challenge him, and Ling Han knew that he was outmatched, so he took the initiative to close up.
“What a sore loser.”
“What Cauldron Forging Tier elite? What a joke.”
“Coward.”
The Galaxy Network was filled with curses, which made the empress, Hu Niu, and Princess Bixiao extremely furious.
Yet Ling Han was unconcerned, and waited for the day of the test to arrive.

Only by satisfying one of the three conditions of the Nine Suns Holy Land, would one be qualified to register. Whether one could become an official disciple or not would still have to go through a formal selection process.

A few days later, the old man delivered the entry plaque to Ling Han, so that Ling Han would drip blood in front of him, completing the soul bond. Otherwise, merely the entry plaque could completely be gifted to another.

When the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog went to register, they also received a permit to enter after their certifications were approved. Dripping blood on the plaque, the entry permit was completed.

There was only a month left, and the first opening of the Nine Suns Holy Land to recruit disciples would be held. If they missed it, they would have to wait until next year, and there would only be ten such chances. Ten years later, the Nine Suns Holy Land would close its doors again, and who knew when it would open again.
Ling Han cultivated diligently every day. After switching to cultivating the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, his advancement speed increased slightly.
A month passed, and he had already completely cultivated the third leg of the Heaven Cauldron.

The Heaven Cauldron was the limit of the ordinary Cauldron Forging Tier. However, Ling Han naturally wouldn’t be satisfied with the Heaven Cauldron. He wanted to cultivate to the limit of Nine Cauldrons.

However, from Heaven Cauldron to Four Cauldrons, this step was difficult to take. Even Ling Han couldn’t break through just like that. Instead, he needed a certain amount of time to accumulate enough power.

After all, he had become a Heaven Cauldron the moment he broke through. This process was too fast. Even if he didn’t break through to Four Cauldrons, he still needed to stabilize his cultivation level.
At this time, the Nine Suns Holy Land officially began recruiting disciples.

It could be said that aside from places that were really too remote, the majority of the prodigies in the galaxy had all come. In fact, there was no shortage of descendants of Ancestral Kings and heirs of Great Emperors.

For celestial techniques like Saint-level and Great Emperor-level, no matter how much one learns, it would not be too much. That was unless one himself had reached Saint-level. By then, he would really begin to walk his own path, and attempt to become the Ancestral King that only one person in ten million years could reach.
Thus, exclamations of shock would occasionally erupt from the crowd. Who and who had come, a certain person had come, that person had arrived.
“Imperial Clan, Lin Qi. Though he is not the strongest successor, he is ranked 207th in the Galaxy Network. This is practically enough to scare anyone to death.”
“Look at his hair. It’s actually burning with energy flames. This is too terrifying.”
“This kind of person can insta-kill Heaven Cauldron with a single move, right?”
“That is necessary. It is said that Lin Qi has formed seven cauldrons. Who among the prodigies of this generation would be able to surpass him?”
“Seven! Cauldrons!”
“And over there, the Dao Child of the Eight Treasures Holy Land, Gan Ping, and ranked 188th
on the Galaxy Network.”
“Though he is not a descendant of a Great Emperor, and does not have the strongest bloodline, it is said that he is a Saint Physique!”
“Jie Yingqiu, the Holy Daughter of the Flower Rain Sect. Though she is only ranked in the 2000s, she is still one of the 100 great beauties of the universe. She is indeed breathtakingly
beautiful!”
“Tan Meng, the princess of the Golden Silk Moth Holy Land, and also a seductive beauty on the beauty roll.”
“Jiang Yifei, Holy Daughter of the Great Forest Sect, ranked seventy-second on the Beauty Leaderboard.”
“How beautiful. If I could marry such a beautiful wife, I would have no regrets in this life.”

“Heh, you’re overthinking things. Which of the top 100 beauties in the galaxy isn’t proud and arrogant? Even if they want to marry someone, they’ll have to marry someone who’s ranked in the top 100 in terms of abilities.”
In this place, elites with powerful abilities were certainly sought after, and exquisite beauties
were also attractive.
Hu Niu was instantly defiant, and said, “Niu is much better looking than them.”
Ling Han laughed loudly, wrapped his arms around her, and said, “Of course.” “Pfft.” The person beside him immediately laughed. He was really shameless. He actually
said that she was even more beautiful than Jie Yingqiu and Tan Meng. Where had his confidence come from?
Ling Han glared at him, and his aura spread out slightly. That person’s face immediately paled, and he could not make another sound.

This was only the first year of disciple recruitment. It was possible that some prodigies were too far away and hadn’t arrived yet. Some might be at a critical stage of their cultivation, while others might have been adventuring in an ancient site and hadn’t gotten the news. In short, among the people who had come now, there were about two thousand in the top ten thousand in the Cauldron Forging Tier of the Galaxy Network, and the majority ranged from one thousand to ten thousand. There were relatively few in the top few hundred.
The highest ranked person was Gan Ping, ranked 188th.
Meanwhile, eleven beauties from the Universal Exquisite Leaderboard had arrived. Tan Meng
was ranked fifty-third, and the most powerful beauty was Jie Yingqiu, ranked more than 2000th on the individual strength leaderboard.
In fact, there were also those who possessed both beauty and strength. For example, those in
the top ten of the Exquisite Leaderboard were all super geniuses ranked in the top 100 of
Galaxy Network.
“Cough, then the selections have officially begun.”

Yet Ling Han was unconcerned, and waited for the day of the test to arrive.
Only by satisfying one of the three conditions of the Nine Suns Holy Land, would one be qualified to register.
Whether one could become an official disciple or not would still have to go through a formal selection process.
A few days later, the old man delivered the entry plaque to Ling Han, so that Ling Han would drip blood in front of him, completing the soul bond.
Otherwise, merely the entry plaque could completely be gifted to another.
When the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog went to register, they also received a permit to enter after their certifications were approved.
Dripping blood on the plaque, the entry permit was completed.
There was only a month left, and the first opening of the Nine Suns Holy Land to recruit disciples would be held.
If they missed it, they would have to wait until next year, and there would only be ten such chances.
Ten years later, the Nine Suns Holy Land would close its doors again, and who knew when it would open again.
Ling Han cultivated diligently every day.
After switching to cultivating the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, his advancement speed increased slightly.
A month passed, and he had already completely cultivated the third leg of the Heaven Cauldron.
The Heaven Cauldron was the limit of the ordinary Cauldron Forging Tier.
However, Ling Han naturally wouldn’t be satisfied with the Heaven Cauldron.
He wanted to cultivate to the limit of Nine Cauldrons.
However, from Heaven Cauldron to Four Cauldrons, this step was difficult to take.
Even Ling Han couldn’t break through just like that.
Instead, he needed a certain amount of time to accumulate enough power.
After all, he had become a Heaven Cauldron the moment he broke through.
This process was too fast.
Even if he didn’t break through to Four Cauldrons, he still needed to stabilize his cultivation level.
At this time, the Nine Suns Holy Land officially began recruiting disciples.
It could be said that aside from places that were really too remote, the majority of the prodigies in the galaxy had all come.
In fact, there was no shortage of descendants of Ancestral Kings and heirs of Great Emperors.
For celestial techniques like Saint-level and Great Emperor-level, no matter how much one learns, it would not be too much.
That was unless one himself had reached Saint-level.
By then, he would really begin to walk his own path, and attempt to become the Ancestral King that only one person in ten million years could reach.
Thus, exclamations of shock would occasionally erupt from the crowd.
Who and who had come, a certain person had come, that person had arrived.
“Imperial Clan, Lin Qi.
Though he is not the strongest successor, he is ranked 207th in the Galaxy Network.
This is practically enough to scare anyone to death.”
“Look at his hair.
It’s actually burning with energy flames.
This is too terrifying.”
“This kind of person can insta-kill Heaven Cauldron with a single move, right?”
“That is necessary.
It is said that Lin Qi has formed seven cauldrons.
Who among the prodigies of this generation would be able to surpass him?”
“Seven!
Cauldrons!”
“And over there, the Dao Child of the Eight Treasures Holy Land, Gan Ping, and ranked 188th
on the Galaxy Network.”
“Though he is not a descendant of a Great Emperor, and does not have the strongest bloodline, it is said that he is a Saint Physique!”
“Jie Yingqiu, the Holy Daughter of the Flower Rain Sect.
Though she is only ranked in the 2000s, she is still one of the 100 great beauties of the universe.
She is indeed breathtakingly
beautiful!”
“Tan Meng, the princess of the Golden Silk Moth Holy Land, and also a seductive beauty on the beauty roll.”
“Jiang Yifei, Holy Daughter of the Great Forest Sect, ranked seventy-second on the Beauty Leaderboard.”
“How beautiful.
If I could marry such a beautiful wife, I would have no regrets in this life.”
“Heh, you’re overthinking things.
Which of the top 100 beauties in the galaxy isn’t proud and arrogant?
Even if they want to marry someone, they’ll have to marry someone who’s ranked in the top 100 in terms of abilities.”
In this place, elites with powerful abilities were certainly sought after, and exquisite beauties
were also attractive.
Hu Niu was instantly defiant, and said, “Niu is much better looking than them.”
Ling Han laughed loudly, wrapped his arms around her, and said, “Of course.” “Pfft.” The person beside him immediately laughed.
He was really shameless.
He actually
said that she was even more beautiful than Jie Yingqiu and Tan Meng.
Where had his confidence come from?
Ling Han glared at him, and his aura spread out slightly.
That person’s face immediately paled, and he could not make another sound.
This was only the first year of disciple recruitment.
It was possible that some prodigies were too far away and hadn’t arrived yet.
Some might be at a critical stage of their cultivation, while others might have been adventuring in an ancient site and hadn’t gotten the news.

In short, among the people who had come now, there were about two thousand in the top ten thousand in the Cauldron Forging Tier of the Galaxy Network, and the majority ranged from one thousand to ten thousand.
There were relatively few in the top few hundred.
The highest ranked person was Gan Ping, ranked 188th.
Meanwhile, eleven beauties from the Universal Exquisite Leaderboard had arrived.
Tan Meng
was ranked fifty-third, and the most powerful beauty was Jie Yingqiu, ranked more than 2000th on the individual strength leaderboard.
In fact, there were also those who possessed both beauty and strength.
For example, those in
the top ten of the Exquisite Leaderboard were all super geniuses ranked in the top 100 of
Galaxy Network.
“Cough, then the selections have officially begun.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3814: Contesting for the position of captain
paragraphs: An old man walked out from the Holy Land. He looked to be in his sixties.
He was extremely powerful, and he had to be at least at the True Self Tier. He was like a sun as he stood there, attracting everyone’s attention.

“The test is very simple. You guys will be divided into groups first, with every ten people forming a team. Then, you’ll be sent to the Barbaric Star Xing. Ferocious beasts rampage there, and it’s an incomparably desolate land. You guys have ten days to hunt ferocious beasts and killing different ferocious beasts will gain you different points.”
“Points will be recorded for the team. Ten days later, the remaining people in the team will share their points evenly. Those ranked in the top hundred can become the disciples of the Holy Land.”
“Let me explain in detail.”

“Before you all enter into the Barbaric Planet, each of you will receive a special connection device. This was created by our Holy Land, and is only limited to the seven great planets in the territory of our Holy Land.”
“On the Barbaric Planet, you all cannot harm your competitors, but can plunder and destroy the connecting devices of your opponents.”
“Once you lose the connection device, it means that you have failed this selection.”
“Additionally, at least three members have to be retained on the team. Otherwise, no matter how high the score is, they would all be eliminated.”

“Additionally, the connecting devices can only communicate with the members of the small team at present, and ask for help from the Holy Land – if you encounter a ferocious beast that is too powerful, and endanger your lives, you can ask for help, but once you ask for help, you will be eliminated.”
“All right, let’s begin the grouping.”
The groupings were very simple. They were not drawing lots, but rather following the order in which they had previously obtained the entry plaque.

In this way, Ling Han would have to separate from the empress and the others, and the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog, and the babies would have a high chance of being in the same group, if it was coincidental.
“You guys be careful. If you encounter danger, there’s no harm in asking for help. Safety first,” Ling Han said.
“En.” The empress and Hu Niu both nodded.

However, the Cauldron Forging Tier and Foundation Building Tier cultivators were screened separately. Though they were all entering the Barbaric Planet, Foundation Building Tier and Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators would definitely not be placed in the same group. Thus, even if Ling Han, the empress, and the others had gotten the entry plaque together at the time, there was still nothing that could be done.

The masses began to divide into groups, and very quickly, groups of ten were formed. The Foundation Building Tier cultivators and the Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators entered the Transfer Formation respectively. As the light surged, they immediately disappeared. Transfer was done in small teams, and the destination of each transfer was random. However, the Foundation Building Tier cultivators were all in the southern hemisphere, while the Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators were in the northern hemisphere. There were formations separating them, and it was definitely impossible for them to communicate with each other. Ling Han was ranked very far behind. He had finally reached his turn after waiting for about an hour, and he stepped into the Transfer Formation with his nine teammates. With a flash of light, they had already arrived on another planet.
The Barbaric Planet was a planet without a sea. Its surface was covered with an incredibly dense primitive forest, and the tall trees were even three thousand meters tall, taller than some mountains.
The group of ten appeared under a large tree. The ground was covered with thick fallen leaves, soft and limp. Even if they fell, they would not be injured.

“Let’s choose a captain first!” A young man in blue robes was the first to speak up, “My name is Luo Shan, and I am a Bright Moon Divine Physique. I hope that I can lead everyone into the top hundred.”

“Hehe, a mere fifth grade Divine Physique cultivator actually dares to be so confident?” a man in green said disdainfully. He raised his thumb and pointed at himself, “Ma Gang, Heaven Cauldron Tier, Golden Celestial Cauldron!”
“You guys had best stand aside!” Another person stepped out, “Huang Lingyun, ranked 8532nd on the Galaxy Network!”
Whatever Innate Divine Physique, Golden Celestial Cauldron were all empty words. Cultivation depended on abilities, and the ranking on the Galaxy Network was the best proof of that.

With Huang Lingyun’s words, the two people from before immediately shut up obediently. “Hehe, what a coincidence.” A young man with long flowing hair shook his head, “Mu Long, ranked 8366th in the Galaxy Network.”
Shua! Huang Lingyun immediately looked over, and said with a smile, “Then I’ll have to ask for some guidance.”
“Come!” Mu Long naturally would not cower. The two of them leaped out, and began a great battle.

Fighting here naturally meant having no scruples, but what was shocking was that those great trees were very, very sturdy. Furthermore, their leaves also had a very strong absorption effect. Thus, though a large portion of the surrounding trees had fallen, their destructive power was also contained in this area.
Otherwise, if two Cauldron Forging Tier elites battled fiercely, the surrounding mountains would all be flattened.
Ling Han yawned, and did not go and watch the battle between Huang Lingyun and Mu Long, because the strongest in the team was not them at all. In fact, they could not even be ranked in
the top three.

He looked towards a person. That was an astonishingly sturdy man. Sitting there, he was not much shorter than an ordinary person standing, like he was a small mountain, and from within his body, Ling Han could see an incredibly vigorous power. His whole person was like a furnace that could burn the heavens and destroy the earth.
Aside from this sturdy man, there was also a young man in purple robes. He was tall and slender, and had a graceful bearing, possessing a carefree air that was above the mortal world.
This person should not be weak either. The others were only so-so.

He was thinking about the rules created by the Nine Suns Holy Land. There were ten people in a group, yet in the end, they still had to share the points equally. What if more of them were burdens? Wouldn’t that implicate the entire team?
However, there was also another rule, and that was that even their own people could be kicked out. They only had to destroy the connection device of the other party.
Then could he directly suppress the number of team members to the lowest limit of three?
Unless it could be guaranteed that the connection devices of the three of them would not be lost, even if two of them could sweep aside all opposition and be invincible, they would still
be eliminated in the end.
Thus, this rule was quite interesting.

As he mulled over this, the battle between Huang Lingyun and Mu Long also came to a stop. After all, this was only a battle for the position of captain, and the right to have a say. There was no need for them to use their trump card.
Furthermore, more importantly, this was to probe the background of every member of the team. Whom they needed to rope in, and who they needed to give up, so as not to hold them
back.
After a short battle, Huang Lingyun and his opponent both acknowledged each other’s strength.
The victor was Mu Long.
“No one has any objections to me becoming the captain, right?” Mu Long asked calmly. He walked in front of Ma Gang, and asked, “Do you yield?”
Ma Gang’s expression changed. In the end, he still lowered his head, and said, “I concede.”
He had watched the battle between Huang Lingyun and Mu Long, and his battle prowess was indeed superior to his. He had no choice but to admit defeat.
“Do you yield?” Mu Long asked Luo Shan again.
“I concede.”
A satisfied smile appeared on Mu Long’s face, and he turned to the third person, “Do you
yield?”
“I concede.”
“Do you yield?”
“I concede.”
It wasn’t long before five people in the team nodded in agreement. Taking into account the defeated Huang Lingyun, only Ling Han, the sturdy man, and the young man in purple were
left.
“Do you yield?” Mu Long arrived in front of the sturdy man.
“I do not.” The sturdy man raised his head. His hair was disheveled, and his face was covered
with stubble. He was also wearing animal hide, and looked like a wild man.
Mu Long was taken aback. He was not conceding?
“He, then I will make you concede defeat!” He stretched out a hand to grab the sturdy man.

chapters.title: Chapter 3815: Four Cauldrons!
paragraphs: Mu Long’s palm strike arrived.

He was ranked in the 8000s on the Galaxy Network, and his abilities could be considered extremely terrifying. Even if he had not used his full power in this palm strike, it was still as if the heavens were collapsing and the earth was cracking.
The sturdy man moved. He stood up, and it was as if a small mountain had suddenly become a large mountain. Then, he delivered a palm strike at Mu Long.

There was no flash of light. This palm strike was extremely simple, but as the palm strike passed, peng, Mu Long was sent flying like a cannonball. He crashed heavily into a large tree, and directly created a human-shaped hole. Then, he broke through the large tree, and continued to crash backwards.
In a single stroke, he had crashed through eleven great trees, and only then did Mu Long finally stop. He collapsed onto the ground, unable to get back to his feet.
Hiss, it was only a single palm strike, and an elite in the 8000s on the Galaxy Network was directly sent flying?
This was too shocking.
This was something that no one had expected, and they all looked at this sturdy man in shock. As it turned out, this was the true elite that had hidden himself.
Even the young man in purple withdrew his absent-minded expression, and began to carefully examine the sturdy man.
“You-“The sturdy man pointed at Huang Lingyun, “Do you yield?”
Huang Lingyun couldn’t help but feel extremely vexed. Previously, it was Mu Long who had been strutting around, so why had he sought him out for revenge?

However, he had sent Mu Long flying with a single strike. This was indeed due to Mu Long’s carelessness. However, this sturdy man’s strength was definitely terrifyingly strong, enough to rank in the top eight thousand of the Galaxy Network.
After entering into the top 10,000, ordinarily, every difference of 1000 would be a crushing gap, and if one entered into the top 1000, there would be a huge gap every 100 places.
He lowered his head and did not speak. He still had his pride.
However, the sturdy man strode over, his massive figure casting a long shadow. “Do you yield?”
By the looks of it, he was about to deliver a palm strike.
Huang Lingyun could only open his mouth, and say, “I concede.”
Only then did the sturdy man break into a grin, and said to everyone, “My name is Wu Qiyuan. I am nineteen years old this year.”
Pu!
Quite a number of people spluttered. This burly, bearded man was actually only nineteen years old? Which mountain had this savage come from?

However, those who were laughing immediately withdrew their contemptuous expressions. This Wu Qiyuan was too strong, and possessed such strength. Who could underestimate him? “Little Brother Wu, let me experience your guidance!” The young man in purple finally stood up. He smiled slightly, and was extremely gentle, as if he was harmless, “My name is Yuwen Tian. I have not fought the Galaxy Network Level Battles yet, so I have no ranking. However, I should have formed a few more Celestial Cauldrons than all of you.”

When everyone heard this, they all scoffed. What kind of joke was this? Did he think that they were all Human Cauldrons or Earth Cauldrons? And he said he had cultivated a few more Celestial Cauldrons? Wasn’t he afraid that they would laugh themelves to death?
Yuwen Tian did not argue either, and showed his Celestial Cauldron, one at a time, hovering above his head.
One, two, three... four cauldrons!
F***, instantly, everyone was stunned. Four Cauldrons, it was actually Four Cauldrons.
It was common knowledge that the peak stage of the Cauldron Forging Tier was Heaven Cauldron, and one would only need to form three cauldrons, and forming four cauldrons would be breaking the limit.
Who could break through their limits?
A prodigy among prodigies.

Hiss, this Yuwen Tian was really too shocking. He had actually formed four cauldrons. Then, even in the Galaxy Network, he would be ranked in the top thousand, at least. In fact, he would be ranked in the top seven hundred.
Who would have thought that such a monster would actually appear among them?

Wu Qiyuan scratched his head with his long and thick fingers, and said in slight confusion, “Yi, you also have four Celestial Cauldrons, huh? My crippled Master that told me to cultivate lied, and said that there would not be a thousand such people in the whole universe.”
Pu!
Everyone spluttered again.
‘Did you hear what this guy said?’
“Also.”
Hiss, this guy also had four cauldrons?
At first, Yuwen Tian’s expression was one of showing off, but now, it immediately crumbled, appearing extremely depressed.
How was their group allocated?
There were actually two Four Cauldrons!

Being able to break through his limits and form four cauldrons, and even more in fact, there were at most a thousand of them in the galaxy at present, but merely participating in a competition to enter the Holy Land, there were actually two such existences in a team of ten. What kind of bullsh*t probability was that?
Wu Qiyuan had lied?
Yuwen Tian shook his head internally. One look, and he could tell that this guy was the honest type. It was already very inconceivable that he could lie, what more when he had to speak in
such a refreshing and natural manner.
Failing to show off, Yuwen Tian sighed.

Actually, he was a very secretive person, and that was why he had been suppressing himself all this while, waiting for the best chance to make a grand appearance. He had waited for this chance, but the effects had not reached his expectations, which made him feel really
depressed.
“All right, come fight me!” His fighting spirit blazed, his eyes bright.
Wu Qiyuan would not be reserved either. With a loud roar, he charged forwards. Like a wild bull, he just barged around like that.

Though there was nothing fancy about this, his physique was astonishing. With a single step, the whole ground would shake violently with a rumble, showing his terrifying power. If one was hit like this, it was guaranteed that any Cauldron Forging Tier would be in trouble. Yuwen Tian did not dare to take it head-on either. He turned the Celestial Cauldron around, and two streaks of white and black light descended, turning into multiple barriers, while he
retreated continuously.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Wu Qiyuan charged all the way, shattering those black and white barriers, one after another. His speed was practically unaffected.
“F***, are you forged from Divine Metal? You’re practically a freak!” Yuwen Tian couldn’t
help but complain.

Yet Wu Qiyuan did not make a sound. He had grown up in the primitive areas, and battled with powerful wild beasts every day. How could he open his mouth to speak when he was fighting desperately with the wild beasts? The slightest distraction would mean death.
His battle style was extremely primitive, and that was close-quarter combat. He would use his tough physique to take the attack head-on, and then use his violent power to kill his
opponent.
Faced with such a desperate stance, Yuwen Tian was extremely depressed. All techniques were
useless in front of such a barbaric style of fighting.
This was too barbaric, and too lacking in skill.
After exchanging a few more blows, his anger had also risen. He no longer dodged, but rather
greeted the incoming attack brazenly, “Do you really think that I am afraid of you?”
He formed his hands into palms, and clashed head-on with Wu Qiyuan.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
They exchanged a dozen over blows, and both of them were trembling madly.

Wu Qiyuan bared his teeth in a grin, “How fun!” He was sent back more than thirty meters, but he merely shook his body, and then charged back again as if nothing had happened. Yet Yuwen Tian wanted to throw up blood. His physique was far from being as tough as this. This kind of head-on confrontation was too disadvantageous for him.
His expression was solemn, and with a battle cry, multiple green sword blades appeared
around him.

Wu Qiyuan charged over. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Those green-coloured blades immediately slashed towards him. The blades were too sharp, and left behind multiple wounds on his bare upper body. Though they were not very deep, they still managed to wound this bull-like guy. “Die!” However, Wu Qiyuan’s blood only caused him to become even more frenzied. His eyes were bloodshot, and his offensive became even fiercer, forcing Yuwen Tian to put his life on the line. Otherwise, if he still held back, he would definitely die. Ling Han shook his head, and strode forwards. He had to mediate the fight.
