This was something that no one had expected, and they all looked at this sturdy man in shock.
As it turned out, this was the true elite that had hidden himself.
Even the young man in purple withdrew his absent-minded expression, and began to carefully examine the sturdy man.
“You-“The sturdy man pointed at Huang Lingyun, “Do you yield?”
Huang Lingyun couldn’t help but feel extremely vexed.
Previously, it was Mu Long who had been strutting around, so why had he sought him out for revenge?
However, he had sent Mu Long flying with a single strike.
This was indeed due to Mu Long’s carelessness.
However, this sturdy man’s strength was definitely terrifyingly strong, enough to rank in the top eight thousand of the Galaxy Network.
After entering into the top 10,000, ordinarily, every difference of 1000 would be a crushing gap, and if one entered into the top 1000, there would be a huge gap every 100 places.
He lowered his head and did not speak.
He still had his pride.
However, the sturdy man strode over, his massive figure casting a long shadow.
“Do you yield?”
By the looks of it, he was about to deliver a palm strike.
Huang Lingyun could only open his mouth, and say, “I concede.”
Only then did the sturdy man break into a grin, and said to everyone, “My name is Wu Qiyuan.
I am nineteen years old this year.”
Pu!
Quite a number of people spluttered.
This burly, bearded man was actually only nineteen years old?
Which mountain had this savage come from?
However, those who were laughing immediately withdrew their contemptuous expressions.
This Wu Qiyuan was too strong, and possessed such strength.
Who could underestimate him?
“Little Brother Wu, let me experience your guidance!” The young man in purple finally stood up.
He smiled slightly, and was extremely gentle, as if he was harmless, “My name is Yuwen Tian.
I have not fought the Galaxy Network Level Battles yet, so I have no ranking.
However, I should have formed a few more Celestial Cauldrons than all of you.”
When everyone heard this, they all scoffed.
What kind of joke was this?
Did he think that they were all Human Cauldrons or Earth Cauldrons?
And he said he had cultivated a few more Celestial Cauldrons?
Wasn’t he afraid that they would laugh themelves to death?
Yuwen Tian did not argue either, and showed his Celestial Cauldron, one at a time, hovering above his head.
One, two, three... four cauldrons!
F***, instantly, everyone was stunned.
Four Cauldrons, it was actually Four Cauldrons.
It was common knowledge that the peak stage of the Cauldron Forging Tier was Heaven Cauldron, and one would only need to form three cauldrons, and forming four cauldrons would be breaking the limit.
Who could break through their limits?
A prodigy among prodigies.
Hiss, this Yuwen Tian was really too shocking.
He had actually formed four cauldrons.
Then, even in the Galaxy Network, he would be ranked in the top thousand, at least.
In fact, he would be ranked in the top seven hundred.
Who would have thought that such a monster would actually appear among them?
Wu Qiyuan scratched his head with his long and thick fingers, and said in slight confusion, “Yi, you also have four Celestial Cauldrons, huh?
My crippled Master that told me to cultivate lied, and said that there would not be a thousand such people in the whole universe.”
Pu!
Everyone spluttered again.
‘Did you hear what this guy said?’
“Also.”
Hiss, this guy also had four cauldrons?
At first, Yuwen Tian’s expression was one of showing off, but now, it immediately crumbled, appearing extremely depressed.
How was their group allocated?
There were actually two Four Cauldrons!

Being able to break through his limits and form four cauldrons, and even more in fact, there were at most a thousand of them in the galaxy at present, but merely participating in a competition to enter the Holy Land, there were actually two such existences in a team of ten.
What kind of bullsh*t probability was that?
Wu Qiyuan had lied?
Yuwen Tian shook his head internally.
One look, and he could tell that this guy was the honest type.
It was already very inconceivable that he could lie, what more when he had to speak in
such a refreshing and natural manner.
Failing to show off, Yuwen Tian sighed.
Actually, he was a very secretive person, and that was why he had been suppressing himself all this while, waiting for the best chance to make a grand appearance.
He had waited for this chance, but the effects had not reached his expectations, which made him feel really
depressed.
“All right, come fight me!” His fighting spirit blazed, his eyes bright.
Wu Qiyuan would not be reserved either.
With a loud roar, he charged forwards.
Like a wild bull, he just barged around like that.
Though there was nothing fancy about this, his physique was astonishing.
With a single step, the whole ground would shake violently with a rumble, showing his terrifying power.
If one was hit like this, it was guaranteed that any Cauldron Forging Tier would be in trouble.
Yuwen Tian did not dare to take it head-on either.
He turned the Celestial Cauldron around, and two streaks of white and black light descended, turning into multiple barriers, while he
retreated continuously.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
Wu Qiyuan charged all the way, shattering those black and white barriers, one after another.
His speed was practically unaffected.
“F***, are you forged from Divine Metal?
You’re practically a freak!” Yuwen Tian couldn’t
help but complain.
Yet Wu Qiyuan did not make a sound.
He had grown up in the primitive areas, and battled with powerful wild beasts every day.
How could he open his mouth to speak when he was fighting desperately with the wild beasts?
The slightest distraction would mean death.
His battle style was extremely primitive, and that was close-quarter combat.
He would use his tough physique to take the attack head-on, and then use his violent power to kill his
opponent.
Faced with such a desperate stance, Yuwen Tian was extremely depressed.
All techniques were
useless in front of such a barbaric style of fighting.
This was too barbaric, and too lacking in skill.
After exchanging a few more blows, his anger had also risen.
He no longer dodged, but rather
greeted the incoming attack brazenly, “Do you really think that I am afraid of you?”
He formed his hands into palms, and clashed head-on with Wu Qiyuan.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
They exchanged a dozen over blows, and both of them were trembling madly.
Wu Qiyuan bared his teeth in a grin, “How fun!” He was sent back more than thirty meters, but he merely shook his body, and then charged back again as if nothing had happened.
Yet Yuwen Tian wanted to throw up blood.
His physique was far from being as tough as this.
This kind of head-on confrontation was too disadvantageous for him.
His expression was solemn, and with a battle cry, multiple green sword blades appeared
around him.
Wu Qiyuan charged over.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
Those green-coloured blades immediately slashed towards him.
The blades were too sharp, and left behind multiple wounds on his bare upper body.
Though they were not very deep, they still managed to wound this bull-like guy.
“Die!” However, Wu Qiyuan’s blood only caused him to become even more frenzied.
His eyes were bloodshot, and his offensive became even fiercer, forcing Yuwen Tian to put his life on the line.
Otherwise, if he still held back, he would definitely die.
Ling Han shook his head, and strode forwards.
He had to mediate the fight.

chapters.title: Chapter 3816: Intercession
paragraphs: Ling Han strode toward the battle.
“Hey, are you seeking death?”
“That is not a battle that you can interfere in.”

Two team members immediately shouted a reminder, but there were also some who watched coldly from the sidelines. In any case, as long as the number of people in the team was no less than three, it was fine. It just so happened that some trash would be eliminated. In this way, the battle prowess of the remaining people would be stronger, and the average score would naturally be higher as well.

Boom, Wu Qiyuan’s fist attacked fiercely, the tip of the fist tearing through the air, forming a large number of swirls of air, which turned into multiple eyes of the storm. That scene was like the end of the world.
This guy was incredible. He walked the path of strengthening his physical body, and in future, who knows, he may become a great elite that dazzled the universe.

Shua, shua, shua! The green-coloured blades continuously slashed onto his body, and there were flashes of blood. However, Wu Qiyuan only acted as if he did not know anything. He simply threw fierce punches, simple, direct and domineering.
Peng! The punch landed, and Yuwen Tian was instantly sent flying. However, his
counterattack was also incredibly fierce, and left behind a considerable number of wounds on Wu Qiyuan’s body, causing blood to gush out.
Now that the battle had progressed to this extent, it was really like how stabbing knives drew blood, and he was really angered.
“Ao!” Wu Qiyuan roared loudly, like a violent bear. He charged towards Yuwen Tian, his whole body wrapped in grey energy, filled with terrifying destructive power.
One side was putting his life on the line, and the other side naturally could not hold back either. Otherwise, he would either die in battle or be severely injured.
Moreover, Yuwen Tian was also filled with anger. Why did he have to retreat?
Who was afraid of whom?

He also roared loudly, and multiple golden veined patterns appeared all over his body. The four Celestial Cauldrons also unleashed endless Celestial Qi, which transformed into a Divine Sword that blasted towards Wu Yuan Sheng.
Not good.
Everyone was exclaiming internally. If this exchange of blows really came to be, the two of them would probably be in dire straits.
They hadn’t even begun hunting, yet two of their powerhouses had already been killed because of internal strife. How could they continue to compete with the other teams?
Right at this moment, Ling Han finally barged into the battle area.
In a flash, he stopped between Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian. In this way, it was equivalent to the attacks of both of them being directed at him.
Hiss!

Everyone inhaled sharply. Everyone could clearly see the strength of Yuwen Tian and Wu Qiyuan. Yet Ling Han had barged right in between the two of them, which was equivalent to suffering the combined attack of the two of them. How could he possibly block this?
Oh no, he was definitely going to die.
With how fast the attack speed of the two elites was, even if they discovered that their “opponent” had already switched to Ling Han, they could not possibly stop.
Firstly, it would be too late, and secondly, what if he stopped, but the other party did not? Then, the attack would still land on him through Ling Han.
That would be courting death.
Thus, they could only grit their teeth and continue to attack.

Ling Han moved. His speed did not seem slow, but it was as if time itself was endlessly slowing down. It could be clearly seen that his left hand had grabbed onto Yuwen Tian’s wrist, while his right hand had grabbed onto Wu Qiyuan. Then, the scene stopped.
What, what was going on?
Everyone was petrified. An earth-shattering attack from two great prodigies, and in the end, they were forced to a stop just like that.
Everyone stared at Ling Han as if they were looking at a monster. All of them felt their heads go numb, and felt their hearts constrict to the extreme.
This, this, this, this, what kind of strength did this have to be, to be able to resolve the mad exchange of blows between Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian so easily?

In other words, not only did Ling Han’s strength have to be superior to the combined strength of Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian, it had to be far superior as well. Otherwise, it could not have been so easily done.
“It’s just a competition for the position of captain. There’s no need to be so rash,” Ling Han said calmly.
On the other side, Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian were also petrified.
They were even clearer than the others, and felt that with this grab from Ling Han, they could not use the power in their bodies at all.
No, this description was inappropriate. It should be said that there seemed to be a supreme god hidden in Ling Han’s body, that they could only worship him, and could not even think of matching him.

For prodigies like them, this kind of feeling was really too terrible. The two of them hurriedly composed themselves, and finally gained some courage, but they still felt that their abilities were severely suppressed.
They couldn’t help but feel stunned. Even if their abilities were equal, how much battle prowess could they unleash against Ling Han?
This was too terrifying. This guy who did not say a word was the most awesome person.
This naturally was because of the Celestial Cauldron in Ling Han’s body. That level far surpassed Golden Celestial Cauldron. In a situation when cultivation level was equal, anyone
would be affected.
“You’re not going to fight anymore?” Ling Han smiled, and looked towards Yuwen Tian.

Yuwen Tian was extremely depressed. He had wanted to show off, and in the end, he had encountered someone who could show off even more. Now, all the limelight had been stolen by Ling Han, so how could he not be depressed? However, Ling Han was too strong, so what
could he say?
“I’m not fighting anymore,” he said honestly.
Ling Han nodded, then turned to look at Wu Qiyuan, “What about you?”
Wu Qiyuan scratched his head, “You are stronger than me, so I will listen to you.”
Ling Han smiled, and at the same time, loosened his hands, and said, “We’re all in the same group. At least, in these ten days, we’ll work together.”
“Yes, yes, yes. We should, we should,” Huang Lingyun hurriedly said. “In future, we’ll all listen to... this captain.”
He still didn’t know who Ling Han was, but he definitely had to cling to this powerful backer. He was too strong. He was probably ranked in the top 700 on the Galaxy Network, or perhaps
even higher.
Ling Han shook his head, “I have no interest in becoming a captain. It would be better for you to do it.” He pointed at Yuwen Tian.
“Ah?” Yuwen Tian pointed at himself, slightly surprised.
Ling Han actually didn’t want to be the captain; he really was purely here to mediate the fight.

He indeed wanted to become a captain, but that was because of his temperament. He wanted to display his abilities, and show off a bit, so that others would look at him in reverence and worship, but now, Ling Han had let him have the position. All of a sudden, he had lost the meaning and pleasure of showing off.
“I don’t want to be one,” he shook his head.
“Then you go.” Ling Han looked towards Wu Qiyuan again.
“I’m not as strong as you. I don’t deserve it! I don’t deserve it!” Wu Qiyuan also shook his
head.
Ling Han couldn’t be bothered to be the captain, so he turned to Mu Long, and said, “Then
you can do it.”
“I-“Mu Long also wanted to refuse. There were three great gods in this team, and he, as the captain, could not command them at all. Then what was the point of being one?
But he had just opened his mouth, when he realized that Ling Han’s eyes had turned harsh. Instantly, he stopped abruptly, and did not dare continue.
“Alright, you’re the captain,” Ling Han said. “Let’s begin hunting.”
Hearing him speak of serious matters, everyone was solemn. No matter who was the captain,
they had to hurry up and hunt fierce beasts. Otherwise, without enough points, they would all
be eliminated.
“Let’s go,” Mu Long forced himself to say. With a wave of his hand, he led the way.
The hunting team began to move, searching for traces of the wild beasts, and then began their
attack.
In this aspect, Wu Qiyuan had played a very important role.

chapters.title: Chapter 3817: Six Cauldron-level Giant Frog
paragraphs: Wu Qiyuan had been battling in the primitive forest since childhood. To him, wild beasts were far more familiar than humans.
What was a fierce beast?

For those living creatures that had cultivated and gained intelligence like the large black dog, they were called Demonic Beasts, while fierce beasts had walked the path of cultivation, but they had not developed intelligence and only knew slaughter.
This was very strange. They could clearly cultivate, and were in fact incredibly strong, yet they were muddleheaded, and could only act according to their instincts.
It could only be said that the heaven and earth was amazing.

Wu Qiyuan was extremely good at searching for traces of wild beasts. Furthermore, he only needed the slightest bit of information to be able to determine the strength of this wild beast. This kind of ability was really too useful. In a single day, the small team had killed a total of thirteen wild beasts, and it could be said that their battle results were quite bountiful.

Thirteen was really quite a number, because they had killed Cauldron Forging Tier-level fierce beasts. How many such existences were there in the whole Barbaric Planet? And just how big was the Barbaric Planet? It had only been a single day, and they had already gained so much. This was really commendable.
At night, they did not make another move.
It wasn’t that they didn’t want to, but that after night fell, those stronger wild beasts seemed to have all jumped out of their lairs at once. It was really too dangerous.

They saw a massive four-winged bat streak across the skies, its wingspan as wide as thirty thousand meters, completely covering the moon. A soundwave was sent out, and the mountains and forests collapsed, looking extremely terrifying.

This was most likely the first Core Formation Tier wild beast, and it was recklessly searching for its prey. However, it had just flown over a mountain when a crimson streak was seen shooting out from the forest. It wrapped around the giant bat, and with a shua, brought it back to the ground. After that, there was no more movement.
The strong preyed on the weak, and this was the law of the jungle.
Who would dare to run around on such a dangerous night?
They didn’t even dare to light a fire, nor did they dare to rest on a tree. They all dug a hole and buried themselves in it.
This was the safest method now.
A night passed, and in the early morning, everyone began to cultivate under the rising sun. The difference was too great.

For example, when Ling Han, Yuwen Tian, and Wu Qiyuan were cultivating, it was as if the three of them had turned into three massive whirlpools that were continuously absorbing the power of heaven and earth in the surroundings. Compared to them, the others were like a tiny splash of water, and the gulf between them was boundless.
Everyone could not help but be impressed by this. Ling Han and his group’s crushing strength was not without reason.
After they finished cultivating, they began to hunt.

“There is a large one,” Wu Qiyuan said. They were presently in a forest, and there were traces of battle all around them. “Two fierce beasts had an intense battle, and one of them won. Going by my deduction, the one that won should have the battle prowess of Six Cauldrons, but its opponent was not weak either, causing it to be severely injured.”
“Should we take the risk to battle?”
An equivalent to Six Cauldrons?
Everyone was stunned. Was this an opponent that they could contend against?

With a difference of one cauldron of cultivation level, the difference in battle prowess was overwhelming, and even Yuwen Tian and Wu Qiyuan only had four cauldrons, which was a whole two cauldrons of difference in cultivation level.
All of a sudden, everyone’s eyes were focused on Ling Han.
None of them knew exactly what cultivation level Ling Han was at. However, to be able to easily crush Yuwen Tian and Wu Qiyuan, he had to be at least Five Cauldrons.

Five Cauldrons against Six Cauldrons, though they were still at a disadvantage, Wu Qiyuan had also said that this ferocious creature had been severely injured, so its abilities should have dropped from the level of Six Cauldrons. Added with the fact that there were still nine of them, if they worked together, there might be a chance.
On the other hand, if they could kill a Six Cauldrons-level vicious beast, how many points would they get?
Riches were found in danger.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “All right, let’s go and take a look.”
Wu Qiyuan led the way, and everyone followed behind him, following the tracks left behind by that fierce beast.

After walking for quite a while, a lake appeared in front of them. The lake was not very big, and its widest area was only about 2.5 km wide. The lake waters were dark green, and there were large amounts of algae growing in the lake, blocking vision and preventing one from seeing into the depths beneath the surface of the water.
“The trail ends here.” Wu Qiyuan sniffed here and there, “My guess is that this fierce beast should be in the lake.”
“All right, let’s force it out,” Yuwen Tian said. He took out a sword, and with the surge of mystical power, the veined patterns on the blade all lit up.
He raised his sword, and shua, swept it towards the lake.
The green Sword Qi was like lightning as it shot into the lake, immediately scooping up a wall of water that rushed up the riverbank, causing the water level of the lake’s surface to drop
greatly.
“Gua!” A strange cry rang out, and a colossal creature scuttled out of the lake. It was as big as a house, and was actually a frog!

This frog was completely dark green in colour, but from its head all the way to its back, there were multiple blood-coloured veined patterns, which added a bit of viciousness to it. And on the chest of this giant frog, there was a very deep wound, which was still bleeding, though the amount was relatively small.
The giant frog rolled its eyes, and immediately focused on Ling Han and his group.
“Gua!” It suddenly charged out, and with a leap, jumped high into the air. Then, it rapidly descended, as if it wanted to use its colossal size to crush everyone to death.

Everyone hurriedly dispersed. Even Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian were no exception. This giant frog could possibly possess a battle prowess of Six Cauldrons. Even if it was severely injured now, it was probably still equivalent to a Five Cauldrons elite.
Blocking it head-on was an action of courting death.
Only Ling Han didn’t retreat. His eyes narrowed slightly, and his fists were already clenched
tightly.
He wanted to see what level his current strength was equivalent to.
Xiu, with a leap, he charged towards the giant frog.
The speed of the man and frog was astonishingly fast, so naturally, they immediately crashed
into each other. Frightening power collided, and masses of seals exploded. Everyone felt that the light was blinding, and could not see anything clearly.
Peng! Two shadows shot out of the ball of light, one large and one small. They were none
other than the giant frog and Ling Han.
No way!
The nine team members stared at the same time. Ling Han was actually capable of engaging
in a contest of strength with this giant frog?
Ling Han laughed loudly, filled with confidence. In terms of power, he was not the slightest
bit inferior to this giant frog, but he was naturally going to win.
In a contest of celestial techniques and mystical power, who would he be afraid of?
His figure landed on the ground, and he immediately exerted force with his feet. Imminent Skyline activated, and he charged towards the giant frog again.
The giant frog was extremely ferocious, and with a croak, a visible soundwave surged over. Pa, pa, pa, pa! There were fine particles in the air, but they were all shattered by this
soundwave.
Ling Han’s momentum was instantly halted. The powerful soundwave was even capable of
blasting him to burst.
But in the next instant, Starlight Screen appeared on Ling Han’s body, blocking the impact of
the soundwave.

The giant frog showed a hint of wariness. Even if the wild beast had not developed intelligence, its instincts of survival allowed it to realize that its opponent was not to be trifled with. It lowered its head. Xiu, xiu, xiu! The blood veined patterns on its back actually came to life, and multiple streaks of blood shot out, blasting towards Ling Han. Ling Han was unafraid, brandishing his fists in response. The Heavenly Dao Flames wrapped
around him, and had astonishingly high temperatures. Those bloody streaks evaporated completely before they could even approach.
Finally, he charged close enough, and began a physical battle with the giant frog.

sentences.text: Wu Qiyuan had been battling in the primitive forest since childhood.
To him, wild beasts were far more familiar than humans.
What was a fierce beast?

For those living creatures that had cultivated and gained intelligence like the large black dog, they were called Demonic Beasts, while fierce beasts had walked the path of cultivation, but they had not developed intelligence and only knew slaughter.
This was very strange.
They could clearly cultivate, and were in fact incredibly strong, yet they were muddleheaded, and could only act according to their instincts.
It could only be said that the heaven and earth was amazing.
Wu Qiyuan was extremely good at searching for traces of wild beasts.
Furthermore, he only needed the slightest bit of information to be able to determine the strength of this wild beast.
This kind of ability was really too useful.
In a single day, the small team had killed a total of thirteen wild beasts, and it could be said that their battle results were quite bountiful.
Thirteen was really quite a number, because they had killed Cauldron Forging Tier-level fierce beasts.
How many such existences were there in the whole Barbaric Planet?
And just how big was the Barbaric Planet?
It had only been a single day, and they had already gained so much.
This was really commendable.
At night, they did not make another move.
It wasn’t that they didn’t want to, but that after night fell, those stronger wild beasts seemed to have all jumped out of their lairs at once.
It was really too dangerous.
They saw a massive four-winged bat streak across the skies, its wingspan as wide as thirty thousand meters, completely covering the moon.
A soundwave was sent out, and the mountains and forests collapsed, looking extremely terrifying.
This was most likely the first Core Formation Tier wild beast, and it was recklessly searching for its prey.
However, it had just flown over a mountain when a crimson streak was seen shooting out from the forest.
It wrapped around the giant bat, and with a shua, brought it back to the ground.
After that, there was no more movement.
The strong preyed on the weak, and this was the law of the jungle.
Who would dare to run around on such a dangerous night?
They didn’t even dare to light a fire, nor did they dare to rest on a tree.
They all dug a hole and buried themselves in it.
This was the safest method now.
A night passed, and in the early morning, everyone began to cultivate under the rising sun.
The difference was too great.

For example, when Ling Han, Yuwen Tian, and Wu Qiyuan were cultivating, it was as if the three of them had turned into three massive whirlpools that were continuously absorbing the power of heaven and earth in the surroundings.
Compared to them, the others were like a tiny splash of water, and the gulf between them was boundless.
Everyone could not help but be impressed by this.
Ling Han and his group’s crushing strength was not without reason.
After they finished cultivating, they began to hunt.
“There is a large one,” Wu Qiyuan said.
They were presently in a forest, and there were traces of battle all around them.
“Two fierce beasts had an intense battle, and one of them won.
Going by my deduction, the one that won should have the battle prowess of Six Cauldrons, but its opponent was not weak either, causing it to be severely injured.”
“Should we take the risk to battle?”
An equivalent to Six Cauldrons?
Everyone was stunned.
Was this an opponent that they could contend against?

With a difference of one cauldron of cultivation level, the difference in battle prowess was overwhelming, and even Yuwen Tian and Wu Qiyuan only had four cauldrons, which was a whole two cauldrons of difference in cultivation level.
All of a sudden, everyone’s eyes were focused on Ling Han.
None of them knew exactly what cultivation level Ling Han was at.
However, to be able to easily crush Yuwen Tian and Wu Qiyuan, he had to be at least Five Cauldrons.

Five Cauldrons against Six Cauldrons, though they were still at a disadvantage, Wu Qiyuan had also said that this ferocious creature had been severely injured, so its abilities should have dropped from the level of Six Cauldrons.
Added with the fact that there were still nine of them, if they worked together, there might be a chance.
On the other hand, if they could kill a Six Cauldrons-level vicious beast, how many points would they get?
Riches were found in danger.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “All right, let’s go and take a look.”
Wu Qiyuan led the way, and everyone followed behind him, following the tracks left behind by that fierce beast.
After walking for quite a while, a lake appeared in front of them.
The lake was not very big, and its widest area was only about 2.5 km wide.
The lake waters were dark green, and there were large amounts of algae growing in the lake, blocking vision and preventing one from seeing into the depths beneath the surface of the water.
“The trail ends here.” Wu Qiyuan sniffed here and there, “My guess is that this fierce beast should be in the lake.”
“All right, let’s force it out,” Yuwen Tian said.
He took out a sword, and with the surge of mystical power, the veined patterns on the blade all lit up.
He raised his sword, and shua, swept it towards the lake.
The green Sword Qi was like lightning as it shot into the lake, immediately scooping up a wall of water that rushed up the riverbank, causing the water level of the lake’s surface to drop
greatly.
“Gua!” A strange cry rang out, and a colossal creature scuttled out of the lake.
It was as big as a house, and was actually a frog!
This frog was completely dark green in colour, but from its head all the way to its back, there were multiple blood-coloured veined patterns, which added a bit of viciousness to it.
And on the chest of this giant frog, there was a very deep wound, which was still bleeding, though the amount was relatively small.
The giant frog rolled its eyes, and immediately focused on Ling Han and his group.
“Gua!” It suddenly charged out, and with a leap, jumped high into the air.
Then, it rapidly descended, as if it wanted to use its colossal size to crush everyone to death.
Everyone hurriedly dispersed.
Even Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian were no exception.
This giant frog could possibly possess a battle prowess of Six Cauldrons.
Even if it was severely injured now, it was probably still equivalent to a Five Cauldrons elite.
Blocking it head-on was an action of courting death.
Only Ling Han didn’t retreat.
His eyes narrowed slightly, and his fists were already clenched
tightly.
He wanted to see what level his current strength was equivalent to.
Xiu, with a leap, he charged towards the giant frog.
The speed of the man and frog was astonishingly fast, so naturally, they immediately crashed
into each other.
Frightening power collided, and masses of seals exploded.
Everyone felt that the light was blinding, and could not see anything clearly.
Peng!
Two shadows shot out of the ball of light, one large and one small.
They were none
other than the giant frog and Ling Han.
No way!
The nine team members stared at the same time.
Ling Han was actually capable of engaging
in a contest of strength with this giant frog?
Ling Han laughed loudly, filled with confidence.
In terms of power, he was not the slightest
bit inferior to this giant frog, but he was naturally going to win.
In a contest of celestial techniques and mystical power, who would he be afraid of?
His figure landed on the ground, and he immediately exerted force with his feet.
Imminent Skyline activated, and he charged towards the giant frog again.
The giant frog was extremely ferocious, and with a croak, a visible soundwave surged over.
Pa, pa, pa, pa!
There were fine particles in the air, but they were all shattered by this
soundwave.
Ling Han’s momentum was instantly halted.
The powerful soundwave was even capable of
blasting him to burst.
But in the next instant, Starlight Screen appeared on Ling Han’s body, blocking the impact of
the soundwave.
The giant frog showed a hint of wariness.
Even if the wild beast had not developed intelligence, its instincts of survival allowed it to realize that its opponent was not to be trifled with.
It lowered its head.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
The blood veined patterns on its back actually came to life, and multiple streaks of blood shot out, blasting towards Ling Han.
Ling Han was unafraid, brandishing his fists in response.
The Heavenly Dao Flames wrapped
around him, and had astonishingly high temperatures.
Those bloody streaks evaporated completely before they could even approach.
Finally, he charged close enough, and began a physical battle with the giant frog.

chapters.title: Chapter 3818: Demon Core
paragraphs: Even though the giant frog was huge, its movements were extremely agile. It pounced and jumped. Sometimes, it would stand on its hind legs, and its two front legs would rapidly swat at Ling Han. It was like a palm technique Grandmaster. Sometimes, it would lie down on all fours, and open its mouth to spit out a long tongue. That was like a fierce spear, its penetrating power incredibly terrifying. It could even just barely pierce through the Starlight Screen.
However, this kind of attack was also very taxing on the giant frog. It could not use it continuously, and could only attack suddenly, which was even more threatening.

Of course, Ling Han’s attack power was not to be outdone either. The level of the Heavenly Dao Flames was extremely high, and as the fist force blasted out, this giant frog was extremely wary, and had to dodge. Otherwise, this would be able to blast out a charred hole with a single blow.
Both sides were wary of each other, and the battle instantly became drawn out.
“Let’s go!” Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian exchanged a look, then leaped up and joined the battle.
However, the others did not make a move.

It wasn’t that they didn’t want to attack, but that they didn’t have the right to. At least, when the battle prowess of Five Cauldrons blasted over, they were only Heaven Cauldrons and Earth Cauldrons, so how could they withstand it?
Actually, if Ling Han went all out, it wasn’t that he couldn’t defeat this giant frog, but there was no need.
This wasn’t a test for him alone, so why did he have to do everything?
Moreover, it was naturally better for fewer people to know his ultimate moves. If there was no need, why would he use it?
With the addition of Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian, the three of them joined forces, and the giant frog instantly fell into a disadvantage.
With Ling Han holding it back, his battle prowess of Four Cauldrons could be unleashed to his heart’s content. How could this kind of destructive power be underestimated?
“Gua!” The giant frog shouted loudly, and the soundwaves turned into waves.
This was an area-of-effect attack, and was precisely a weapon to deal with mass attacks.
Ling Han was naturally unafraid, and Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian both had their own ways of dispersing the soundwaves. They both drew out their respective Spirit Tools to block the soundwave attacks.
Next, they launched a powerful counterattack.

After a few dozen moves, the giant frog was already struggling. It was already injured in the first place, and now that it was being ganged up on by the three of them, its injuries were compounded, so it naturally couldn’t hold on any longer.

“Gua!” The giant frog began to fight with its life on the line. It stuck out its tongue madly, like a divine spear committing violence. It could almost be claimed to be indestructible. Even the Starlight Screen could not block it. It was really very powerful.
Ling Han and the others didn’t face this head-on, and they continued to wander around. This kind of explosive power definitely wouldn’t last for long.
The giant frog took advantage of the opening to flee, but Ling Han and the others had caught up again, so it could only continue to put its life on the line.
Another dozen over minutes later, the giant frog was finally unable to continue, and was killed by the powerful attacks of Ling Han and the others.
“Phew, it’s finally taken care of.” Yuwen Tian panted heavily. There were also some injuries on his body. They had been left behind from the intense battle, but they were all light injuries.

Wu Qiyuan was not much better off either. His battle style was rougher than Yuwen Tian’s, so his injuries were even heavier. However, his physique was tough, so this little injury naturally did not matter.

Only Ling Han was an exception. In fact, he could deal with that giant frog all by himself. Thus, it was naturally impossible for him to suffer any injuries. He appeared to be extremely relaxed, and did not look like he had just fought a great battle at all.
Huang Lingyun and the others all gathered around it, and began to cut open this giant frog. The flesh and blood of a fierce beast of this level was extremely nutritious, so how could it be wasted?

“Yi, there is actually a Demon Core!” Mu Long suddenly called out, looking very excited. “What Demon Core?” Ling Han swept an eye over it, and saw that Mu Long was holding a dark green bead in his hand. It was only the size of a walnut.
“Brother Ling, don’t you know about Demon Cores?” Yuwen Tian asked in surprise.
“I really don’t know.” Ling Han shook his head.

“Demon Core can only be nurtured by this kind of fierce beast. Usually, they have special effects, such as protection against fire or cold. Some can even be used to concoct alchemical pills and formations. Their value is astonishing,” Yuwen Tian explained.
Ling Han was astounded. He really didn’t know that there was such a thing as Demon Core, and they were extremely valuable.

Actually, this was also because Demon Cores were really too rare. There may not even be one in a hundred fierce beasts that could nurture them, and the fierce beasts that possessed Demon Cores would also be extraordinarily powerful.
Mu Long delivered the Demon Core over. Though everyone wanted it, it was Ling Han and the others that had killed the giant frog this time. The others were not even qualified to receive the benefits.

Ling Han carefully examined the green bead, yet he couldn’t find anything special about it. He connected to the Galaxy Network, entered the information of the giant frog, and conducted a search. Finally, he found something.

It was extremely likely that this was the Poison Neutralization Pearl, which, according to its name, could neutralize poison. Moreover, though this was nurtured by a giant frog of Cauldron Forging Tier, it could neutralize poison on the level of the Core Formation Tier, at most. However, this would require the Poison Neutralization Pearl to be crushed and swallowed, unlike neutralizing other poisons, when one only had to hold the Poison Neutralization Pearll in one’s mouth or stick it on the wound.
“Haha, our luck is not too bad. We actually encountered a fierce beast that nurtured a Demon Core.” Laughter rang out, and five men walked out of the dense forest.
Seeing Ling Han and the others look over, one of the men’s expressions turned cold, “What are you standing around for? Hurry up and hand over the Demon Core!”
“Then, obediently destroy the connection device, so as to avoid suffering a little,” another man said.
Heh, this was both to decrease the number of competitors, and at the same time, to earn a
Demon Core.
“Fang Ming!” Huang Lingyun recognized one of the men, and immediately introduced him to the others, “An elite ranked in the 6000s on the Galaxy Network.”
Fang Ming crossed his arms behind his back, fully displaying his arrogance, “Since you know who I am, what are you still standing around for?”
Why was there only five people in their team?
That was because the other five were too weak. Fang Ming and the others felt that they were a burden, so they destroyed all their connection devices. From a certain aspect, teammates
were also competitors.
Five people was enough.
However, Huang Lingyun and the others were unafraid, because there were three freaks in their group. What was the Galaxy Network ranking above 6000 worth? It was completely not
enough.
“En?” Fang Ming and the others were slightly surprised. These people were actually unafraid
of them?
“Very well, youngsters nowadays really don’t know the immensity of the world.” A red- clothed man walked out, his expression dark. He pointed at a member of Ling Han’s group,
and shouted, “Kneel!”
“F***, what arrogance!” Yuwen Tian said slowly, a slight hint of mockery on his face. He finally had a chance to show off. This was great.
“Who do you think you are?” the red-clothed man asked coldly.
“I’m your uncle!” Yuwen Tian said with a smile.
The red-clothed man couldn’t help but look furious. He laughed loudly towards the sky, then

turned back to look at Yuwen Tian, “Though killing is forbidden here, there is no such thing as no beating. Hehe, a loose tongue causes trouble. I will make you feel extreme regret.” “Your uncle will always be your uncle. Come, grandson!” Yuwen Tian crooked a finger, his attitude extremely disdainful.
The red-clothed man humphed, and strode towards Yuwen Tian.
“Kneel!” he shouted loudly. He sent out a palm strike, and the light of lightning blazed.

chapters.title: Chapter 3819: Beast tide
paragraphs: The red-clothed man’s attack arrived, while Yuwen Tian laughed loudly, and delivered a slap back at the red-clothed man.
Pa, with a palm strike, the red-clothed man was sent flying.
A figure streaked past, and pa, fell onto the ground, motionless.
This!
The faces of Fang Ping and the others twitched, and there was deep fear in their eyes.
He had sent their companion flying with a single slap. What kind of strength was that? Oh no, they had kicked an iron plate.
Yuwen Tian’s desire to show off had already soared to the heavens. Crossing his arms behind his back, he walked towards Fang Ping and the others, “How is it? Does anyone else want me to kneel?”

“Heh, apologies for the lack of manners!” Fang Ping clasped his hands in obeisance, and signalled at his three companions. The four of them turned around and fled at the same time. Run, this man was very likely to be ranked in the top 5000 in the Galaxy Network, or even ranked higher than that. They couldn’t fight him head-on.
“Little Wu, give me a hand!” Yuwen Tian called out, as he broke out into a run in pursuit.
“All right!” Wu Qiyuan also charged out, his body like a wild bull. Hong long long long, even the ground beneath his feet was reverberating endlessly.
The two of them attacked, and Fang Ping and the others couldn’t escape at all. They were forcefully stopped.

Since these people had made the first move, Yuwen Tian didn’t mind doing the same. After showing off for a while and robbing the five of them, he destroyed the connection devices of Fang Ping and the others. In this way, the five of them were eliminated.
Fang Ping and the others left angrily, but they did not dare to say anything. Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian were too strong. At least for now, they were completely outmatched.
“Come, let’s continue,” Ling Han said with a smile.
They continued to hunt fierce beasts, but though they killed a considerable number in a day, they did not encounter any more fierce beasts that had nurtured Demon Cores.
At night, they still dug a pit to sleep in. After a night, the sky gradually became lighter, and they welcomed the rising sun to cultivate, just like how it had been in the past.
During daytime, they continued to hunt. It was really as if they had become people who were earning a living in the primitive forest.

On the fifth day, they walked out of the forest, and a massive grassy plain appeared ahead of them. This grass was as tall as a man. If they did not jump, their vision would be greatly affected, and they would not be able to see very far at all.

Ling Han and the others then stepped on the grass. To Cauldron Forging Tiers, as long as they had the slightest bit of power to lend, they would be able to walk on air, so treading on grass was naturally even less of a problem.

They continued to hunt, and their gains were quite bountiful. There was a kind of wild beast in the grassland that was similar to a wild bull, but it had a triangular shape, six legs, and was in groups of three to five. It was just right to be hunted by a small team.
And in this manner, the seventh day had arrived.
On this day, they continued their pursuit as per usual, but all of a sudden, everyone felt a powerful tremor take place in the ground.
“What’s going on?”

The ten people were all confused. At first, they thought that a great battle was happening in the distance. A battle on the level of Cauldron Forging Tier was completely capable of causing such an effect, but very soon, the trembling became more and more intense. The grass rose and fell like waves.
“Look!”
Wu Qiyuan pointed at the sky, and saw that innumerable black shadows had appeared in the horizon. Because they were really too far away, he could not see clearly what exactly they
were.
“To be able to see it clearly from so far away, its body must be incredibly massive.”
“Are they the ones that caused the ground to tremble?”
In a short while, the silhouettes of those black shadows were fully revealed. They were at least
a few thousand winged lions, and their size was astonishingly huge. Even at such a far
distance, a terrifying vicious might still spread out.

In the team, some people with weaker abilities were already weak in the knees. This was because they had been intimidated by the ferocious might. It was completely the suppression on the level of being.
“Hurry up and crouch down. These fierce beasts are hunting for food!” Wu Qiyuan shouted. Everyone hurriedly jumped down from the blades of grass and hid among the grass.

These lion beasts were at least Four Cauldrons and Five Cauldrons-level. Otherwise, they could not possibly have such terrifying vicious might. One or two was not much, but if several thousand of them charged up at the same time, who would be able to withstand them?
Even Ling Han couldn’t.
However, the rumbling of the ground became more and more intense, and the ground fluctuated like a carpet.
“That’s not right!” Ling Han frowned. Those lion beasts were flying in the skies, so no matter how strong they were, how could it possibly cause the ground to tremble like this?
He flew on his Tool, and arrived at a higher position. His eyes swept over, and his expression instantly changed.
“Run!” he shouted towards the ground. Then, he immediately turned around. Xiu, he rapidly flew away.
Everyone didn’t understand the situation, but since even Ling Han had fled in such a panic, how could they dare not to flee?

beasts.
It was terrible. They had encountered a herd of lion beasts hunting and feeding, and the herd of wild bulls still ran towards them, dragging them into the water as well.

such a situation.

wild beasts.

distance, a terrifying vicious might still spread out.

chapters.title: Chapter 3820: Running for Life
paragraphs: The benefit of flying on a Tool was actually in “flying”, and not that there would be any increase in speed.
Thus, this plain didn’t have any earth-shattering obstacles, and one didn’t need to fly or leap over it. Thus, using one’s feet to run on the ground wasn’t slow at all.
They ran quickly, and as expected, they were no longer attacked by the lion beasts.
The nine of them rejoiced for a moment, but good times didn’t last long. They immediately discovered another problem.
The herd of bulls!
Their speed was too fast, so fast that it actually surpassed the speed at which they were running, and was closing the distance between them.
This was too dangerous. If they were rammed by the herd of bulls, then even elites of the Core Formation Tier would probably be rammed to death and trampled to death.
There were too many bulls, at least over a hundred thousand. What Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator would be able to withstand them?
“F***, how could a bull’s speed be so fast?”
“Six legs?”
“What do we do now?”

If they continued to run forward, with the speed of the bulls, they would definitely catch up to them. However, if they ran to either side, avoiding the direction in which the bulls fled, this would also be a huge problem. That was because the distance they ran diagonally would definitely be very long. Perhaps, they would be caught up to before they could even run out of the area where the bulls were charging.

“We still have to separate to the two sides. If the bulls really catch up to us, we’ll fly on our Tools. We’ll be at a super low altitude, just enough so we don’t get hit by the bulls.” Ling Han came up with an idea.
“All right!” Everyone nodded. This was also the only way out.
“Take care!” everyone said through the connection device.

In this kind of situation when they were fleeing for their lives, it was absolutely impossible for them to continue staying together. If they insisted that they wait for the others, that would really be a suicidal action.
They all ran towards the left, not daring to miss too much, or they would soon be caught up by the bulls.
Thankfully, though the bulls ran faster than them, they did not surpass them by much. Thus, for the moment, there was no need to worry that they would be crushed by the bulls.
In the process of running, they discovered that other teams had been startled and jumped out of the bushes, and joined the team that was fleeing for their lives.
-If any team dared to stay and fight, that would be like a mantis trying to stop a chariot, and would only be crushed into dust.
After so many days, the majority of the teams had walked out of the forest and entered into the great grassland. Thus, they were all implicated, and joined in on this majestic great flight.
Some reacted slightly slower, and were immediately drowned in the wild beasts. It was unknown whether they had been trampled to death, or if they had called for help in time, and were rescued.

In short, hunters like them had all become prey, and could only flee for their lives. Ling Han was separated from the others. At present, everyone was busy taking care of themselves, so how could they have the time to care about others?

He used the Imminent Skyline, and his speed was astonishingly fast. After more than ten minutes, he had arrived at the periphery of the herd of bulls. He only had to jump a few more times, and he would be able to leave the danger zone.
But right at this moment, xiu, a crimson light shot over.
Ling Han activated the Starlight Screen and blocked this attack. He turned around and saw a lion beast staring at him.
‘F*ck! There’s beef everywhere, yet you’re not eating it? Why are you targeting me?’
It was tired of eating beef, and wanted a change of tastes?
This lion beast opened its mouth, and another crimson light shot out, heading straight for Ling Han.
Ling Han still used the Starlight Screen to block, but the destructive power of the crimson light was too terrifying. With a single strike, the light screen was shattered.
This guy’s strength was not inferior to the giant frog from before.
Actually, Ling Han wasn’t afraid of a battle, but once the battle began, he would be surrounded. This was naturally an incredibly stupid thing to do.
“I’ll remember you!” Ling Han said. He didn’t even turn around as he ran toward the side.
Perhaps that lion beast really wanted a change of tastes too much. It actually flapped its wings and left the lion’s pride, setting off in pursuit of Ling Han and the others.
Was it seeking death?
Ling Han sneered internally. As long as you leave the main troops, just see if I won’t beat you up forcefully.
As he thought this, he continued to sprint, but did not cast the Imminent Skyline, slowing down his speed to avoid being lost by that lion.
One pursued relentlessly, while the other had the intention to draw the other away. Naturally, they maintained the situation of neither leaving nor abandoning each other.
After running for a while longer, Ling Han decided to get started.
He suddenly stopped, turned around, and faced that fierce beast in the skies.
The lion beast flapped its wings, and slowly descended. It raised its head, looking incredibly
arrogant.
It was a top-notch predator, and had the pride of a king of beasts in its bones.
Ling Han cracked his knuckles, “Come, I’ll teach you how to behave today.”

The intelligence of the lion beast was limited. It did not pursue Ling Han because it thought that this new prey was interesting, but rather really wanted a change of taste. What need was there for it to be so smug about its prey? Thus, it immediately charged towards Ling Han. Opening its mouth, xiu, xiu, xiu, the crimson light slashed out madly.

Ling Han shot out a punch, shattering the streaks of crimson light, and when the last streak of crimson light was dispersed, the lion beast had already charged over. Spreading out its wings, it quickly turned around, and a wing sliced towards Ling Han.
This was like a Spirit Tool Divine Saber. The tip of its wing emitted a light like cold iron, and
was definitely capable of slicing through iron as if it was mud.
Ling Han humphed, and Destructive Energy wrapped around his fists. He directly used Demonic Monkey Fists.
There was only one move, but this was an Imperial Technique, and one punch was enough.
Peng!

The punch landed, and the lion beast was instantly sent flying, landing heavily on the ground. Then, it flapped its wings rapidly, its four legs kicking rapidly. However, as if it was drunk, it was completely tossed around on the ground, unable to stand up at all.
In just half a minute, it stopped moving, and lay quietly on the ground.
Large amounts of blood gushed out of its chest, and its life was cut off.
Ling Han also flopped onto the ground. Even though it was only a single punch, it seemed to have sucked out all his energy.
If there were still enemies, he would definitely be able to fight again, but for a very long time, it would be impossible for him to channel the Demonic Monkey Fists.
Imperial Technique. That was a supreme technique that only an Ancestral King could casually
cast.
After Ling Han rested for a while, he dissected the lion beast, wanting to see if there were any
Demon Core.
To his disappointment, there was none.
He didn’t waste it, either, and stored the lion beast into his Spatial Spirit Tool. This was a Cauldron Forging Tier fierce beast, and its blood and flesh were greatly nutritious, so how
could he miss it?
“I don’t know what’s going on outside, so let’s not go that way first.”

Ling Han looked around at his surroundings. He was at the foot of a mountain. This mountain was neither too tall nor too big. Compared to those colossal trees that could easily reach 3000 meters, it could only be considered a small hill.
He strode forwards, planning to take a roundabout route.
After walking for a while, he could vaguely smell a fragrance.
As an outstanding alchemist, Ling Han was certain that this was the Celestial medicine’s
scent.

Yi, he had survived a great disaster, so a Celestial medicine was going to bestowed on him? Ling Han naturally wouldn’t miss it. He followed the fragrance, and soon, a cave appeared in front of him. The fragrance was coming from within the cave.
The Celestial medicine was inside the cave.
Ling Han pondered for a moment. He didn’t act rashly. Instead, he temporarily shut down the connection device. Then, he took out the Void Beast hide and put it on. He then headed into the cave.
There were many powerful wild beasts here, so he had to be careful.

chapters.title: Chapter 3821: Dragon Grass, Earth Spirit Milk
paragraphs: Better safe than sorry.
Ling Han was confident, but definitely not conceited. If he still had overwhelming confidence in such a dangerous place, that would only be courting death.
He entered into the cave, and searched for the Celestial medicine.
-The Celestial medicine’s medicinal fragrance, he could smell it from miles away, so with the sharp nose of a fierce beast, how could a fierce beast not smell it?

Thus, Ling Han would rather believe that there was something fishy going on than believe that this was really a coincidence. It just so happened that when he passed by, the Celestial medicine had ripened.
He walked slowly, and not long after, he arrived at the depths of the cave. Though this was not the end, it was pitch-black, and the medicinal fragrance was incredibly strong.

Ling Han activated his eye technique. The darkness naturally couldn’t stop him. He could clearly see that there was a plant that was half the height of a human that was growing healthily, and there was a green flower blooming at the top. It was precisely this that was exuding refreshing fragrance.
Dragon Grass!

Ling Han thought internally. It was said that the Dragon Grass had transformed from an ordinary Spiritual Herb into a Celestial medicine because it had been contaminated with the saliva of the Immortal Dragon so it was extremely effective in healing injuries, but that should have been fabricated.
He looked again, and a smile appeared at the corners of his lips.
Beside the Dragon Grass, there were multiple beast bones. Upon counting, there were at least
a few dozen, as if they were worshipping that Celestial medicine.
As expected, Ling Han confirmed internally. He released his divine sense, and searched carefully.
Found it.
Ling Han looked towards a corner and activated his eye technique. He immediately saw something different.

A... er, something that looked like mud was presently adhering to the rock. It was a very thin layer, and covered an extremely large area. However, Ling Han saw it with his eye technique, and discovered that this was not mud, but rather a fierce beast.
This guy used the Celestial medicine to lure other fierce beasts into this space, and then took advantage of the opening to attack and devour its prey.
The white bones on the ground were clear proof of this.

A smile tugged at the corners of Ling Han’s lips. It had always been this ferocious beast hiding in the shadows, waiting for an opportunity to sneak attack, but now, it was the other way round. He was the hunter that was hiding in the shadows.
He snuck over quietly, very, very slowly.
When they were extremely close, this fierce beast seemed to have sensed something, and instantly reacted.
It “floated”. At first, it was like a film, but now, it had turned into a long ball. It had short legs, and there were quite a number of them. It looked like an insect.
This insect didn’t have eyes, nor did it have a nose, mouth, or ears. However, its head was turning around, as if it wanted to find Ling Han.
Its senses were very sensitive.
Ling Han had already seen through to its strength, and did not hide any further. Instead, he directly uncovered the hide of the Void Beast, and began his attack.

Peng, his fist landed on the body of that fierce beast, but the strange thing was that it was actually empty without any place to exert force, and that fierce beast had turned into soft clay that actually wrapped around his fist, and then spread out towards his arm.
Ling Han immediately felt a burning sensation on his hand. That was the ferocious beast
tearing open his skin, wanting to suck out his blood and flesh.
Hiss, this fierce beast was really cruel. It did not kill its prey first before slowly feeding on it, but rather directly devoured its prey’s flesh and blood alive.
But it should be known just how agonizing this was for his prey.
Ling Han smirked coldly. He activated Destructive Energy. Boom! Like flames, it immediately combusted on his hand.
Instantly, that fierce beast released a terrible cry. It did not have a mouth, and this was a cry on the level of divine sense.

Originally, Ling Han’s opponents would try as much as possible to avoid being touched by Destructive Energy. That would be too terrifying, but this ferocious beast chose to approach him on its own volition, and was so determined to seek death. Who could it blame?

The ferocious beast hurriedly retreated. It had now returned to its soft mud-like form, but there was a piece missing from its middle. Furthermore, it was still expanding. That was the Destructive Energy spreading out.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “You’ve brought this upon yourself, so how can you live?”
The beast was scared, and hurriedly fled.
Ling Han caught up to it, and shot out several punches in quick succession. The Destructive Energy boiled, and in a few moves, this fierce beast was blasted into smithereens.
Unfortunately, though this fierce beast was very strange, it did not have a Demon Core.
Ling Han shook his head, and went to pluck the flower of that Dragon Grass.
This was the part that could be used in medicine, but the body and roots would not have any effect.
Ling Han walked deeper into the cave. He was going to search carefully.
That was because though the legend of the Dragon Grass was false, and this was not produced from the saliva of the Immortal Dragon, a Celestial medicine would not grow for no reason
either.
Since the Dragon Grass had grown here, there must be a reason for it.
A blessed land, or a land of peril, could nurture a Celestial medicine, and that was always the
case.
When he arrived at the end of the cave, Ling Han’s eyes lit up. He saw a groove on a rock, which was filled with milky white liquid. When he raised his head again, he saw that there was
a stone pillar hanging down, which just happened to point at the groove.
Dripping water penetrates stone.
At present, the stone had not been penetrated, and only a groove had formed, which had also preserved the “water” that was dripping.
This was... Earth Spirit Milk.
An extremely nutritious item!
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh loudly. As expected, a place that could nurture Celestial medicines definitely corresponded to a paradise or a desolate land. He was lucky; this was a
paradise.

Earth Spirit Milk was nurtured by heaven and earth, and could nourish one’s physical body and divine sense. It was the highest grade substance to be used at the point of breaking through. Though Ling Han had bought a great many Treasured Fruits of Life through the Galaxy Network, after advancing into the Cauldron Forging Tier, the corresponding Treasured Fruits of Life were not only more than ten times more expensive, but also incredibly rare in number. There was really no lack of buyers but no one willing to sell.
Thus, this Earth Spirit Milk was truly a pleasant surprise. It was also a timely help.
That was because Ling Han was just a sliver away from breaking through, and just happened
to be in need of this kind of nutritious tonic.

He carefully put away the Earth Spirit Milk. All of a sudden, he was overwhelmed with emotion. Previously, he had seen the great battle between the wild bulls and the flying lions, and he had also participated in such a soul-stirring hunt, so he was naturally moved.
All of a sudden, he discovered an opportunity to break through.
This was very sudden, but also very natural. With his natural talent, it was not difficult for him
to break through in the first place. The hunting in the last few days, and the final flight for life, had all touched him greatly, so he naturally took this step.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate. He immediately sat down in a cross-legged position and began to
break through.
This opportunity came easily, but once he missed it, it was possible that he would need who knew how long to be able to grasp it again.
Boom, tumultuous waves instantly rose up in his body.
Four Cauldrons, breaking through the limit, the commotion would naturally not be small.
He ingested a few drops of Earth Spirit Milk to nourish himself. Then, he used his own essence to construct the fourth Celestial Cauldron.

Unlike the Foundation Building Tier, the other three Celestial Cauldrons did not obstruct him. Thus, the fourth Celestial Cauldron naturally formed into an embryonic form, and then slowly grew stronger. The body of the cauldron was rapidly forming.
Very quickly, he felt his body dry up, and hurriedly drank a few more drops.
A day later, the fourth Celestial Cauldron was more or less formed, but it was a cauldron with
no legs.
This was the end of his breakthrough.
Ling Han smiled. He was now at Four Cauldrons, and his battle prowess had increased several
times over.

If he were to battle that lion beast again now, he wouldn’t need to use the Demonic Monkey Fists at all. With the Great Overarching Heaven Technique, he would be able to kill it. He put on the connection device again to check on his teammates.

chapters.title: Chapter 3822: Best not to trifle with me
paragraphs: “Hu, Brother Ling, you have finally appeared again.”
“Haha, I thought you had died. I worried for nothing for you.”
Connecting to the network of the Holy Land, Ling Han immediately received a considerable number of messages.
“Are you guys all right?” Ling Han asked.
“Sigh, this is terrible. Including you, Brother Ling, there are only five of us left,” Yuwen Tian said.
Only half of them remained?

Ling Han also felt a little rueful, but when he thought about how dangerous the situation had been at that time, it was already very impressive that half of them managed to survive. “Are you all together now?” he asked.
“En, after we escaped the barrage of bulls, we’ve gotten back together. Now, the only one left is you.”
“Alright, I’ll come over right away.”
The connection device actually had many functions. As long as the map was brought out, the location of the members of the small team would be displayed, which was very convenient.
Thus, Ling Han only had to head in that direction.
He used his movement technique, and his speed was extremely fast.
Half a day later, he found Wu Qiyuan and the others. All of them had more or less gained some injuries on their bodies, which was enough to prove how terrifying that beast tide was.
Even though they had only been apart for two days, everyone still felt as if they had been reborn after a great tribulation. They had all become closer to each other.

The five people who had been eliminated were the weakest among them. For example, Yuwen Tian, Wu Qiyuan, Huang Lingyun and Mu Long were still standing here, but Luo Shan, Ma Gang and the others had been eliminated. It was unknown if they were still alive.
“Let’s continue.”
They advanced, and began hunting again.
On the afternoon of the ninth day, everyone received a message.
“Now, the scores of each team and the remaining number of people will be announced. Every ten minutes, everyone’s whereabouts will also be displayed on the map.”
Sure enough, a noticeboard appeared in the cyberspace of the Holy Land that was connected through the connecting device. The points and remaining members of each team were listed on this noticeboard.
Ling Han’s team was shockingly ranked first, with a total of 752 points. On average, each person had more than 150 points.
The second place also had 684 points, but there were still six people remaining in the team. Thus, the average score would be even lower.

The third team just happened to have 600 points, but there were only four of them. In this way, each person’s points would be 150, second only to Ling Han and the others. It was possible that the gap between them would only be a matter of killing another fierce beast. With such direct observation, everyone only had to do a slight calculation to know which teams would be eliminated, and which teams would be able to advance into the top hundred.
Most importantly, everyone’s location would appear on the map at almost all times. This was equivalent to saying, “Come, kill this group of people, and we’ll be able to squeeze into the top 100.”

This was a gamble. That was because eliminating the members of the enemy team might not necessarily allow one to squeeze into the top hundred, because as long as the other party had more than three members, then with one less member, the average score of every person would instead be higher.
One could “eliminate” other teams, and he could also “eliminate” his own people. He could also continue hunting ferocious beasts. There were various choices.

“This time, a great battle is inevitable,” Ling Han said with a shake of his head. However, he was unafraid. He was already at Four Cauldrons, and his battle prowess was at least on par with Seven Cauldrons. Was there any elite at Seven Cauldrons here?

Whether it was the total score or the average score, their team was first place. Thus, they naturally had the initiative, and continued to hunt fierce beasts, to maintain the advantage of being in the lead.
But among the other teams, the “massacre” had already begun.

From the points leaderboard, it could be clearly seen that there would be teams that would disappear from time to time, and the number of people in some teams was decreasing drastically. There was suddenly a change in the individual rankings.
At night, Ling Han and the others were just about to find a place to rest when they heard Huang Lingyun say, “Not good, there are a lot of people heading towards us.”

It could be seen that there were a great many dots on the map that were very close to them. Furthermore, these dots were very close together. Clearly, they were in the same group. Counting, there were as many as 30 of them. This was clearly not just a single team. “Haha, they actually dare to have designs on us; there will be no return for them,” Yuwen Tian said with a laugh. The flames of showing off were already burning fiercely.
Wu Qiyuan merely clenched his fists, and did not speak.
His personality was simple, and there was only one word for it-fight.
Ling Han was even more unconcerned. He was completely unperturbed, as if he had not heard anything at all.
Seeing the three generals act in this manner, Huang Lingyun was naturally relieved.
After a while, figures appeared in the surroundings, forming a circle that surrounded them.
“Hand over the connection device!” The other party didn’t waste any words.
With such a good opportunity, how could Yuwen Tian not show off?
He strode out, incredibly flamboyant, “If you want the connection device, fine. Whoever can
take three moves from me, I will consider giving it to you.”
“Hahaha!” A great many people laughed, “Idiot, we all know that your team is awesome, with the first place in points. Who would come to fight you one-on-one?”
F***, he had failed in showing off.
Yuwen Tian couldn’t help but fly into a humiliated rage. Was it easy for him to show off? Why was it always ruined?
“I’ll beat you all to burst!” he roared, and took the initiative to charge out.
“You’re seeking death!” Those people immediately moved, pressing down on Yuwen Tian.
However, Four Cauldrons was still Four Cauldrons. How could this breaking of limits be
ordinary?

A Four Cauldrons formed through cultivation was different from Four Cauldrons cultivated by wild beasts. A Four Cauldrons wild beast was indeed Four Cauldrons, but a Four Cauldrons cultivator could possibly reach the battle prowess of Five Cauldrons, or perhaps even
stronger.

Yuwen Tian’s battle prowess was close to Five Cauldrons. Compared to an ordinary Heaven Cauldron, this surpassed his cultivation level by two minor levels. This made him feel like a tiger that had entered a pack of wolves, and he could do as he pleased.
But a wolf pack was a wolf pack, after all, and not a sheep that could not resist at all.

Some of the 30 people were responsible for impeding Yuwen Tian, while others were launching powerful attacks from the rear, causing Yuwen Tian to feel immense pressure. After all, everyone who could participate in the competition was extraordinary, what more those who could last until now.
After battling for a short while, Yuwen Tian was already on the back foot, looking extremely
disheveled.
“I’m coming!” Wu Qiyuan roared, and rushed into the battle.
He was a reckless man, and barged all the way. He would basically absorb all the attacks that came his way, and his tough physique could disperse more than half of them. Then, he
launched a fierce counterattack, causing those people to dodge quickly.
However, two fierce tigers were still not enough to suppress this wolf pack.

Huang Lingyun and Mu Long also joined the battle. However, though they were ranked in the top 10,000 of the Galaxy Network, under the current circumstances, these abilities couldn’t be considered strong at all. They could only barely protect themselves.
Ling Han did not make a move, and merely watched from the sidelines.
“Brat, you have a lot of free time.” Someone set their eyes on him.
Ling Han smiled, and said, “You had best not trifle with me.”
“So what if I trifle with you?” That person refused to believe it, and walked towards Ling Han.
Ling Han sighed, and sent out a palm strike. Peng, the clothes that the person was wearing, including the connecting device, were all turned into dust.
“That’s what.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3823: God Slaying Technique
paragraphs: It was only a single palm strike, and he had eliminated one of them.
That person was not injured, but he had instantly turned into a naked pig, which naturally made him extremely angry and embarrassed.
However, he did not dare to make a move at all.
This palm strike didn’t hurt him in the slightest. It only shattered his clothes and connection device. The difficulty level was several times higher than killing him.
How could he dare to trifle with such an elite?
He hurriedly covered his crotch with his hand, and rapidly retreated.
“Hiss, so this guy is the core of the team.” The team of thirty people all looked over. The palm strike just now was enough to prove how terrifying Ling Han was.
“Let’s attack together. We’ll deal with him first.”
“All right!”
Twenty of them directly charged over, and the remaining nine held back Yuwen Tian and the others, not giving them the chance to help Ling Han.
However, was this useful?
Ling Han looked casual, but with a single punch, one of them was blasted into a naked pig. After ten punches, half of them had already revealed their fair behinds.
This time, no one dared to make another move.
He was too strong, practically reaching a freakish extent.
“Run!”

At this point, the opposing team of 30 had been completely annihilated.

-The five people here were too strong. They had won with a disadvantage in numbers, and defeated all their opponents.
The number one team was indeed powerful, so it was best not to trifle with them.
The night passed, and there was only one day left in the competition.

Clearly, they were not in the same team, yet they had gathered together because of her.

Indeed, the might of beauties could not be underestimated, especially for someone like her, who could be ranked on the Exquisite Beauty Leaderboard. There may only be one in tens of thousands of galaxies.

The closer it was to the end of the tournament, the more intense the internal strife became. Occasionally, teams would disappear, and teams would suddenly turn from six, five, or four to three. Thus, the rankings of teams changed very quickly, and the individual rankings would change drastically in an instant.

However, when the sun disappeared from the horizon, it meant the end of this competition. They had received a notice, and everyone was to gather at a certain place. There was a Transfer Formation there that would allow them to leave.

After walking for half a day, Ling Han’s group of five arrived at their destination. They saw that this was a simple camp, but there was an ancient mirror floating in the air. Occasionally, a streak of light would pass by, exuding a chilling aura.
Though vicious beasts did not have intelligence, they would instinctively seek fortune and avoid calamity. Naturally, they would avoid this base from afar.

A great many people had already returned, and there was no shortage of those who had called for help and been eliminated or those who had lost their connection devices. They had all been sent here by the people of the Nine Suns Holy Land.

This time, the teleportation wasn’t going to take place in groups of 10 people. Instead, it was going to take place in groups of 100 people. After a short while, everyone left the Barbaric Planet and reappeared in the Nine Suns Holy Land.
Those who had been eliminated in advance naturally left dejectedly, and even if they managed to hold on until the end of the competition, the majority of them would still be eliminated.
The members of the Holy Land began to tally the scores, and then listed the top hundred according to their individual score ranking.
Actually, it was not just 100, but rather 103, because the final four had the same score.
In that case, they would relax the rules a bit, and take them all in.

On the Cauldron Forging Tier’s side, there were 103, and on the Foundation Building Tier’s side, there were 102. In total, there were 205 of them. For a Holy Land, this number was not the slightest bit large. Even if in the next nine years, the recruitment number was the same, there would still only be a total of over 2000 people, which could be considered quite poor. The empress and the others all passed the test successfully, though their ranking wasn’t the highest.

Those who passed all entered into the true Nine Suns Holy Land. Disciples of the Foundation Building Tier lived in the Foundation Building Valley, disciples of the Cauldron Forging Tier were in the Cauldron Forging Mountain, and when they advanced into the Core Formation Tier, they would move to the Core Formation Sea. From the True Self Tier onwards, they would be qualified to live in the Holy Palace.
