Those who could live for more than 10,000 years would have to be in the True Self Tier- very few, because the True Self Tier elites would only be able to live for 10,000 years at most. Those who could live for this number of years were basically extremely lucky, and had eaten Saintly medicine that could
extend their lifespan.

However, it wasn’t that the Holy Land didn’t have Foundation Building Tiers, Cauldron Forging Tiers, or even Core Formation Tier disciples. Because some elders and the like would also secretly take disciples, while others would be the Dao Apprentice by their side, receiving guidance. As time passed, a few naturally stepped onto the path of cultivation.
Because they had just entered into the Holy Land, everyone appeared to be very low-key.

In the Holy Land, everyone used the connection device that was unique to the Holy Land. There were contribution points used internally, and to be frank, it was Universe Coins. However, one could not use Dao Stones to buy Universe Coins. Instead, one had to make a solid contribution to the Holy Land to be able to obtain contribution points.
Contribution points included achievements in martial arts, or winning honour for the Holy Land. There were quite a number of different ways.
Ling Han investigated in detail. The Nine Suns Holy Land didn’t have a Saint Master, only an
acting Saint Master.
Why?
This was a rule that the Nine Suns Saint had set all those years ago.

The ultimate technique that the Nine Suns Saint was most proud of was the Nine Suns Finger. At the time, it was practically invincible in this world. Afterwards, he had failed in his competition for the position of Ancestral King, so he focused on his studies, and cultivated an even stronger ultimate technique called the “God Slaying Technique”. However, the God Slaying Technique had not been passed on. Instead, it had been hidden somewhere by the
Nine Suns Saint.
And whoever could find the God Slaying Technique and learn it would be the Saint Master of the Nine Suns Holy Land.

Why did the Nine Suns Saint take in so few disciples, which did not match the status of a Holy Land at all? This was also one of the rules of the Nine Suns Saint. The more talented he was, the more likely he was to become a successor. This was a good opportunity to gather his limited resources and nurture out a powerful successor. Otherwise, if he went out, wouldn’t that be embarrassing the Nine Suns Saint?
Ling Han felt that this Saint was a little extreme, because even those Imperial Clans did not
have such rules. There was no Great Emperor or Ancestral King that hid their invincible techniques, and would require their descendants to expend great effort to find them.
Then, was Nine Suns Finger easy to learn?
It would be difficult.

Because this was something that only the acting Saint Master could learn, and if one wanted to become the acting Saint Master, he would first have to become a Dao Child, and then emerge victorious from nine Dao Child candidates. He would have to be the first to reach the cultivation level of Venerate Tier, and then wait until the last acting Saint Master died, or he himself stepped down from his position, to be able to succeed.

Going by this calculation, no matter how smooth it was, it would still take tens of thousands of years the present acting Saint Master had only lived for over sixty thousand years, so no matter what, he should be able to live for another twenty thousand years.
Thus, the fastest way to obtain the Saint’s celestial technique was to find the God Slaying Technique, and become the Saint Master. Then the Nine Suns Saint would naturally fall into
his hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 3824: Cauldron Heart Pill
paragraphs: Every generation of disciples, including the elders and the acting Saint Masters, were all searching for the whereabouts of the God Slaying Technique, but in the past 100 million years, not a single person had succeeded.
Who knew where the Nine Suns Saint had hidden this Saint Technique?

There were even some who speculated that the Nine Suns Saint had not created this ultimate technique that was claimed to be comparable to an Imperial Technique. It was completely because of the issue of pride that he had made such an exaggeration, and in order not to slap himself in the face, he could only say that he had hid the God Slaying Technique away.
Nearly 100 million years had passed, so Ling Han naturally couldn’t deduce which one was real and which one was fake. He would believe that there really was a God Slaying Technique first.
In the Holy Land, there was a cultivation technique that could be cultivated directly. It was called Earth Mysterious Art, which was equivalent to the level of Sect Master.
For an ordinary disciple to be able to cultivate a cultivation technique on the level of Sect Master, it was clear how wealthy the Holy Land was.

And above Earth Mysterious Art, there was still Heaven Mysterious Art. This was the level of Venerate Tier, but Heaven Mysterious Art was not something that could be easily obtained. Instead, one would have to use contribution points to exchange for it, and one could only exchange for cultivation techniques that was not above his own cultivation level.
Above Heaven Mysterious Art, there was still the Absolute Yang Scroll, and this was the Saint Technique. Only a Dao Child could cultivate this technique.
Aside from that, the Holy Land also had a great many secret techniques that could be traded with contribution points, or they could try their luck on their own.
That was because you could possibly pick up a rock by the roadside, and there would be a secret technique engraved on it.
Why did they do this?
This was because they wanted to encourage their disciples to be imaginative and find the God Slaying Technique.
When he saw this, Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh. This Nine Suns Saint was toying terribly with his descendants and disciples.
Hence, in summary, there were four points: contribution points, luck, Dao Child and God Slaying Technique.

After finding the God Slaying Technique, everything would be settled. Otherwise, they could only use their contribution points to exchange for it, or try their luck, or after becoming a Dao Child, they could obtain some cultivation techniques and secret techniques.

Obviously, the difficulty of finding the God Slaying Technique was much, much too high, and becoming a Dao Child would also need time. Thus, all Ling Han could do now was try his luck or earn merit points.
Trying his luck wasn’t reliable. Earning contribution points was still the most reliable method.
Though Dao Stones could not be traded for contribution points, it did not mean that they could not be traded for other items.
For example, alchemical pills.

The standard of alchemy was also the measure of a force’s strength. If one had control of a large pile of resources, but did not have an alchemist that coulc concoct alchemical pills, that would be a massive waste.
There were more people than there were resources. Something like alchemical pills was never enough.
Thus, if he handed the alchemical pills over to the Holy Land, he would be able to exchange them for contribution points.
Ling Han planned to start from here.
He took a look. Among the two levels of Foundation Building Tier and Cauldron Forging Tier, the most expensive alchemical pill was Foundation Dissolution Pill and Cauldron Heart Pill respectively.
What was the Cauldron Heart Pill?
After ingesting it, it could form the core of a Celestial Cauldron, and help a cultivator cultivate the Celestial Cauldron. Of course, it was only a help, and did not mean definite success.
This alchemical pill was extremely difficult to concoct.
Why?
That was because the alchemist needed to have the cultivation level of at least Four Cauldrons, to be able to use the power of his own Celestial Cauldron to form a core.
However, how many alchemists were prodigies of martial arts?
Dual cultivation in alchemy and martial arts was already commendable, but to excel in both? It was naturally difficult.
Yet Ling Han smiled. Wasn’t this just prepared for him?

At present, he could no longer concoct Foundation Dissolution Pills, so he had no plans to hand over the remaining Foundation Dissolution Pills. That was because who knew if Ling Xi and the others would give birth to some grandchildren, great-grandchildren or the like for him. Thus, he had best save the Foundation Dissolution Pills. Who knew how long it would take to wait for a second person who could concoct Foundation Dissolution Pills.

The pill recipe for the Cauldron Heart Pill was also quite expensive. It was sold for 5 million Universe Coins on the Galaxy Network, and Ling Han still bought it. This was extremely practical, and also very easy to sell.
The sale of pill recipes was real-time. Ling Han had just paid, and the pill recipe had conveniently appeared in his connection device. He only had to pull it out and he would be able to check.
Ling Han studied it carefully, then meditated, and simulated it in his mind. After a few times, The already had some confidence.
He continued to buy ingredients and transported them through the Transfer Formation, spending money like water.
Sigh, Origin and the others had also become smarter. Otherwise, if he sold tickets for battles, his wealth would be rolling in.
Forget it, he would earn money by concocting alchemical pills himself. It was the same.
After buying the ingredients, Ling Han shut himself in his room and focused on concocting alchemical pills.
The empress, Lin Luo, and the others had the advantage in numbers, so they didn’t need to worry about being treated unfairly at all. Thus, Ling Han only needed to work hard to earn
contribution points now.
Even for the Alchemy Emperor, Ling Han still failed many times when he first started. However, after only two days, Ling Han had already concocted his first cauldron of Cauldron
Heart Pills.
The first time he succeeded, for Ling Han, it meant that he could no longer fail.
Ling Han continued to concoct alchemical pills. Apart from cultivating for half an hour every morning, he spent the rest of his time concocting alchemical pills.
Ten days later, he finally walked out.
He tidied himself up, then went out the doors, and ran towards the Saint Palace.
Descending the Cauldron Forging Mountain, there was a massive plaza. On one side of the
plaza was the Saint Palace.
There was a stone tablet erected in the middle of the plaza, and it was surrounded by many
people.
Yi, what was so interesting about a blank stone tablet?

Ling Han was confused. Previously, when he had entered into the Holy Land, it was not like he had not seen this stone tablet before. It was completely blank, and looked very ordinary. Was there any need for it to be surrounded by so many spectators?
He walked over, and when he heard everyone’s discussion, realization dawned on him.
As it turned out, the stone tablet wasn’t blank now. Instead, there were rows of names listed
on it.
What kind of ranking was this?
Total contribution value.
He, was this inspiring competitive spirit?
Ling Han took a look. The person ranked first was Gan Ping, the super genius ranked 188th on
the Galaxy Network. His total contribution value was 206.
The total value was regardless of expenditure, representing the extent of your contribution to
the Holy Land.
“As expected of Gan Ping. His natural talent is too terrifying. He only used three days to
master the Dragon Spirit Sword Technique.”
“That’s right, I still haven’t learnt it even now.”
“He’s ranked in the top 200 of the Galaxy Network, after all. His freakish talent is
indescribable.”
Everyone was exclaiming in shock, and Ling Han only found out after looking at the news on

the connecting device. As it turned out, seven days ago, an elder had given a public lecture, teachingthe Dragon Spirit Sword Technique, and he had been focused on concocting alchemical pills, and turned off the connecting device, so he had not received any news at all. One could earn contribution points by quickly learning a sword technique?
F***, didn’t they say that secret techniques had to be traded for contribution points, or found
through luck?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel that it was a pity. If he had known, he would have gone.
Forget it. He would first hand over the Cauldron Heart Pills.
Ling Han walked past the plaza and arrived at the entrance of the palace. There were guards here, and anyone below True Self Tier would have to first make a report.
After knowing why Ling Han had come, the guard called over a companion, and had him bring
Ling Han in to seek someone out.
The two of them soon arrived at the alchemy repository. There was an old man sitting there,
unperturbed.
“Elder Qin.” That guard bowed respectfully.
“What business do you have with me?” the old geezer asked casually.
“This disciple wishes to contribute alchemical pills.”
“Oh?” The old geezer was still completely unconcerned, “What alchemical pill?”
“Cauldron Heart Pill.”
“What!” The old geezer immediately stood up, his eyes burning.

Was there any need for it to be surrounded by so many spectators?
He walked over, and when he heard everyone’s discussion, realization dawned on him.
As it turned out, the stone tablet wasn’t blank now.
Instead, there were rows of names listed
on it.
What kind of ranking was this?
Total contribution value.
He, was this inspiring competitive spirit?
Ling Han took a look.
The person ranked first was Gan Ping, the super genius ranked 188th on
the Galaxy Network.
His total contribution value was 206.
The total value was regardless of expenditure, representing the extent of your contribution to
the Holy Land.
“As expected of Gan Ping.
His natural talent is too terrifying.
He only used three days to
master the Dragon Spirit Sword Technique.”
“That’s right, I still haven’t learnt it even now.”
“He’s ranked in the top 200 of the Galaxy Network, after all.
His freakish talent is
indescribable.”
Everyone was exclaiming in shock, and Ling Han only found out after looking at the news on
the connecting device.

As it turned out, seven days ago, an elder had given a public lecture, teachingthe Dragon Spirit Sword Technique, and he had been focused on concocting alchemical pills, and turned off the connecting device, so he had not received any news at all.
One could earn contribution points by quickly learning a sword technique?
F***, didn’t they say that secret techniques had to be traded for contribution points, or found
through luck?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel that it was a pity.
If he had known, he would have gone.
Forget it.
He would first hand over the Cauldron Heart Pills.
Ling Han walked past the plaza and arrived at the entrance of the palace.
There were guards here, and anyone below True Self Tier would have to first make a report.
After knowing why Ling Han had come, the guard called over a companion, and had him bring
Ling Han in to seek someone out.
The two of them soon arrived at the alchemy repository.
There was an old man sitting there,
unperturbed.
“Elder Qin.” That guard bowed respectfully.
“What business do you have with me?” the old geezer asked casually.
“This disciple wishes to contribute alchemical pills.”
“Oh?” The old geezer was still completely unconcerned, “What alchemical pill?”
“Cauldron Heart Pill.”
“What!” The old geezer immediately stood up, his eyes burning.

chapters.title: Chapter 3825: Screwed himself over
paragraphs: The old geezer had initially been wearing an indifferent expression, but when he heard the words “Cauldron Heart Pill”, he instantly couldn’t sit still any longer.
Cauldron Heart Pill, what kind of good thing was that? The requirements for concoction were too high.
Just ask what alchemist could reach Four Cauldrons?
To say nothing of alchemists, just in terms of cultivators, how many could cultivate to Four Cauldrons? If this was placed in the case of alchemists, it was naturally even more pitifully
rare.

Furthermore, the Cauldron Heart Pill was the same as the Foundation Dissolution Pill, and both had the requirement of cultivation level. Those who could concoct it did not mean that they could concoct both.

These conditions added together naturally made the Cauldron Heart Pill incredibly valuable. It should be known that not only could this help Human Cauldrons and Earth Cauldrons cultivate a new Celestial Cauldron, it could also help Heaven Cauldrons, Four Cauldrons, Five Cauldrons and so on cultivate even more Celestial Cauldrons.
The significance... was incredibly shocking.
Just look, how many prodigies in the entire universe had cultivated Four Cauldrons or above? Even at the current Cauldron Forging Tier, there were only a thousand of them.

Such a large universe, and there were only a thousand? It was enough to prove how difficult it was to form Four Cauldrons, and how valuable they were. In that case, the value of the Cauldron Heart Pill would naturally be reflected.

Of course, the chances of Heaven Cauldrons, Four Cauldrons and the like being able to form more Celestial Cauldrons after ingesting the pill was pitifully small, but there was still an additional sliver of possibility after all. It was assured that any Cauldron Forging Tier prodigy would fight madly for this.
“Really?” The old geezer stared at Ling Han as if he wanted nothing more than to pounce over and rob Ling Han completely.
Ling Han smiled, and took out a pill bottle which he placed on the table. There were three Cauldron Heart Pills inside.
The old geezer hurriedly snatched it over. His speed was inhumanly fast, but when he uncorked the bottle, he was very careful, and his movements were extremely slow.

He sniffed lightly at the opening of the bottle, and poured out an alchemical pill for a closer look. A look of delight instantly appeared on his old face, and he hurriedly placed the alchemical pill back into the bottle. He closed the cork tightly to prevent the medicinal effects from dispersing.
“Not bad, this really is the Cauldron Heart Pill.” The old geezer was extremely satisfied. Now, no matter how he looked at Ling Han, he found him pleasing to the eye. “Brat, what’s your name?”
“This disciple is Ling Han.”
The old geezer nodded, “That’s a good name!”
What was so good about it?
Ling Han didn’t think that there was anything special about his name, but since the old geezer praised him like this, he would play along.

“I am Yan Dong.” The old geezer introduced himself. This was actually an honor, because if others came to hand in alchemical pills, he would not even bother to speak. He would directly collect alchemical pills and give them contribution points. He would not be introducing himself like he was doing now.
Thus, the guards at the side were naturally shocked, completely unable to believe their eyes and ears.
F***, Elder Yan had changed his personality?
“Lord Yan.” Ling Han clasped his hands in greeting.

The more Yan Dong looked at Ling Han, the more he liked him. He was all smiles, “According to the rules, the Cauldron Heart Pill is a Two Star Celestial level pill. No matter how extraordinary it is, it is still too low-grade. One pill is fifty contribution points. However, I will make the decision privately, and double that for you.”
This was really quite a lot. Three pills would be 300 contribution points, which was enough to send Ling Han to the first place of the current leaderboard of contribution points.
Obviously, Yan Dong was deliberately helping Ling Han.
Ling Han hurriedly clasped his hands and said, “Thank you for your concern, Lord Yan.”
The guard at the side hurriedly reminded, and said, “It’s Elder Yan!”
Yet Yan Dong waved his hand, “It doesn’t matter what the address is.”
This was also because of Ling Han. Otherwise, if it was any other person, he would have long since sent out a slap.
He looked at Ling Han and nodded, his expression filled with praise, “You were the one who concocted this Cauldron Heart Pill, right? I can smell that fresh medicinal fragrance.”
The fact that the old geezer had been allocated here meant that he was clearly someone who knew what he was doing.
Ling Han didn’t hide it, and said, “Yes. You really have good insight.”
Naturally, it would be a waste not to flatter him.

Yan Dong laughed loudly, appearing very happy. He deliberately circled around from behind the table and patted Ling Han’s shoulder, “I know that the Cauldron Heart Pill is extremely difficult to concoct, and the pill completion rate is very low, but I still hope that you can concoct more.”
Ling Han nodded earnestly, “All right.”
“Go on.” The old geezer’s gaze was practically benevolent to the extreme.
Ling Han felt slightly embarrassed, and said, “Elder Yan, actually, I still have more Cauldron Heart Pills to hand in.”
Er!

Yan Dong’s expression suddenly became a little stiff. He had just said that the Cauldron Heart Pill was difficult to concoct and had low pill completion rate, and you f****** said that there were even more? Sigh, this was a good thing, a good thing.
The old geezer paused for a moment before asking, “More?”
“En.” Ling Han took out another bottle of Cauldron Heart Pills and placed it on the table. However, before Yan Dong could reach over to take it, he took out a third bottle.

The corner of Yan Dong’s mouth was already twitching slightly. This was the Cauldron Heart Pill, and not some ordinary alchemical pill that was commonly found on the streets. How could they be taken out one by one like this?
Aiyo, my heart.
He wanted to stretch out his hand, yet saw Ling Han take out the fourth bottle of alchemical
pills.

The old geezer was rendered speechless, and the gaze he directed at Ling Han was a little eerie. ‘You’ve f****** deliberately come to slap the old geezer’s face, haven’t you?’ However, this was not the end. Ling Han took out the fifth bottle, the sixth bottle, the seventh bottle... very soon, nineteen pill bottles were laid out on the table, and added with the bottle that Yan Dong had put away previously, there were a total of twenty bottles, making a total of sixty Cauldron Heart Pills.
Yan Dong was already numb. He examined bottle after bottle, and by the seventh bottle, his petrified face had an expression of shock.
These were naturally all Cauldron Heart Pills, and there was no problem with them at all. What shocked him was the fact that these alchemical pills were too fresh.
Freshness was naturally not a bad thing, but what did it mean? These alchemical pills were all
concocted in the short term.
There was a huge problem here.
How difficult was it to concoct the Cauldron Heart Pill?
Even if there were alchemists who could concoct it, being able to concoct a cauldron’s worth
of these alchemical pills in a month was already very impressive. However, what about Ling Han? So many alchemical pills had definitely been concocted in the last month.
What kind of alchemy ability was this?
The old geezer was so stunned that he stopped what he was doing and went into a daze again.
Ling Han waited for a while, and couldn’t help but cough lightly.
Yan Dong finally came back to his senses, and said, “Brat, I was wrong!”
This wasn’t some alchemy prodigy, but a freak, all right? He had surpassed prodigy countless
times over.
At first, he could only say that he admired Ling Han, but now, he was really treating Ling Han
like a treasure.
Actually, he did not know alchemy. He only knew how to appraise alchemical pills, but having
dealt with alchemical pills for so many years, he naturally knew the difficulty level of
concocting various alchemical pills, and that was why he was so stunned.
Ling Han smiled “shyly”. For the Alchemy Emperor, this was really no big deal.
“Er... contribution points,” he kindly reminded.
“Ah!” Only now did Yan Dong remember, but his expression immediately became ugly.
He had personally announced that he would double the contribution points for the Cauldron
Heart Pill, but that was because there were only three pills. If he privately gave Ling Han an additional 150 contribution points, none of the other higher ups would say anything about
him.
But it was different now. There were a total of 60 pills, and the contribution points involved
was 3000 points.
Three thousand points!
A great many people had earned less than this amount of contribution points in a few years,
yet it had slipped out of his hands.
Oh no, he had screwed himself over.

chapters.title: Chapter 3826: Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation
paragraphs: When Ling Han saw this, he smiled and said, “If this makes things difficult for Elder Yan, then I’ll just accept the original price.”
For the sake of his pride, there was no way Yan Dong could accept this. How could he go back on his word to a junior?
“No need, just stick with a hundred contribution points for one.” He was someone who cared about his pride.
“Thank you, Elder Yan!” Ling Han hurriedly bowed as low as possible. He had only been pretending to be polite in the first place.
Oh no, what exactly am I doing?
The corner of Yan Dong’s mouth twitched. He wanted nothing more than to slap himself. Originally, Ling Han had already given in, so why was he so determined to save face?
He had brought this upon himself.
The old geezer felt completely ill. He waved his hand, indicating that Ling Han could leave. He wanted to be alone for a while.

The guard from before still brought Ling Han out. His face was filled with envy, and he said, “Elder Yan is famous for his strict impartiality. If you can gain Elder Yan’s recognition, there should be no one who would bully you in the future in the Holy Land.”
Ling Han smiled. Even without Yan Dong’s protection, he wasn’t afraid of anyone.
In a battle of equal cultivation levels, whom had Ling Han ever been afraid of?
Ling Han was quite satisfied with this trip. In an instant, he had obtained 6000 contribution points, which could be used to redeem for some good stuff.
He told the guard that he wanted to sit for a while, and the guard did not rush him. After all, this was Elder Yan’s favorite.
Ling Han opened the connection device of the Holy Land and searched for what he needed and could redeem.
He naturally ignored the alchemical pills. He could concoct alchemical pills himself, so using contribution points to exchange for alchemical pills was practically idiotic.
However, he still took a look, and saw that the “price” of the Cauldron Heart Pill was actually a hundred contribution points.
F***, so deceitful.
Though Ling Han did not lose out, this was actually the contribution points that Yan Dong had offered by doubling the original price. Ordinarily, it should have been fifty.

However, aside from the fact that the Cauldron Heart Pills here required contribution points, there was also a further explanation, saying that quantity was limited. Only three pills would be provided every month, and if there were many people applying to redeem, the Holy Land would make the decision on which three people to give them, or even the fact that all three pills would be given to one person.
Forget it, he wasn’t going to look.
Ling Han found the natural treasures. This was what he was most concerned about. In his hands, the value of natural treasures could be doubled.
Nine Stalk Exquisite Grass, Purple Crystal Heavenly Heart Stone, Yellow Flower Fruit... There was a dazzling array of them, and Ling Han was also extremely conflicted as he browsed.
He wanted this, and he also wanted that, but there were only so many contribution points, so which few should he choose?
If others knew this, they would definitely stomp in envy and jealousy.
-Others would only be able to redeem a single treasure after saving up for a few months, or even a few years in fact, yet you f****** can choose a few. What else do you want?
Ling Han was in no rush to make a move. He continued to investigate. Wasn’t there still the cultivation techniques and celestial techniques?

Hiss, he merely took a glance, and then shook his head. That was because the exchange for the cultivation technique and celestial technique required too many contribution points. Even the lowest cost would be a thousand contribution points.
Was he going to trade?
Of course not. How could a cultivation technique or secret technique that could be redeemed with 1000 contribution points be worthy of Ling Han’s notice?
He went to look at something else.
Formation technique.
“Yi!”
Ling Han soon set his eyes on a formation called the Three Element Treasure Bottle Formation.

This was a Core Formation Tier-level formation. Theoretically speaking, it could kill a martial artist in the Core Formation Tier, but it was very troublesome to set up. It required the heaven and earth environment to meet the requirements, and only then could it change the power of heaven and earth, forming a great formation to kill a martial artist in the Core
Formation Tier.

Ling Han decided to redeem this, and it would become one of his trump cards in the future. If any Core Formation Tier cultivator wanted to hunt him down, he would set up the Three Element Treasure Bottle Formation, and then draw them into the formation, refining them forcefully.

He handed over his application for redemption. Because he had enough contribution points, 5300 contribution points were immediately deducted, and all the information about this formation appeared in his connection device.

Without reaching the level of an elder, one definitely could not teach all the cultivation techniques, secret techniques, pill recipes, and formations that were redeemed with contribution points. Otherwise, they would be dealt with on the charge of betraying the Holy Land.
After redeeming it, Ling Han set out again, heading out of the palace.
-Previously, he had not been in a rush to leave, because if he wanted to redeem a physical item, he would still have to retrieve it from the Saint Palace, and would not have to make an
additional trip.

He exited the palace, and had not taken a few steps, when he saw that those people that had been looking at the stone tablet on the plaza were gradually turning their eyes towards him, all of them bearing expressions of shock.
How could it not be frightening?
This guy had obtained a total of six thousand contribution points, which left Gan Ping, who was in second place, far behind.
Ling Han was unconcerned, and strode forwards. He still had to study formation techniques.
He didn’t hand over all of the Cauldron Heart Pills. Instead, he left a portion for auction on the Galaxy Network. Otherwise, he couldn’t just sit by and do nothing, simply spending what
wealth he had, right?
After the auction was completed, he had the large black dog make a trip over, and as per usual, the Chang Clan was responsible for transporting the goods.
In exchange for a large amount of Universe Coins, Ling Han rented the Time Chamber again to master the Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation as soon as possible.
A dozen over days passed, and Ling Han exited the Time Chamber, a smile on his face.
He was already familiar with this formation technique, so he could attempt to forge formation foundations.
He put on the connection device of the Holy Land again, and discovered that a great many people were discussing heatedly about his contribution points.

The sudden acquisition of so many contribution points would naturally draw the curiosity of others. Was there something fishy going on here? Furthermore, the Saint Palace had also made clear that Ling Han had used the Cauldron Heart Pill to exchange for contribution points. Because this was his first time, and because the Cauldron Heart Pill was too valuable and practical, they had given him twice the amount of contribution points. This was naturally Yan Dong’s excuse. He couldn’t say that he had screwed himself over,
right?

A great many people expressed their envy, but there were also some that made cynical remarks. For example, Gan Ping expressed that alchemy was only a minor path, and martial arts was the true path. What alchemist had ever become an Ancestral King?
Ling Han merely chuckled. This was completely jealousy, and there was no need to take it to
heart.
However, everyone had also guessed that Ling Han was definitely an alchemist prodigy. Moreover... he had formed Four Cauldrons. This was a necessary condition to concoct the
Cauldron Heart Pill.
Four Cauldrons, what kind of concept was that?
Among the current Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators, Ling Han’s strength could be ranked in
the top 1000.
Previously, Ling Han had been in seclusion. Now that he had come out, a great many people immediately came to pay him a visit, trying to cotton up to him.

Mainly, it was because of his alchemy abilities. They hoped that Ling Han could help them concoct the Cauldron Heart Pill. After all, it was too difficult to redeem them with contribution points – even though Ling Han had easily obtained 6000 contribution points, if it was anyone else, it would be extremely difficult to even obtain a single contribution point.
“Master, Celestial Maiden Tan seeks an audience,” a Dao Apprentice came to report to Ling
Han.

In the Holy Land, every disciple would be assigned a Dao Apprentice to handle some trivial matters. This Dao Apprentice of Ling Han was called Mingyue, and was only fourteen or fifteen years old. He had just broken through to the Mystery Realm Tier.
Ling Han glanced at him, and saw that this half-grown child’s face was filled with
admiration, looking completely distracted.
Right, he must have been captivated by Tan Meng.
As expected of a seductive beauty on the Exquisite Leaderboard; even this kind of young boy
fell for her charms.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. “Invite her in.”

He wanted this, and he also wanted that, but there were only so many contribution points, so which few should he choose?
If others knew this, they would definitely stomp in envy and jealousy.
-Others would only be able to redeem a single treasure after saving up for a few months, or even a few years in fact, yet you f****** can choose a few.
What else do you want?
Ling Han was in no rush to make a move.
He continued to investigate.
Wasn’t there still the cultivation techniques and celestial techniques?
Hiss, he merely took a glance, and then shook his head.
That was because the exchange for the cultivation technique and celestial technique required too many contribution points.
Even the lowest cost would be a thousand contribution points.
Was he going to trade?
Of course not.
How could a cultivation technique or secret technique that could be redeemed with 1000 contribution points be worthy of Ling Han’s notice?
He went to look at something else.
Formation technique.
“Yi!”
Ling Han soon set his eyes on a formation called the Three Element Treasure Bottle Formation.
This was a Core Formation Tier-level formation.
Theoretically speaking, it could kill a martial artist in the Core Formation Tier, but it was very troublesome to set up.
It required the heaven and earth environment to meet the requirements, and only then could it change the power of heaven and earth, forming a great formation to kill a martial artist in the Core
Formation Tier.
Ling Han decided to redeem this, and it would become one of his trump cards in the future.
If any Core Formation Tier cultivator wanted to hunt him down, he would set up the Three Element Treasure Bottle Formation, and then draw them into the formation, refining them forcefully.
He handed over his application for redemption.
Because he had enough contribution points, 5300 contribution points were immediately deducted, and all the information about this formation appeared in his connection device.
Without reaching the level of an elder, one definitely could not teach all the cultivation techniques, secret techniques, pill recipes, and formations that were redeemed with contribution points.
Otherwise, they would be dealt with on the charge of betraying the Holy Land.
After redeeming it, Ling Han set out again, heading out of the palace.
-Previously, he had not been in a rush to leave, because if he wanted to redeem a physical item, he would still have to retrieve it from the Saint Palace, and would not have to make an
additional trip.

He exited the palace, and had not taken a few steps, when he saw that those people that had been looking at the stone tablet on the plaza were gradually turning their eyes towards him, all of them bearing expressions of shock.
How could it not be frightening?
This guy had obtained a total of six thousand contribution points, which left Gan Ping, who was in second place, far behind.
Ling Han was unconcerned, and strode forwards.
He still had to study formation techniques.
He didn’t hand over all of the Cauldron Heart Pills.
Instead, he left a portion for auction on the Galaxy Network.
Otherwise, he couldn’t just sit by and do nothing, simply spending what
wealth he had, right?
After the auction was completed, he had the large black dog make a trip over, and as per usual, the Chang Clan was responsible for transporting the goods.
In exchange for a large amount of Universe Coins, Ling Han rented the Time Chamber again to master the Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation as soon as possible.
A dozen over days passed, and Ling Han exited the Time Chamber, a smile on his face.
He was already familiar with this formation technique, so he could attempt to forge formation foundations.
He put on the connection device of the Holy Land again, and discovered that a great many people were discussing heatedly about his contribution points.
The sudden acquisition of so many contribution points would naturally draw the curiosity of others.
Was there something fishy going on here?
Furthermore, the Saint Palace had also made clear that Ling Han had used the Cauldron Heart Pill to exchange for contribution points.
Because this was his first time, and because the Cauldron Heart Pill was too valuable and practical, they had given him twice the amount of contribution points.
This was naturally Yan Dong’s excuse.
He couldn’t say that he had screwed himself over,
right?
A great many people expressed their envy, but there were also some that made cynical remarks.
For example, Gan Ping expressed that alchemy was only a minor path, and martial arts was the true path.
What alchemist had ever become an Ancestral King?
Ling Han merely chuckled.
This was completely jealousy, and there was no need to take it to
heart.
However, everyone had also guessed that Ling Han was definitely an alchemist prodigy.
Moreover... he had formed Four Cauldrons.
This was a necessary condition to concoct the
Cauldron Heart Pill.
Four Cauldrons, what kind of concept was that?
Among the current Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators, Ling Han’s strength could be ranked in
the top 1000.
Previously, Ling Han had been in seclusion.
Now that he had come out, a great many people immediately came to pay him a visit, trying to cotton up to him.
Mainly, it was because of his alchemy abilities.
They hoped that Ling Han could help them concoct the Cauldron Heart Pill.

After all, it was too difficult to redeem them with contribution points – even though Ling Han had easily obtained 6000 contribution points, if it was anyone else, it would be extremely difficult to even obtain a single contribution point.
“Master, Celestial Maiden Tan seeks an audience,” a Dao Apprentice came to report to Ling
Han.
In the Holy Land, every disciple would be assigned a Dao Apprentice to handle some trivial matters.
This Dao Apprentice of Ling Han was called Mingyue, and was only fourteen or fifteen years old.
He had just broken through to the Mystery Realm Tier.
Ling Han glanced at him, and saw that this half-grown child’s face was filled with
admiration, looking completely distracted.
Right, he must have been captivated by Tan Meng.
As expected of a seductive beauty on the Exquisite Leaderboard; even this kind of young boy
fell for her charms.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself.
“Invite her in.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3827: Asking for alchemical pills
paragraphs: Mingyue hurriedly scrambled over to invite her in. After only a short while, the clinking of ornaments was heard, and an exquisite beauty appeared in front of Ling Han.

Even with Ling Han’s picky taste, he had to admit that this woman was indeed beautiful. She was breathtakingly beautiful and elegant, slightly superior to even the princess of the Demon Race, Ling Han. She was only inferior to the empress and Hu Niu.
It should be known that she was only ranked fifty-third on the Exquisite Beauty Leaderboard. If she was in the top ten, what kind of grace would she have?
That was probably really capable of matching Hu Niu and the empress.

Ling Han sized up this seductive beauty with an admiring gaze. Her figure was slender, and she was clearly elegant and graceful, but because her slender waist was only tied simply, it was inevitable that both ends would appear very plump, adding a sliver of charm to her.
“Greetings, Senior Brother Ling.” She smiled slightly, revealing a little bit of her pearly white teeth, her bearing enchanting.
Mingyue was already transfixed with shock, his small face completely flushed red.
Ling Han was only admiring her, so he naturally wouldn’t be flustered. He smiled faintly, and said, “Hello, Junior Sister.”
“Senior Brother, are you looking down on me? You’re not even inviting me to sit down,” Tan Meng said slowly. It was as if she had suffered a grievance, causing one’s heart to melt.
Ling Han stretched out a hand, and said, “Please sit.”
Only then did Tan Meng break out into a smile. Instantly, it was as if a hundred flowers had bloomed at the same time, indescribably beautiful.
She sat down in an incredibly elegant position, and just looked quietly at Ling Han, not saying a word.
Ling Han sighed, and said, “Mingyue, don’t look anymore. Hurry up and make some tea.”

Mingyue seemed to have woken up from a dream, and hurriedly turned around to exit. Peng, in his rush, he had even crashed into a pillar. Thankfully, he had not used too much force, or the pillar would definitely have been broken.
When Tan Meng saw this, she couldn’t help but cover her small mouth and chuckle softly.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “With Junior Sister’s arrival, even my Dao Apprentice doesn’t know how to do things anymore.”
“Senior Brother Ling, are you saying that a beauty like me is a calamity?” Tan Meng asked with a smile.
“I wouldn’t dare.”

Tan Meng laughed delicately again, “Senior Brother, you are too modest. With your cultivation level of Four Cauldrons, and added with your accomplishments in alchemy, you are definitely ranked in the top three in this batch of disciples. What would you not dare to do?”
Though her flattery was good, just what had Ling Han experienced? How could he possibly be knocked dizzy by her flattery?
He smiled slightly, “If you have something to say, just say it.”
“Senior Brother, what are you saying? Can’t I come see you for no reason?” Tan Meng asked with a smile.
“Sure,” Ling Han said with a nod. “I’ve always liked to cut to the chase. Why don’t we go to the bedroom and face each other frankly?”
The smile on Tan Meng’s face instantly froze. She had never imagined that Ling Han would be so direct.

She certainly saw Ling Han in a new light, but it was definitely not in terms of romance. Instead, she had her eye on Ling Han’s alchemy ability, and that was why she wanted to charm Ling Han with her personal charisma.
In her eyes, only the top 100 of the Galaxy Network would be worthy of becoming her husband.
Though Ling Han had formed Four Cauldrons, that was all. He was ranked in the top 700 on the Galaxy Network, at most, and that was still very far from the top 100.
“Senior Brother Ling, you jest.” Tan Meng forced out a smile.
“I never joke around in this area,” Ling Han said with a shake of his head. He wore a serious expression.
Tan Meng was suddenly rendered speechless. She felt as if she had encountered a pervert, and she was powerless to resist.

She did not just possess beauty, but also had outstanding intelligence. Otherwise, wouldn’t she just be a pretty face and an idiot? However, when she encountered Ling Han, who took the unusual path, it made both her EQ and IQ seem to have short-circuited.
Thankfully, Mingyue just happened to bring tea over. She hurriedly sipped it, as she calmed her emotions and organized her thoughts.
She decided that she could no longer be polite, or she would be teased to death by Ling Han.
“Senior Brother Ling, actually, I have indeed come this time to ask for Senior Brother Ling’s help.”
Meanwhile, Ling Han sighed faintly, “So, as expected, you are still playing around with me.” Tan Meng was instantly speechless. Playing around with you?
‘Do I dare to trick you? You’re clearly the one taking liberties with me.’

She finally understood. Ling Han didn’t think of her as a goddess or celestial maiden at all, and he didn’t have any adoration for her. Otherwise, no man would speak to a girl whom he was interested in like this.
“I would like to ask Senior Brother to concoct a cauldron of Moon Pills for me.” She acted as if she had not heard Ling Han’s words, and went straight to the point.
Moon Pill?
Ling Han thought for a moment, then gave an ‘oh’.
He didn’t know how to concoct Moon Pills, but he had seen the introduction of this alchemical pill before. In fact, it had completely nothing to do with cultivation. It would only increase
one’s charisma.
Bearing was an ethereal thing, but it was said that the Moon Pill could increase one’s temperament and increase one’s charm.
Obviously, Tan Meng was not satisfied with being ranked fifty-second on the Exquisite Beauty Leaderboard. She still wanted to be ranked fortieth, thirtieth, or perhaps even higher.
For elites, whether their appearance had changed or not could be seen clearly with a single glance, but temperament was a different story.
Ling Han smiled, “I never help others concoct alchemical pills for free. Why don’t we talk in the bedroom?”
Tan Meng’s expression instantly changed again, and she said, “Senior Brother, don’t joke
around.”
“I’m such a serious person, so how could I joke about something like this?” Ling Han asked
solemnly.
Tan Meng finally couldn’t hold on any longer. After saying that she was feeling unwell, she hurriedly left.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile. This woman clearly wanted him to concoct alchemical pills for nothing. What a joke; did he owe her anything? She must be dreaming.
After leaving, Tan Meng’s intelligence instantly came online.
“Oh no, I’ve fallen into a trap!” She immediately realized that something was off. If Ling Han was really such an unbearable pervert, how could he have cultivated both martial arts and
alchemy?
Thus, the other party had deliberately used this kind of method to chase her away.
Though she had thought things through, Tan Meng was still filled with indignation.
A seductive beauty on the Exquisite Leaderboard was actually rejected?
This was too damaging to her pride.
No, she definitely could not take this lying down.

It was not just Tan Meng. The other two seductive beauties on the Exquisite Leaderboard also paid Ling Han a visit, one after the other. However, they did not intend to ask Ling Han to concoct alchemical pills for them. They merely thought that Ling Han was a genius, and was worthy of recruitment.
All of a sudden, the news of the three seductive beauties visiting Ling Han at the same time spread like wildfire, and also caused Ling Han to instantly become a public enemy.
Gan Ping and Lin Qi had both publicly declared that Ling Han was only an alchemist, and his
abilities were mediocre. If he dared to exchange blows with them, he would definitely be defeated within ten moves.
Ling Han couldn’t help but ponder. Should he seek out these two people for a battle, then collect tickets and earn some contribution points?
However, contribution points could not be transferred, and this was a problem.
Ling Han also spoke up. If they wanted a battle, he would oblige.
However, Gan Ping and Lin Qi both expressed disdain at exchanging blows with a weakling
like Ling Han. Bullying an alchemist would lower their status.
F***, they were the ones who said they wanted to fight, and they were also the ones who said
they didn’t want to fight.

Ling Han couldn’t be bothered to pay them any regard. He had bought the ingredients through the Galaxy Network, wanting to create the formation foundations of the Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation.
This was not something that could be done overnight. He studied earnestly, and ruined a great many ingredients, but was still unable to create the formation foundations.

He was very busy at the moment. Aside from cultivating, he also had to concoct alchemical pills and study formation techniques. Several days later, he planned to go out and change his mood. Perhaps it would be of help.

After walking for a while, he suddenly came to an understanding. He sat under a tree, and was just about to grab hold of this enlightenment. Pa, something crashed down from the top. He hurriedly dodged, and when he raised his head, he saw that there was actually an elder standing at the top of the tree.

chapters.title: Chapter 3828: Illusion Cloud Cat
paragraphs: The Nine Suns Holy Land only recruited new disciples once every 10,000 years.
Thus, for an old geezer to appear here, it was highly possible that he was an old monster that had lived for ten thousand years or even longer.
What did this signify?
He had to be True Self Tier, at least, but it was more likely that he was a Spirit Transformation True Lord, or a Sect Master elite.
“Brat, you’re not paying your respects to this old man!” the old man said with a humph. His aura fluctuated slightly, and it was indescribably abundant.
Initially, Ling Han had wanted to pay his respects. It was only right that he maintain respect for his elders, but hearing the other party’s words, he felt that something was off.
When he thought about it again, he had even deliberately thrown the core of the fruit at him. Was this something that an elder should do?
Thus, he activated his eye technique and looked at the old man again.
A smile appeared at the corners of Ling Han’s lips. Then, he shook his head, “No.”
“How dare you!” The old man shouted loudly, and landed on the ground. An image appeared behind him, manifesting the destruction of planets, which was extremely terrifying.
This had far surpassed the level of the Cauldron Forging Tier, or even the might of the Sect Master Tier.
Yet Ling Han was unhurried, and began to circle around the old man.
“Brat, are you tired of living?” the old man asked balefully.
Ling Han chuckled, and did not say anything. He continued to walk in circles.
“Are you really seeking death?”
“Hehe.”
“How dare you! I’ll give you another chance. Don’t ruin yourself!” the elder shouted loudly. His voice rumbled like thunder.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, saying, “Don’t just spout nonsense. Come, teach me a lesson.”

The elder flew into a thunderous rage, and with a wave of his hand, hong, multiple great stars appeared behind him. Every great star was engraved with incredibly complex seals, and it was as if even if only a single star crashed down, even a Spirit Transformation True Lord could only wait for death.
Ling Han wore a faint smile as he crossed his arms behind his back. He appeared calm and composed.

“You—” The old man shouted again, and suddenly withdrew his hand, pressing it on his stomach, “Not good, I ate something bad! Brat, just you wait, when I go to relieve myself, I will come back to deal with you!”
He turned around to flee.
Xiu, Ling Han’s figure flashed, blocking the other’s path.
“Brat, this old man will temporarily spare your life. Don’t forget yourself in your conceit,” the old man said coldly.

Ling Han laughed loudly, “Come on, old senior, how do you plan to teach me a lesson?” “This old man, this old man, this old man-” The old man’s eyes darted around madly. No matter how he looked at it, he did not look like a Sect Master elite. He suddenly pointed behind Ling Han, “Look, what is that!”
Ling Han was unmoved, and continued to stare at him.
“Why aren’t you turning around?” the elder couldn’t help but ask.
“If I turned around to look, what if you managed to escape?” Ling Han asked.
“Would I run? Are you joking? Do you know who I am?” the old man shouted loudly. Ling Han cracked a smile, “A cat demon.”
Pu!
At first, the old man wanted to roar, but when he heard Ling Han’s words, he immediately wilted, and revealed a shocked expression, “You actually saw through my true identity?”
“What’s so difficult about it?” Ling Han asked calmly.

Peng, a burst of light twisted, and the old man in front of him immediately changed. From a great elite with an oppressive aura, he turned into an ordinary-sized white cat, with a bell hanging from his neck.
“Mew, brat, how did you see through it?” the white cat asked, an obvious curiosity on its face.
Though it was in the form of a cat, this was definitely not a wild beast, but rather a Cat Demon. It had developed intelligence, and even knew how to act mysterious and deceive others.
“Fiery Golden Eyes,” Ling Han said with a smile.

“Forget it. Those that can see through my illusions must have cultivated a Mystical Eye Technique. There are only a few such people in the entire galaxy.” The white cat licked its paw, “Brat, let me warn you. Don’t expose me, or I will tell that old geezer, Nine Mountains, and suppress you.”
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. Nine Mountains? Could it be that it was the Nine Mountains Venerate?
“Are you the pet beast of the Nine Mountains Venerate?” he asked.

“Pei, you’re the beast pet here. Your whole family are beast pets!” The white cat instantly became agitated. “One day, I’ll suppress that guy, Nine Mountains, and have him act like a stuffed furball for me every day – meow!”
It suddenly pounced out, grabbed a ball and began playing with it.
However, as it played, it realized that something was wrong. It hurriedly stopped, and stared at Ling Han with a bitter and hateful gaze.
It was this guy that had thrown the ball at it. It had actually reflexively pounced out without control.
He really wanted to chop off his own paws.
Ling Han pursed his lips, and said, “I see that you’re playing quite happily. It’s obvious that you want to play, right?”
“Pei, pei, pei! I am an incredibly noble Illusion Cloud Cat, so how could I possibly like to play with such childish things?” The white cat wore a proud expression.
“Go.” Ling Han threw another ball.
The white cat tragically discovered that it had pounced out again, unable to resist at all.
Ling Han shrugged, “Look.”

He was internally surprised. The Illusion Cloud Cat’s battle prowess was not very strong, but this kind of Demonic Beast was skilled in creating illusions. The higher the cultivation level, the more realistic the illusions were. Even Venerate Tier elites and Saints could possibly fall
for it.

Thus, the Illusion Cloud Cat was an extremely good supportive tool in battle. Additionally, because the Illusion Cloud Cat could create all kinds of images, it was actually of great help to cultivators comprehending precious techniques and cultivation techniques.
Of course, the Illusion Cloud Cat’s cultivation level also had to catch up. Wasn’t it a joke to have a Cauldron Forging Tier Illusion Cloud Cat create illusions that even Saints couldn’t
distinguish from reality?
“Don’t tease this cat anymore!” the white cat said in displeasure.
“All right, I’m done playing.” Ling Han nodded, but couldn’t hold himself back. Shua, he
threw out the third ball.
The white cat: “...”

“Alright, alright, I really don’t want to play anymore.” Ling Han sat down again. At first, he had suddenly come to an enlightenment, but the moment the enlightenment appeared, it was destroyed. He naturally had to punish this demon cat.
The white cat was still fuming, raising its head proudly.
Ling Han looked at the white cat, and said, “You’re here to trick people, right?”
The white cat humphed, “So what? I deceived you with my own abilities. Even if you have the ability, go ahead and deceive others yourself.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, “You’re acting so self-righteous now?”
“Let me warn you again, don’t leak out the matter of this cat!” the white cat said solemnly.
“Sure,” Ling Han nodded.

Ling Han smiled and said, “What benefits did you get? Just give me some.”
‘Holy f*ck!’
The white cat stared fixedly at Ling Han, “I suddenly realize that you are even more
shameless than this cat.”
“You can deceive me with your own abilities, but I can also use my own abilities,” Ling Han
said with a smile.

“Pei, I only let those idiots use their contribution points to redeem some Cold Plum Wine to satisfy my cravings. I am not as unbearable as you think,” the white cat said angrily. “Alright, I’ll keep it a secret for you.” Ling Han observed the expression on the cat’s face, and felt that the white cat was telling the truth.
“You’re really so kind?” How could the white cat possibly trust Ling Han so easily?
“Just think, if they could have bene deceived by even you, they would have deserved it,” Ling
Han said with a smile.
The white cat instantly bristled, “What do you mean? Are you looking down on me?”
“Just kidding! Just kidding!” Ling Han hurriedly comforted the cat demon.

Thus, for an old geezer to appear here, it was highly possible that he was an old monster that had lived for ten thousand years or even longer.
What did this signify?
He had to be True Self Tier, at least, but it was more likely that he was a Spirit Transformation True Lord, or a Sect Master elite.
“Brat, you’re not paying your respects to this old man!” the old man said with a humph.
His aura fluctuated slightly, and it was indescribably abundant.
Initially, Ling Han had wanted to pay his respects.
It was only right that he maintain respect for his elders, but hearing the other party’s words, he felt that something was off.
When he thought about it again, he had even deliberately thrown the core of the fruit at him.
Was this something that an elder should do?
Thus, he activated his eye technique and looked at the old man again.
A smile appeared at the corners of Ling Han’s lips.
Then, he shook his head, “No.”
“How dare you!” The old man shouted loudly, and landed on the ground.
An image appeared behind him, manifesting the destruction of planets, which was extremely terrifying.
This had far surpassed the level of the Cauldron Forging Tier, or even the might of the Sect Master Tier.
Yet Ling Han was unhurried, and began to circle around the old man.
“Brat, are you tired of living?” the old man asked balefully.
Ling Han chuckled, and did not say anything.
He continued to walk in circles.
“Are you really seeking death?”
“Hehe.”
“How dare you!
I’ll give you another chance.
Don’t ruin yourself!” the elder shouted loudly.
His voice rumbled like thunder.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, saying, “Don’t just spout nonsense.
Come, teach me a lesson.”
The elder flew into a thunderous rage, and with a wave of his hand, hong, multiple great stars appeared behind him.
Every great star was engraved with incredibly complex seals, and it was as if even if only a single star crashed down, even a Spirit Transformation True Lord could only wait for death.
Ling Han wore a faint smile as he crossed his arms behind his back.
He appeared calm and composed.
“You—” The old man shouted again, and suddenly withdrew his hand, pressing it on his stomach, “Not good, I ate something bad!
Brat, just you wait, when I go to relieve myself, I will come back to deal with you!”
He turned around to flee.
Xiu, Ling Han’s figure flashed, blocking the other’s path.

Don’t forget yourself in your conceit,” the old man said coldly.

He suddenly pointed behind Ling Han, “Look, what is that!”
Ling Han was unmoved, and continued to stare at him.
“Why aren’t you turning around?” the elder couldn’t help but ask.

“Would I run?
Are you joking?
Do you know who I am?” the old man shouted loudly.

Pu!
At first, the old man wanted to roar, but when he heard Ling Han’s words, he immediately wilted, and revealed a shocked expression, “You actually saw through my true identity?”
“What’s so difficult about it?” Ling Han asked calmly.
Peng, a burst of light twisted, and the old man in front of him immediately changed.
From a great elite with an oppressive aura, he turned into an ordinary-sized white cat, with a bell hanging from his neck.
“Mew, brat, how did you see through it?” the white cat asked, an obvious curiosity on its face.

Nine Mountains?

for it.

chapters.title: Chapter 3829: Legendary places
paragraphs: Without any inspiration, Ling Han roamed around outside before helplessly returning to his residence.
After a few days, Ling Han was suddenly inspired again. Just as he was about to cultivate diligently, the large black dog ran over.

Because Ling Han had informed Mingyue before, if those like the empress, the large black dog, Lin Luo and the others came, there was no need to report their arrival. He could just let them in directly. Thus, he could be considered to have suffered the consequences of his own actions, and his rhythm had been disrupted again.
Ling Han sighed, “You despicable dog, you really came at the best time.”
“Woof, I’ve been tricked.” The large black dog felt extremely gloomy.
“What is it?” Ling Han asked, though his heart was moved.

“F***, I was looking for an opportunity, and encountered an old geezer. He said that he was fated with Grandpa Dog, and was willing to teach me the supreme Mystical Power. In the end, Grandpa Dog believed him, and even eagerly bought him a pot of Cold Plum Wine. The old geezer told Grandpa Dog to look for him on the mountain in the middle of the night, but in the end... I was chased down the mountain, and lost a contribution point for nothing.” The large black dog was extremely depressed.
Fine, this guy had been played by that white cat.

With the white cat’s illusion technique, aside from cultivating a Mystical Eye Technique, one would have to be a True Self Tier elite to be able to see through it. It wouldn’t be strange for the large black dog to fall for it.

“Grandpa Dog really doesn’t understand. As a Venerate Tier elite, do you have to go so far just for a pot of Cold Plum Wine!” The large black dog bared its teeth. In the day, he had said that would teach him the supreme Mystical Power, but at night, he suddenly turned hostile. Wasn’t this just toying with him?

Ling Han couldn’t help but think that the Nine Mountains Venerate was probably very depressed as well. That white cat impersonated him to deceive people everywhere, and it was to trick people into buying wine for it at that. How could this Venerate endure this?
His character was really too low!
“Despicable dog, when you see that old geezer in the future, why don’t you rush up and take a few bites?” Ling Han suggested.

The large black dog looked at Ling Han with disdain, “Do you think Grandpa Dog is retarded? That damn old geezer is a Venerate Tier elite, and you want Grandpa Dog to bite him? Even if Grandpa Dog bites that old geezer, the only result would be Grandpa Dog breaking all his teeth.”
Ling Han shook his head with a smile, “Since you don’t believe me, don’t blame me even if you can’t get your revenge.”
“Yi, do you know something?” The large black dog was skeptical.
“You guess.” Since Ling Han had already promised the white cat, he naturally wouldn’t go back on his word. No matter how much the large black dog pestered him, he didn’t relent.

The large black dog left resentfully, but he still managed to obtain a considerable number of alchemical pills from Ling Han. This was actually his main motive for coming here. Otherwise, how could it be that he really wanted Ling Han to fight with a Venerate Tier elite?

Actually, it was not only the large black dog, but also a great many people that had been deceived by that Cat Demon. However, not one of them managed to see through the illusion of the Cat Demon. They all thought that they had been tricked by a Venerate Tier elite, and dared not speak out in anger.

Another dozen over days passed, and Ling Han finally had some idea of how to create the formation foundations of the Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation. He began to carve out the formation foundations one after another. Although there were also failures, he spent nine days to finally complete all the formation foundations.
He did not waste any more time on formations, and began to walk around in the Holy Land.

It was not just the Nine Suns Saint. The seniors of the past generations also liked to hide their ultimate techniques in some corner, waiting for their descendants to unearth them. Of course, to prevent them from being lost, they could also use their contribution points to redeem them. However, as long as it was a celestial technique at the level of Sect Master, the contribution points needed to redeem it would be overwhelmingly high. Thus, they still had to try their luck.

There were some strange places in this Holy Land. For example, there was a dry well with no bottom, a rock that couldn’t be moved no matter what, a mountain cave that cried like a ghost all day, and so on.
Ling Han was a very curious person. Thus, he planned to go to these legendary places to take a look. His first stop was that dry well with no bottom.
The rookies did not believe it, and were always suspicious of legends. Thus, there were also a great many people here.
“Three days have already passed, so why hasn’t he come up yet?”
“He didn’t die inside, did he?”
“That’s impossible. If there’s danger, the Holy Land will stop us from entering.”

The people in the surroundings were all discussing. As it turned out, one of them had gone into the well previously, but three days had already passed, and he had still not returned. What about the connection device then?
Sorry, but once they entered into the dry well, even if they were face to face, the connection device would not allow communication.
“Ling Han?” Someone discovered him, and revealed a smile, “My name is Cang Shan. How fortunate to meet you.”
How was he fortunate?
Ling Han mocked internally, and smiled, “Hello.”

“Ling Han, Senior Brother Cang Shan is at the peak stage of Four Cauldrons. Among the disciples of Cauldron Forging Tier recruited this time, his abilities are enough to rank in the top ten, so you had best be more respectful,” someone immediately shouted.
Tsk, they could already enter into the Holy Land, so how could there still be such boot- lickers?
Ling Han glanced at that person, but did not speak. If he spoke to a bootlicker, it would degrade his status for nothing.

Cang Shan smiled, appearing to be very magnanimous. He said, “It’s like this. I’m presently preparing to break through to Five Cauldrons. Though I have a 50% chance, I’m also afraid of what if. Thus, I would like Junior Brother Ling to give me two Cauldron Heart Pills.”
Junior Brother Ling? Give?
Ling Han was surprised. Where did your confidence come from? You’re calling me Junior Brother just like that? Moreover, who do you think you are? Why should I give you anything?
More importantly, he was clearly asking for something from someone else, yet he still looked like he was giving alms to him. What a joke.
Cang Shan smiled again, “Junior Brother, I will not take your things for nothing. If you encounter any difficulties in future, feel free to look for me.”
“For example, if someone wanted to beat me up, would you block them for me?” Ling Han
asked.
“Piece of cake,” Cang Shan declared proudly.

He was filled with anticipation for breaking through to Five Cauldrons, because his present strength could be ranked in the top ten, but if he could become Five Cauldrons, he would definitely be able to rank in the top five. In fact, he would even be qualified to challenge Gan
Ping, Lin Qi and the others for the position of king tier.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “You can block any opponent?”
“Of course.” Cang Shan’s expression was still filled with confidence.
Boom, a fist shot over.
Cang Shan couldn’t help but feel furious. Ling Han actually dared to make a move on him; how
audacious.
He also threw a punch, wanting to let Ling Han know the immensity of heaven and earth.
-Even if they were both at Four Cauldrons, there would still be a world of difference between
their abilities.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a punch, and Cang Shan’s expression instantly changed drastically. Teng, teng, teng! He took a few dozen steps back, his face flushed red.
Yi?
Everyone was stunned. Cang Shan was actually no match for Ling Han?
How was this possible?
It should be known that both of them had broken through their limits, and formed Four Cauldrons. Since that was the case, the deciding factor would be whose cultivation level was
higher.
Cang Shan was already at the peak stage of Four Cauldrons, so no matter how weak he was, he should at least be able to fight Ling Han to a tie, right?
“You do have some abilities. Looks like I can’t suppress you with only thirty percent of my strength.” Cang Shan forced himself to be calm, and said calmly.
When everyone heard this, realization dawned on them. So that was how it was.
However, only Cang Shan himself knew that he had used 70% of his strength in this punch, yet
was completely no match for his opponent. In that case, even if he went all out, he could not
possibly gain any advantage.
However, the arrow was already drawn, so how could it not be fired?

chapters.title: Chapter 3830: The dry well without bottom
paragraphs: Cang Shan did not dare to be the slightest bit careless. He did not charge back at the first instant. Instead, he took a deep breath, and then formed his hands into claws. One in front, one on the right, one yin and one yang, and there were two balls of light, one black and one white, in his palms.
Xiu, he finally moved, his speed fast to the extreme. A great many people felt their vision blur, and there was already no sign of Cang Shan.
They couldn’t help but feel shocked. If Cang Shan wanted to kill them, would one move be enough?
Meanwhile, Ling Han simply threw a casual punch. He didn’t need to use any celestial technique, and it was just a simple punch.
But it was this very simple punch that directly hit the nail on the head.
Peng, Cang Shan was instantly sent flying.
Yi? Ah? Ya?
Everyone was once again stunned. What was going on here? Why had Cang Shan flown away again?
The first time could still be considered carelessness, but what about the second time? He clearly already knew how strong Ling Han was, yet would still be careless?
That was definitely impossible.
Thus, there was only one reason, and that was Ling Han was too strong.
Hiss, even a peak stage Four Cauldrons was completely unable to fight back in front of him. Just how strong was this guy?
Five Cauldrons? Six Cauldrons?
There were a few female cultivators here, and their eyes instantly lit up.
The prodigy cultivator and the prodigy alchemist added together, his brilliant light could not be concealed even by Gan Ping and Lin Qi.
Not far away, Cang Shan got up from the ground. He spat out a mouthful of blood, his face filled with viciousness, but did not say anything. He turned around and left.
“Wait!” Ling Han stepped forward to block him, and said, “You’re leaving just like that?” “What else do you want?” Cang Shan was indignant.

“Hehe, I have never liked to trifle with others, but after being trifled with, if I don’t kill my opponent, then I would have him admit it wholeheartedly. In future, when he sees me, he would have to call me Big Brother.” Ling Han broke into a smile, “Since we are all Sect Brothers, I will not kill you. I will just beat you until you call me Big Brother.”
He moved, launching an attack at Cang Shan.
Though Cang Shan was extraordinary, how could he be a match for Ling Han? He could only be continuously trampled on, and instantly, screamed repeatedly.
Everyone kept quiet out of fear, thinking that Ling Han was really the type to seek revenge for the smallest grievance.
But if they asked themselves honestly, if it was them, what would they do?
Quite a number of people nodded in agreement. That was definite. Why should I be extorted by you?
“Do you yield?” Ling Han asked with each punch.
“No! No! No!” In full public, Cang Shan naturally would not admit defeat. In any case, Ling Han did not dare to kill him, so he was completely capable of continuing to be stubborn.
Ling Han was extremely patient, throwing punch after punch. Every punch was extremely forceful, avoiding Cang Shan’s vital points, yet maximizing the pain he endured.
He could tolerate these ten or eight punches, but to continue like this?
Cang Shan couldn’t bear it either. In the end, he yielded.
“I concede,” he said with his eyes closed, his face flushed red.
Peng, another punch.
Cang Shan opened his eyes. F***, I have already admitted defeat, and you still want to fight?
“Have you forgotten something?” Ling Han smiled faintly, yet sent out another punch.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
After throwing another dozen over punches, Cang Shan finally came to his senses, and said, “Big Brother, I concede defeat.”
“You’re really convinced?”
“I’m really convinced.”
Ling Han nodded in satisfaction, “Go on.”

This time, Cang Shan really did not have the slightest bit of temper. After he got to his feet, he bowed and paid his respects to Ling Han, acting as if he was Ling Han’s lackey. Only then did he turn and leave.

“It’s Wu Kan, he has finally climbed up!” someone exclaimed in shock.
This Wu Kan was the one who had gone down the well three days ago, and now, he had finally climbed back up.

his own.
Could it be that... there was a ghost in the well?
Everyone shivered, and hurriedly asked Wu Kan.
“What, three days?”
Wu Kan immediately jumped up, his expression filled with disbelief, “I have only crawled for over ten minutes.”
Everyone exchanged looks. He must have seen a ghost. It was impossible that they had all remembered the time wrongly. Wu Kan must have been bewitched, and that was why he was
treating three days like ten minutes.
“Also, what’s wrong with your face?” everyone asked.
“What’s wrong with my face?” Wu Kan was at a loss.
Someone took out a mirror for him to see. Wu Kan looked at it, and was even more at a loss,
“There is nothing on my face.”
Everyone looked, and an even stranger thing happened. That palm print on Wu Kan’s face had
actually disappeared.
This... was really haunted.
“What did you see in the well?” everyone asked.
“Nothing much, just an empty well.” Wu Kan said.
“Have you gotten to the bottom?”
“No.” Wu Kan shook his head.
“Then why have you returned? Didn’t you say that you would reach the bottom?”
“That’s right.” Wu Kan showed a puzzled expression, appearing very confused.
Ling Han’s interest was piqued. He strode towards the dry well and looked downwards.
It was pitch-black, and he could only see a depth of 30 meters. Beyond that, there was only
darkness.
Ling Han activated his eye technique again. This time, he could see about 300 meters away, and what followed was still complete darkness.
With a leap, he headed down the well.
This well was very narrow, and it was difficult for even one person to turn around. Thus, Ling
Han could only slowly squeeze downwards.
He soon became impatient. This speed was too slow. He compressed his bones, and with a crisp cracking sound, his figure shrunk by half, and his figure instantly sped up.
His hands pressed lightly on the wall of the well to maintain the current speed of his descent,
so that he would not accelerate too quickly, that he would not be able to stop in time.
Falling, falling, everything in front of him remained unchanged, incredibly monotonous.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han was suddenly startled. How long had passed?
One minute, one hour, or... one day?
Ling Han exerted force with both hands, making himself stop. Looking down, it was still
pitch-black, and bottomless.
He released his divine sense, and saw that there was a palm print on his cheek. The fingers were especially long and slender, and he could tell at a glance that it was inhuman.
Just like Wu Kan?
Ling Han stretched out a hand to stroke the walls of the well. At the same time, he sniffed
lightly, a smile curling up the corners of his lips.
If it was another person, they would definitely be bewitched.
Unfortunately, he was both an alchemist and a Formation Master.
It was very difficult for these two identities to appear on the same person, but unfortunately,
he was this kind of freak.
Ling Han took out the giant frog’s Demon Core and placed it in his mouth. At the same time,
he released the Starlight Screen and began to touch the walls of the well.
Right, right.
He slowly climbed downwards, but he had only descended 300 meters when he stopped,
because he saw a very small hole. Compared to his body, this hole was completely impassable.
It didn’t matter. Ling Han shrunk down again and landed in the cave.
“How could you have possibly discovered it!” A voice was heard ahead of him, filled with
surprise.
