chapters.title: Chapter 3831: Cave Dweller
paragraphs: Ling Han channeled his eye technique. That was like a child, only three feet tall, yet possessed a pair of long, thin hands. But looking at his face, he actually had a beard.
“It’s just an illusory formation, and added with some medicine that can confuse one’s mind, how difficult would it be to break through?” He smiled slightly.

That dwarf’s expression was filled with disbelief. Don’t speak so lightly. Throughout the ages, aside from those higher ups of the Holy Land, which disciple could resolve the double mystery of this formation and medicine? Furthermore, he had also secretly placed palm imprints on people’s faces, which would rapidly disappear when they came into contact with sunlight, creating an extremely strange effect.
Though every new student would come out of curiosity, but as long as they were given a scare, they would naturally be well-behaved in future.
This was the first time he had been caught red-handed by a new student.
“You’re a freak,” he said weakly.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel speechless. Being called a freak by a dwarf... why did it sound so strange?
He shook his head, and asked, “Are you the only one here?”
“How could that be? Our Underground Cave People are a colossal tribe,” the dwarf said.
“Come, tell me about it.” Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position.
“I can’t say, this is a tribe rule.” The dwarf hurriedly shook his head.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “Looks like we need to have a nice chat.”
In just half an hour, the dwarf told him everything in full detail.

A very, very long time ago, the cave dwellers encountered their natural enemy, and were close to destruction. Thankfully, a Venerate Tier from the Nine Suns Holy Land passed by, and in a moment of soft-heartedness, saved the cave dwellers, and all of them moved to the Nine Suns Holy Land.
Cave dwellers, as the name implies, all lived in caves, and in the Nine Suns Holy Land, they all lived underground, digging one tunnel after another.
However, cave dwellers didn’t live for nothing. They had a specialty, and that was growing Celestial medicines.
In the colossal underground space under the Holy Land, the cave dwellers planted large amounts of Celestial medicines to supply the expense of the Holy Land.
Thus, one side provided shelter for safety, while the other side provided Celestial medicines, which could be considered mutually beneficial.
Ling Han’s eyes lit up, “Come, let’s go take a look at your Celestial Herb Garden.”
“Are you planning to steal the Celestial medicine?” This cave dweller was about to cry. How could he be so easily frightened? In a daze, he had confessed everything.
“Do you think a righteous person like me would be a thief?” Ling Han glared at him, “I just want to take a look.”
The cave dweller had no choice but to bring Ling Han on a tour.

The matter of the cave dwellers was not exposed, but rather left behind the legend of a dried up well without any bottom. This was due to the mischief of some big shot from the Holy Land that had long since died, and he was sure that the other legends were the same.

Ling Han was also extremely speechless. After the Nine Suns Saint hid the God Slaying Technique, he had screwed over his descendants, and they in turn were also thinking of ways to screw over their own descendants.
Very soon, a massive medicinal field appeared in front of Ling Han, and according to the cave dweller, this was only one of the medicinal fields.
Ling Han cracked a smile, and said to the cave dweller, “This is a small secret between the two of us. I was never here, right?”
“En!” The cave dweller hurriedly nodded.
Ling Han left in a flash. Whenever he wanted to concoct alchemical pills, he would come here
to roam around, using the Void Beast hide as a cover. He was sure that no one would be able to discover his existence.
He went back the way he came. After exiting the dry well, everyone hurriedly asked.

Ling Han pretended to be at a loss. There was also a palm print on his face, which quickly disappeared when he saw the light. The situation was the same as Wu Kan previously, so it naturally did not arouse anyone’s suspicion.

He then went to where the rock could not be moved no matter what. This was a rock that was only the size of a head. It definitely did not look like any precious stone material. It was very ordinary, but he could not move it no matter what.
Ling Han had tried many times. This rock would absorb power, and no matter how strong you were, it was useless.
To say nothing of being unable to move it, even if he used the celestial technique, it would be useless. This was a little like the perverted pig, being able to absorb all attack power.
Ling Han went to the cave that was releasing the wails of ghosts. There were people gathering here, and they wanted to enter and adventure.

According to an elder from the Holy Land, there was a secret technique hidden in the mountain cave, but the cave was extremely dangerous. Although venturing in wouldn’t be life-threatening, one would at least suffer a serious illness if they came out.
However, when these people heard that there was no life-threatening danger, and that they could possibly obtain the secret technique, they were naturally excited.
“Brother Ling, why don’t we explore together?” someone asked.
Ling Han shook his head. If he was alone, he would be more mobile.
“If we join forces, our chances of winning are higher.” That person still wanted to persuade
him further.
“Don’t waste your energy. He doesn’t like us at all,” one of the team members said in a strange tone.

The three people beside him hurriedly covered his mouth. You still don’t f****** know that Cang Shan had been beaten to the point that he was begging for mercy, right? He actually dared to trifle with this bringer of misfortune.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and walked into the cave.

“Wu-” He had only taken a few steps in, and sure enough, a strange sound was heard. It sounded like wind, but also like the howl of a ghost, causing one’s hair to stand on end. It even had destructive power against divine sense.
Ling Han activated the Starlight Screen. His reserves of mystical power were extremely deep, so he didn’t mind wasting just that tiny bit.

However, he discovered that the Starlight Screen couldn’t block this sound. It was only slightly weakened, and it was still charging towards him. It surged into his mind, turning into multiple sabers and swords, planning to cause great damage.
Ling Han humphed. The Six Characters Bright King Curse unfolded. Though there was only one word, this was an Imperial Technique, so how overbearing was it?
“An!”
He shouted in his mind, and the Buddhist chant rolled out. Those sabers and swords immediately crumbled.
Ling Han strode forwards, but the wails of ghosts sounded again.
“An!” Ling Han recited the Buddhist chant, resisting the wails of ghosts with ease.

This cave was very big, and also very complicated, going back and forth. After walking for a long time, the surrounding temperature dropped all of a sudden. Even with Ling Han’s physique, he felt the flow of his blood slow down. In fact, it was as if his blood was about to
freeze.
He couldn’t help but shiver. Was there a piece of Millennium Black Ice or something hidden in this cave, so why was it so cold?
Right at this moment, he suddenly saw a figure float out from a stone pillar ahead of him.
How could a person possibly pop out of a stone pillar?
Yin soul!

Ling Han immediately thought. Actually, illusions could also pass through physical matter, but combined with this environment that had suddenly become cold, he was more inclined to think that this was a Yin soul.
Could it be that the Nine Suns Holy Land was also suppressing an underworld passageway?

Just as he was pondering, the Yin soul released a sharp cry and launched an attack at him. Ling Han showed a hint of mockery. When the Yin soul approached, he shot out a punch, and Destructive Energy boiled.
The Yin soul instantly looked shocked, and hurriedly stopped in its tracks, then retreated.
In its eyes, encountering Destructive Energy was like a normal person seeing a ghost.

Ling Han gave chase, and with a series of punches, destroyed the Yin soul. According to the information obtained from the Ancient Sun Saint, the Yin soul was the enemy of all living beings. Once the Yin souls invaded in full force, they would be possessing
living beings, and the whole world would be in chaos.
Thus, when encountering Yin souls, he definitely could not be merciful.

chapters.title: Chapter 3832: Soul Forming Technique
paragraphs: Death was like the extinguishing of a lamp.
Death was death. Even if the Yin soul was brought back from the Netherworld, and pressed back into its original body, it was no longer the original person.

Yin soul had lost all the beautiful aspects of intelligent creatures, leaving behind only extreme negative emotions. They were even more ruthless and terrifying than wild beasts. At least, wild beasts wouldn’t bother to hunt anymore after eating, but Yin soul was different. It only had the urge to destroy everything.

Was it a coincidence that Yin souls had appeared here? However, the great elites of the Holy Land had deliberately set up a place like this; was their main purpose still to tease the disciples of the younger generation?
Ling Han was willing to believe this possibility. Otherwise, if there was still an entrance to the underworld here, that would really be too dangerous.

In the past, with a Saint standing guard, the Celestial Sea Planet had still been destroyed in the great battle. Now, though this was also a Holy Land, it did not have a Saint standing guard. If a Yin soul riot broke out, it could be imagined that the Nine Suns Planet would very soon be wreaked havoc by the Yin souls, and become an Asura Hell.

He continued to advance, and soon, Yin souls appeared again, launching attacks at him. This was very rhythmic. It was as if every Yin soul was set in a fixed area. Only whenone walked into this area, would the Yin soul attack.
By the looks of it, the Nine Suns Planet probably didn’t have a door to the underworld.

The Destructive Energy was specialized in subduing Yin souls. Thus, Yin souls, which were extremely troublesome in the eyes of others, were extremely simple in Ling Han’s eyes. Furthermore, even the Six Characters Bright King Curse had a certain restraining effect on Yin souls.
After some effort, Ling Han finally arrived at the end of the cave.
This was a very smooth stone wall. It was obviously deliberately carved out by someone, but
it should have a very long history. There was no longer any signs that this stone wall had been scraped out.
However, there were also paintings on the stone walls.
Ling Han watched on as these static scenes suddenly moved, playing out in his mind.
This was a celestial technique called the Soul Forming Technique, and its use was... to manifest another soul.
This second soul was extremely fragile, and couldn’t cultivate. However, it could completely change one’s appearance.

it.

accounting!”

communicate.

running out in a sorry state. All of them were bleeding from their seven apertures, their
expressions greatly deflated.

waiting for him.

“Grandpa Dog has been bullied, and your wife has also been bullied,” the large black dog said.

suppressed it, and said darkly, “Tell me the details.”

black dog continued.
“Afterwards, Eldest Baby couldn’t bear it any longer, so she gave that guy a good thrashing.”

He even threatened that if your monkey wife did not accept his younger brother, he would come again.” Ling Han controlled his killing intent, and said, “Isn’t there a rule in the Holy Land that says the Cauldron Forging Tier can’t attack Foundation Building Tier cultivators?”

chapters.title: Chapter 3833: Counterattack
paragraphs: “Don’t mention it. That Xue Clan actually has a clansman in the valley. He’s the Dao Apprentice of some big shot, and now, he’s also cultivated to the level of the Core Formation Tier. So, as long as he doensn’t cripple us, for the sake of that Core Formation Tier from the Xue Clan, the Law Enforcement Hall will just turn a blind eye,” the large black dog said gloomily.
“Which big shot is that person’s backer?” Ling Han asked.
“Liu Sanjun,” the large black dog replied.

Ling Han flipped through his memory, and Liu Sanjun’s information immediately appeared in his mind. This was a Sect Master, a very old elite. If he still did not break through to Venerate Tier, he should not have much lifespan left.
Thus, Liu Sanjun’s prestige was very high.
Ling Han calculated in his mind, and already came up with a plan.
“I’m going to see someone first,” he said.
“Who?”
“Yan Dong.”
“Yi, brat, you actually know Elder Yan?” The large black dog was very surprised.
Ling Han first went to see Yan Dong, and roughly related the matter, which made Yan Dong very furious.
A mere Dao Apprentice actually dared to undermine the laws of the Holy Land?
Humph!
“All right, just go all out,” Yan Dong vouched for Ling Han.
Ling Han nodded and left.

He first went to the Foundation Building Valley to see the empress and the others. The empress, Hu Niu, and Princess Bixiao were unscathed, but the seven babies, Lin Luo, and the others had suffered considerable injuries, but not too serious. After all, this was a breach of the laws of the Holy Land. Even Xue Zhan did not dare to be too heavy-handed. If anything serious happened, even that clansman of Core Formation Tier would not be able to protect him.

“Leave this matter to me,” Ling Han said solemnly. Previously, he had already been filled with anger when he heard the large black dog just talking about it. Now that he saw how injured everyone was, his fury burned even hotter.
He didn’t attack immediately. Instead, he chose the terrain first, then inserted the formation foundations one after another.
Humph, if that Core Formation Tier martial artist from the Xue Clan came, just see if he wouldn’t kill him!
The preparations were complete, and Ling Han still hadn’t found Xue Hai yet. He hadn’t thought that Xue Hai would actually come looking for him on his own.
“Hehe, there shouldn’t be anyone chasing me away this time, right?”

This Xue Hai looked to be only in his early twenties. He was tall and slender, and was also very handsome. However, the expression on his face was too smug, infuriating those who saw him. At least, that was the case for everyone here.
He swaggered in just like that, sat down on his own, and said with a smile, “Yi, why are you so unruly? Where’s the tea?”
Ling Han smiled, poured a cup of tea, and then tossed it over to Xue Hai. The cup drew a beautiful arc, and landed steadily on Xue Hai’s table.

“Now that’s more like it.” Xue Hai picked up the teacup, but he had just lifted the lid. Boom, a flame gushed out, scaring him so much that he hurriedly waved his hand, and threw the cup of tea onto the ground. He stood up angrily, “How dare you, to actually dare to toy with me!”
Meanwhile, Ling Han took a sip of tea, as if he had not seen anything.
“You’re seeking death!” Xue Hai charged over, and delivered a slap at Ling Han.
Ling Han opened the connection device at the right time, and began recording. Then, his figure flashed, dodging this attack, “Xue Hai, you really want to make a move on me?”

“So what? Do you think I don’t dare?” When Xue Hai saw Ling Han dodge, how could he possibly think that Ling Han was a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator? He only thought that Ling Han was afraid. He humphed, “In front of me, you are worthless!”
However, he was also a little puzzled. Why didn’t he seem to have seen this person before?
Hehe, these few words were enough.
Ling Han turned off the connection device, and delivered a palm strike at Xue Hai. Pa, how could Xue Hai possibly block it? Instantly, he was knocked to the ground.
“You!” Xue Hai finally came to a realization. This was a Cauldron Forging Tier elite, so it was no wonder that he looked unfamiliar.
Great, he had also invited a Cauldron Forging Tier.
As he used the connection device to ask Xue Zhan for help, he said coldly, “You actually dare
to trick me. Fine, when my brother comes, I’ll see how you die!”
Pa, Ling Han’s foot stomped down, and Xue Hai instantly released a terrible scream. He opened his mouth, and actually spat out over ten broken teeth.
Ling Han’s heart did not soften in the slightest. His reverse scale was his family and friends. If it was not for the fact that this was the Nine Suns Holy Land, how could Xue Hai still be alive?
He stomped on Xue Hai’s face, one step after another. Xue Hai’s face was covered with blood. Not only were his teeth shattered, even his nose had caved in.

The large black dog, Lin Luo, and the others all felt their anger vented when they saw this. With their strength, they were naturally not inferior to Xue Hai, but because of Xue Zhan, they had been very terribly humiliated by Xue Hai. It should be known that they were all ultimate elites in the Genesis World, so how proud and arrogant were they?
“Stop!” A loud shout rang out, and someone rushed in, shouting loudly at Ling Han.
It was Xue Zhan.
However, while Xue Hai did not recognize Ling Han, Xue Zhan did. He couldn’t help but feel stifled. Immediately, he clasped his hands and said, “So it is Brother Ling. Sorry, sorry.”
“Brother, what’s the point of being so polite with him? Kill him quickly,” Xue Hai couldn’t help but call out. ‘Can’t you see how miserable I am now? You’re actually still chatting with
my enemy.’
“Shut up!” Xue Zhan shouted harshly. He naturally knew how terrifying Ling Han was. How could he offend such a person?

Their backer was only a Core Formation Tier cultivator. Of course, Liu Sanjun was also one of the cards they had, because this great elite treasured pride and was protective of his own people the most, but he was too far from them, after all.
Ling Han breaking through to the Core Formation Tier definitely wasn’t a problem for him. It was best not to offend such an elite.
“Brother Ling, I’m ignorant. How has my brother offended you? I apologize on his behalf,”
Xue Zhan said. He was quite a ruffian.
Ling Han nodded, “The people here are all my friends.”
Xue Zhan immediately said, “I’m really sorry. I guarantee that what happened in the past will
never happen again.”
“Of course,” Ling Han said calmly.
“Then can you return him to me?” Xue Zhan asked patiently.
Ling Han shook his head and said, “I’ve only dealt with one of the main culprits, and there’s
one more left.”

Xue Zhan faltered upon hearing this. Only then did he realize that Ling Han was talking about him. His expression involuntarily darkened, and he said, “Brother Ling, we are fellow disciples, after all. Don’t take things too far.”
“Have I gone too far?” Ling Han laughed in spite of himself. Why didn’t he feel that he had
gone too far when he was bullying others?
He strode towards Xue Zhan.
Xue Zhan couldn’t help but retreat. He had heard of Ling Han’s strength. Even a peak stage Four Cauldrons had been beaten into submission by him. He was only a Heaven Cauldron, so
how could he possibly match him?
Why wasn’t that clan elder here yet?

Xue Zhan was internally anxious, but he still maintained the smile on his face, appearing calm and composed, “Ling Han, could it be that you don’t know that one of our clan elders is an elite of the Core Formation Tier, and is also Elder Liu’s Dao Apprentice!”
“What is it? Are you using this to suppress me?” Ling Han said with a faint smile. Xiu, his
figure had already charged out.
Xue Zhan didn’t dare to battle, but since Ling Han had made his move, how could he possibly
escape?
In just one move, he was taken down.
Peng, Ling Han slammed him heavily onto the ground, then stepped on him. Xue Zhan’s nose
instantly collapsed, and blood flowed from his nose.
“Ah-” he screamed tragically. The Xue Clan was also a Spiritual Transformation Tier clan. Since childhood, when had he ever suffered such injustice?
‘Uncle, hurry up and save me!’

In just one move, he was taken down.
Peng, Ling Han slammed him heavily onto the ground, then stepped on him.
Xue Zhan’s nose
instantly collapsed, and blood flowed from his nose.
“Ah-” he screamed tragically.
The Xue Clan was also a Spiritual Transformation Tier clan.
Since childhood, when had he ever suffered such injustice?
‘Uncle, hurry up and save me!’

chapters.title: Chapter 3834: Angered
paragraphs: Ling Han thrashed Xue Zhan harshly.
The Xue brothers should thank the fact that they were in the Nine Suns Holy Land. Otherwise, Ling Han definitely wouldn’t have been so polite. Instead, he would have directly killed the two of them.
“Brilliant! Brilliant!” the large black dog called out from the sidelines. However, he
suppressed his urge and didn’t rush over to give him a kick.
This was something that Ling Han had especially instructed. If it was just him alone, it would be easy to deal with him.
After being thrashed for more than ten minutes, that clan uncle of the Xue Clan, Xue Bingyuan, finally arrived late.
It was not that he had not received Xue Zhan’s call for help, but rather that he had been serving Liu Sanjun tea at that time, so how could he possibly dare to speak up?
—Liu Sanjun was indeed a headstrong person, but he was not an idiot. If he knew that Xue Bingyuan was using his name as an intimidation tactic, Xue Bingyuan would definitely be in trouble.
However, against a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, he naturally could deal with him easily, and there was even less need for Liu Sanjun to know.
Thus, Xue Bingyuan could only endure endlessly, right until Liu Sanjun had finished drinking his tea, and went off to cultivate. Only then did he get the chance, and immediately charged
over.
He was aggressive. Since he knew that the Xue brothers were his clansmen, this Ling Han actually still dared to make a move. He was really outrageously bold.
Could it be that he was trying to rebel?

“How dare you!” Xue Bingyuan said calmly. He was treading on empty air. This was an ability that only a cultivator at the Core Formation Tier could possess. Finally, he no longer needed to borrow the power of a Spirit Tool to be able to fly. In fact, he could even tread on empty air. “I’m not as bold as you. You’re just a Dao Apprentice, yet you actually dare to indulge your clansmen and break the rules of the Holy Land,” Ling Han said calmly. “Do you think that the Holy Land belongs to your family?”
Xue Bingyuan raised a brow, and was just about to flip out.

He was a Core Formation Tier elite, and furthermore, he was Liu Sanjun’s Dao Apprentice, so who would not give him some face? Even if he was a Cauldron Forging Tier disciple, so what? When they saw him, they still had to address him as Lord, their attitude respectful.
However, Ling Han actually dared to mock him, so how could he not be furious?
However, the Xue brothers were still in Ling Han’s hands, so he didn’t dare to make a move rashly.
“Let him go!” he commanded coldly.
“Who are you showing off your might for?” Ling Han shook his head, unmoved.

“Humph!” Xue Bingyuan released his own aura, which instantly boiled up like a tsunami. How foolish. Didn’t he know that the martial artist with a higher cultivation level could completely crush the martial artist with a lower cultivation level? He didn’t even need to make a move. A single aura would be enough to disintegrate Ling Han’s battle prowess, rendering him unable to withstand a single blow.
However, Ling Han’s aura didn’t change in the slightest. What!
Xue Bingyuan was instantly surprised. What was going on?
Could it be that he had some rare treasure on him that could resist the suppression of an elite’s aura?
That must be the case.
He felt slightly troubled, because this forced him to make a move, and once he made a move, Xue Zhan and Xue Hai, the two hostages, would become variables.
“It’s rude not to reciprocate!” Ling Han unleashed his murderous aura.
So what if he was a Core Formation Tier cultivator? Xue Bingyuan was completely unguarded, and was instantly hit. He was momentarily dazed.
However, he was an elite, after all, so the effects were really only momentary.
Xue Bingyuan flew into a humiliated rage, his old face flushed red.
-His name was Dao Apprentice, but after so many years, he had long since become an old
man.
This was too humiliating.
The aura he emitted did not affect Ling Han at all, but Ling Han’s counterattack had caused him to fall for it... how could this be tolerated?
One had to realize that Ling Han was only at the Cauldron Forging Tier. Meanwhile, he was at the Core Formation Tier.
A cold light shot out of Xue Bingyuan’s eyes, and he felt an urge to kill Ling Han, regardless of the consequences.
Ling Han smiled faintly, grabbed Xue Zhan and his brother, and turned to leave, “If you can, come and chase me. If you can catch me, it’s your win.”
He used the Imminent Skyline, and his speed was extremely fast.

Xue Bingyuan naturally set off in pursuit without the slightest hesitation. A mere Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, no matter how extraordinary he was, was still like an ant in his eyes, so how could he possibly be afraid?
But he shockingly discovered that Ling Han’s speed was really too fast, so fast that he did not seem like a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator.
With this kind of speed, it was probable that those who had just advanced into the Core Formation Tier would also just barely manage this speed.
This brat should have used some kind of powerful movement technique, but the stronger a cultivation technique was, the more limited the time he could cast it. The movement
technique was no exception.
Was this brat on steroids or something? He could still maintain his high speed even with two
people in his grasp?
s was too inconceivable.
But there was nothing that could be done. He couldn’t not give chase, right?
Xue Bingyuan chased with all his might, slowly closing the distance between them.
He was in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, so his speed naturally couldn’t be compared to those who had just entered the Core Formation Tier.
Just as he was about to get closer and closer to Ling Han, this brat suddenly braked and
actually stopped.
‘Hmm?’
Xue Bingyuan didn’t know what Ling Han was playing at, but he was already extremely vigilant against this Cauldron Forging Tier junior. He really didn’t dare to be careless at all,
and also stopped.
As long as he remained unchanged, he would definitely be able to suppress Ling Han with his strength as a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
“I have hostages in my hands, so don’t come over again.” Ling Han raised Xue Zhan and Xue
Hai high in the air.
Pu!
Xue Bingyuan almost tripped and fell. Just now, he had still been wary of Ling Han, but this brat actually made such a weak move in the blink of an eye. This really made his jaw drop.
If it was claimed that this brat was cowardly, he even dared to trifle with him. But to call him courageous, he was actually using hostages to threaten him now. What kind of tough guy was this?
“What exactly do you want me to do for you to let them go?” Xue Bingyuan asked calmly. “Let’s have a nice chat about compensation,” Ling Han said seriously.
“All right, how do you want to compensate?” Xue Bingyuan smiled. This brat was finally
afraid.
This was very natural. He was the elite of the Core Formation Tier, and there was a great elite of the Sect Master level standing behind him. Wasn’t it very normal for him to give in?
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Old geezer, you’ve made a mistake. It’s not how I’m
going to pay, but how you guys are going to pay.”
What!
Xue Bingyuan was stunned for a moment before coming back to his senses. Involuntarily, he couldn’t help but look furious.

You beat up my clansmen, and that was already trifling with me in the first place. Furthermore, as a mere Cauldron Forging Tier, where did you get such great courage to dare ask him, a Core Formation Tier elite, to compensate you?
“You’re truly tired of living!” he said balefully.
Xiu, someone flew over from afar, one after another, and there were quite a number of them.
There was Lin Luo, the empress, and the others, as well as some unrelated people. Previously, when they saw Ling Han and Xue Bingyuan rushing past, they subconsciously ran over to
watch the excitement.
Xue Bingyuan was unafraid. He felt that he was in the right in this matter, so even if Ling Han was injured in the end, Liu Sanjun would still try his best to protect him.

Thus, he stood with his hands clasped behind his back, appearing very confident. Ling Han’s expression was solemn. “This b@stard coveted my wife, harrassed her several times, and was taught a lesson. After telling him to behave himself, he actually invited his Cauldron Forging Tier elder brother. He gave my friends a beating, but did not suffer any punishment himself. Ultimately, the reason why they have such great courage is because they have a relative who is in the Core Formation Tier like you.”
At first, he had wanted to say that Princess Bixiao was his friend, but when he thought about
how the grudge for the sake of a friend was not as great as the grudge for a wife, he changed his words at the last moment. He was sure that the empress and the Demon Race would
understand.

chapters.title: Chapter 3835: Formation confining Core Formation Tier
paragraphs: Xiu, xiu, xiu, even more people ran over.
For example, Tan Meng, Jie Yingqiu, the three great beauties had all arrived. They were all very concerned about this matter.
In their eyes, though Ling Han was not qualified to become a good husband, he was a rare talent, which made them want to recruit him, and this was a very good opportunity.

Ling Han definitely wouldn’t be able to resolve this tribulation. Thus, if they helped Ling Han settle this tribulation, the latter would owe them a huge favor. The following matters would be easy to deal with.
It was naturally impossible for Xue Bingyuan to admit it in public. With a flutter of his sleeve, he said, “What a bunch of nonsense.”
Ling Han broke into a grin. He first threw Xue Zhan onto the ground, then patted Xue Hai’s head, “Come, as the person involved, and as the instigator, tell me the whole story.”
“You are spouting nonsense!” Xue Hai would definitely not admit it either, and immediately shouted loudly.
In this kind of situation, how could Ling Han possibly dare to use force to extort a confession from him?
“Ah-” He suddenly released a terrible scream. One of his arms had already been forcefully broken by Ling Han.
This guy really dared!
Hiss, no wonder this guy had only been targeting his face previously. At that time, had he already expected this scene to happen?
Ling Han not only broke his arm, but also began to crush his finger bones inch by inch.
The ten fingers were connected to the heart; how painful was this?
Xue Hai screamed repeatedly, tears streaming down his face.

“Stop!” Xue Bingyuan shouted angrily, but when he discovered that Ling Han’s whole body was filled with killing intent, he did not dare move. That was because in this state, Ling Han would really commit murder.
He could not force him into a corner.

With a thought, he used the connection device to inform Xue Hai, telling him to temporarily relent and admit it. In any case, he could still deny and say that it was Ling Han who had forced him to confess in the future, and that he had no choice but to admit it.
Initially, Xue Hai could no longer hold on. Now that his uncle had relented, he naturally related the matter in full detail.
A great many people did not know the whole story, and when they heard, they were all furious.
If a sect didn’t even have the basic rules, how could they cultivate in peace?
This was going too far.
“And you!” Ling Han pointed at Xue Zhan again.
Xue Zhan did not want to suffer any further, and also wanted to “confess”, but Ling Han did not care at all. He first broke more than half of his bones, and only then did he allow him to speak.
This... as everyone looked at Ling Han, they all broke out in a cold sweat.
This guy would seek revenge for the smallest grievance, and was resolute in killing. In future, The definitely could not be trifled with.
Even the beautiful eyes of Tan Meng and the other women rippled. Could they control such a man?
Ling Han cracked a smile and said, “Fine, since you’ve already confessed and admitted your mistake, I’ll let you go. I’ll naturally punish you according to the sect’s rules.”
As he said this, he shook his hands. Pa, pa! Xue Zhan and his brother were both thrown out by him, landing on the ground extremely far away.
Yi?
Everyone was stunned. What was going on here?
Without a hostage, how could you coerce a Core Formation Tier elite?
Just now, you were mighty and mighty, but as long as a Core Formation Tier cultivator made a move, wouldn’t you follow in the footsteps of the Xue brothers?
Had he gone mad?
Xue Bingyuan laughed loudly, but his voice was cold and sinister, clearly filled with fury, “Brat, you are really bold!”

“Uncle, kill him! Kill him!” Xue Hai shouted from the sidelines. He had been thrashed repeatedly, and previously, he did not dare to speak at all, fearing that he would anger Ling Han. But now that he had escaped from the tiger’s den, and with his uncle standing guard, he naturally had nothing holding him back.

Though Xue Zhan did not speak, his eyes were filled with venom. Naturally, he too hoped that Ling Han would be taught a harsh lesson by Xue Bingyuan. The best scenario would be for him to be directly killed.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “How could it be that I would be afraid of you?”
Because he was confident, Xue Bingyu was not in a rush to make a move. Instead, he asked calmly, “Shouldn’t you be afraid of me?”

“Why should I be afraid?” Ling Han shook his head, “I am a disciple of the Holy Land, and who do you think you are? You are merely a Dao Apprentice, and you want me to be afraid of you? Hehe, do you still have any regard for the Holy Land?”
Xue Bingyuan was instantly suffocated. This had pierced his sore spot.
Even if he was now in the Core Formation Tier, and could look down on all the disciples of this term, in terms of status, how could a mere Dao Apprentice be qualified?
His expression was twisted, his eyes shooting out flames of fury.

“I am a dignified Core Formation Tier cultivator, and you dare disrespect elites. This is looking down on the order of martial arts!” he said balefully. He couldn’t endure it any longer, and strode out, planning to apprehend Ling Han.
However, he had just taken one step, when he saw that there were actually veined patterns glowing on the ground all around him, forming a complicated pattern.
Not good, this was a formation!
He immediately understood why Ling Han had led him here, and why he had suddenly stopped. As it turned out, it was to draw him into the formation.
However... heng, heng, how could a mere Cauldron Forging Tier formation be able to trap him?
“If I were you, I wouldn’t move a single muscle from now onwards,” Ling Han said calmly.
How could Xue Bingyuan be willing to listen? His foot had already descended, “A mere Cauldron Forging Tier is no different from an ant in my eyes.”
Peng, instantly, the formation patterns’ brilliance flashed madly, shooting rapidly towards
Xue Bingyuan.

Xue Bingyuan moved, and shattered these streaks of light. However, he was shocked to discover that not only was the offensive power of these streaks of light terrifying, but there was also a huge amount of them. They were endless, and even he could only parry them
wearily.
He paled in shock. If this continued, he would eventually collapse.
This was really too hard to believe. A Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator was actually capable of setting up a formation on the level of Core Formation Tier.

He hurriedly broke through, wanting to charge out of the formation, but the moment he moved, it incited an even stronger backlash from the formation. More and more brilliance surged out, shooting towards him, and from the outside, these lights actually formed the
shape of a treasure bottle.
“This is... the Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation!” someone recognized.
“What, a formation that can slay Core Formation Tiers?”
“No way!”
Everyone exclaimed in shock. Then, realization dawned on them. No wonder Ling Han was so
calm and collected. As it turned out, everything was under his control.
They couldn’t help but feel rueful. Even a Core Formation Tier elite was toyed around with by
Ling Han; he was truly awesome.
Tan Meng and the other seductive beauties’ eyes also lit up. They felt that Ling Han’s value had to be re-evaluated. This was not just a great alchemist, but also had outstanding natural
talent in formations.
This kind of talent was worthy of being roped in with the highest treatment. In fact, in fact, he could be listed as a candidate for future husband.
At this moment, the ones with the worst expressions were naturally Xue Hai and Xue Zhan.
The clan uncle that they were leaning on for support was actually dealt with by Ling Han just
like that?
It was as if they were in a dream.
They looked at Ling Han, and felt that this young man was a monster.
A Core Formation Tier versus a Cauldron Forging Tier, and it was the Core Formation Tier that was actually suppressed instead.

“Ah—” Xue Bingyuan screamed in agony. The Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation could refine a cultivator in the Core Formation Tier, and though he was in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, he was only a Dao Apprentice, so his natural talent in martial arts naturally couldn’t be too outstanding. His abilities could only be considered average, and he couldn’t break out of the formation at all.

Because he was confident, Xue Bingyu was not in a rush to make a move.
Instead, he asked calmly, “Shouldn’t you be afraid of me?”
“Why should I be afraid?” Ling Han shook his head, “I am a disciple of the Holy Land, and who do you think you are?
You are merely a Dao Apprentice, and you want me to be afraid of you?
Hehe, do you still have any regard for the Holy Land?”
Xue Bingyuan was instantly suffocated.
This had pierced his sore spot.
Even if he was now in the Core Formation Tier, and could look down on all the disciples of this term, in terms of status, how could a mere Dao Apprentice be qualified?
His expression was twisted, his eyes shooting out flames of fury.
“I am a dignified Core Formation Tier cultivator, and you dare disrespect elites.
This is looking down on the order of martial arts!” he said balefully.
He couldn’t endure it any longer, and strode out, planning to apprehend Ling Han.
However, he had just taken one step, when he saw that there were actually veined patterns glowing on the ground all around him, forming a complicated pattern.
Not good, this was a formation!
He immediately understood why Ling Han had led him here, and why he had suddenly stopped.
As it turned out, it was to draw him into the formation.
However... heng, heng, how could a mere Cauldron Forging Tier formation be able to trap him?
“If I were you, I wouldn’t move a single muscle from now onwards,” Ling Han said calmly.
How could Xue Bingyuan be willing to listen?
His foot had already descended, “A mere Cauldron Forging Tier is no different from an ant in my eyes.”
Peng, instantly, the formation patterns’ brilliance flashed madly, shooting rapidly towards
Xue Bingyuan.
Xue Bingyuan moved, and shattered these streaks of light.
However, he was shocked to discover that not only was the offensive power of these streaks of light terrifying, but there was also a huge amount of them.
They were endless, and even he could only parry them
wearily.
He paled in shock.
If this continued, he would eventually collapse.
This was really too hard to believe.
A Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator was actually capable of setting up a formation on the level of Core Formation Tier.
He hurriedly broke through, wanting to charge out of the formation, but the moment he moved, it incited an even stronger backlash from the formation.
More and more brilliance surged out, shooting towards him, and from the outside, these lights actually formed the
shape of a treasure bottle.
“This is... the Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation!” someone recognized.
“What, a formation that can slay Core Formation Tiers?”
“No way!”
Everyone exclaimed in shock.
Then, realization dawned on them.
No wonder Ling Han was so
calm and collected.
As it turned out, everything was under his control.
They couldn’t help but feel rueful.
Even a Core Formation Tier elite was toyed around with by
Ling Han; he was truly awesome.
Tan Meng and the other seductive beauties’ eyes also lit up.
They felt that Ling Han’s value had to be re-evaluated.
This was not just a great alchemist, but also had outstanding natural
talent in formations.
This kind of talent was worthy of being roped in with the highest treatment.
In fact, in fact, he could be listed as a candidate for future husband.
At this moment, the ones with the worst expressions were naturally Xue Hai and Xue Zhan.
The clan uncle that they were leaning on for support was actually dealt with by Ling Han just
like that?
It was as if they were in a dream.
They looked at Ling Han, and felt that this young man was a monster.
A Core Formation Tier versus a Cauldron Forging Tier, and it was the Core Formation Tier that was actually suppressed instead.
“Ah—” Xue Bingyuan screamed in agony.

The Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation could refine a cultivator in the Core Formation Tier, and though he was in the late stage of the Core Formation Tier, he was only a Dao Apprentice, so his natural talent in martial arts naturally couldn’t be too outstanding.
His abilities could only be considered average, and he couldn’t break out of the formation at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 3836: Sect Master makes his move
paragraphs: Hearing Xue Bingchuan’s screams become louder and louder, everyone’s hearts shivered. Could it be that... Ling Han wanted to forcefully refine Xue Bingyuan?
Hiss, no one would believe this if he told them.
A Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator not only defeated a Core Formation Tier cultivator, but also counterattacked? Wasn’t this a fantasy story?
Furthermore, Xue Bingyuan had a Sect Master elite backing him up. Aren’t you afraid that Liu Sanjun would fly into a thunderous rage?
“Brat, stop! Stop!” Xue Bingyuan screamed. He really couldn’t hold on any longer. If he continued to hold on, he would really be refined by Ling Han.

Yet Ling Han only acted as if he had not heard anything. Family and friends were his reverse scale. Thus, the moment someone dared to trifle with him in this aspect, he would definitely counter harshly, and let everyone know that this was an insurmountable bottom line.
Xue Bingyuan had not thought that Ling Han would be so ruthless. He was really going to put him to death.
He had no choice, and could only ask Liu Sanjun for help.

Originally, he had not wanted to trouble Liu Sanjun. What logic was there for a master to turn around and clean up the mess for a servant? Furthermore, he was a dignified Core Formation Tier cultivator, and could not even deal with a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator. With Liu Sanjun’s fiery temper, would he still allow him to stay by his side in future?
Thus, he had always wanted to break free through his own effort previously. But now that he couldn’t barge out forcefully and couldn’t beg for mercy either, he could only use his last
move.
There was only hope if he was alive. If he was dead, everything would be for naught.

Ling Han smirked coldly. He began to circle around the formation. Even though he seemed to be very casual, with every step he took, there would be streaks of Spiritual Power sinking into the ground, stimulating the power of heaven and earth.

With his current strength, it was naturally impossible for him to create a Core Formation Tier formation. However, the formation had already been formed, so if he only went to add fuel to the fire, it would naturally be a hundred times easier.
“Ah! Ah! Ah!” Xue Bingyuan’s screams suddenly became louder, and even shriller. He felt like he was about to die.

Most importantly, Liu Sanjun was presently comprehending Dao, searching for an opportunity to break through to Venerate Tier. Once he had entered into a state of deep meditation, how could he possibly awaken with a soft call from him?
“Elder! Elder! Save me!” He tried his best to call for help through the connection device, but very quickly, with a pa, the connection device fell down, and was destroyed by the formation.
He had lost all hope. The terrifying energy was presently refining him, and fusing him with the heaven and earth.

Weng, right at this moment, a terrifying aura circulated, and everyone felt their vision blur. A white-haired, white-browed, white-bearded old man had appeared in the arena. He had a square face, and was exuding endless might.
Liu Sanjun, a Sect Master great elite!

He moved, and with a single grab, the treasure bottle that was actually formed from energy instantly shattered with a loud bang. How could a Core Formation Tier formation be able to withstand an attack of Sect Master-level?
However, it was already too late. Inside the formation, Xue Bingyuan had already turned into a pile of bones.
Even so, Liu Sanjun could still easily sense that the shards of consciousness that were exuding from this corpse. It was lingering resentment.

“Who dares to kill this old man’s Dao Apprentice?” Liu Sanjun asked coldly. The temperature in the surroundings instantly dropped. Even if they were Cauldron Forging Tiers, so what? They were all trembling, wanting to cross their arms over their chests, and ice shards were continuously falling from the skies.
This was a Sect Master elite. With a single thought, he could affect heaven and earth, and in his fury, he could create a river of blood.
“Elder!” Xue Zhan scrambled over, “Xue Bingyuan is my uncle. My name is Xue Zhan, and my uncle was killed by that despicable brat!”
He pointed at Ling Han, his eyes filled with resentment and a sliver of light.
Xue Bingyuan had died at Ling Han’s hands. Not only could he use Liu Sanjun to kill Ling Han, if he acted appropriately, he could even form a relationship with Liu Sanjun.
Thus, this was a great opportunity.
Xue Hai was not stupid either. He similarly ran out, and knelt down together to talk about Ling Han’s crimes.

From the mouths of the two brothers, everything was naturally Ling Han’s fault. He bullied them just because he had higher abilities, and after they asked Xue Bingyuan to help them, he was even killed by Ling Han using formation techniques.
This was really distorting the truth and spouting nonsense.

However, Liu Sanjun’s expression became uglier and uglier. Even if he only had to trust a little bit of what they said, and added with the corpse of Xue Bingchuan laid out in front of him, it was enough to make him so furious that he wanted to commit murder.

“How dare you!” Liu Sanjun looked at Ling Han with baleful eyes, and said, “Even if your natural talent is unparalleled, you’ll only become a great calamity in the future if you commit evil. Let me eliminate you!”
He stretched out a hand. Boom, endless energy converged, turning into a colossal hand that struck out at Ling Han.
This was the attack of a Sect Master elite. Even if Ling Han was a hundred times more freakish,
it would still be useless. He was completely no match-unless he summoned the Heavenly Dao Flames inside the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
However, Ling Han didn’t.
That was because a figure had shot out, and managed to block this blow in time.
“Yan Dong, what is the meaning of this?” Liu Sanjun asked coldly. The person who had
stopped him was none other than Yan Dong.
Yan Dong chuckled, “I have come to resolve a misunderstanding.”
“Misunderstanding?” Liu Sanjun smirked coldly, “This Dao Apprentice of mine died here. Could it be that my eyes have blurred?”

Yan Dong’s face was still smiling, but he secretly blamed Ling Han for taking things too far, to actually kill someone. However, on the other hand, he was also very impressed with Ling Han. How many people in history had managed to kill a Core Formation Tier with the cultivation level of Cauldron Forging Tier?

He was only an apprentice, and not an official disciple. In Yan Dong’s eyes, this was not a big deal at all. The problem now was Liu Sanjun’s pride. As long as Liu Sanjun could maintain his pride, this matter was actually very easy to deal with.
“Ling Han, come, apologize to Elder Liu.” He waved at Ling Han.

“Yes.” Ling Han’s expression was respectful as he strode to Yan Dong’s side. He then raised his clasped hands in Liu Sanjun’s direction and said, “I accidentally killed Elder Liu’s Dao Apprentice by mistake, so I’m willing to pay compensation.”
Compensate, compensate your sister!

Liu Sanjun was almost angered to death. He, a great Sect Master elite, would care about the compensation of a mere Cauldron Forging Tier? What compensation could you offer? Even if you paid with your life, he would not take it to heart either.
Fine, was this an apology or a mockery?
“Good! Good! Good!” he said balefully, his eyes fixed on Yan Dong. “You must interfere?”
Yan Dong could not stop now, but he was extremely slick, and said, “This is all a matter of the Holy Land. They are all disciples of the Holy Land, so don’t be rash.”
Liu Sanjun only acted as if he had not heard him. Pointing at Xue Zhan, he said, “All right. I will give guidance to this person in one month’s time, and then have him engage in a mortal
duel with that despicable brat.”
A mortal duel!
Then it would be a battle to the death.
Liu Sanjun looked towards Xue Zhan, “Do you dare or not?”
Xue Zhan gritted his teeth, and said, “I dare!”

This was obviously a chance. Liu Sanjun would use extraordinary means to madly increase his strength within a month’s time. This was a great opportunity. Of course, this would definitely be incredibly painful. To have a world-shaking change in his strength within a month’s time, how could that be an empty promise?
Liu Sanjun looked towards Ling Han again, “Do you dare or not?”
Yan Dong gave Ling Han a look, signalling for Ling Han to not agree. In any case, Xue
Bingchuan was not a disciple of the Holy Land, so even if he died, so be it.
“Sure,” Ling Han said calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 3837: Deathmatch
paragraphs: Yan Dong really wanted to curse. Why did you agree? Could it be that you don’t know how
amazing the methods of a Sect Master elite were? He was completely capable of creating a monster in a short period of time.
However, Ling Han had already agreed, so what else could he say?
“Good, very good.” Liu Sanjun nodded, then beckoned Xue Zhan over, “Follow me.”

“Yes, Elder!” Xue Zhan was overjoyed. Since Liu Sanjun had set a deadline of a month, then with his status and identity, how could it be that this Elder would slap himself in the face? Thus, he would be completely transformed within a month’s time, powerful to the point of crushing Ling Han.
This was a great opportunity.
He hurriedly scrambled after Liu Sanjun, and Xue Hai was extremely envious, but there was nothing he could do about it. Who asked him to only be a Foundation Building Tier?
“Sigh, you’re so rash. Why did you agree?” Yan Dong couldn’t help but grumble about Ling Han.
He truly admired this alchemy prodigy. Furthermore, Ling Han actually knew formations as well. He was even more of a prodigy among prodigies, which made him think even more highly of him.
“Do you know that mortal duels prohibit all external power? Tool, Talisman Weapons, formations, and so on aren’t allowed to be used.”
Ling Han really didn’t know, but he didn’t care. Both of them could not use external power, so what did he have to fear?
One month later, would Xue Zhan be able to become a Core Formation Tier elite?
This was impossible. Even a Sect Master elite could not do this. If it was a Saint, it would be more likely.
“With such a bet, it can motivate me.” Ling Han gave a reason. He naturally did not speak his true thoughts — this was a chance to kill Xue Zhan openly and publicly.
Yan Dong was speechless. You are just an alchemist, and now you have the identity of Formation Master, but in terms of martial arts, are you really that powerful?

“Ai, you child!” He sighed, and said, “Do you know that a Sect Master elite is capable of molding a Celestial Cauldron for a Cauldron Forging Tier? Though it does not last long, it is more than enough for a battle.”
“Then why does he still need a month’s time?” Ling Han was curious.
Yan Dong was also subconsciously taken aback, then looked shocked, “Unless... that guy, Liu Sanjun, wants to create more than one Celestial Cauldron for Xue Zhan!”

This kind of technique was actually used to help a Cauldron Forging Tier break through. This was because even if he managed to forge a Celestial Cauldron that was unstable and would soon collapse, it would still allow a cultivator to grasp a sliver of an opportunity and gain some comprehension.

However, only a single Celestial Cauldron had to be created for this, and that was enough. There was no benefit in having more. Furthermore, this was extremely damaging to the user’s vitality. What Sect Master elite would have nothing better to do?
Hence, it was very problematic that Liu Sanjun had set a deadline of a month.
-He did not just want to help Xue Zhan forge a Celestial Cauldron, but rather a few, allowing him to temporarily possess strength that surpassed Ling Han.
Only a Sect Master elite would dare to make such a boast. This kind of technique was indeed heaven-defying.
“Brat, just admit defeat and don’t go to this appointment,” Yan Dong hurriedly said.
Such a prodigy should focus on studying alchemy, and the larger the force, the greater the need for a great alchemist. This was one of the criteria for measuring the strength of a force.
Ling Han merely smiled, “Thank you for your concern, Elder Yan. However, in a battle of equal cultivation levels, I am not afraid of anyone!”
He said these words resolutely and decisively, his confidence soaring.
Yan Dong was also convinced. This was a kind of self-confidence that had even influenced him.
He secretly decided that he would have Ling Han participate in the battle. If he was outmatched, he would save Ling Han even if it meant sacrificing his pride.

Due to the appearance of the two Elders, the matter today had temporarily cooled down. The authorities of the Holy Land did not say who was in the wrong, but a month later, they would definitely settle accounts.
Rules were rules. Without rules, nothing could be accomplished.
The large black dog, Lin Luo, and the others were all a little worried. How could a powerful Sect Master elite confidently agree to a bet with a deadline of a month be slapped in the face?
Thus, when the time came, Xue Zhan’s strength would definitely undergo an earth-shattering change. He definitely had to be careful.
“I know.” Ling Han nodded, “In this month, I will also strive for another breakthrough.”

The maximum limit of the Cauldron Forging Tier was Nine Cauldrons, but there were pitifully few people that could cultivate to this level. Not only did they need their own natural talent, they also had to have astonishing fated opportunities.
Thus, Ling Han definitely did not believe that external power could help Xue Zhan reach this step.
Then he would assume that Xue Zhan could become Eight Cauldrons. This was the highest estimate possible.

He was now at Four Cauldrons, so it shouldn’t be difficult for him to destroy Seven Cauldrons. If he faced Eight Cauldrons, he might not be a match, but it wouldn’t be difficult for him to ensure his safety.
However, Ling Han had never pursued the purpose of just ensuring his safety. What he wanted was victory.
Thus, if he could advance further, and reach Five Cauldrons, then even if Xue Zhan could forge Eight Cauldrons, he would still have the confidence to defeat him.

Everyone was cheering Ling Han on, as well as comforting him to not force himself. That was because he was equivalent to having a battle of arts with a Sect Master elite, so no one would laugh at him even if he admitted his cowardice.
It was difficult to break through to Five Cauldrons within a month!

After advancing into Celestial Path, to say nothing of crossing over a minor level of cultivation level, even taking a small step within a minor level would take a very long time. It would take years at the drop of a hat. Thus, wanting to break through to Five Cauldrons in a month was a little like daydreaming.
Under normal circumstances, Ling Han wouldn’t dare to have such extravagant thoughts. However, he now knew the location of a medicinal field, and it was practically unguarded.
He decided to steal the medicine.

Stealing was definitely not right, but this was also a special circumstance. Worse come to worst, when Ling Han attained great dao, he would come back and make up for it. Special times require special measures, and there was no need to adhere too much to the
rules.
At night, Ling Han quietly arrived at that dry well. After entering, he put on the hide of the Void Beast and headed to the medicinal field.
He searched around, and found a few Celestial medicines that could increase cultivation level,
but they had not ripened.
He could only apologize.
Without maturity, the effects would be slightly inferior, but it would definitely be effective.

Ling Han plucked three unripe fruits and returned to his residence. Then, he ingested the fruits and after refinement, his cultivation level instantly shot up. Alchemical pills had a sliver of alchemic poison, and taking too many wouldn’t be beneficial. Instead, it would be harmful. However, natural treasures didn’t have such worries. It was just that there were too few of them, so it was impossible to take them in an unlimited amount.
Ling Han decided that he would go take a look tomorrow.
Time passed quietly, and Ling Han was also improving every day, which was very shocking.

The news that he and Xue Zhan were going to have a mortal duel in a month’s time had already spread throughout the entire Holy Land. A great many people had expressed their interest, and when the time came, they would definitely go and join in on the excitement. However, there were also some that appeared disdainful, such as Lin Qi and Gan Ping. They looked down on Ling Han greatly, and thought that Ling Han could only borrow external power. In terms of personal strength, he was only an ordinary Four Cauldrons.
This was naturally naked jealousy, because Ling Han actually killed a Core Formation Tier cultivator. What other Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator could do this?
Since they couldn’t do it, they could only nitpick.

You are just an alchemist, and now you have the identity of Formation Master, but in terms of martial arts, are you really that powerful?
“Ai, you child!” He sighed, and said, “Do you know that a Sect Master elite is capable of molding a Celestial Cauldron for a Cauldron Forging Tier?
Though it does not last long, it is more than enough for a battle.”
“Then why does he still need a month’s time?” Ling Han was curious.
Yan Dong was also subconsciously taken aback, then looked shocked, “Unless... that guy, Liu Sanjun, wants to create more than one Celestial Cauldron for Xue Zhan!”
This kind of technique was actually used to help a Cauldron Forging Tier break through.

This was because even if he managed to forge a Celestial Cauldron that was unstable and would soon collapse, it would still allow a cultivator to grasp a sliver of an opportunity and gain some comprehension.
However, only a single Celestial Cauldron had to be created for this, and that was enough.
There was no benefit in having more.
Furthermore, this was extremely damaging to the user’s vitality.
What Sect Master elite would have nothing better to do?
Hence, it was very problematic that Liu Sanjun had set a deadline of a month.
-He did not just want to help Xue Zhan forge a Celestial Cauldron, but rather a few, allowing him to temporarily possess strength that surpassed Ling Han.
Only a Sect Master elite would dare to make such a boast.
This kind of technique was indeed heaven-defying.
“Brat, just admit defeat and don’t go to this appointment,” Yan Dong hurriedly said.
Such a prodigy should focus on studying alchemy, and the larger the force, the greater the need for a great alchemist.
This was one of the criteria for measuring the strength of a force.
Ling Han merely smiled, “Thank you for your concern, Elder Yan.
However, in a battle of equal cultivation levels, I am not afraid of anyone!”
He said these words resolutely and decisively, his confidence soaring.
Yan Dong was also convinced.
This was a kind of self-confidence that had even influenced him.
He secretly decided that he would have Ling Han participate in the battle.
If he was outmatched, he would save Ling Han even if it meant sacrificing his pride.
Due to the appearance of the two Elders, the matter today had temporarily cooled down.
The authorities of the Holy Land did not say who was in the wrong, but a month later, they would definitely settle accounts.
Rules were rules.
Without rules, nothing could be accomplished.
The large black dog, Lin Luo, and the others were all a little worried.
How could a powerful Sect Master elite confidently agree to a bet with a deadline of a month be slapped in the face?
Thus, when the time came, Xue Zhan’s strength would definitely undergo an earth-shattering change.
He definitely had to be careful.
“I know.” Ling Han nodded, “In this month, I will also strive for another breakthrough.”
The maximum limit of the Cauldron Forging Tier was Nine Cauldrons, but there were pitifully few people that could cultivate to this level.
Not only did they need their own natural talent, they also had to have astonishing fated opportunities.
Thus, Ling Han definitely did not believe that external power could help Xue Zhan reach this step.
Then he would assume that Xue Zhan could become Eight Cauldrons.
This was the highest estimate possible.
He was now at Four Cauldrons, so it shouldn’t be difficult for him to destroy Seven Cauldrons.
If he faced Eight Cauldrons, he might not be a match, but it wouldn’t be difficult for him to ensure his safety.
However, Ling Han had never pursued the purpose of just ensuring his safety.
What he wanted was victory.
Thus, if he could advance further, and reach Five Cauldrons, then even if Xue Zhan could forge Eight Cauldrons, he would still have the confidence to defeat him.
Everyone was cheering Ling Han on, as well as comforting him to not force himself.
That was because he was equivalent to having a battle of arts with a Sect Master elite, so no one would laugh at him even if he admitted his cowardice.
It was difficult to break through to Five Cauldrons within a month!
After advancing into Celestial Path, to say nothing of crossing over a minor level of cultivation level, even taking a small step within a minor level would take a very long time.
It would take years at the drop of a hat.
Thus, wanting to break through to Five Cauldrons in a month was a little like daydreaming.
Under normal circumstances, Ling Han wouldn’t dare to have such extravagant thoughts.
However, he now knew the location of a medicinal field, and it was practically unguarded.
He decided to steal the medicine.
Stealing was definitely not right, but this was also a special circumstance.
Worse come to worst, when Ling Han attained great dao, he would come back and make up for it.
Special times require special measures, and there was no need to adhere too much to the
rules.
At night, Ling Han quietly arrived at that dry well.
After entering, he put on the hide of the Void Beast and headed to the medicinal field.
He searched around, and found a few Celestial medicines that could increase cultivation level,
but they had not ripened.
He could only apologize.
Without maturity, the effects would be slightly inferior, but it would definitely be effective.
Ling Han plucked three unripe fruits and returned to his residence.
Then, he ingested the fruits and after refinement, his cultivation level instantly shot up.
Alchemical pills had a sliver of alchemic poison, and taking too many wouldn’t be beneficial.
Instead, it would be harmful.
However, natural treasures didn’t have such worries.
It was just that there were too few of them, so it was impossible to take them in an unlimited amount.
Ling Han decided that he would go take a look tomorrow.
Time passed quietly, and Ling Han was also improving every day, which was very shocking.
The news that he and Xue Zhan were going to have a mortal duel in a month’s time had already spread throughout the entire Holy Land.
A great many people had expressed their interest, and when the time came, they would definitely go and join in on the excitement.
However, there were also some that appeared disdainful, such as Lin Qi and Gan Ping.
They looked down on Ling Han greatly, and thought that Ling Han could only borrow external power.
In terms of personal strength, he was only an ordinary Four Cauldrons.
This was naturally naked jealousy, because Ling Han actually killed a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
What other Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator could do this?
Since they couldn’t do it, they could only nitpick.

chapters.title: Chapter 3838: Five Cauldrons
paragraphs: Ling Han didn’t counterattack. The best way to deal with this kind of person was to defeat them. If he defeated him, wouldn’t he be convinced?
Five days, ten days, half a month, time passed quietly, and the deadline of a month was getting closer and closer.
No one knew how powerful Xue Zhan was now, because he had been staying at Liu Sanjun’s place all this while. As the residence of a Sect Master great elite, who would dare barge in recklessly?
However, according to Lin Qi, he had once been invited by Liu Sanjun to spar with Xue Zhan.
When the news spread out, everyone was curious, and asked Lin Qi one after another to find out just how strong Xue Zhan had become by now.
Lin Qi did not speak directly, and only said that Ling Han was definitely going to die.
Was this not enough?

Yet Ling Han was completely unconcerned. In his imagination, he had already considered Xue Zhan as Eight Cauldrons. Then, what was so strange about an Eight Cauldrons tie, or even defeating Lin Qi in reality?

The problem now was that the cave dwellers seemed to realize that there was something “something” stealing the Celestial medicine, and had already strengthened their defenses. When Ling Han had gone to steal the Celestial medicine yesterday, he had almost been discovered, because there was shockingly a True Self Tier elite.
Stealing medicines would be much more difficult.
It couldn’t be helped. Who asked Ling Han to steal it every day? This would definitely arouse suspicion.
Thankfully, Ling Han’s cultivation level was close to peak stage Four Cauldrons.

He didn’t steal any more medicines. Instead, he focused on cultivating. Even if it wasn’t the half an hour before dawn, he was still cultivating. Although his efficiency was a hundred times lower, no matter how small a mosquito’s leg was, it was still meat. With the current situation, he had to make the most of every second.
Another seven days later, Ling Han finally reached the peak stage of Four Cauldrons.
He could now attempt to reach Five Cauldrons.
The basic conditions had been met, but there had to be an opportunity to break through. How could one break through just like that?
Ling Han then went to battle on the Galaxy Network, wanting to find inspiration in the midst of battle to take that crucial step.
One day, two days, three days, yet Ling Han made no progress at all. It was as if he could only cultivate to Four Cauldrons, and this was his limit.
Ling Han naturally didn’t believe this. He did not continue fighting, but rather cultivated in seclusion.

He emptied his mind and stopped thinking about the battle that would take place a few days later. He sorted through his recent battles over and over again. Finally, he recalled the battles of the Ancestral King, Pan Shi, in his mind. Great scenes appeared in his mind, surging magnificently.
All of a sudden, he had an inspiration.
Begin!
Ling Han took a sip of Earth Spirit Milk, then sat down in a cross-legged position and charged towards Five Cauldrons.
He had also ingested a Cauldron Heart Pill, and in his mind, the image of a Celestial Cauldron appeared.
Though this was only an image, it could be used as a reference to reconstruct his fifth Celestial Cauldron.
‘Come!’
His life essence condensed, turning into the core of the fifth Celestial Cauldron. Then, using this as a foundation, it continued to grow stronger.
Two days later, the breakthrough was completed.
In Ling Han’s mind, the fifth cauldron was formed. It floated gently, emanating Celestial Qi. However, it was only a cauldron, but there were no legs.

“Though it is only early stage Five Cauldrons, with my battle prowess, it would not be a problem for me to defeat Eight Cauldrons. Even if I encounter Nine Cauldrons, I am sure that I would be just barely qualified to battle them.” Ling Han was filled with confidence. Of course, the more Celestial Cauldrons he formed, it meant that the higher his natural talent, the stronger this prodigy’s battle prowess would be.
How many people in the entire universe could cultivate to the level of Nine Cauldrons within the same era?

Thus, this kind of person would definitely have battle prowess that defied the heavens. Ling Han didn’t dare to boast that he could still defeat someone with a disadvantage of a few minor levels of cultivation.
For example, Origin, Myriad Dao and Heaven Crushing were all monsters like him. He wanted to defeat them with a disadvantage of two or three minor levels? How was that possible!
However, Xue Zhan? Hehe.

How could this kind of cultivation level that had been rapidly achieved in a short period of time, and one that had been temporarily attained through the power of others, possibly compare to the likes of Origin and the others?
To say nothing of Origin, even Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian were much stronger than him.
There were still three days until the mortal duel.
Ling Han came out of seclusion, and began to wander around in the Holy Land, appearing extremely calm.

In this Holy Land, it was possible that secret techniques were hidden everywhere. Thus, since he had just broken through, it was not appropriate for him to advance any further. He needed to relax, so he could use this time to hunt for treasures.

His luck began to improve. In a short three days, he actually managed to obtain a considerable number of celestial techniques from within the cracks of a rock, the body of a fish in the lake, and the rhythm of eruption of a volcano, and so on. However, it was a shame that their levels weren’t too high. At present, he really didn’t take Sect Master-level secret techniques to heart.
Then, another night later, it would be the day of the final battle between Ling Han and Xue
Zhan.
The sun had just risen, and Ling Han cultivated for half an hour as usual. This was something
that would not change ever.
He packed his things, and left.
When he arrived at the foot of the mountain, he saw that the empress, Hu Niu, Lin Luo, Wu Qiyuan, Yuwen Tian and the others were all waiting for him.
Ling Han nodded at everyone, and then headed towards the location of the final battle.

This was a massive open space, and there were a great many people waiting there. The entire Holy Land had been strengthened by the great elites of the past eras, so to say nothing of Cauldron Forging Tier, even if Sect Master great elites moved, the damage they could cause would be extremely limited. Thus, there was no need for the deliberate set up of a tournament stage for the mortal duel.
As expected, neither Lin Qi nor Gan Ping had come. It was as if they wanted to use this attitude to tell everyone that they were not optimistic about Ling Han at all, and did not want to waste
any time.
However, Tan Meng and the other great beauties had all arrived, and when they saw Ling Han approach, they all approached him.
“Senior Brother Ling, if you’re not confident, it’s best not to accept the challenge,” Jie
Yingqiu was the first to say.
“That’s right. Senior Brother Ling is skilled in both alchemy and formations, so there is no
need for you to come to blows with a brute,” Jiang Yifei echoed.
Yet Tan Meng smiled beautifully, “I wish Senior Brother Ling a triumphant return in
advance.”

She had “exchanged blows” with Ling Han before, and with her intelligence, she was naturally very familiar with Ling Han’s personality. If this guy was not confident, how could The possibly agree to a mortal duel with Xue Zhan?
Therefore, this guy must have a trump card – it should be known that Elder Yan Dong had previously stood up for him.
Then, if Xue Zhan could obtain Liu Sanjun’s help, why couldn’t Ling Han do the same? Hu Niu instantly looked like she was protecting her food, and looked at the three women with
a vigilant gaze, “You three ugly monsters, Ling Han is Niu’s, don’t even think about it!”

These words were too direct, causing the beautiful faces of the three women to flush. They were prodigies on the Exquisite Leaderboard, and who knew how many prodigies would fight tooth and nail just to see them, yet you mistakenly thought that they were here to get
close to Ling Han?
Ling Han had not even spoken, when xiu, a swift light shot out from a certain mountain peak,
and appeared in the arena in a flash.
Liu Sanjun had come.
There was a person in his grasp, and it was Xue Zhan.

“Begin,” he said calmly. This was merely a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, and he couldn’t even be bothered to take another look at him. What was the point of wasting time? Meanwhile, Xue Zhan twisted his neck, as if he was stretching his muscles and bones. Then, he looked at Ling Han with a provoking gaze, “Haha, can you block three moves from me?” Right now, he was brimming with confidence. With Liu Sanjun’s help, he had condensed five Celestial Cauldrons, allowing him to become an Eight Cauldrons elite.
Though after this battle, those five Celestial Cauldrons would all disappear, there would still be seeds left behind. In future, it was possible that he could charge up to Five Cauldrons, or
even Six Cauldrons in fact.
