chapters.title: Chapter 3839: Kneel
paragraphs: He was truly a vile character who had become conceited.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Who do you think you are, that you can strut around in front of me?”
“Hahahaha!” Xue Zhan laughed loudly, “Frog at the bottom of a well, you have not reached this level, so there is absolutely no way that you would know just how strong I am now!”
He stretched out a finger, “To defeat you, one finger is enough.”
Ling Han stood with his hands clasped behind his back, saying, “You’re far too boastful. Don’t be defeated at the first exchange. That would be far too humiliating.”
Xue Zhan’s eyes were cold. In terms of bickering, he was really no match for Ling Han. Thus, it was better to make a move directly.

He had absolute confidence in his own strength. He was so strong that it was as if he could match even a Core Formation Tier cultivator. Wasn’t suppressing a Four Cauldrons cultivator a piece of cake?
Fine, he would beat this brat to the ground first, and then slowly humiliate him.
Xue Zhan made up his mind, and walked towards Ling Han. As he walked, he released his Celestial Cauldron.
One, two, three, four!

When he released the fourth Celestial Cauldron, everyone couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise. Four cauldrons! In the entire Galaxy Network, there were only a thousand or so people who could form four cauldrons. This kind of strength was enough to rank in the top thousand. No matter which sect they went to, they would be qualified to become a Dao Child.
However, this was not the end. Xue Zhan released the fifth Celestial Cauldron.
“Heavens!” Everyone exclaimed in shock. Five cauldrons, breaking through on the basis of the maximum limit was even harder.
This was still not Xue Zhan’s limit. He released the sixth Celestial Cauldron.
Actually, he clearly could have released all the Celestial Cauldrons at the same time, but for the sake of achieving the greatest effect of showing off, he chose to show them one by one.
Only then would it be stunning.
As expected, everyone was exclaiming in shock. Six cauldrons! Even Gan Ping and Lin Qi probably only had this kind of strength.
Immediately afterward, the seventh Celestial Cauldron appeared.
Seven cauldrons!
Everyone was numb with shock, not knowing how to speak.
No wonder Gan Ping had said that Ling Han was definitely going to die. Seven cauldrons, that was too terrifying.
“Do you think that this is my limit?” Xue Zhan roared loudly, and the eighth Celestial Cauldron appeared.
Eight cauldrons, the highest peak that was inferior only to Nine Cauldrons.
Everyone couldn’t help but turn to look at Liu Sanjun. Was this the strength of a Sect Master? It had only been a month, and he had already raised a Heaven Cauldron to Eight Cauldrons.
“No, five of Xue Zhan’s Celestial Cauldrons were forcefully created by Elder Liu with his supreme might. This can’t be maintained for long.”
“So that’s how it is. Otherwise, it would be too terrifying.”
“That’s natural. If the Celestial Cauldron could be condensed like this, then what would be so strange about eight cauldrons or even nine cauldrons in fact?”
“That’s right.”

“However, this Celestial Cauldron has left a mark in Xue Zhan’s body after all. In future, if he wants to forge a new Celestial Cauldron, it would be ten times, or even a hundred times easier than others.”

“This guy is really lucky, and can be considered to have profited from this misfortune.” Everyone was discussing spiritedly. There would always be those who had good insight and were knowledgeable, and spoke of Xue Zhan’s true situation at this time.

This caused a great many people to feel envious. Perhaps, Xue Zhan’s limit was only Four Cauldrons, but after this incident, this guy’s future limit could possibly be Five Cauldrons, or even Six Cauldrons in fact.
After all, how could it be as simple as temporarily improving one’s battle prowess when it was causing serious injury to the vitality of a Sect Master elite?

Xue Zhan was really high-spirited now, proud to the extreme. He felt that all the men were envious of him, and all the women were admiring him, causing his vanity to swell endlessly. “Kneel!” he shouted loudly at Ling Han. His aura surged madly, like tumultuous waves.
In the distance, many people felt their legs go weak, and almost knelt down.
They couldn’t help but feel shocked. They were already so far away, yet they were still affected. This guy’s strength was practically heaven-defying.
However, Ling Han was completely unmoved.
Yi?
Xue Zhan looked surprised. Why was this guy completely unaffected?
“Kneel!” Ling Han also spoke up. Boom! A murderous aura surged out.
Xue Zhan instantly felt his mind go blank, and then a powerful chill rose up in him. Involuntarily, his legs weakened, and he fell to his knees.
Peng, this kneel was extremely heavy, and the sound was loud and clear.
F***, what was going on?

Everyone was dumbfounded. Xue Zhan was clearly awe-inspiring, with a cultivation level of Eight Cauldrons. To say nothing of the fact that he was invincible against all those in Cauldron Forging Tier, there were only a rare few that could defeat him at present. However, in the blink of an eye, Xue Zhan had knelt down, so how could they not be shocked to the point of their eyes popping out?

However, Tan Meng and the other seductive beauties’ beautiful eyes shone brilliantly. What they feared the most was Ling Han being rash and quick-tempered. Whether it was this kind of person as a subordinate, partner or husband, it was all incredibly troublesome. Now, it was proof that Ling Han wasn’t arrogant at all. Instead, he was genuinely powerful.
This was called confidence.

Meanwhile, Liu Sanjun’s expression instantly became dark. He had worked hard for a month, even sacrificing his vitality to forcefully raise Xue Zhan’s cultivation level to Eight Cauldrons. At first, he had thought that he would be able to trample on Ling Han and win back some face for him. Who would have thought that Xue Zhan would kneel down before they had even
exchanged blows?
What was the point of continuing the battle?
“Ah!” Xue Zhan immediately jumped up, his face flushed red. Pointing at Ling Han, he exclaimed, “You actually dare to use a Spirit Tool, despicable and shameless!”
Otherwise, how could a mere Four Cauldrons cause him to lose his senses?
When everyone heard this, doubt arose in their hearts. That’s right. This was a little
inconceivable. Could Four Cauldrons be so strong?
“Stop humiliating yourself, and make your move!” However, right at this moment, Liu
Sanjun suddenly shouted in a deep voice.
Was he using a Spirit Tool? How could it be that he wasn’t aware of it?
This was truly humiliating. His skills were inferior, yet he actually said that it was because his opponent had used a Tool. This was even uglier than when he had been kneeling on the
ground.
Hearing Liu Sanjun’s words, everyone naturally understood.
Ling Han didn’t use a Spirit Tool. Otherwise, Liu Sanjun would definitely attack at the first
instant.
Hiss, without using a Spirit Tool, and merely relying on his true abilities, Ling Han actually managed to make an Eight Cauldrons kneel. This was too terrifying.

Ling Han smiled faintly, “Who do you think you are, that you can strut around in front of me?”
“Hahahaha!” Xue Zhan laughed loudly, “Frog at the bottom of a well, you have not reached this level, so there is absolutely no way that you would know just how strong I am now!”
He stretched out a finger, “To defeat you, one finger is enough.”
Ling Han stood with his hands clasped behind his back, saying, “You’re far too boastful.
Don’t be defeated at the first exchange.
That would be far too humiliating.”
Xue Zhan’s eyes were cold.
In terms of bickering, he was really no match for Ling Han.
Thus, it was better to make a move directly.
He had absolute confidence in his own strength.
He was so strong that it was as if he could match even a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
Wasn’t suppressing a Four Cauldrons cultivator a piece of cake?
Fine, he would beat this brat to the ground first, and then slowly humiliate him.
Xue Zhan made up his mind, and walked towards Ling Han.
As he walked, he released his Celestial Cauldron.
One, two, three, four!
When he released the fourth Celestial Cauldron, everyone couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise.
Four cauldrons!
In the entire Galaxy Network, there were only a thousand or so people who could form four cauldrons.
This kind of strength was enough to rank in the top thousand.
No matter which sect they went to, they would be qualified to become a Dao Child.
However, this was not the end.
Xue Zhan released the fifth Celestial Cauldron.
“Heavens!” Everyone exclaimed in shock.
Five cauldrons, breaking through on the basis of the maximum limit was even harder.
This was still not Xue Zhan’s limit.
He released the sixth Celestial Cauldron.
Actually, he clearly could have released all the Celestial Cauldrons at the same time, but for the sake of achieving the greatest effect of showing off, he chose to show them one by one.
Only then would it be stunning.
As expected, everyone was exclaiming in shock.
Six cauldrons!
Even Gan Ping and Lin Qi probably only had this kind of strength.
Immediately afterward, the seventh Celestial Cauldron appeared.
Seven cauldrons!
Everyone was numb with shock, not knowing how to speak.
No wonder Gan Ping had said that Ling Han was definitely going to die.
Seven cauldrons, that was too terrifying.
“Do you think that this is my limit?” Xue Zhan roared loudly, and the eighth Celestial Cauldron appeared.
Eight cauldrons, the highest peak that was inferior only to Nine Cauldrons.
Everyone couldn’t help but turn to look at Liu Sanjun.
Was this the strength of a Sect Master?
It had only been a month, and he had already raised a Heaven Cauldron to Eight Cauldrons.
“No, five of Xue Zhan’s Celestial Cauldrons were forcefully created by Elder Liu with his supreme might.
This can’t be maintained for long.”
“So that’s how it is.
Otherwise, it would be too terrifying.”
“That’s natural.
If the Celestial Cauldron could be condensed like this, then what would be so strange about eight cauldrons or even nine cauldrons in fact?”
“That’s right.”
“However, this Celestial Cauldron has left a mark in Xue Zhan’s body after all.
In future, if he wants to forge a new Celestial Cauldron, it would be ten times, or even a hundred times easier than others.”
“This guy is really lucky, and can be considered to have profited from this misfortune.” Everyone was discussing spiritedly.
There would always be those who had good insight and were knowledgeable, and spoke of Xue Zhan’s true situation at this time.
This caused a great many people to feel envious.
Perhaps, Xue Zhan’s limit was only Four Cauldrons, but after this incident, this guy’s future limit could possibly be Five Cauldrons, or even Six Cauldrons in fact.
After all, how could it be as simple as temporarily improving one’s battle prowess when it was causing serious injury to the vitality of a Sect Master elite?
Xue Zhan was really high-spirited now, proud to the extreme.
He felt that all the men were envious of him, and all the women were admiring him, causing his vanity to swell endlessly.
“Kneel!” he shouted loudly at Ling Han.
His aura surged madly, like tumultuous waves.
In the distance, many people felt their legs go weak, and almost knelt down.
They couldn’t help but feel shocked.
They were already so far away, yet they were still affected.
This guy’s strength was practically heaven-defying.
However, Ling Han was completely unmoved.
Yi?
Xue Zhan looked surprised.
Why was this guy completely unaffected?
“Kneel!” Ling Han also spoke up.
Boom!
A murderous aura surged out.
Xue Zhan instantly felt his mind go blank, and then a powerful chill rose up in him.
Involuntarily, his legs weakened, and he fell to his knees.
Peng, this kneel was extremely heavy, and the sound was loud and clear.
F***, what was going on?
Everyone was dumbfounded.

To say nothing of the fact that he was invincible against all those in Cauldron Forging Tier, there were only a rare few that could defeat him at present.
However, in the blink of an eye, Xue Zhan had knelt down, so how could they not be shocked to the point of their eyes popping out?
However, Tan Meng and the other seductive beauties’ beautiful eyes shone brilliantly.
What they feared the most was Ling Han being rash and quick-tempered.
Whether it was this kind of person as a subordinate, partner or husband, it was all incredibly troublesome.
Now, it was proof that Ling Han wasn’t arrogant at all.
Instead, he was genuinely powerful.
This was called confidence.

exchanged blows?

ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 3840: Directly Killed
paragraphs: “Ling Han, do you dare to fight me head-on?” Xue Zhan provoked.

It was unknown what kind of technique the other party had used. Though he was prepared, it was still impossible for him to guard against it. He kept falling to his knees against his will. —This was natural. This was an attack on the level of divine sense. Unless one’s willpower was as strong as iron, only the heirs of the Buddhist Race would be able to stand against the attacks. The Six Characters Bright King Curse had an outstanding defensive effect against spiritual attacks.
Ling Han didn’t want to continue playing with him, and said calmly, “Make your move.”
Xue Zhan succeeded in provoking Ling Han, and couldn’t help but sneer. As long as he could unleash the battle prowess of Eight Cauldrons, he would have a crushing advantage against Four Cauldrons.
“Die!”
He charged over and threw a punch.
The mortal duel prohibited all external items, but it was all right. His fists could crush everything.
Ling Han humphed lightly, and also shot out a punch.
Peng!

The two fists crashed into each other, instantly creating a storm of energy, turning into a mushroom cloud that rose into the air. However, the ground here was too firm. Even this kind of attack could only create a pit that was not too deep.
Amidst the chaotic flashes of light, both Ling Han and Xue Zhan were seen retreating rapidly. What!
Everyone could not believe their eyes.

Previously, Xue Zhan had repeatedly knelt down, making everyone guess that Ling Han had mastered a powerful Spiritual Power secret technique, but just now, it was a genuine clash of mystical power. It would be clear who was stronger.
But what had they seen?
The two of them were actually evenly matched!
How was this possible?
Eight Cauldrons was actually unable to suppress Four Cauldrons in terms of power. What justice was there left in this world? Was there any law?
Liu Sanjun couldn’t help but turn to look at Ling Han. At first, he couldn’t be bothered to pay attention to a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, but now, he was suddenly curious about this young man.
Yi!
With his Sect Master-level strength, he naturally could see very clearly that there were five Celestial Cauldrons in Ling Han’s mind, and one of them only had the body of cauldron without any legs.
Early stage of Five Cauldrons.
There was a gap of three cauldrons, and he was actually not at a disadvantage at all?
Though Xue Zhan’s five cauldrons were all fake, and only temporary, in such a short period of time, using them was not much different from Eight Cauldrons.
Hiss!
Liu Sanjun looked again, and his expression involuntarily became solemn. What had he seen? Stone-like Celestial Cauldron.
The Five Elements Celestial Cauldron?

Aside from the bronze, silver, and gold Celestial Cauldrons, there were some prodigies that were unique. When forging the Celestial Cauldron, they would infuse some special substances, or even the power of the bloodline, which would cause the Celestial Cauldron to mutate. Thus, there would be the Flame Celestial Cauldron, Frost Celestial Cauldron, and so on. It would not be strange for a Stone Celestial. Perhaps Ling Han was a Stone Element Innate Divine Physique.
But when he took a closer look, he immediately discovered that something was off.
This was definitely no ordinary Stone Celestial Cauldron. Instead, it was filled with a supreme aura, as if that was the king tier of Celestial Cauldrons.
Hiss, there was actually someone that could forge a Celestial Cauldron like this?

Liu Sanjun couldn’t help but cherish talent. In this lifetime, there was practically no hope for him to become a Venerate Tier, but if he could nurture a Venerate Tier-level disciple, that feeling of accomplishment should not be inferior to him becoming a Venerate.
In fact, he felt that Ling Han’s future wasn’t limited to merely Venerate Tier. In fact, he even had a chance of becoming a Saint.

He didn’t dare to think about him being able to achieve the level of Emperor. Not only did one need natural talent, but they also needed great fortune and great opportunities. For example, the Nine Suns Saint had once claimed to be the strongest Saint, yet hadn’t he still lost to Ancestral King Lingtian?
“How is this possible!” Xue Zhan roared, his face filled with disbelief.
“Nothing is impossible,” Ling Han said calmly. “Within three moves, I’ll send you on your way.”
“Haha, you really have a wild imagination!” Xue Zhan smirked coldly, his killing intent blazing.

This time, he definitely had to kill Ling Han. Otherwise, his strength would very soon disappear like the ebbing tide, and Ling Han was still so strong. Then, wouldn’t he be terribly bullied by Ling Han in future?
Hence, this was the only chance, kill!
In a mortal duel, there was no need to bear responsibility for killing.
He roared loudly, and communicated with high-level energy. Instantly, his whole body was wrapped in flames, as if he had turned into a god of fire.

“Die!” He pounced out again, channelling a powerful celestial technique. As he shot out a punch, the power of his fist took the form of a massive firebird. Its whole body was covered with densely packed seals, as it pounced towards Ling Han.

Ling Han was unafraid, and directly charged towards the firebird. Peng, he threw a punch, and the firebird directly shattered. He charged out, channelling the Imminent Skyline beneath his feet, and instantly arrived in front of Xue Zhan. The Great Overarching Heaven Technique was
used, similarly entwined in flames.
Peng!
Xue Zhan was instantly sent flying. He hurriedly scrambled to his feet, and was just about to make a move, when he shockingly discovered that there were flames burning on his body.
He hurriedly wanted to extinguish the flames, but discovered that these flames were incredibly stubborn, and there was actually no end to them.
He was shocked, but he had not even finished this thought, when he saw Ling Han charge towards him again.

It was still the Great Overarching Heaven Technique. Ling Han’s hands formed into fists and claws, manifesting the ultimate technique of the Jin Clan. A series of attacks crashed down, and Xue Zhan was instantly killed.
Ling Han sighed internally. If he used the Three Styles of the God of War, he should be able to deal with him with a single strike.
As expected, there was still a very, very large gap between a Venerate Tier-level precious
technique and a Saint Technique.
But the others were all numb with shock, completely rendered speechless.
An Eight Cauldrons was directly killed by Ling Han just like that.
Open and aboveboard; there was no excuse.
Hiss, what kind of terrifying abilities was this?
Gan Ping, Lin Qi?
In front of this kind of strength, they would probably have to kneel down and proclaim their
conquest.
All the beauties’ eyes lit up with iridescent light, and even Tan Meng and the other seductive beauties were no exception. How could this kind of man not tempt others?

Outstanding alchemy skills, astonishing formation abilities, and now added with this incomparably domineering battle prowess, no matter how picky a noble daughter was, she would still have to cast aside her reservedness and be overwhelmed with uncontrollable love
for him.

Contrary to everyone’s expectations, Liu Sanjun only cast a meaningful look at Ling Han, and actually did not say a word. Instead, he directly turned around and flew away. “Strange!” Yan Dong mumbled in the crowd. This was not like Old Monster Liu. He had already prepared himself to make a move, to prevent Liu Sanjun from killing Ling Han in his humiliated rage, but he had not thought that Liu Sanjun would actually leave directly. Ling Han walked back, and everyone immediately surged towards him. Whether male or female, they were all incredibly cordial.
“Senior Brother Ling!” they all called out, feeling a bone-deep admiration.
Ling Han smiled at everyone, but did not stop at all. He squeezed out of the crowd, and brought the empress, Hu Niu and the others back.
The empress was proud, and didn’t pay any attention to anyone at all. Meanwhile, Hu Niu turned around and made a face at Tan Meng and the others, meaning that Ling Han was Niu’s,
so don’t even think about it.
However, how could this possibly scare off Tan Meng and the other women?

“This is the ideal husband that I am looking for. Not only is he skilled in both alchemy and formations, his natural talent in martial arts is also outstanding, and there is hope for him to become a Saint in future.” Tan Meng thought, “Furthermore, this guy has a glib tongue, so he should know how to be romantic. Being with him, the rest of my life would definitely not be
boring!”
Jiang Yifei and Jie Yingqiu had similar thoughts. The three women looked at each other, and animosity rose up in them.
They had never seen the empress and Hu Niu’s true appearances before, so they didn’t think of them as worthy rivals at all. They only felt that the two people in front of them were their
greatest rivals.

chapters.title: Chapter 3841: Candidate for the Dao Child
paragraphs: After this battle, Ling Han’s name resounded throughout the entire Holy Land. In fact, his fame even surpassed that of Gan Ping and Lin Qi.
Just look at his battle merits – creating a formation that killed a Core Formation Tier, destroying Eight Cauldrons with punches, who could compare?
However, Gan Ping and Lin Qi quickly jumped out, and began to find excuses.

Creating a formation that killed a Core Formation Tier, there was nothing much to say about that; he was only relying on formations. Furthermore, the setting up of formations had to depend on the environment of heaven and earth, and that kind of great formation had to be set up in advance, as it had too many limitations.
Oh, if you met an enemy on a narrow path, how could it be that you could ask them to give you half a day’s time to set up the formation?
Thus, in a battle between elites, this ability was useless.
Secondly, destroying Eight Cauldrons with punches?

Hehe, could Xue Zhan be considered as Eight Cauldrons? That was only a fake Eight Cauldrons that had been forcefully piled up by an elite. His true battle prowess was comparable to Six Cauldrons, or even slightly above Five Cauldrons.
Thus, Ling Han was indeed a little strong, but he was still far from being invincible to the point of sweeping aside all opposition in the Cauldron Forging Tier.

Of course, this was deliberately belittling Ling Han. No matter how weak Eight Cauldrons was, he would still have battle prowess of at least Six Cauldrons to Seven Cauldrons, and Ling Han had easily killed Xue Zhan. Just how strong would his abilities have to be?
Anyone with eyes would naturally know, but there were also some people who were blind, and thought that Galaxy Network’s ranking was the most authoritative measure.
-What was the ranking of Gan Ping and Lin Qi, and what was Ling Han’s ranking?
Ling Han couldn’t be bothered to argue with them. He only had one thing to say: are you going to fight or not? If not, then cut the crap.

Yet Gan Ping and Lin Qi did not accept the challenge, and still responded with disdain. In truth, they should not have absolute certainty of victory either, so how could they possibly dare to rashly start a battle?

The Holy Land still issued a punishment. Xue Hai was imprisoned for five years, and though Ling Han was passively defending himself, he had still broken the rules and had to self-reflect for three months.
However, an unexpected person interceded on Ling Han’s behalf, turning three months of self-reflection into three days of self-reflection.
This person was none other than Liu Sanjun.

It should be known that punishing Ling Han to self-reflect for three months was also for the sake of taking care of Liu Sanjun’s pride, but no one would have thought that Liu Sanjun would actually intercede on Ling Han’s behalf. Then, the Law Enforcement Hall would naturally go with the flow, and give Ling Han a symbolic punishment.
This result was something that even Ling Han had not expected.
He had killed Liu Sanjun’s Dao Apprentice and the “disciple” that he had painstakingly nurtured, and he was actually interceding on his behalf?
He couldn’t figure it out no matter how hard he thought about it.
Forget it. So be it if he didn’t know. He couldn’t read Liu Sanjun’s mind.

And if he deliberately teased them... he would have fallen into the trap of the three women instead. All of them looked like they had feelings for him, causing Ling Han to instantly become a gentleman, and no longer dared to say any more teasing words.

However, he couldn’t stand being annoyed, but the pervert pig was like a fish in water. Originally, what it was most afraid of was being captured by Ling Han and compelled to work, but now, there were beauties patronizing this place every day, so it refused to leave.

From the outside, the pervert pig was indeed very attractive to young girls. Whether it was Tan Meng, Jiang Yifei or Jie Yingqiu, they would always hug this little perverted pig when they came, and made the little perverted pig captivated, drooling.

Wasn’t he just a little bigger?

Pu!
Immediately, he spluttered. This was what the large black dog had transformed into. Needless to say, after shrinking its size and turning into a small puppy, it was really a little
cute.
“... Old Black, you also want to trick people into hugging you, so you can take advantage?” Ling Han suppressed his laughter.
“What is it? Can’t I?” The large black dog humphed. He just couldn’t bear to see the pervert pig, “Grandpa Dog is warning you, don’t expose me.”
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I can guarantee that you definitely won’t succeed!”
“Pei, it’s fine if you don’t want it yourself, brat, but don’t stop Grandpa Dog from seeking happiness!” The large black dog didn’t listen to Ling Han’s advice.
“All right, as you like.”
When they were having lunch, Jie Yingqiu walked over gracefully. When the large black dog saw this, it immediately wagged its tail and went up to greet her.
Come, give me a hug!
Pa, it only felt its vision blur, and was already sent flying with a kick.
F***, what the hell was this?

One failure was not enough to make the large black dog give up. He continued to work hard, and when Tan Meng came over, he went up to greet her again, wagging his tail even faster. At the same time, he widened his eyes, making himself even more adorable.
However, what greeted it was a kick of disdain.
Why?
It continued its efforts, and when Jiang Yifei came to visit, it went up to greet her again.
In the end, there was still no change. It was still sent flying with a kick.
“Why!” It finally complained to Ling Han, “Grandpa Dog is already so shameless, turning into
a cute little puppy, so why can’t I do it?”
Ling Han glanced at the iron underwear on the large black dog’s body. It was still flickering, and he wondered if he should give it a reminder.
Even if you are a little puppy, wearing a pair of iron underwear and immediately revealing a strong vulgarity, who would still find you cute?
Forget it. The large black dog was shameless, and he was really despicable enough. This kind of blow could not possibly cause him to become depressed.
After a small interlude, a major event was welcomed.
There was going to be a selection for the candidate for Dao Child and Holy Daughter.

There was no need for them to fight or compete. The Holy Land directly decided the ten candidates. In future, one of them would stand out and become the Dao Child or Holy Daughter, and then compete with the Dao Child or Holy Daughter of the next nine batches. Who knows, one of them would become the future Acting Saint Master.
The 10 people were Ling Han, Gan Ping, Lin Qi, Wu Qiyuan, Yuwen Tian, Cang Shan, Hu Ming, Jie Yingqiu, Jiang Yifei and Tan Meng.

This naturally did not mean that it would remain unchanged. Everyone could challenge these ten people, and the victor would be able to replace them. From then onwards, they would accept the challenges of others, right until the final Dao Child or Holy Daughter was
confirmed.
The moment the namelist of candidates appeared, challenges immediately appeared.

However, being able to be chosen by the members of the Holy Land, these ten people were definitely the strongest at present. Naturally, none of them had fallen from grace. This made Ling Han very surprised. Weren’t Tan Meng and the others ranked in the 1000s or 2000s on the Galaxy Network? How had they managed to squeeze into the top 10?
By the looks of it, they were hiding their strength. Their true strength far surpassed Galaxy
Network’s ranking.
However, only two days had passed, and a major event had happened.
Lin Qi had lost. He had lost to a challenger.
How was this possible? With Lin Qi’s strength, he was definitely in the top three, so how had
he lost?
His opponent was called Guo Xiang. Though he had also broken through his limits, and reached Four Cauldrons, no matter how he thought about it, he should not have been able to
defeat Lin Qi.
But a day later, everyone knew the reason.
That was because Lin Qi had issued a challenge to Ling Han.
Hehe, so that was the case. Lin Qi wanted to use this kind of method to humiliate Ling Han.
It would be utterly humiliating to kick you out of the position of candidate for the Dao Child
position. Ling Han naturally chose to accept this challenge.
Those who dared to offend him would be thrashed.

chapters.title: Chapter 3842: Fighting Lin Qi
paragraphs: Ling Han was about to fight Lin Qi.
This news instantly spread to the ears of every disciple through the network of the Holy Land. Instantly, everyone moved out, wanting to watch this fierce battle.
This wasn’t a mortal duel, so it was not forbidden to use Spirit Tools. However, because the challenger could choose the time and place, this undoubtedly crippled Ling Han’s formation abilities.
-Where were you going to set up the formation in advance?
It could be said that Lin Qi was quite smart.
On one side, it was the descendant of an Imperial Clan. Though he was not the most awesome descendant of the Lin Clan, he still had an Emperor’s blood flowing in his veins. Was that not enough?
He was ranked 207th on the Galaxy Network, and this was the best description of Lin Qi’s abilities.

On the other side, there was a dazzling new star. He came from an ordinary background, but his natural talent in cultivation was terrifying. With Four Cauldrons, um, Five Cauldrons, the Holy Land announced Ling Han’s cultivation level later, it was Five Cauldrons instead of Four Cauldrons, but even if he had defeated an Eight Cauldrons as a Five Cauldrons, he still belonged to the category of fantasy legends.
The battle between the two of them would definitely be incredibly exciting.
Early in the morning, everyone arrived at the open space, waiting for the two people involved to arrive.
Not long after, Ling Han and Lin Qi arrived at about the same time. They both arrived on the dot, not one second longer, not one second less.
Lin Qi crossed his arms behind his back, and slowly walked towards the centre of the arena. There was a faint smile on his face, but there was considerable fury in his heart.
He had always acted as if he couldn’t care less about Ling Han. Why had he suddenly issued a challenge this time?
It was very simple. A beautiful woman.

He had been pursuing Jiang Yifei all this while, and Gan Ping had his eye on Tan Meng. This was no secret. However, Jiang Yifei treated him coldly, and only acted as if she had not seen his attentiveness, yet she would go to Ling Han’s place every day.
How could he not explode in fury?
Thus, he wanted to take this opportunity to ruthlessly humiliate Ling Han, and let Jiang Yifei know that he was the one who was worthy of her favour.
When it came to women, even a descendant of an Imperial Clan like Lin Qi, a prodigy ranked 207th on the Galaxy Network, was dazed, and could no longer think calmly.
“Ling Han, come, see how I will suppress you!” he said calmly, showing his contempt for Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and also strode forwards.

Lin Qi drew out a sword. The blade was dark green in colour. This was a replica of the Lin Clan’s Imperial Weapon. It was also a standard Spirit Tool. All important heirs would have one each. Depending on the cultivation level, the level of the Spirit Tool would also be different.
However, even though this was a replica, how could the means of an Imperial Clan be ordinary?

This Jade Water Sword was one of the best of the current Cauldron Forging Tier Spirit Tools. He was sure that aside from similar Imperial Clan standard weapons, the other Spirit Tools would not be able to withstand a single blow in front of it.
Why?

That was because this Jade Water Sword had been forged right next to the Imperial Weapon. It had a sliver of the aura of the Imperial Weapon, and that alone was enough. What Spirit Tool in this world could stand against it?
“If you don’t want to suffer, I’ll allow you to surrender,” he said calmly.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “Who would’ve thought? You’re actually an expert at telling jokes.”
Lin Qi was not angered. In the Galaxy Network, he was no match for Gan Ping, but in a real battle, he believed that he would definitely be able to win.
This was because the Galaxy Network battles had excluded all external factors such as Spirit Tool, Talisman Weapon, and so on. This was both fair and unfair.
-I am a descendant of the Imperial Clan, so why can’t I use resources to crush you to death?
“How long can you continue to be stubborn?” Lin Qi said calmly, “In front of absolute strength, you are nothing but a clown.”
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “The more disdainful you speak now, the greater your humiliation will be.”

“That is impossible!” Lin Qi was filled with confidence, and the Jade Water Sword in his hand sliced out. Shua, a flash of Sword Qi sliced out towards Ling Han, turning into an azure streak, with a terrifying brilliance rippling out.
Ling Han activated the Starlight Screen and took this strike head-on.
Peng! The Sword Qi slashed over, and the Starlight Screen instantly shattered. However, the might of the Sword Qi was also exhausted.
Ling Han was slightly surprised. The might of this Spirit Tool was strong enough to actually slice open his Starlight Screen with a single strike.

However, Lin Qi was even more stunned, because he knew the background of the Jade Water Sword, but his opponent had taken a strike head-on, and it actually only managed to break through his protective shield, and he was unwounded. This caused his heart to tremble wildly. ‘I can’t underestimate him. I definitely can’t underestimate him. This brat is truly freakish.’ Alarm bells rang loudly in his heart, but his expression was calm. Furthermore, he indeed had the qualifications to break through Ling Han’s strongest defense with a single strike. The Jade Water Sword was indeed worthy of being a replica of the Imperial Weapon.

“Again!” Lin Qi brandished his sword. Shua, shua, shua! A flash of Sword Qi slashed over, and a green-colored stream filled the air. A terrifying aura was presently condensing. This was the aura of the Imperial Weapon, but it was too thin. However, with every strike of the sword, this aura would increase slightly, and when it reached a certain extent, this would eventually overwhelm everything. At least, there was no one that could match this in
Cauldron Forging Tier.
Thus, the Jade Water Sword was the strongest Two Star Spirit Tool. Aside from similarly an imitation of an Imperial Weapon, there was nothing that could match it.
Ling Han activated his Eye Technique and jumped around in the net-like Sword Qi, dodging each flash of Sword Qi just right. This could practically be considered an art, and was pleasing
to the eye.
Yet Lin Qi smirked coldly. The Sword Qi attacks were only superficial, while the true killing move was the aura of the Imperial Weapon. This was something that no Cauldron Forging
Tier could block.
Ling Han got impatient after dodging a few moves. He directly attacked head-on. The Starlight Screen spread out, and he faced the Sword Qi head-on.
The light screen shattered, and he used his fists to attack. At this moment, he was even more barbaric, violent, and direct than Wu Qiyuan.
Yet Lin Qi smirked coldly, and stretched out a hand to make a pressing motion at Ling Han.
From the looks of it, this palm strike was nothing special. However, he had drawn on the aura of the Imperial Weapon, turning it into an indestructible blade.
A powerful chill immediately rose up in Ling Han’s heart. This was an instinctive feeling of danger. He leaped forward, not facing it head-on.

“You can’t even withstand a single blow,” Lin Qi said disdainfully, but internally, he was crying out in pity. If this palm strike could land, then added with the destructive power of the aura of the Imperial Weapon, Ling Han would be severely injured. In fact, it would leave behind an aftereffect that would never be erased.
Ling Han’s sharp eyes focused on that dark green long sword. He had a feeling that all this was
because of that sword.
Since Lin Qi came from the Imperial Clan, this should be a replica of the Imperial Weapon, so
its might was naturally extraordinary.
If he had been more patient, he could have easily captured Lin Qi. However, he didn’t want to
drag the battle out for too long.
“I’ll dispose of you within three seconds,” Ling Han said calmly.
Lin Qi couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. What kind of colossal joke was this?
‘You’re at a complete disadvantage right now, and it’s only me who can hit you. Yet, you still want to dispose of me in three seconds? What kind of joke is this?’
But Ling Han had absolutely no intention of joking. Xiu, his figure darted out, heading
towards Lin Qi.
“You’re seeking death!” Lin Qi slashed out with his sword, and at the same time, his left palm was ready to strike. He wanted to see how Ling Han would deal with this blow.
Ling Han naturally charged head-on. Peng! The Starlight Screen shattered, but he also broke through the Sword Qi and charged over.
Lin Qi smirked coldly, and delivered a palm strike with his left hand. The aura of the Imperial Weapon was implicit, and increased the destructive power of this palm strike endlessly.

However, he didn’t want to
drag the battle out for too long.
“I’ll dispose of you within three seconds,” Ling Han said calmly.
Lin Qi couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself.
What kind of colossal joke was this?
‘You’re at a complete disadvantage right now, and it’s only me who can hit you.
Yet, you still want to dispose of me in three seconds?
What kind of joke is this?’
But Ling Han had absolutely no intention of joking.
Xiu, his figure darted out, heading
towards Lin Qi.
“You’re seeking death!” Lin Qi slashed out with his sword, and at the same time, his left palm was ready to strike.
He wanted to see how Ling Han would deal with this blow.
Ling Han naturally charged head-on.
Peng!
The Starlight Screen shattered, but he also broke through the Sword Qi and charged over.
Lin Qi smirked coldly, and delivered a palm strike with his left hand.
The aura of the Imperial Weapon was implicit, and increased the destructive power of this palm strike endlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 3843: Burning Imperial Blood
paragraphs: Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, out!
Ling Han summoned his pseudo-Imperial Weapon. If even a future Imperial Weapon couldn’t block his opponent’s attack, then he would have no choice but to accept it.
Weng!
The two powerful auras clashed. This was a clash between two Emperors.
However, Ling Han charged over unscathed. As the aura of Primal Chaos descended, he was like an invincible god of war.
No matter what, how could a replica that only had a sliver of the aura of an Imperial Weapon rival the Origin Gold?

What cultivation level was Ling Han at? The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was the most powerful tool of this level. Unless there was another Spirit Tool forged from Origin Gold, only would there be a match for it.
Unfortunately, the Jade Water Sword in Lin Qi’s hand was only an imitation.
Ling Han charged over. Zi, zi, zi! Lightning flashed madly, and shot towards Lin Qi.
How could Lin Qi possibly withstand this? Instantly, he was struck head-on. Pa, the Jade Water Sword in his hand bore the brunt of the attack, and instantly exploded.
In front of the Origin Gold, all tools would feel inferior. This was imperial might.
Lin Qi wore a blank expression. What was going on? This was a replica of an Imperial Weapon, so how could it be so weak?
In a moment of distraction, Ling Han’s fist also smashed over.
Peng! Lin Qi was instantly sent flying.

All of this happened in the blink of an eye. Everyone had yet to react, and the majority were still exclaiming at how awesome Lin Qi’s Tool was. They had not thought that in the blink of an eye, the battle had practically been decided.
As expected, it was only three seconds.
Without a Spirit Tool, would Lin Qi still be able to fight?

Lin Qi got to his feet. Under the barrage of lightning, a large portion of his clothes had been torn apart. Thankfully, his skin had also been charred by the lightning, so he did not have to worry about exposing himself.

His situation was slightly dire. Wounds covered his entire body. This was caused by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. The fact that he hadn’t been directly killed was already a sign of his strength.
He panted heavily, and looked at the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower with shock and suspicion. What kind of Spirit Tool was this? It was too terrifying, wasn’t it?
Ling Han put away the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and said calmly, “I won’t bully you either.”
Seeing this, everyone nodded internally.

Lin Qi drew out his Spirit Tool from the very beginning, clearly intending to depend on the might of the Jade Water Sword, but Ling Han’s Spirit Tool was clearly stronger than this, yet immediately withdrew and did not use it. The superiority was obvious.
-Ling Han already possessed the demeanor of an elite, because every elite walked the path of their own strength. Which one of them would depend on external factors?
Lin Qi glared hatefully at Ling Han. In full public, he had been defeated. This would be a humiliation that he could not wash away.
“You’ve angered me!” he said menacingly. At first, he was extremely wary of Ling Han’s tower-shaped Tool, but now that Ling Han actually put it away, he naturally had a chance of winning again.
He roared loudly, and the blood in his entire body boiled. There was also an indescribably powerful pressure exuding from him, as if even the stars in the skies had to submit in front of him.
This was because he had ignited his Imperial Blood. Though there was only a sliver, what kind of existence was a Great Emperor? Even if it was incredibly thin, it was still incredibly terrifying.
Lin Qi’s eyes were exuding white light, incredibly blazing. He looked coldly at Ling Han. That was a kind of indifference from a being of a higher level.
At this moment, Lin Qi was like a Great Emperor when he had been in the Cauldron Forging Tier. Who could stand against him?
Peng!
Lin Qi took a step out. It was clearly not heavy, but everyone felt as if their hearts had been harshly struck, and their faces had all turned pale.
Imperial Might.
Ling Han’s interest was finally piqued. The current Lin Qi seemed to have been possessed by a Great Emperor, and his battle prowess would undergo an earthshaking change.
The Great Emperor was invincible, but could a Cauldron Forging Tier do the same?

Ling Han didn’t believe this. This was because the Nine Suns Saint had even defeated Ancestral King Lingtian in the past. Thus, even the Great Emperor might not be invincible for the rest of his life. It could only be said that after achieving Dao, he would truly be peerless in the world.
Come, let’s battle.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and charged towards Lin Qi.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Lin Qi did not retreat in the slightest, and began exchanging blows with Ling Han. Various celestial techniques were used, and all of them were just right, indescribably amazing.

However, due to the limitation of his cultivation level, Lin Qi was unable to channel the Imperial Technique. At most, he could only unleash a burst of power, but this kind of burst of power naturally had to be left at the most crucial moment. It would either be used to achieve victory with a single strike, or to resolve a life-threatening danger.
The two of them battled fiercely, using their respective techniques to exchange blows. It was an extremely exciting battle.
“Lin Qi is burning his Imperial Blood, which is equivalent to transforming into a young Great
Emperor.”
“This battle prowess is really fierce.”
“But the problem is... Ling Han doesn’t have any Imperial Blood, but he can actually still
withstand it.”
“Hiss, being able to stand against a young Great Emperor, if this guy does not die, there is a possibility that he could become a Saint in future!”
Becoming a Saint!
This was an unattainable peak. Even among Imperial Clan elites, how many could reach the level of Saint Tier?
However, Ling Han was able to exchange blows with a Great Emperor when he was young. This kind of potential was really too astonishing, and that was why he had received such a
high evaluation. He had the potential to become a Saint.
“As long as Ling Han can hold on, the loser would definitely be Lin Qi.”
“En!”
Everyone nodded in agreement. Right now, Lin Qi wasn’t this powerful by himself. Instead, he

was relying on combusting his Imperial Blood The time that he could maintain this power was limited, and the cooldown period was also astonishingly long. Thus, he definitely wouldn’t be able to do this a second time.
Thus, as long as they fought a drawn-out battle, Ling Han would definitely win.

Lin Qi clearly knew this as well. He finally couldn’t hold himself back any longer, and with a sharp cry, he crossed his fingers in the air, forming a circle. Then, he aimed directly at Ling Han. Xiu, a flash of light blasted out, and instantly, everyone was blinded even if their eyes
were open, unable to see anything.
This was an Imperial Technique, and even he had only learnt one move.
However, an Imperial Technique was an Imperial Technique, which was invincible among its
peers!

Ling Han didn’t dare to be careless either. Right now, it was as if Lin Qi had been possessed by a Great Emperor, and he was no weaker than Ling Han, and had blasted out an Imperial Technique. He had to unleash his full strength.
“Go!”
He also channelled the Demonic Monkey Fists, and blasted out explosively. A Demonic Monkey that was exuding endless violence appeared, greeting that streak of light.
Peng!
Amidst a loud bang, multiple seals exploded. Brilliance surged, shooting madly into the skies, turning into a massive mushroom cloud.
Looking again at Ling Han and Lin Qi, they were both injured. The Imperial Techniques clashed, destroying each other, but still causing both of them to be injured.
Thankfully, their injuries were not heavy.
Without the slightest bit of hesitation, the two of them once again charged towards each
other.
Peng, peng, peng! The battle situation was incredibly intense, but without the explosive burst
of the Imperial Technique, neither of them could insta-kill the other, and continued to be in a
stalemate.
However, the battle did not last long, and Lin Qi’s aura fell drastically.
– His Imperial Blood had already been exhausted.
There was nothing more to say. Under Ling Han’s powerful attacks, Lin Qi was quickly
defeated.
Without a word, he left with his tail between his legs.
This was truly humiliating. Not only had his Spirit Tool been destroyed, but he had even used
the last resort of combusting his Imperial Blood. Yet, he had still suffered a crushing defeat.
How could he defend himself?

Meanwhile, Ling Han frowned slightly. This was only a clansman of the Imperial Clan, and he wasn’t the strongest heir yet. However, after combusting his Imperial Clan, he was actually able to fight him to a stalemate. There were so many Imperial Clans in the world, and if two or three of them joined forces, wouldn’t he be in a very passive position?
No, he had to become stronger!

chapters.title: Chapter 3844: Malicious Guest
paragraphs: Yet Ling Han was thinking too much.
Even for the Imperial Clan, the number of times they could combust their Imperial Blood in their lifetime was extremely limited.
-After the Imperial Blood was burnt, it would slowly recover, but it would become slower and slower, and in the end, there would be no more Imperial Blood left to burn.
Moreover, what was Lin Qi’s cultivation level?
It was Six Cauldrons now, and with the advantage of one cauldron, he still hadn’t defeated Ling Han. What did that mean?
Ling Han was even stronger than a young Great Emperor at the same cultivation level, even if it was just a little bit.
If Ling Han also had six cauldrons, then if he battled with Lin Qi, who was burning his Imperial Blood, would it still end in a tie?

After this battle, Ling Han’s status as the number one disciple of the younger generation was completely confirmed. Lin Qi had suffered a terrible defeat, so what about Gan Ping? He was sure that he would only be able to lose with grievances.
Gan Ping naturally wouldn’t admit this. However, he didn’t say anything else about how Ling Han could not withstand a single strike. He had accumulated some merit.

However, the main doors of Ling Han’s residence became even livelier. The male disciples all came over to cotton up to Ling Han, while the female disciples were all filled with tender affection, wanting nothing more than to use some medicine and forcefully bed Ling Han.
If Ling Han was a little more fickle, he could completely become a groom and sleep next to different beautiful disciples of the Holy Land every night.
However, he was naturally not that kind of person, so he could only tire himself out in parrying such exquisite beauties like Tan Meng and Jiang Yifei, which also made the others envious and jealous.

The following days became peaceful. Everyone made the most of their time to cultivate, while at the same time, they searched for the God Slaying Technique that the Nine Suns Saint had hidden somewhere, whether it existed or not. This was the true purpose of everyone entering into the Nine Suns Holy Land. Once they obtained the God Slaying Technique, they would be able to further obtain the Nine Suns Finger, and gain control of a colossal force. In future, they would have a Saint Tool in their hands when they fought with others. How domineering would that be?
To say anything major happened, it would be that Lin Qi had snatched back his identity as a Dao Child, causing a great many people to laugh their heads off.
Before they knew it, they had already entered the Holy Land for a year.
At this time, a great many people had arrived in front of the gates of the Holy Land, and were waiting for the Holy Land to once again open its gates, and recruit a second batch of disciples.
“Hurry up and go see a beauty!” someone posted on the Holy Land network. “A supreme beauty!”
No matter when, a beautiful woman would always be able to capture the eyes of others, and cause them to become excited.
Thus, quite a number of people went to watch the disciple recruitment this time round.
In the end, a heated discussion instantly broke out on the net.
“A great beauty has really come. In fact, she is even more beautiful than Celestial maiden Tan, Celestial maiden Jie,!”
“You’ve got to be kidding, Celestial Maiden Tan and the others are on the Exquisite Leaderboard!”
“Hehe, won’t you find out once you take a look for yourself?”

This attracted the curiosity of many people, and they all ran over to watch. In the end, those who went to watch all thought that this woman’s beauty was something that even Tan Meng and the other women could not compare to.
“That’s natural. Do you guys know who she is?” someone asked disdainfully.
“Who?”
“Ninth on the Exquisite Leaderboard, Song Lan!”
“What!”

When they found out the identity of this stunningly beautiful woman, everyone was stunned, but also felt that it was only natural. She was ranked ninth on the Exquisite Beauty Leaderboard, so she was naturally exquisitely beautiful.
“Hey, hey, hey, don’t have any delusions. How can you guys even think of touching the beauty who is ranked ninth on the Exquisite Leaderboard?”
“Can’t you even think about it?”
“Hey, do you guys know who Song Lan came with?”
“Who?”
“Lu Qi.”
Hiss!
At this moment, everyone was silent.
Who was Lu Qi?
Ranked nineteenth among Cauldron Forging Tiers in the Galaxy Network!

It should be known that if one managed to squeeze into the top hundred of the level rankings, there would be a considerable gap in strength between every ten or so people. Lu Qi was ranked nineteenth in Galaxy Network, which was who knew how many times stronger than
Gan Ping.
It was said that this person had already formed eight cauldrons.

The eight cauldrons that he had formed were completely different from the eight cauldrons that Xue Zhan had temporarily accumulated with the help of an elite. If the two of them were to battle, Lu Qi would probably be able to crush Xue Zhan with a single strike.
“No way, one of the top twenty in the Galaxy Network rankings would actually join the Holy
Land?”
“Hehe, because Lu Qi is presently courting Song Lan, since Song Lan is here, Lu Qi is naturally here as well.”
“Hehe, there’s going be a good show now,” someone said meaningfully.
Ling Han was presently the number one disciple of this generation, but after Lu Qi had come, the situation was different.
Would it be a battle between two mighty figures, or would Ling Han withdraw from the stage
dejectedly?
When Ling Han heard this, he only smiled faintly, and did not take it to heart.

Perhaps Lu Qi was indeed stronger than him now, but he was only in the late stage of Five Cauldrons. He only had to increase his cultivation level, and in a battle of equal cultivation levels, let’s see who would be able to defeat whom.
Furthermore, he had a great many trump cards. He had the Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and any one of them could kill any
Cauldron Forging Tier elite.

After a few days of examination, Lu Qi and Song Lan naturally entered into the Holy Land without a doubt. There were also other freakish characters in this batch, such as Su Wenbai and Ji Yuanbai. They were all ranked in the top 100 of the Galaxy Network, and in the area of beauties, there was actually another beauty on the Exquisite Leaderboard, Du Qingqing, who had also entered into the Holy Land, but because of Song Lan’s existence, she was naturally
much dimmer.
With the addition of this batch of disciples, the Holy Land was instantly bustling with noise and excitement.

The first and second batches of people naturally formed their own teams. Those who came first thought that they were seniors and were experienced, and those who came later were naturally dissatisfied. There were ten batches of disciples, so they naturally belonged to the same batch. Why had they become seniors just because they came a year earlier?
In addition, what did martial arts depend on?
Strength!
Thus, battles naturally broke out among the disciples of the two batches. Because the

numbers were equal, the abilities were more or less the same. They fought a few times, but did not manage to distinguish a clear advantage or disadvantage. In the end, it was the Law Enforcement Hall that stepped out and forbade this kind of large-scale group battle, or they
would be expelled.

Ling Han only wanted to cultivate quietly, and was in no mood to contend for first and second place. He paid absolutely no attention to the outside world. Even if the large black dog egged him on time and time again, he completely ignored it.
However, this was how things were sometimes. You didn’t cause trouble, but things would come knocking on your door.
Ling Han was concocting an alchemical pill when he heard a knock on the door.

If this was any other alchemist, this cauldron of pills would probably be considered useless after being disturbed like this. However, Ling Han was the Alchemy Emperor. Moreover, he had already refined the Cauldron Heart Pill countless times, so he could still control it even if he multitasked. He asked, “What is it?”
He was already a little angry. He had already instructed that he was not to be disturbed while
he was concocting alchemical pills.

“Master, a malicious guest has come. I have clearly already told him that you are presently concocting alchemical pills, and cannot see him, yet he broke the door. He even said that he would only wait three minutes, and after three minutes, he would barge in,” Mingyue said softly, looking a little aggrieved, but also showing a strong fury.
Ever since Ling Han was crowned as the strongest disciple, who would dare to be so rude? Ling Han continued to concoct alchemical pills, and said, “Ignore him.”
“Understood,” Mingyue replied with a nod.
Peng!
As expected, not long after, a loud bang was heard. That malicious guest must have gotten
impatient from waiting, and barged in forcefully.

Who was Lu Qi?
Ranked nineteenth among Cauldron Forging Tiers in the Galaxy Network!
It should be known that if one managed to squeeze into the top hundred of the level rankings, there would be a considerable gap in strength between every ten or so people.
Lu Qi was ranked nineteenth in Galaxy Network, which was who knew how many times stronger than
Gan Ping.
It was said that this person had already formed eight cauldrons.
The eight cauldrons that he had formed were completely different from the eight cauldrons that Xue Zhan had temporarily accumulated with the help of an elite.
If the two of them were to battle, Lu Qi would probably be able to crush Xue Zhan with a single strike.
“No way, one of the top twenty in the Galaxy Network rankings would actually join the Holy
Land?”
“Hehe, because Lu Qi is presently courting Song Lan, since Song Lan is here, Lu Qi is naturally here as well.”
“Hehe, there’s going be a good show now,” someone said meaningfully.
Ling Han was presently the number one disciple of this generation, but after Lu Qi had come, the situation was different.
Would it be a battle between two mighty figures, or would Ling Han withdraw from the stage
dejectedly?
When Ling Han heard this, he only smiled faintly, and did not take it to heart.
Perhaps Lu Qi was indeed stronger than him now, but he was only in the late stage of Five Cauldrons.
He only had to increase his cultivation level, and in a battle of equal cultivation levels, let’s see who would be able to defeat whom.
Furthermore, he had a great many trump cards.
He had the Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and any one of them could kill any
Cauldron Forging Tier elite.
After a few days of examination, Lu Qi and Song Lan naturally entered into the Holy Land without a doubt.
There were also other freakish characters in this batch, such as Su Wenbai and Ji Yuanbai.

They were all ranked in the top 100 of the Galaxy Network, and in the area of beauties, there was actually another beauty on the Exquisite Leaderboard, Du Qingqing, who had also entered into the Holy Land, but because of Song Lan’s existence, she was naturally
much dimmer.
With the addition of this batch of disciples, the Holy Land was instantly bustling with noise and excitement.
The first and second batches of people naturally formed their own teams.
Those who came first thought that they were seniors and were experienced, and those who came later were naturally dissatisfied.
There were ten batches of disciples, so they naturally belonged to the same batch.
Why had they become seniors just because they came a year earlier?
In addition, what did martial arts depend on?
Strength!
Thus, battles naturally broke out among the disciples of the two batches.
Because the
numbers were equal, the abilities were more or less the same.
They fought a few times, but did not manage to distinguish a clear advantage or disadvantage.
In the end, it was the Law Enforcement Hall that stepped out and forbade this kind of large-scale group battle, or they
would be expelled.
Ling Han only wanted to cultivate quietly, and was in no mood to contend for first and second place.
He paid absolutely no attention to the outside world.
Even if the large black dog egged him on time and time again, he completely ignored it.
However, this was how things were sometimes.
You didn’t cause trouble, but things would come knocking on your door.
Ling Han was concocting an alchemical pill when he heard a knock on the door.
If this was any other alchemist, this cauldron of pills would probably be considered useless after being disturbed like this.
However, Ling Han was the Alchemy Emperor.
Moreover, he had already refined the Cauldron Heart Pill countless times, so he could still control it even if he multitasked.
He asked, “What is it?”
He was already a little angry.
He had already instructed that he was not to be disturbed while
he was concocting alchemical pills.
“Master, a malicious guest has come.
I have clearly already told him that you are presently concocting alchemical pills, and cannot see him, yet he broke the door.
He even said that he would only wait three minutes, and after three minutes, he would barge in,” Mingyue said softly, looking a little aggrieved, but also showing a strong fury.
Ever since Ling Han was crowned as the strongest disciple, who would dare to be so rude?
Ling Han continued to concoct alchemical pills, and said, “Ignore him.”
“Understood,” Mingyue replied with a nod.
Peng!
As expected, not long after, a loud bang was heard.
That malicious guest must have gotten
impatient from waiting, and barged in forcefully.

chapters.title: Chapter 3845: Summoned by my Master
paragraphs: Ling Han continued to concoct alchemical pills, acting as if he had not heard anything.
If he stopped now, all his previous efforts would be wasted. He naturally wouldn’t waste a precious medicinal ingredient and the time that he had already spent.
Mingyue trembled. He had not stepped onto the Celestial Path yet, and Cauldron Forging Tier was like a god to him.
A terrifying aura approached, and soon, a man walked into the alchemy chamber.

This was a tall, broad-shouldered man. He was not very old, and looked to be less than thirty years old, while his eyes were burning with spirit. In fact, his gaze would cause one to feel a piercing pain.

“He, what arrogance. I, Zha Hu, have come to pay a visit, and you actually still dare to hide and not come out!” This man said coldly. His aura had turned into a blade that could be seen with the naked eye. Pu, pu, pu, marks had appeared on the walls and furniture of the room, showing his powerful strength.
Ling Han’s hands didn’t stop, and he said calmly, “You’re in the right to barge into my residence?”
“What is it? Can’t I barge in?” Zha Hu asked disdainfully.
Ling Han did not speak further, but rather focused on alchemy. Even if he was the Alchemy Emperor, he could not possibly be distracted all the time while concocting alchemical pills.
This kind of disregard caused Zha Hu to feel very hurt. What kind of existence was he? A mere alchemist actually dared to disregard him?
“Don’t think that you can look down on everyone just because you know how to concoct a few alchemical pills!” he said balefully.
He had heard of how Lin Qi had lost to Ling Han, but as he saw it, this was completely just a rumor. How could an alchemist have such high battle prowess?
What kind of joke was this?

It should be that someone was boot-licking Ling Han, and that was why they had deliberately fabricated such a story. After all, he was an existence that could concoct the Cauldron Heart Pill, and even his Master was very interested in Ling Han.
“Ling Han, my Master summons you, come with me quickly!” he called out loudly.
Ling Han chuckled, and said, “What does your master have to do with me? He wants to see me, so I have to go and see him?”
“My Master is Lu Qi!” Zha Hu declared proudly.
Lu Qi, ranked 19th on the Galaxy Network!
Tremble like a mortal, Zha Hu stared at Ling Han. A great many people would turn pale when they heard Lu Qi’s name, and be at a loss of what to do. He was sure that Ling Han was no exception.
However, he was disappointed.
Ling Han was as calm as could be, as if Lu Qi was no different from any random person.
Er, it must be that this brat only knew how to concoct alchemical pills, so he had absolutely no idea who Lu Qi was. That must be the case.
Zha Hu introduced, “My Master is the supreme prodigy ranked 19th in Cauldron Forging Tier on the Galaxy Network!”
Ling Han smiled and said, “I thought you were going to say that he is the number one on the Galaxy Network! Merely 19th, and he actually dares to show off!”
Zha Hu looked at Ling Han as if he was looking at an idiot.
Do you know what ranking 19th on the Galaxy Network means?
The 19th place in the entire universe, what kind of concept was that?
Sigh, he was really an alchemist. His head was filled with alchemy, and he had no concept of martial arts at all.
“Humph, my Master said that he wants to see you. Whether you’re willing or not, you have to come with me!” He had lost all patience, and moved directly, grabbing out at Ling Han.

Ling Han was presently concocting alchemical pills, so he naturally could not free himself. He was not concerned either. His figure moved, and dodged Zha Hu’s grab. Meanwhile, his movements did not stop. He continued to stimulate the energy of heaven and earth, and did not stop the process of concocting alchemical pills.
Yi?
Zha Hu’s attack missed, and he couldn’t help but reveal a hint of surprise.
He had actually missed?
Again.

He moved again, grabbing out at Ling Han. However, Ling Han’s steps were still the same. Ling Han calmly dodged his attack, and the process of concocting alchemical pills was still the same. It was not interrupted.
This caused Zha Hu to feel slightly embarrassed. He had been boasting for so long just now, but who would have thought that he would not be able to do anything to Ling Han at all?
He pulled himself together, and decided that he had to be more serious.
He pounced again. Shua, shua, shua! However, after a few times, he was still unable to touch a single corner of Ling Han’s clothes.
Zha Hu’s expression changed drastically. Looks like he had underestimated this alchemist.

He stopped, one hand in front and one behind. Three veined patterns appeared on his forehead. They were purple, red and blue respectively, exuding light. A vicious might also seeped out, as if he was not a human, but rather an incredibly fierce beast.
In truth, he was a Demonic Beast from the Tiger Race.
He charged out again, his hands turning into tiger claws, and a golden whip also grew from his back. That was his tail, and with a scissoring, its might was boundless.
However, it was still useless. Ling Han moved back and forth in such a small room, yet he was repeatedly unsuccessful.

Zha Hu couldn’t bear it any longer. This was practically a blatant humiliation. Just look, he was being attacked and was still concocting alchemical pills. What kind of contempt was this towards his opponent?
He roared loudly, and struck out with both palms. This time, he wasn’t aiming to grab Ling Han, but was instead sweeping out with a large-scale attack.
Ling Han frowned and blocked this attack. He activated the Starlight Screen and took the
attack head-on.
...Mingyue had long since run out.
Boom, as the attack surged past, energy surged, and this house was naturally razed to the
ground in an instant.
Thankfully, the alchemy cauldron wasn’t damaged, and the formation wasn’t affected.
Ling Han moved casually, and the lid of the alchemy cauldron flew out. Four crimson-gold alchemical pills flew out, and he grabbed them in his hand.
The pills were completed!
Ling Han put away the alchemical pills, then turned to look at Zha Hu, his eyes cold.
Even if Zha Hu was from the Tiger Race and had a murderous aura to begin with, when this
gaze swept over him, he still felt a chill rise up from the bottom of his heart, and actually felt
a fear that made him want to tremble.
“Heng, heng, now you know fear, right?” Yet he was still stubborn.
Ling Han sighed. Why were there always such idiots?
Xiu, with a flash, he had already appeared in front of Zha Hu.
So fast!
Zha Hu thought to himself. His hands hurriedly slapped forward instinctively, and at the same
time, his legs retreated.
However, how could he possibly be faster than Ling Han?
Pa, he was smacked onto the ground, feeling as if his head was about to explode.
How could he be so strong? Wasn’t this an alchemist? When did an alchemist also possess
such battle prowess?
Peng, peng, peng! He was pummeled, and Ling Han’s punches rained down. Each punch landed on his most painful spot, causing him to scream repeatedly.
This naturally attracted the attention of the surrounding people. Disciples gradually came over to watch the excitement.

Zha Hu felt humiliated. He roared in fury, “Ling Han, you insulting me is equivalent to insulting Lord Lu Qi. You have to think carefully, can you bear this kind of consequences!” Ling Han scoffed, “You should think carefully about what consequences you would have to
bear if you trifled with me.”
When everyone saw this, they all shook their heads.
How could it be that this idiot had not heard of the fierce legend of Ling Han?
In the past, even a Core Formation Tier elite had been forcefully refined by Ling Han. Even a
Sect Master elitehad not been able to force him to bow his head. How could he possibly be
afraid of anyone?
Even avoiding this kind of murderous god was not enough, and you actually took the initiative to trifle with him. If he did not beat you up, who would he beat?
Peng, peng, peng! Ling Han gave Zha Hu a good beating, beating him until he was almost out
of breath. Only then did he stop.
“Now, let us discuss the matter of your compensation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3846: Old Monster Liu
paragraphs: What, you still want compensation from me?
Zha Hu was a little dizzy. He had been beaten up, and was riddled with injuries. Who knew
how many bones in his body had been broken, or even shattered. Shouldn’t it be Ling Han who was compensating him?
“Firstly, it’s the main doors. I’ll give you a cheaper price. Just 100 Dao Stones.” Ling Han started to calculate.
Pu!
Zha Hu immediately raised his head and looked towards Ling Han. Are your doors made from Divine Metal; how could they be worth a hundred Dao Stones?
‘You’re deliberately extorting money.’
Pa, Ling Han slapped him across the face, and said balefully, “Do you have any objections?” Yes, but he did not dare to say.

Zha Hu lowered his head, thinking that no matter what Ling Han said now, he would no longer object. In any case, once he escaped, he would ignore this matter altogether. In the future, Lu Qi would naturally deal with Ling Han.
A mere alchemist like Ling Han actually dared to oppose his master; he was truly courting death.
“The house has also been destroyed by you.” Ling Han continued to calculate, “Let’s make it cheaper. I’ll price it at 900 Dao Stones, um, let’s make it a whole number, so let’s make it 1000.”
‘Motherf*cker! Is there any such thing as rounding up the numbers?’
Zha Hu wanted to retort, but when he saw Ling Han’s fierce gaze, he obediently shut his mouth.
“And there’s also that cauldron of alchemical pills of mine. It’s cheaper, so I’ll just count it as 100,000 Dao Stones,” Ling Han continued.
“Isn’t that cauldron of pills of yours undamaged?” Zha Hu could no longer bear it. This naturally still had to be debated.

Pa, Ling Han slapped him across the face, “With you charging over and attacking like this, what alchemist would not have their cauldron explode? It did not explode because of my own skill. I used my own skill to save the alchemical pills, so what does it have to do with you?”
Yi, that made a lot of sense. There was practically no way to refute that.
Actually, Zha Hu very much wanted to refute him. What kind of f****** alchemical pills did he concoct? One cauldron was actually worth a hundred thousand Dao Stones.
Extorting money, this was a blatant extortion of money.
He would endure it. In any case, when he escaped, he would not admit to anything.
“As for other furniture and whatnot, I won’t argue with you. Please pay 11,100 Dao Stones quickly.” Ling Han stretched out his hand.
Zha Hu shook his head, and replied, “I don’t have it.”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “It’s all right even if you don’t have any cash. I also accept transfer of Universe Coins.”
Zha Hu’s expression involuntarily darkened. ‘You’re really thoughtful.’
“I don’t have that much money,” he said weakly.
“You don’t!” Ling Han’s expression instantly changed. His smile disappeared, and peng, he threw a punch. “Think carefully about whether you have or not!”
One punch after another, under the endless barrage of blows, Zha Hu finally could not hold on any longer.
“Yes, I do!”
He connected to the Galaxy Network, then transferred money to Ling Han’s account. However, he only had 73,000 or so Universe Coins.
“I really only have this much,” he said, scowling miserably.
He was only a Cauldron Forging Tier, and he was Lu Qi’s subordinate at that, so how much savings could he have?
“Poor guy!” Ling Han thought for a moment, “It’s fine. I’ll ask your master for the rest.”
Zha Hu hurriedly lowered his head to hide the excitement on his face.
You want to ask Lu Qi for money?
Hahaha, wasn’t this just walking right into a trap?
Go on, hurry up and go.
“Scram!” Ling Han shot out a foot and sent Zha Hu flying. Then, he went to the Saint Palace to make his application. This house was damaged, so he naturally had to change to another one.
However, the Saint Palace had directly arranged an abode for him.
What difference did it have with an ordinary house?

There was a formation in the abode, which could extract the energy of heaven and earth to speed up cultivation. It also had protective effects. As long as the owner didn’t allow it, outsiders couldn’t barge in unless this person had the strength of a Sect Master.
Since there was such a good thing, why wasn’t it taken out earlier?

Because there was a limited number of such abodes, the Saint Palace had not yet decided who would be using them. However, Ling Han’s house was broken, so they took advantage of the situation and directly arranged an abode for him.
Being so generous, it must be because there was someone backing him up.

Ling Han immediately went to find Yan Dong, wanting to express his thanks. However, the result was slightly beyond his expectations, because the one who had really exerted great effort in this matter was actually Liu Sanjun.
-This Lord was very old in the Holy Land, and was close to the end of his lifespan. Thus, everyone had to give him some face.

Added with the fact that Ling Han was indeed freakish, being extremely prodigious in the three fields of martial arts, alchemy and formations, this kind of talent naturally had to be nurtured vigorously. Thus, the Saint Palace decided to simply do him a favour, allowing Ling Han to be the first to move into an abode.
Yi, had Liu Sanjun’s head been damaged because he had been too agitated?

“The way I see it, it should be Old Monster Liu that has developed a desire to cherish your talent,” Yan Dong said seriously. Previously, when Xue Zhan had been defeated, Liu Sanjun surprisingly did not make a move on him. At the time, he was already suspicious, and added with this matter, he was absolutely sure that Liu Sanjun indeed admired Ling Han very much. Moreover, people like Liu Sanjun were eccentric and prone to going to extremes. If they disliked someone, they would despise them immensely, but if they admired someone, they would also admire them immensely. For example, though Yan Dong also admired Ling Han, he would definitely not slam his hand on the table in public, and rage in front of a great many people, immediately supporting the motion of having Ling Han moveinto his abode.
This old man was quite interesting.
Ling Han decided to pay a visit to this great elite. He had done him such a huge favor, so no matter what, he should still go and thank him.
He took his leave from Yan Dong, then went to pay his respects to Liu Sanjun.
It had already been so long, so Liu Sanjun naturally had a new Dao Apprentice, who was only fifteen or sixteen years old.
However, when this young man saw Ling Han, his face instantly turned pale. As he retreated, he shouted, “Don’t kill me! Don’t kill me!”
Ling Han’s expression involuntarily darkened. ‘F*ck! Is this necessary?’
He had indeed killed Liu Sanjun’s Dao Apprentice, but it was not to the extent that he had developed a grudge against all of Liu Sanjun’s Dao Apprentices, and kill every single one he saw, right?
“Don’t worry, I won’t kill you,” Ling Han said.
Only then did the Dao Apprentice breathe a sigh of relief. However, he immediately asked
weakly, “Will you eat me?”
Where did this come from? Where did you f****** hear that from? Am I a man-eating
demon?
Ling Han sighed, “Don’t worry, I don’t eat humans either.”
“You’re not lying to me?” The Dao Apprentice was still worried.
Ling Han felt an urge to pummel someone. F***, who exactly was spreading rumors about him behind his back? When had he become a murderous demon, or a man-eating monster?
“No, I, am, not!” he said word by word.
Only then did the Dao Apprentice breathe a sigh of relief. He patted his chest and said, “Now I can rest easy.” After saying this, he turned around and headed up the mountain.
“Hey, hey, hey, don’t go,” Ling Han hurriedly called out.
The Dao Apprentice turned around, and his face instantly became pale again. “Are you still
going to eat me?”
“No, I have something to see Elder Liu about,” Ling Han said. He felt like he was about to go crazy. These words should have been said at the first instant.
“Oh, you have come to pay your respects to Elder Liu, and really have not come to eat me.”
The Dao Apprentice was even more at ease.
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, “Quickly go and make the report.”
He turned his head, not looking at this Dao Apprentice, fearing that he would not be able to
hold himself back from beating this guy up.
“Oh.” The Dao Apprentice finally turned around and went up the mountain, and did not start
another topic of conversation.
Not long after, a thought rang out in Ling Han’s mind, “Come.”
It was Liu Sanjun.
