“The house has also been destroyed by you.” Ling Han continued to calculate, “Let’s make it cheaper.
I’ll price it at 900 Dao Stones, um, let’s make it a whole number, so let’s make it 1000.”
‘Motherf*cker!
Is there any such thing as rounding up the numbers?’
Zha Hu wanted to retort, but when he saw Ling Han’s fierce gaze, he obediently shut his mouth.
“And there’s also that cauldron of alchemical pills of mine.
It’s cheaper, so I’ll just count it as 100,000 Dao Stones,” Ling Han continued.
“Isn’t that cauldron of pills of yours undamaged?” Zha Hu could no longer bear it.
This naturally still had to be debated.
Pa, Ling Han slapped him across the face, “With you charging over and attacking like this, what alchemist would not have their cauldron explode?
It did not explode because of my own skill.
I used my own skill to save the alchemical pills, so what does it have to do with you?”
Yi, that made a lot of sense.
There was practically no way to refute that.
Actually, Zha Hu very much wanted to refute him.
What kind of f****** alchemical pills did he concoct?
One cauldron was actually worth a hundred thousand Dao Stones.
Extorting money, this was a blatant extortion of money.
He would endure it.
In any case, when he escaped, he would not admit to anything.
“As for other furniture and whatnot, I won’t argue with you.
Please pay 11,100 Dao Stones quickly.” Ling Han stretched out his hand.
Zha Hu shook his head, and replied, “I don’t have it.”
Ling Han cracked a smile, “It’s all right even if you don’t have any cash.
I also accept transfer of Universe Coins.”
Zha Hu’s expression involuntarily darkened.
‘You’re really thoughtful.’
“I don’t have that much money,” he said weakly.
“You don’t!” Ling Han’s expression instantly changed.
His smile disappeared, and peng, he threw a punch.
“Think carefully about whether you have or not!”
One punch after another, under the endless barrage of blows, Zha Hu finally could not hold on any longer.
“Yes, I do!”
He connected to the Galaxy Network, then transferred money to Ling Han’s account.
However, he only had 73,000 or so Universe Coins.
“I really only have this much,” he said, scowling miserably.
He was only a Cauldron Forging Tier, and he was Lu Qi’s subordinate at that, so how much savings could he have?
“Poor guy!” Ling Han thought for a moment, “It’s fine.
I’ll ask your master for the rest.”
Zha Hu hurriedly lowered his head to hide the excitement on his face.
You want to ask Lu Qi for money?
Hahaha, wasn’t this just walking right into a trap?
Go on, hurry up and go.
“Scram!” Ling Han shot out a foot and sent Zha Hu flying.
Then, he went to the Saint Palace to make his application.
This house was damaged, so he naturally had to change to another one.
However, the Saint Palace had directly arranged an abode for him.
What difference did it have with an ordinary house?
There was a formation in the abode, which could extract the energy of heaven and earth to speed up cultivation.
It also had protective effects.
As long as the owner didn’t allow it, outsiders couldn’t barge in unless this person had the strength of a Sect Master.
Since there was such a good thing, why wasn’t it taken out earlier?
Because there was a limited number of such abodes, the Saint Palace had not yet decided who would be using them.
However, Ling Han’s house was broken, so they took advantage of the situation and directly arranged an abode for him.
Being so generous, it must be because there was someone backing him up.
Ling Han immediately went to find Yan Dong, wanting to express his thanks.
However, the result was slightly beyond his expectations, because the one who had really exerted great effort in this matter was actually Liu Sanjun.
-This Lord was very old in the Holy Land, and was close to the end of his lifespan.
Thus, everyone had to give him some face.

Added with the fact that Ling Han was indeed freakish, being extremely prodigious in the three fields of martial arts, alchemy and formations, this kind of talent naturally had to be nurtured vigorously.
Thus, the Saint Palace decided to simply do him a favour, allowing Ling Han to be the first to move into an abode.
Yi, had Liu Sanjun’s head been damaged because he had been too agitated?
“The way I see it, it should be Old Monster Liu that has developed a desire to cherish your talent,” Yan Dong said seriously.
Previously, when Xue Zhan had been defeated, Liu Sanjun surprisingly did not make a move on him.
At the time, he was already suspicious, and added with this matter, he was absolutely sure that Liu Sanjun indeed admired Ling Han very much.
Moreover, people like Liu Sanjun were eccentric and prone to going to extremes.
If they disliked someone, they would despise them immensely, but if they admired someone, they would also admire them immensely.

For example, though Yan Dong also admired Ling Han, he would definitely not slam his hand on the table in public, and rage in front of a great many people, immediately supporting the motion of having Ling Han moveinto his abode.
This old man was quite interesting.
Ling Han decided to pay a visit to this great elite.
He had done him such a huge favor, so no matter what, he should still go and thank him.
He took his leave from Yan Dong, then went to pay his respects to Liu Sanjun.
It had already been so long, so Liu Sanjun naturally had a new Dao Apprentice, who was only fifteen or sixteen years old.
However, when this young man saw Ling Han, his face instantly turned pale.
As he retreated, he shouted, “Don’t kill me!
Don’t kill me!”
Ling Han’s expression involuntarily darkened.
‘F*ck!
Is this necessary?’
He had indeed killed Liu Sanjun’s Dao Apprentice, but it was not to the extent that he had developed a grudge against all of Liu Sanjun’s Dao Apprentices, and kill every single one he saw, right?
“Don’t worry, I won’t kill you,” Ling Han said.
Only then did the Dao Apprentice breathe a sigh of relief.
However, he immediately asked
weakly, “Will you eat me?”
Where did this come from?
Where did you f****** hear that from?
Am I a man-eating
demon?
Ling Han sighed, “Don’t worry, I don’t eat humans either.”
“You’re not lying to me?” The Dao Apprentice was still worried.
Ling Han felt an urge to pummel someone.
F***, who exactly was spreading rumors about him behind his back?
When had he become a murderous demon, or a man-eating monster?
“No, I, am, not!” he said word by word.
Only then did the Dao Apprentice breathe a sigh of relief.
He patted his chest and said, “Now I can rest easy.” After saying this, he turned around and headed up the mountain.
“Hey, hey, hey, don’t go,” Ling Han hurriedly called out.
The Dao Apprentice turned around, and his face instantly became pale again.
“Are you still
going to eat me?”
“No, I have something to see Elder Liu about,” Ling Han said.
He felt like he was about to go crazy.
These words should have been said at the first instant.
“Oh, you have come to pay your respects to Elder Liu, and really have not come to eat me.”
The Dao Apprentice was even more at ease.
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, “Quickly go and make the report.”
He turned his head, not looking at this Dao Apprentice, fearing that he would not be able to
hold himself back from beating this guy up.
“Oh.” The Dao Apprentice finally turned around and went up the mountain, and did not start
another topic of conversation.
Not long after, a thought rang out in Ling Han’s mind, “Come.”
It was Liu Sanjun.

chapters.title: Chapter 3847: Admiration
paragraphs: Ling Han climbed the mountain.
There were some elders who lived in the Saint Palace, but there were also some elders who chose to live on the mountain for peace and quiet. Liu Sanjun was one of the latter.

Ling Han arrived at the summit, and saw that there was a thatched cottage on top. It did not take up much space, and could not be distinguished at all that this was the residence of a Sect Master elite.
“What are you doing here?” Liu Sanjun walked out of his rooms, “You want to kill my Dao Apprentice again?”
The Dao Apprentice from before was presently following behind him, and when he heard this, he couldn’t help but shrink his neck back, hiding behind Liu Sanjun.
F***, it was definitely this old geezer who had spread the rumor that he was a murderous demon and a man-eating monster.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. He glanced at the Dao Apprentice, scaring the latter so much that he hurriedly ducked his head back in, as if Ling Han’s gaze would kill him.
“Senior, I have come to express my gratitude to you.” He bowed with both hands.
Liu Sanjun said coldly, “So, you scared my Dao Apprentice to this extent?”
The Dao Apprentice hurriedly nodded his head. This was too terrifying.
Ling Han’s expression was extremely dark. Hadn’t all this been because you have deliberated defrauded me? Furthermore, this Dao Apprentice was really too cowardly, wasn’t he?
“How could that be? Senior, you have misunderstood,” he said with a smile.
He knew that Liu Sanjun should still be embarrassed, because Ling Han had indeed killed his Dao Apprentice. Even if he had changed his mind out of love for his talent, but what about his pride?
Hence, he had to treat Ling Han coldly and indifferently.

It was easy now that he knew this. Ling Han had been around the large black dog for a long time, and he had a smooth tongue. He was extremely good at pleasantries, and after saying a few good words, a smile slowly appeared on Liu Sanjun’s cold face.
This scared the Dao Apprentice out of his wits. If Liu Sanjun had been bewitched by Ling Han, what would he do?
Would he be steamed or braised?
Ling Han conversed with Liu Sanjun for a long time, and he also reacquainted himself with this elder.

That’s right. Liu Sanjun was indeed headstrong and conceited, and he was indeed protective of his own people. However, he was not a bad person by nature. Previously, he had trusted Xue Bingyuan too much, and always thought that the people around him would not deceive him.

Finally, the old geezer said to Ling Han that if he encountered any confusion during cultivation, he could come and find him at the first instant, and if he encountered any trouble, he could also come and find him.
Ling Han thanked him, then descended the mountain.
Unless he really encountered an opponent that he could not match, Ling Han could not possibly use this kind of relationship.
Moreover, if he went to seek out Liu Sanjun to resolve any trouble, would Liu Sanjun still admire him?
Ling Han went to his new abode. He took control of the formation core, and in future, only he himself would be able to control this abode.
The abode wasn’t big, and could only accommodate him and a Dao Apprentice. Thus, it was unrealistic to ask the empress and the others to share the benefits brought by the formations here.

Through the connection device, he informed everyone of his new accommodations. Instantly, not only did the empress and the others come, even Tan Meng, Jiang Yifei and the other seductive beauties also came over to offer their congratulations. Their voices were filled with affection, and their tender attacks were on again.
Just when they were enjoying themselves, an uninvited guest suddenly paid them a visit.

“Which one of you is Ling Han?” That was a young man in his early twenties. He was tall and slender, but did not look frail at all. He looked like a cheetah, ready to explode with terrifying power at any moment.
“What is it?” Ling Han asked.
“So you’re Ling Han,” the young man said with an arrogant smile. “You don’t have three arms or four legs either.”
These words were filled with a strong provocation.
Wu Qiyuan walked out, and rubbed his arms, “Are you asking for a beating?”
Xiu, that young man raced out, his speed astonishingly fast. In an instant, he had already arrived in front of Wu Qiyuan, and delivered a palm strike at his left shoulder.

This blow was too fast. Even Wu Qiyuan was not able to dodge, but this guy was born with a fondness for close-quarter combat, so did not panic in the slightest. He too shot out a punch at his opponent.
Peng, the two of them exchanged a blow, and both retreated.

The blow that Wu Qiyuan had sustained was slightly heavier, but because his physique was tough, he had dispersed more than half of the force. Thus, his injuries should be about the same as that young man’s.
The young man was slightly dissatisfied. It was clear that he had the upper hand, and had taken him off guard, yet he had still fought to the point that both sides were injured.

Only then did he withdraw his arrogance, and said, “My name is Cheng Bao, and I have come under the command of my Master, to have you-” he pointed at Ling Han, “—immediately go to my Master and beg for forgiveness. The deadline is one day. If you do not do as you are told, my Master would be very angry! Believe me, you definitely would not want to see my Master angry.”
“Who is your Master?” Yuwen Tian asked, though he already had an answer in his heart.
“Lu Qi!” Cheng Bao declared proudly.
Sure enough, it was the guy who ranked nineteenth in the Galaxy Network.
“Alright, that’s all I have to say. You’re on your own now.” Cheng Bao laughed loudly, then
strode off.
Arrogant, how truly arrogant.
“Ling Han!” Everyone looked towards Ling Han.

The opponent this time was too strong. Ranked nineteenth on Galaxy Network, and it was said that it had already formed eight Celestial Cauldrons. This kind of strength overwhelmed Xue Zhan by who knew how many times, and was much stronger than even Lin Qi. How was Ling Han going to stand against that?
“It’s fine. Counter soldiers with arms, and water with an earth weir.” Ling Han smiled calmly, and everyone was relieved.

“Why don’t we go over tonight and cripple that brat?” the large black dog suggested. Everyone’s expressions darkened. What kind of stupid idea was this? Did he really think that the great elites of the Holy Land were all useless?
However, this matter ended in an unexpected manner.
-Song Lan had stepped out, and interceded on Ling Han’s behalf with Lu Qi.
Now that the beauty had stepped out, Lu Qi naturally had to give her face, so he said that this matter would be temporarily put to an end.
It was not a resolved matter, but resolved for now. After all, wasn’t Lu Qi’s reputation worth anything? As for how long this would last for for, that would have to depend on Lu Qi’s mood.
Ling Han also found this strange. He clearly didn’t know this beautiful Song Lan, so why would she intercede on his behalf?
However, it was as if Song Lan had forgotten about this matter. She had only offered a casual word, and had not taken it to heart at all.
Temporarily, peace returned.

Everyone was searching for the whereabouts of the God Slaying Technique, but tens of millions of years had passed, and not a single person had managed to find it. How could they find it just by searching like this?

However, no one gave up. This was because the Nine Suns Saint was most likely the most powerful Saint in history. The Nine Suns Finger was incomparably powerful, and there were few that could rival it in the world. In that case, just how powerful would the God Slaying Technique that the Nine Suns Saint had painstakingly developed in his later years be? Even if it was only a legend, everyone would tirelessly search for it, unwilling to give up. “Ling Han, recently, the ancient abode of a Spirit Transformation True Lord has been discovered. Should we go and take a look?” Yuwen Tian came to find him.
“Oh?” Ling Han was slightly curious, and he asked, “Why are you interested?”

It wasn’t that he was arrogant, but the celestial technique that they had obtained in the Holy Land was at least on the level of Spirit Transformation True Lord. There was absolutely no need for them to explore the abode of a Spirit Transformation True Lord, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 3848: Spirit Transformation True Lord’s abode
paragraphs: “The abode of a normal Spirit Transformation True Lord is certainly not worth exploring. However, this one is different.” Yuwen Tian shook his head. “Because this Spirit Transformation True Lord is also a great alchemist, Earth Tier High Grade alchemist!”
Only then did Ling Han give an ‘oh’, revealing an interested expression.
“What is it? Are you tempted?” Yuwen Tian asked, smiling.
“En, indeed.” Ling Han nodded. He was naturally not interested in alchemical pills, but in pill recipes.

Even if he was willing to spend money, he could not possibly buy all the pill recipes on the Galaxy Network, because there were some alchemical pills that were not difficult to concoct, and the demand for them was great. Thus, the pill recipes had become treasures, and would definitely not be leaked out.
This was profit.
Thus, Ling Han wanted more pill recipes, and finding the abode of this kind of ancient Grandmaster Alchemist should be a very good solution.

“The Spirit Transformation True Lord is called Sun Quan, and he’s been dead for almost 3000 years,” Yuwen Tian said. “Sigh, it’s been too long, and most of the pills have probably already deteriorated. They can’t be taken anymore.”
“Where did you get the information?” Ling Han asked.
“The Galaxy Network has people who specialize in selling this kind of information,” Yuwen Tian said. “We have to hurry. If we’re late, we won’t be able to get anything.”
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.

When it came to this kind of thing, it was the time when friendship would be shown. Yuwen Tian went to call Wu Qiyuan over. After some thought, he also called Huang Lingyun and Mu Long over. Because the empress, the large black dog, and the others were presently breaking through to the crucial stage of Cauldron Forging Tier, Ling Han did not call them over.
The group of five set out, heading towards Sun Quan’s ancient abode.

This Sun Quan was actually quite famous. Though he was only an Earth Tier High Grade alchemist, he had mastered a few pill recipes that had long since been lost. Thus, the alchemical pills he concocted were very popular. No matter where he went, he would be treated as an esteemed guest. However, he had never taken a disciple in his whole life, so after his death, those pill recipes were once again lost.
If their group could find those lost pill recipes, they would naturally make a killing.

They naturally had never thought of earning money from pill recipes, because Ling Han knew how to concoct alchemical pills. Thus, they naturally would hide those pill recipes away, so that they could maximize their profits.
Of course, the prerequisite was that they could obtain the pill recipes.

The information on Sun Quan’s abode was already on sale on the Galaxy Network, so there should be quite a number of people who would go there to try their luck. In fact, there might even be elites of Core Formation Tier and True Self Tier among them. Thus, whether Ling Han and his group would be able to gain anything was another matter.
Thus, time was extremely precious now.

This ancient abode wasn’t located on the Nine Suns Planet. Instead, it was located on a nearby planet. Of course, this “not far” was in terms of interstellar units. If one flew over physically, they would need at least a few dozen years.
Thankfully, there was a Transfer Formation that could reach it directly.
After the five of them handed over the Dao Stones, there was a flash of light, and they had appeared on another planet.

This planet was completely dark blue, not because there was a wide ocean, but because there was a kind of dark blue plant growing everywhere, covering the entire planet. Thus, if one looked at it from the galaxy, this planet would appear the colour of the ocean.

After exiting the Transfer Formation, they immediately discovered the commotion here. Weng, weng, weng! The Transfer Formation was constantly glowing, and practically every moment, there would be people coming over. Afterwards, to prevent the Transfer Formation from being overused and breaking down, the person-in-charge here had no choice but to shut down the Transfer Formation, so that the formation foundations could “rest” for a while.
Hiss, these people should have come for Sun Quan’s abode.

Ling Han activated his eye technique to take a look, and couldn’t help but feel apprehensive. Among them, there was no shortage of elites of Core Formation Tier. Once he encountered such competitors, unless he had set up the Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation in advance, Ling Han would need to use the Heavenly Dao Flames inside the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
“Let’s go.”
The five of them hurriedly set out. With their speed, they only used half a day’s time to arrive at Sun Quan’s abode.

This was hidden within a mountain, and had originally been protected by formations. However, Sun Quan had died three thousand years ago, and the power of heaven and earth was also slowly changing. Thus, the formation gradually lost its effect, allowing this ancient abode to appear in front of the world.

It could be clearly seen that the words “Sun Manor” were written on the doors of the abode. Combined with the information that Sun Quan had indeed lived on this planet in his later years, it was reasonable to conclude that this was Sun Quan’s abode.
However, no one was entering at this moment.

That was because there were a total of two parts to the formation that guarded the Sun Residence. One part was an illusory formation, which was already ineffective, but the other part was the defensive formation. The moment anyone broke in, the formation would immediately attack. It was extremely fierce, and even a Core Formation Tier cultivator would not be able to withstand it.
At present, no True Self Tier elites had arrived, and there was no way to forcibly break through the formation, so they could only ask a Formation Master for help.
“Ling Han, you’re a Formation Master, right?” Yuwen Tian asked.
Ling Han knew what he meant, and nodded, “I’ll break the formation.”
He circled around the mountain, and soon had some ideas.
“How is it?” When they saw him return, the four of them asked.
“Follow me.”
Ling Han was just about to begin breaking the formation, but he had just inserted the first formation foundations, when someone flew over, and shouted harshly, “What are you guys
doing?”
What was he doing? Wasn’t it obvious?
Yuwen Tian humphed, and said, “Of course, to break the formation. Otherwise, what else
could it be?”
“No!” That person was very rude and unreasonable. “The Formation Master that we invited hasn’t arrived yet, so you’re not allowed to break the formation!”
F***, what kind of reason was that?
Ling Han and the others were all angered. You guys are too overbearing, aren’t you?
“Yuan Zhong, what’s going on?” A middle-aged man walked over.
The person from before hurriedly bowed, and said, “Ninth Uncle, they want to break through
the formation!”
“Oh!” The middle-aged man swept his gaze over. “Our Cao Clan arrived first, so we’ll break the formation first. You guys have no objections, right?”
It would be strange if there was no disagreement!
Wu Qiyuan was enraged, and wanted to charge out to fight. His mind was the simplest, and could not be bothered to think too much. There was only one word for it: fight.
Ling Han pulled him back, and said calmly, “Of course not.”
Hearing Ling Han say so, Yuwen Tian and the others all shut up.
“That’s good.” The middle-aged man nodded, then seemed to ask very casually, “You guys
are from the Nine Suns Holy Land, right?”
“That’s right,” Ling Han said.
“Go on.” The middle-aged man waved his hand.
Ling Han and the others retreated.
“F*ck! This is far too displeasing! The Cao Clan is far too arrogant!” Yuwen Tian couldn’t help
but curse.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “That person just now already harbored killing intent toward us. However, he deduced that we might be from the Nine Suns Holy Land, and that we might have a connecting device on us that could communicate with the network of the Holy Land at any time. Thus, he confirmed it and gave up on the idea.”
“So ruthless?” Huang Lingyun was surprised.
“That is a Core Formation Tier; he does indeed have the possibility of insta-killing us,” Ling
Han said slowly. This was also the reason why he had given in. Otherwise, he would have to summon the Heavenly Dao Flames.
Yuwen Tian and the others were all filled with lingering fear. Even though they could all
possibly reach the level of Sect Master in future, at present, any Core Formation Tier would be
able to easily take their lives.
Just now, they had just passed in front of the gates of hell.

sentences.text: “The abode of a normal Spirit Transformation True Lord is certainly not worth exploring.
However, this one is different.” Yuwen Tian shook his head.
“Because this Spirit Transformation True Lord is also a great alchemist, Earth Tier High Grade alchemist!”
Only then did Ling Han give an ‘oh’, revealing an interested expression.
“What is it?
Are you tempted?” Yuwen Tian asked, smiling.
“En, indeed.” Ling Han nodded.
He was naturally not interested in alchemical pills, but in pill recipes.

Even if he was willing to spend money, he could not possibly buy all the pill recipes on the Galaxy Network, because there were some alchemical pills that were not difficult to concoct, and the demand for them was great.
Thus, the pill recipes had become treasures, and would definitely not be leaked out.
This was profit.
Thus, Ling Han wanted more pill recipes, and finding the abode of this kind of ancient Grandmaster Alchemist should be a very good solution.
“The Spirit Transformation True Lord is called Sun Quan, and he’s been dead for almost 3000 years,” Yuwen Tian said.
“Sigh, it’s been too long, and most of the pills have probably already deteriorated.
They can’t be taken anymore.”
“Where did you get the information?” Ling Han asked.
“The Galaxy Network has people who specialize in selling this kind of information,” Yuwen Tian said.
“We have to hurry.
If we’re late, we won’t be able to get anything.”
“All right.” Ling Han nodded.
When it came to this kind of thing, it was the time when friendship would be shown.
Yuwen Tian went to call Wu Qiyuan over.
After some thought, he also called Huang Lingyun and Mu Long over.
Because the empress, the large black dog, and the others were presently breaking through to the crucial stage of Cauldron Forging Tier, Ling Han did not call them over.
The group of five set out, heading towards Sun Quan’s ancient abode.
This Sun Quan was actually quite famous.
Though he was only an Earth Tier High Grade alchemist, he had mastered a few pill recipes that had long since been lost.
Thus, the alchemical pills he concocted were very popular.
No matter where he went, he would be treated as an esteemed guest.
However, he had never taken a disciple in his whole life, so after his death, those pill recipes were once again lost.
If their group could find those lost pill recipes, they would naturally make a killing.
They naturally had never thought of earning money from pill recipes, because Ling Han knew how to concoct alchemical pills.
Thus, they naturally would hide those pill recipes away, so that they could maximize their profits.
Of course, the prerequisite was that they could obtain the pill recipes.
The information on Sun Quan’s abode was already on sale on the Galaxy Network, so there should be quite a number of people who would go there to try their luck.
In fact, there might even be elites of Core Formation Tier and True Self Tier among them.
Thus, whether Ling Han and his group would be able to gain anything was another matter.
Thus, time was extremely precious now.
This ancient abode wasn’t located on the Nine Suns Planet.
Instead, it was located on a nearby planet.
Of course, this “not far” was in terms of interstellar units.
If one flew over physically, they would need at least a few dozen years.
Thankfully, there was a Transfer Formation that could reach it directly.
After the five of them handed over the Dao Stones, there was a flash of light, and they had appeared on another planet.
This planet was completely dark blue, not because there was a wide ocean, but because there was a kind of dark blue plant growing everywhere, covering the entire planet.
Thus, if one looked at it from the galaxy, this planet would appear the colour of the ocean.
After exiting the Transfer Formation, they immediately discovered the commotion here.
Weng, weng, weng!
The Transfer Formation was constantly glowing, and practically every moment, there would be people coming over.

Afterwards, to prevent the Transfer Formation from being overused and breaking down, the person-in-charge here had no choice but to shut down the Transfer Formation, so that the formation foundations could “rest” for a while.
Hiss, these people should have come for Sun Quan’s abode.
Ling Han activated his eye technique to take a look, and couldn’t help but feel apprehensive.
Among them, there was no shortage of elites of Core Formation Tier.

Once he encountered such competitors, unless he had set up the Three Elements Treasure Bottle Formation in advance, Ling Han would need to use the Heavenly Dao Flames inside the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
“Let’s go.”
The five of them hurriedly set out.
With their speed, they only used half a day’s time to arrive at Sun Quan’s abode.
This was hidden within a mountain, and had originally been protected by formations.
However, Sun Quan had died three thousand years ago, and the power of heaven and earth was also slowly changing.
Thus, the formation gradually lost its effect, allowing this ancient abode to appear in front of the world.
It could be clearly seen that the words “Sun Manor” were written on the doors of the abode.
Combined with the information that Sun Quan had indeed lived on this planet in his later years, it was reasonable to conclude that this was Sun Quan’s abode.
However, no one was entering at this moment.
That was because there were a total of two parts to the formation that guarded the Sun Residence.
One part was an illusory formation, which was already ineffective, but the other part was the defensive formation.
The moment anyone broke in, the formation would immediately attack.
It was extremely fierce, and even a Core Formation Tier cultivator would not be able to withstand it.
At present, no True Self Tier elites had arrived, and there was no way to forcibly break through the formation, so they could only ask a Formation Master for help.
“Ling Han, you’re a Formation Master, right?” Yuwen Tian asked.
Ling Han knew what he meant, and nodded, “I’ll break the formation.”
He circled around the mountain, and soon had some ideas.
“How is it?” When they saw him return, the four of them asked.
“Follow me.”

doing?”
What was he doing?
Wasn’t it obvious?
Yuwen Tian humphed, and said, “Of course, to break the formation.
Otherwise, what else
could it be?”
“No!” That person was very rude and unreasonable.
“The Formation Master that we invited hasn’t arrived yet, so you’re not allowed to break the formation!”
F***, what kind of reason was that?
Ling Han and the others were all angered.
You guys are too overbearing, aren’t you?

chapters.title: Chapter 3849: Counterattack
paragraphs: “So ruthless?” Yuwen Tian jumped up.
Yet Wu Qiyuan nodded, “I can sense that guy’s killing intent.”
No one would doubt Wu Qiyuan’s sensory ability. This was a man with child-like innocence, and also a person who had grown up among wild beasts, so he was the most sensitive about killing intent.
“In other words, if we hadn’t come from the Holy Land, we would have been killed just then?” Huang Lingyun hissed.
The five of them watched the two members of the Cao Clan leave, their eyes filled with fury.

Ancient sites had no owner, so everyone could explore them. Moreover, they hadn’t even entered yet, so they couldn’t be considered competitors at all. Yet, they were already filled with killing intent.
How ruthless.

“We’ll wait and see,” Ling Han said calmly, appearing neither angry nor shocked. If the other party had really made a move just now, he would have directly released the Heavenly Dao Flames to see who was stronger.
It wasn’t long before the Formation Master that the Cao Clan had hired arrived and began to break the formation.
This Formation Master’s skill was not too bad. Very soon, he had some ideas, and slowly advanced.

After he had advanced a certain distance, he called for the members of the Cao Clan to follow him. If he wanted to break through the formation, his skill was still slightly inferior, but just finding a safe route was much simpler.
“How infuriating, having them leave first.” Yuwen Tian slapped his thigh, appearing very defiant.
Yet Ling Han smiled and said, “It’s not that simple. Prepare for battle.”
“Yi, what did you see?” Yuwen Tianwen asked.
“They won’t be able to pass,” Ling Han said very confidently. At present, he was also an elite Formation Master, and could tell the level of Formation Master with a single glance.

-If he was given enough time, that person should be able to find a safe path, but he was too confident. Previously, he had still carefully probed, but after grasping a few nodes, he thought that he had figured everything out, and led his people in. This had planted hidden dangers. As long as there was the slightest mistake, it would cause a calamity.
Ling Han believed that this scene would soon play out.

As expected, only ten minutes had passed, and a panicked shout suddenly erupted from the group of people from the Cao Clan. A brilliant light flashed past. Boom, violent energy exploded, as if a supreme elite was making a move.
The formation had been activated.
This was a formation that could kill cultivators at the Core Formation Tier. Now that it was activated, the members of the Cao Clan instantly suffered great misfortune.

It was only the first wave of attack, and half of the members of the Cao Clan had already been killed. Meanwhile, the three group leaders in Core Formation Tier began to hurriedly retreat with the remaining cultivators.

However, in their rush, they had already lost their composure, and were unable to completely follow the steps that they had taken previously. Now, great, the formation had been activated again, and the killing intent returned.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Light exploded madly, incredibly terrifying.
In the end, only three people from the Cao Clan managed to escape. Even the three Core Formation Tier elites were severely wounded.

At first, they had wanted to protect a few of their clansmen, but in the end, they could only give up on this idea helplessly. That was because even protecting themselves was difficult, and they still wanted to bring people out? They would only be trapped inside.
Ling Han’s eyes turned cold. Xiu, he charged out.
‘Huh? You’re not planning to snipe these three Core Formation Tier cultivators, are you?’
“Ling Han, don’t be rash. Although they’ve been severely wounded, they’re still at the Core Formation Tier, after all!” Yuwen Tian hurriedly advised. However, Wu Qiyuan roared and followed him.
“F***!” he cursed, and hurriedly followed after him.
Huang Lingyun and Mu Long exchanged a glance before breaking into a run as well.
Seeing Ling Han approach aggressively, the three Core Formation cultivators from the Cao Clan all smirked coldly. Did he think that they could be taken advantage of just because they were injured?
“Brat, are you trying to take advantage of the situation?” the middle-aged man who had chased Ling Han away said. However, before he could even finish his words, he had already launched an attack.
As for the demeanor of a senior? That was all empty words.

His present injuries were extremely severe. Even if he could still kill Cauldron Forging Tiers, his injuries would be compounded. Thus, he naturally didn’t want to continue the battle, and wanted to kill his opponent at the first instant.
Ling Han wasn’t surprised at all. Some people had no principles at all.
He unleashed the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and unleashed a burst of Primal Chaos Qi above his head. Lightning then surged toward the middle-aged man from the Cao
Clan.

Peng, the attack of the middle-aged man from the Cao Clan landed on the Primal Chaos Qi, just barely penetrating through it. However, Ling Han still had the protection of the Starlight Screen, which completely dispersed this attack. Meanwhile, lightning blasted out, causing the middle-aged man to let out a terrible scream. He was already riddled with injuries in the first place, and now the wound was even larger, looking extremely terrible.

This result was too unexpected. No matter how injured a Core Formation Tier cultivator was, he was still a Core Formation Tier cultivator, so how could he be injured by a Cauldron Formation Tier cultivator?

“Detestable brat!” The middle-aged man gritted his teeth. Being hit by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, his injuries were compounded. Not only was he in great pain, but his abilities were also weakened by 30%.
And this was still because he was a Core Formation Tier cultivator. Otherwise, if it was a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, he probably wouldn’t have the ability to stand after taking a
hit head-on.
Hong long long, Wu Qiyuan had already charged over. Like a wild bear, he crashed towards the
middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man almost went mad with fury. What was wrong with the Cauldron Forging Tier juniors now? Did they really think that he was an easy target to bully?
He gave a loud shout, and shot out an attack at Wu Qiyuan.
Ling Han believed that Wu Qiyuan should be able to deal with the middle-aged man. After all,

he had been severely wounded, and had even been struck by Ling Han’s Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. His battle prowess should have fallen to five to six cauldrons at most, and after more than a year, Wu Qiyuan had also reached the peak stage of Four Cauldrons, so he should be able to put up a fight.
He set his eyes on the other two, not giving them the chance to provide reinforcements.
“Die!”
The two of them didn’t waste their breath, immediately summoning their Spirit Tool. One wielded a spear, while the other wielded a saber, blasting towards Ling Han.
They already knew that Ling Han’s strength was extremely strong, and could not be measured in terms of ordinary Cauldron Forging Tier.

Ling Han was calm and composed. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower hovered above his head, emanating streams of Primal Chaos Qi. This should be the strongest defense of Cauldron Forging Tier, and added with the fact that there was the Starlight Screen behind it, and the fact that he was wearing a Battle Armor, this defense could be considered adequate.
He charged forward, battling two Core Formation Tier cultivators on his own.
If this spread out, it would definitely shock people to the point of numbness.
A Cauldron Forging Tier was actually capable of matching two Core Formation Tier elites?

It could not be helped. Who asked the two of them to be severely injured? Though their situation was better than the first, they only had battle prowess of Eight Cauldrons, at most. This was still no problem for Ling Han.

The great battle was fierce, and Ling Han didn’t dare to be careless. A starving camel was still bigger than a horse. Core Formation Tiers must have grasped some secret technique, and once it exploded, it could possibly be extremely terrifying.
“You’re seeking death!” A Core Formation Tier cultivator released his own aura. This was the best method to deal with low-level cultivators.
However, this was completely ineffective against Ling Han. Instead, they were struck by Ling Han’s murderous aura, causing both of them to be slightly stifled.
At this time, Yuwen Tian and the others also rushed over.
“The three of you, deal with one of them. You only have to hold him back,” Ling Han said. He
created an opening for the three of them to deal with one of his opponents, while he battled a middle-aged man in green alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 3850: Killing Core Formation Tier
paragraphs: Five Cauldron Forging Tiers versus three Core Formation Tiers.

Under normal circumstances, this would be a joke. There was no need for there to be three Core Formation Tiers. Merely the intervention of a Core Formation Tier martial artist would be able to instantly eliminate five Cauldron Forging Tiers. In fact, a Core Formation Tier would be able to kill 50 or even 500 Cauldron Forging Tiers. However, the present situation was unique. The three Core Formation Tiers were all heavily injured, and there was only 1% of their strength remaining. In fact, there was even less. In that case, it was a different story.

Even so, among the three Core Formation Tiers, there were still two people who had the upper hand. Aside from Ling Han who could still resist, in the other two battles, it was the Core Formation Tier that had the upper hand.
Thankfully, Yuwen Tian and the others could still hold on for the moment.
This was Core Formation Tier, after all. Even if it was a dragon swimming in shallow waters, it was still incredibly fierce.
Ling Han knew that he had to turn the situation around.
He gave a loud shout and activated the Demonic Monkey Fists.
Weng, a frightening aura spread out. He was like a young Great Emperor, possessing a supreme bearing.
“What?!” His opponent paled in shock. This was only a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, so how could he give him a feeling of weakness and felt that he could not rival him?
Boom!
Right at this moment, Ling Han had already thrown a punch. Endless energy condensed on his fist, concentrated on a single point of explosive power.
The middle-aged man in green wanted to dodge, but Ling Han’s murderous aura attack caused him to pause slightly, and he instantly missed the best opportunity to dodge.
Left with no choice, he could only return the favor.
Peng!
In an exchange of blows, that Core Formation Tier cultivator was instantly sent flying, his whole person spurting out a fountain of blood, but what was shocking was that he actually didn’t die.
‘F*ck! A Core Formation Tier cultivator is so hard to kill?’
Ling Han forcefully suppressed the burning sensation in his chest, and once again charged over.

“Han Long!” The other two members of the Cao Clan exclaimed in shock. They hurriedly charged over to help, yet they were tightly held back by Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian. However, they had also paid a great price for this, and the injuries on their bodies had become slightly heavier.
Core Formation Tiers that had gone berserk were too terrifying.
On the other side, Ling Han had already caught up to the man in green. He threw another punch, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower also shot out lightning, wanting to kill this man by force.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

The man in green parried, but he had taken a blow from the Demonic Monkey Fists. This was an Imperial Technique, so how could it not cause injury on top of injury? Furthermore, with Ling Han’s ferocious barrage of blows, it was naturally more and more unbearable for him. Every time he took a punch, he would spit out a mouthful of blood, and there were even pieces of his internal organs.
He took more than a hundred punches, and finally reached the point of exhaustion. With a bang, his whole person suddenly exploded.
Ling Han was neither happy nor angry. He turned around and stared at the remaining two Core Formation Tiers.
The two members of the Cao Clan were both terrified by his gaze. A Core Formation Tier clansman had already been beaten to burst by Ling Han, so how could they be spared?

No, they had to break out of the siege immediately. Their injuries were too severe that they could not even suppress a few Cauldron Forging Tiers, but as long as they stabilized their injuries, and they didn’t even need to heal completely. Then wouldn’t killing a Cauldron Forging Tier be child’s play?
“Let’s go!”
The two of them were just about to break out of the siege, but Wu Qiyuan and the others also began to fight with their lives on the line, clinging tightly onto the two of them.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and charged back.

The two members of the Cao Clan were extremely regretful. If they had known earlier, they wouldn’t have cared if they were from the Nine Suns Holy Land or not. If they had encountered them, they should have killed them. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have had such bad
luck.
Obviously, they still did not have the slightest intention to reflect on their actions.

Ling Han once again used the Three Styles of the God of War. This was a Saint Technique, and though it was not the most exquisite ultimate move, after three consecutive moves, that Core Formation Tier cultivator from the Cao Clan was naturally severely wounded, and his battle prowess dropped even further.
And now, it was again Ling Han who was battling alone, while Wu Qiyuan, Yuwen Tian and the others were battling against the other Core Formation Tier from the Cao Clan.
The scales of victory were already completely leaning towards Ling Han’s side. Whether it was Ling Han, Wu Qiyuan and the others, they were all firmly on the upper hand.
“Come, let’s see who can end the battle first,” Ling Han said.
“All right!”
Wu Qiyuan and the others all replied. How could it be that even if the four of them joined forces, they would still be no match for Ling Han?
Kill, kill, kill!
Meanwhile, the two members of the Cao Clan were about to explode in fury. They were Core Formation Tier elites, yet now they had actually become props in a competition between
Cauldron Forging Tiers?
How could they accept this!
“Humph!” The two Core Formation Tier cultivators both released their own auras,
suppressing on the spiritual level.

As expected, Wu Qiyuan and the others were instantly affected, and it was clear that they were much weaker in their attacks. However, Ling Han was completely unaffected, and was still blasting out blows fiercely. In fact, the barrage of murderous aura from him could even slightly affect the Core Formation Tier cultivators.
The two Core Formation Tier elites gritted their teeth. How could it be that they had no other way?

Most importantly, in the process of charging out of the formation, they had already expended all their rare treasures and techniques. Now, even if they wanted to put their lives on the line, they did not have any trump cards that they could use.
Could it be that it was really going to die at the hands of a few Cauldron Forging Tiers?
They were defiant.
“I’ll give it my all!” the two great Core Formation Tier elites roared furiously, breaking through with all their might.
They completely ignored the attacks, and were completely focused on breaking out of the
siege.

“Ah!” Ling Han’s opponent screamed in agony. With a bang, he collapsed onto the ground. -Ling Han’s strength was not suppressed by the aura of Core Formation Tier, and he actually dared to ignore Ling Han’s attack; wasn’t that just courting death?

However, the other member of the Cao Clan finally charged out. He turned around to look at his two companions on the ground, and then swept his gaze over Ling Han and the others. He remembered all five of them. When he recovered, he would definitely charge back and take the
lives of these five people.
Then, he turned his head, and was just about to run with all his might.
But in an instant, he was drenched in cold sweat.
That was because there was a person standing in front of him.
Ling Han!
How was this possible? How could this guy’s speed be so fast?
Ling Han did not make a sound, and simply shot out a punch.
The Core Formation Tier cultivator hurriedly parried. Peng! After receiving a single punch, he
was forced into a continuous retreat.

This person was precisely the one who had exchanged blows with Ling Han at the beginning. He had long since been severely wounded by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Now, he was fighting head-on with Ling Han, so how could he possibly be a match?
After a consecutive dozen over punches, he was beaten to burst.

“Haha, Ling Han, we won,” Yuwen Tian said with a smile, pointing at the second Core Formation Tier cultivator from the Cao Clan that had been killed by the four of them. -He had been knocked down by Ling Han, so Yuwen Tian and the others took advantage of
the opening to move, and take his life.
Ling Han smiled in reply. He naturally wouldn’t say anything about their cheap tricks.
Cauldron Forging Tiers faced a Core Formation Tier elite head-on. None of these four people fell behind, which made him very happy.
The friendship between them naturally deepened further.
“Come, let’s rake in our spoils.”
They searched the corpses of three Core Formation Tier cultivators. However, the treasures on
those three people had all been expended in the formation. Perhaps they still had some
savings, but it must have been on the Galaxy Network account.
“Now, I’m beginning to dislike Galaxy Network,” Yuwen Tian sighed.
“I agree.” The others nodded as well.
They had painstakingly killed three Core Formation Tier cultivators, yet their gains were only
a few Dao Stones. How could this not be depressing?
Furthermore, aside from Ling Han, Wu Qiyuan and the others had all sustained considerable
injuries.
“Let’s recover first, then we’ll enter the abode to rest,” Ling Han said.
Wu Qiyuan and the others didn’t try to be brave. They accepted the healing alchemical pills
and began to recover.
Half a day later, they all leaped up. Though they had not recovered to their prime condition, it
no longer affected their movements.
They had to hurry up, or more and more people would come.
Ling Han was just about to begin breaking through the formation. Xiu! Several figures
streaked past in the sky. Other people had arrived.

sentences.text: Five Cauldron Forging Tiers versus three Core Formation Tiers.
Under normal circumstances, this would be a joke.
There was no need for there to be three Core Formation Tiers.
Merely the intervention of a Core Formation Tier martial artist would be able to instantly eliminate five Cauldron Forging Tiers.
In fact, a Core Formation Tier would be able to kill 50 or even 500 Cauldron Forging Tiers.
However, the present situation was unique.
The three Core Formation Tiers were all heavily injured, and there was only 1% of their strength remaining.
In fact, there was even less.
In that case, it was a different story.
Even so, among the three Core Formation Tiers, there were still two people who had the upper hand.
Aside from Ling Han who could still resist, in the other two battles, it was the Core Formation Tier that had the upper hand.
Thankfully, Yuwen Tian and the others could still hold on for the moment.
This was Core Formation Tier, after all.
Even if it was a dragon swimming in shallow waters, it was still incredibly fierce.
Ling Han knew that he had to turn the situation around.
He gave a loud shout and activated the Demonic Monkey Fists.
Weng, a frightening aura spread out.
He was like a young Great Emperor, possessing a supreme bearing.
“What?!” His opponent paled in shock.
This was only a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator, so how could he give him a feeling of weakness and felt that he could not rival him?
Boom!
Right at this moment, Ling Han had already thrown a punch.
Endless energy condensed on his fist, concentrated on a single point of explosive power.
The middle-aged man in green wanted to dodge, but Ling Han’s murderous aura attack caused him to pause slightly, and he instantly missed the best opportunity to dodge.
Left with no choice, he could only return the favor.
Peng!
In an exchange of blows, that Core Formation Tier cultivator was instantly sent flying, his whole person spurting out a fountain of blood, but what was shocking was that he actually didn’t die.
‘F*ck!
A Core Formation Tier cultivator is so hard to kill?’
Ling Han forcefully suppressed the burning sensation in his chest, and once again charged over.
“Han Long!” The other two members of the Cao Clan exclaimed in shock.
They hurriedly charged over to help, yet they were tightly held back by Wu Qiyuan and Yuwen Tian.
However, they had also paid a great price for this, and the injuries on their bodies had become slightly heavier.
Core Formation Tiers that had gone berserk were too terrifying.
On the other side, Ling Han had already caught up to the man in green.
He threw another punch, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower also shot out lightning, wanting to kill this man by force.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
The man in green parried, but he had taken a blow from the Demonic Monkey Fists.
This was an Imperial Technique, so how could it not cause injury on top of injury?
Furthermore, with Ling Han’s ferocious barrage of blows, it was naturally more and more unbearable for him.
Every time he took a punch, he would spit out a mouthful of blood, and there were even pieces of his internal organs.
He took more than a hundred punches, and finally reached the point of exhaustion.
With a bang, his whole person suddenly exploded.
Ling Han was neither happy nor angry.
He turned around and stared at the remaining two Core Formation Tiers.
The two members of the Cao Clan were both terrified by his gaze.
A Core Formation Tier clansman had already been beaten to burst by Ling Han, so how could they be spared?
No, they had to break out of the siege immediately.
Their injuries were too severe that they could not even suppress a few Cauldron Forging Tiers, but as long as they stabilized their injuries, and they didn’t even need to heal completely.
Then wouldn’t killing a Cauldron Forging Tier be child’s play?
“Let’s go!”
The two of them were just about to break out of the siege, but Wu Qiyuan and the others also began to fight with their lives on the line, clinging tightly onto the two of them.
